en:
This champion race car won 12 out of 20 races in the super-competitive DTM race series.

The 155 2.5 V6 TI was Alfa Romeo’s answer to the increasingly advanced Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM), which, by 1993, allowed significant car modifications. Based on the 1992 155 sedan, it featured a 60-degree 2.5-liter V-6 powerplant producing 414.2 HP and a full-time 4-wheel-drive system. The car won 12 of 20 rounds and secured the championship.
zh:
在20场高性能DTM赛事中赢得12个冠军的真正冠军车。

155 2.5 V6 TI由Alfa Romeo开发，用于参加自1993年起允许深度改装的德国房车大师赛。该车是在92款四门155轿车基础上改装而成，采用动力输出为420 PS的2.5升60度V6引擎以及全时四驱系统。它在总共参加的20场比赛中创下辉煌记录，赢得了12场冠军。

en:
This front-engine/rear-wheel-drive specialty car was given a different character to its sister car, the Silvia.

The 180SX arrived in March 1989 as the liftback variant of the S13 Silvia. Initially set to end production alongside the S13, it was given new life as demand continued abroad. The U.S.-market 240SX, powered by a 2.4-liter engine, remained popular, prompting Nissan to decouple the 180SX from the Silvia lineage. The 180SX became a favorite among enthusiasts who personalized it to suit their tastes and style.
zh:
这款前置后驱特殊车型被赋予了与其姐妹车Silvia完全不同的特征。

1989年3月，180SX作为S13代Silvia的掀背版本推出。按照原计划，它将在Silvia全面改款时与S13一同结束生产。然而，搭载2.4升引擎的美版240SX持续热销，促使Nissan将其从Silvia产品线中独立出来继续生产。改装爱好者尤为喜爱180SX，催生出风格迥异的个性化改装车型。

en:
Born from touring racing, the ultimate evolution of the 190E.

Mercedes-Benz entered DTM with the 190 E 2.3-16 back in 1986. In 1990, it pushed development further with the 190 E 2.5-16 Evolution II. Its wide, muscular fenders gave the car a sporty flair, matched by a 2.5-liter engine tuned to 231.8 HP. Limited to 500 units, it delivered strong performances during the 1992 DTM season.
zh:
自房车赛而生的190 E终极进化型号。

Mercedes-Benz自1986年起开始用190 E 2.3-16参加德国房车大师赛。1990年Mercedes-Benz推出终极车型190 E 2.5-16 Evolution II。外扩的轮拱格外显眼，与新调校后可输出动力为235 PS的引擎相得益彰。该车限量生产500台，并在1992年德国房车大师赛赛事中取得了非凡战绩。

en:
Considered to be Japan's first supercar, this special car possessed originality in both style and mechanics.

Unveiled in 1967, the Toyota 2000GT blended engineering excellence with timeless design, instantly capturing the hearts of sports car enthusiasts. It made its mark on the track as well, setting a world record at 136.7 mph on the Yatabe test course. Global fame followed when it appeared as James Bond’s car in "You Only Live Twice."
zh:
日本汽车史上的梦幻车型，造型和机械技术都充满创意。

1967年首次亮相的Toyota 2000GT是许多人的梦想之车，其设计、工程构造和性能均超乎当时汽车爱好者的期待。该车还在赛道上斩获无数胜利，并且在谷田部测试赛道上跑出了220 公里/小时的速度，创下了世界纪录。此车在全球声名鹊起，甚至在电影《雷霆谷》中作为邦德的座驾登上了银幕。

en:
This compact SUV showcases Peugeot design cues throughout.

The Peugeot 2008 was introduced in 2013. This featured 2008 SUV is a second-generation model. It was built on the same platform as Peugeot’s 208 hatchback. The lighting elements featured motifs inspired by a lion’s claws and fangs. One of the most notable features of this compact SUV was the 3D i-Cockpit, which included a small-diameter steering wheel with flattened top and bottom sections, paired with a head-up digital instrument cluster positioned above it for optimal driver visibility.
zh:
这款紧凑型SUV处处展现Peugeot的设计风格

Peugeot 2008于2013年推出。展示的这台2008 SUV为该系列的第二代车型。它采用与Peugeot“208”掀背车相同的开发平台。灯具设计融入了狮子爪牙的元素。这款紧凑型SUV的另一个显著特点是“3D i-Cockpit”，由上下扁平的小直径方向盘和位于其上方中央的抬头数字仪表盘组成。

en:
A masterpiece hot hatch from France that became a rally legend.

Peugeot introduced the 205 GTI as a spirited road-going counterpart to its 205 Turbo 16 WRC car. Its compact frame and punchy 1.6-liter SOHC engine delivered a thrilling, well-rounded driving experience. More than 300,000 units of this French masterpiece sold across Europe, securing its place in the pantheon of 1980s and 1990s car-culture history.
zh:
一款来自法国的高性能掀背车杰作，也是拉力赛领域的传奇。

205 GTI是Peugeot以参加过世界拉力锦标赛的“205 Turbo 16”为蓝本打造的运动版车型。轻量紧凑的车身搭载强劲的1.6升顶置单凸轮轴引擎，成就了性能上的全面飞跃。这件法国汽车工程杰作仅在欧洲单地便售出超30万辆，是上世纪80至90年代汽车史不可或缺的篇章。

en:
This 4-wheel-drive pocket rocket took the Group B racing world by storm.

The 205 Turbo 16 itself was Peugeot’s Group B contender for the World Rally Championship. It won three rallies in its 1984 debut and repeated the feat in 1985. Peugeot evolved the car with more power, less weight, and better aerodynamics to produce the Evolution 2. The updated version captured 7 of 12 victories in 1985 and 6 of 13 in 1986, taking both the drivers' and manufacturers' titles.
zh:
这辆四驱中置引擎怪兽横扫了B组别的各项赛事。

205 Turbo 16是Peugeot为世界拉力锦标赛打造的一款B组别赛车。该车在1984首秀年便赢得3场赛事，并在接下来的1985年再夺3冠。Peugeot通过对重量、动力与空气动力学效应的优化进一步开发出Evolution 2车型。新车型在1985年12场赛事中7次折桂，并在1986年的13场比赛中再夺6冠，蝉联车手和车厂双料冠军。

en:
An exciting hot hatch with a distinctive French character.

Peugeot’s 208 GTi continued the tradition, based on the popular 208 compact hatch. Smaller than its predecessor, the 207, it shed more than 220 lbs thanks to a redesigned structure and materials. Its 142.9 mph top speed and 0–62.1 mph acceleration time of 6.8 seconds placed it among the top-tier hot hatches.
zh:
轻盈、小巧、有趣、快速。时髦而现实的紧凑型跑车。

208 GTi是Peugeot的主打紧凑车型208的运动款。它的车身比前代207更小，全车构造和材料上的全面革新使得整车重量减轻超过100 公斤。230 公里/小时的最高时速和6.8秒的0-100 公里/小时加速时间让这台车跻身性能掀背车的前列。

en:
A historic model that epitomized the station wagon.

The Volvo 240 Estate became synonymous with the Swedish brand's image as a station wagon maker. Its boxy shape and long profile became design signatures that made the vehicle popular to all. Inside, it offered a minimalist Scandinavian interior with plush, sofa-like seating. Its production run ended in 1993, but the 240 remains a beloved classic, still seen in daily use, a rarity among vintage cars.
zh:
这款拥有特殊历史意义的车型让全世界对旅行车爱不释手。

240 Estate这台车是奠定了Volvo旅行车制造商形象的经典之作。其最大魅力在于棱角分明的方正造型与修长的车身比例。其余亮点包括简约独特的北欧风格内饰及柔软如沙发的座椅。尽管已停产多年，这台车仍被许多人珍视为日常座驾，这在经典车型中实属罕见。

en:
A predecessor to the 250 GTO, this car racked up numerous wins in the world of endurance racing.

Ferrari shortened the wheelbase of the 250 GT Berlinetta for sharper track handling. That change bore fruit with numerous race victories starting in 1960, including wins at the Tour de France and Nürburgring 621.4 miles. Just 162 units were built before its successor, the iconic 250 GTO, took over in 1962.
zh:
250 GTO的前辈，赢得无数耐力赛奖项。

250 GT Berlinetta比前代车型更短的轴距让其在赛道上拥有更优异的过弯性能。这些改进成效显著。从1960年起，这台车在环法汽车赛、纽博格林1000公里耐力赛等赛事中斩获无数胜利。到1962年这款车总共只生产了162辆，在那之后由250 GTO传承其衣钵。

en:
This ultra-popular car was built to win the GT Class International Championship title. 

Back then, the line between road and race cars was thin, and the 250 GT Berlinetta embodied both worlds. The "GTO" name marked its homologation for GT racing. A tubular steel chassis supported the aluminum bodywork, optimizing both weight and rigidity. Its 3.0-liter V-12, fed by six carburetors, produced 295.9 HP. The right-hand-drive model developed for the UK performed admirably, often finishing on the podium.
zh:
为赢得GT组别国际锦标赛而打造的超高人气车型。

直到20世纪60年代初，赛车和公路车之间的界限十分模糊。而这款车正是那个时代的经典。车名中的“GTO”表明这是一台GT赛事认证车型。车架为钢管结构，车身为全铝制。3升V12引擎配备6个化油器，马力高达300 PS。为英国市场生产的右舵型号在英国各地的赛事中多次登上领奖台。

en:
At first glance, this monster car appears to be an offshoot model, but it's 100% custom-built on the inside, and produces over 394 horsepower. 

To qualify for Group B, Ferrari built 200 examples of this homologation special. Although it looked like the 308, it featured a longer wheelbase by 4.3 inches and a longitudinally mounted engine, making it mechanically distinct. The twin-turbocharged 2.8-liter V-8 delivered 394.5 HP, making it the fastest road-going Ferrari at the time.
zh:
乍一看仿佛偏离了原旨，实则100%精心打造。一台怪物级的车，马力达到400 PS。

为了满足B组别赛事规则，这款认证车型一共生产了200台。它的造型与308GTB几乎别无二致，但轴距实际上增加了110毫米，引擎改为纵向安装，意味着内部构造完全不同。2.8升双涡轮增压引擎带来高达400 PS的马力，让其成为当时最快的Ferrari。

en:
This elegant GT3 machine is also known as the "Racing Queen."

Derived from the 296 GTB, the 296 GT3 was a purebred race machine that shed the plug-in hybrid system of the road car, relying solely on a 600-horsepower twin-turbocharged V-6 engine. Built by world-renowned constructor Oreca, the car was crafted with meticulous precision—from chassis construction and assembly to customer support. After its debut at the 24 Hours of Spa in July 2022, it quickly demonstrated its exceptional racing prowess, achieving 100 victories in less than two years.
zh:
一款被誉为“赛道女王”的优雅GT3赛车。

作为基于296 GTB开发的GT3赛车，296 GT3摒弃了公路版车型的插电混动系统，仅搭载可输出600匹马力的V6双涡轮增压引擎，成为了一辆纯种赛车。该车由世界级赛车制造商Oreca打造，其业务涵盖从底盘制造、整车组装到客户服务。该车于2022年7月首次在斯帕24小时耐力赛亮相，随后在不到两年的时间里赢得了100场比赛，展示了其高性能的赛车能力。

en:
Here's a mid-engine sports car with a revolutionary V-6 + PHEV system.

The 296 GTB itself was a plug-in hybrid and the first Ferrari to feature a V-6 engine since the iconic Dino series. The smallest member of Ferrari’s current lineup, its beautifully sculpted body paid homage to the 250 LM of the 1960s. Power came from a mid-mounted twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine paired with a 123 kW electric motor, producing a combined output of 830 horsepower. Capable of accelerating from 0-62.1 mph in just 2.9 seconds and reaching 205.1 mph at full stride, the 296 GTB delivered the breathtaking performance worthy of the Ferrari name.
zh:
采用革命性V6+PHEV系统的中置引擎跑车。

296 GTB是一款插电式混合动力跑车，同时配备了自Dino系列以来首款V6引擎。经典风格的车身设计致敬1960年代的经典车型250 LM，同时也是当前Ferrari产品线中最小的车型。该车采用中置布局搭载3升V6双涡轮增压引擎，结合123千瓦电机，系统综合输出功率达830马力。该车仅需2.9秒即可完成0-100 公里/小时加速，最高速度能达到330 公里/小时，性能当之无愧于Ferrari之名。

en:
This legendary race car put AMG on the map after its class victory at the 1971 24 Hours of Spa.

Mercedes-AMG created this touring car in its early years. The 300 SEL 6.3 was already quick, but AMG bored the engine out to 6.8 liters and re-tuned it, raising output from 246.5 HP to 422.1 HP. At the 1971 24 Hours of Spa, it took 1st in class and 2nd overall—an early showcase of AMG’s racing pedigree.
zh:
这辆传奇赛车在1971年斯帕24小时耐力赛中赢得了所在组别的冠军，打响了AMG的名声。

这台房车由早期的Mercedes-AMG打造。300 SEL 6.3本身已是性能强劲的车型，但在将引擎扩容至6.8升及额外的调校之后，它的动力输出从250 PS大幅提升至428 PS。这台车在1971年斯帕24小时耐力赛赢得分组冠军，总成绩排名第2，充分展现了AMG在赛车领域的潜力。

en:
With its gullwing doors and other advanced technologies, the 1954 Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupe was a car way ahead of its time.

Daimler-Benz revealed the Mercedes-Benz 300 SL at the 1955 New York Auto Show. While its 161.6 mph top speed was impressive, its roof-hinged "gullwing" doors made it unforgettable, which allowed the car's doors to open upward. Only 1,400 gullwing Coupés were built from 1955 to 1957 before the model evolved into the 300 SL Roadster.
zh:
一台领先时代的鸥翼双门轿车，许多现代跑车的鼻祖。

Daimler-Benz在1955年的纽约车展上公布了Mercedes-Benz300 SL。真正夺目吸睛的不是这台车拥有的260 公里/小时惊人极速，而是铰接于车顶中央、向上开启的“鸥翼门”。1955至1957年间，300 SL“鸥翼”双门跑车共生产1400台，随后交棒300 SL Roadster。

en:
The car that brought Mercedes-Benz its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The 300 SL race car, known inhouse as W194, used a tubular frame with aluminum body panels, paired with modified mechanicals from the W186 300. The car’s debut at the 1952 24 Hours of Le Mans resulted in a landmark win for Mercedes-Benz. That success sparked public demand, ultimately leading to the production of the 300 SL road car.
zh:
这款车为Mercedes-Benz带来了勒芒24小时耐力赛有史以来的首胜。

开发代号为W194的300 SL赛车采用了管状车架底盘和铝制板件，搭载来自W186 300的改进版引擎和传动系统。该车在1952年勒芒24小时耐力赛上首次亮相，即为Mercedes-Benz取得胜利。其优异的赛道表现催生了大量对量产车型的呼声，进而推动了公路版车款的研发。

en:
This successor to the Ferrari Dino 246 GT features a V-8 mounted amidships.

Introduced in 1975, the 308 GTB replaced the Dino 246 GT and launched Ferrari’s long-running series of V-8-powered two-seaters. Its elegant body, laid over a steel-tube frame, was designed by Leonardo Fioravanti of Pininfarina, the mind behind many of Ferrari’s most celebrated shapes from the 1960s through the early 1990s.
zh:
这款Dino 246 GT的继任者采用中置布局，容纳一台V8引擎。

1975年亮相的308 GTB接替Dino 246 GT，开启了经久不衰的双座V8车型风潮。管状车架之上覆盖的优雅车身出自Pininfarina的列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂之手，他在1960年代末至1990年代初设计了一系列Ferrari车型。

en:
This V12-powered P Series race car was known as "the most beautiful machine ever."

The 330 P4 was Ferrari’s answer to the dominance of the Ford GT. Although only four units were ever made, a berlinetta version for high-speed tracks and a roofless spider for reduced weight were produced. It won its debut race at the 24 Hours of Daytona. While Ford ultimately triumphed at Le Mans, Ferrari secured the World Sportscar Championship title.
zh:
采用V12引擎的P系列车型中最美丽的一款。

330 P4诞生的目的是为了击败当时风头正盛的Ford GT。尽管总共仅生产了4台，但依旧分出了针对高速赛道的berlinetta版本和为减重而移除车顶的spider版本。它在戴通纳24小时耐力赛中首秀即夺冠。虽然Ford在勒芒获胜，但Ferrari随后就还以颜色，赢得了世界跑车锦标赛。

en:
A semi-race equipped model of the 356A, one of the cars that contributed to the Porsche mystique.

Launched in 1949, the 356 A was a refined successor to Porsche’s first production model, the 356. Two variants were offered, both using a detuned version of the 550 Spyder’s engine. The 1500 GS Carrera road-going version produced 98.6 HP, while the semi-competition 1500 GS GT delivered 108.5 HP. This model also introduced the "Carrera" name—now synonymous with Porsche performance.
zh:
356A的半赛事车型，该车使Porsche闻名于世。

1949年推出的356 A是Porsche首款量产车型356的改进版。356A有两个版本，所搭载的引擎均来自550 Spyder，但性能经过下调。公路车1500 GS Carrera能输出100 PS，半赛车1500 GS GT则能输出110 PS。这款车更是首次启用了Porsche如今标志性的“Carrera”子车型命名。

carNameEn: Porsche 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster '56
en:
With the introduction of this model, Porsche became known as a maker of the world's finest sports cars. 

Porsche’s first mass-produced sports car made its debut in 1949. From 1955 to 1959, these models were referred to as the 356 A, using an engine derived from the 550 Spyder. The semi-competition 1500 GS GT Carrera, producing 108.5 HP, marked the beginning of the Carrera legacy.
zh:
让保时捷成为知名跑车制造商的历史车型。

Porsche的首款量产跑车，首次亮相于1949年。于1955年至1959年间发布的车型被统称为356 A，采用的引擎基于550 Spyder。定位为半赛车的1500 GS GT Carrera版本可输出110 PS的动力，是首款冠以“Carrera”之名的车。

en:
The ultimate super sport, this front engine, rear-wheel drive machine rivaled the Miura for the highest top speed of its day. 

The 365 GTB/4—aka Daytona—was the last Ferrari to have a front-mounted V-12 and made its debut at the 1968 Paris Motor Show. It wore sleek bodywork penned by Leonardo Fioravanti, with a 4390 cc DOHC V-12 powerplant residing underneath. With a top speed of 174 mph, it matched the Lamborghini Miura as the fastest production car of its time.
zh:
最最顶级的前置后驱超级跑车，与对手Miura争夺最高速度的极致。

作为Ferrari最后一款搭载前置12缸引擎的车型，365 GTB/4（又名“Daytona”）于1968年巴黎车展首次亮相。列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂设计的流线性车身下，隐藏着一台4,390 立方厘米的双顶置凸轮轴V12引擎。其最高时速可达280 公里/小时，与竞争对手Lamborghini Miura并列成为当时最快的车。

en:
A road-going racer that greatly improved upon the performance of the F430.

Revealed at the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show in September, the Ferrari 430 Scuderia reflected the brand’s Formula 1 expertise. Compared to the base F430, it featured enhanced aerodynamics, weight reduction, and more power. The result was a 0–62.1 mph sprint in just 3.6 seconds and a top speed of 198.8 mph.
zh:
对F430的性能进行大幅改进的合法上路车。

430 Scuderia于2007年9月在法兰克福车展上亮相，是Ferrari在F1上的技术经验的集大成之作，也是其史上最快的V8 Berlinetta。相较于基础款F430，它的引擎经过了深度调校，车重更轻，空气动力学表面得到了优化。最终造就了它令人咋舌的320 公里/小时最高速度和3.6秒的0-100 公里/小时加速。

en:
With an astonishing 562.1 HP under the hood, this V8 mid-engine machine took its heritage from the F430.

The 458 Italia, introduced at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show, succeeded the F430. Built on a new aluminum space frame, it housed a 4499 cc V-8 producing 562.1 HP and 398.5 ft-lb of torque. The upgraded Manettino system allowed seamless control of engine, transmission, and suspension settings. With F1-derived aero design, it hit 0–62.1 mph in 3.4 seconds and topped out at 201.9 mph.
zh:
这款V8中置引擎车型拥有高达570 PS的惊人马力，是F430的后继车款。

这款车型于2009年在法兰克福车展上公布，是F430的继任者。底盘采用全新铝制空间框架，并搭载4,499 立方厘米V8引擎，马力达570 PS，扭矩则为55.1 公斤力米。整合了引擎、变速箱和悬挂等系统的“Manettino”系统也得到了大幅改进。运用源自F1赛车的空气动力学技术，该车的0-100 公里/小时加速时间仅为3.4秒，最高时速达325 公里/小时。

en:
This car, which generates more downforce than any Ferrari before it, won the FIA-GT European Championship title.

The 458 Italia GT3 was a regulation-compliant race version of the road-going 458. It featured a lower front bumper functioning as an air dam and a prominent rear wing. Although the engine remained the same, a restrictor limited output to 542.4 HP. Making its debut in 2011, it immediately made its mark by winning the FIA GT3 European Championship.
zh:
史上下压力最强的Ferrari车型，FIA-GT欧洲锦标赛冠军得主。

458 Italia GT3是基于458 Italia开发的满足GT3规格的赛车。前保险杠位置进一步压低来充当气坝，同时还增设了一个大尾翼。尽管与公路车型使用的是相同的动力单元，但由于安装了限流器，动力被限制在550 PS。该车在2011年首次亮相，并在同年夺得FIA-GT3欧洲锦标赛冠军。

en:
With an astonishing 562.1 HP under the hood, this mid-engine V-8-powered machine drew its inspiration from the F430.

The 458 Gr.4 is a Gran Turismo Original entry-level race model in Ferrari’s lineup. While its aero-package was subtle, the base car’s downforce and handling remains intact. Combined with the Ferrari V-8 and 7-speed gearbox, it offers strong performance on the circuit.
zh:
这款V8中置引擎车型拥有高达570 PS的惊人马力，是F430的后继车款。

这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅赛车，符合Gr.4组别规则。其原型458 Italia是Ferrari产品线的入门级车型。基础款已能产生充足的下压力，因此尽管可见的空力部件相对较少，该车的行驶状态仍极为稳定。搭配灵活的Ferrari V8引擎和7档变速箱，它在赛道上潜力无穷。

en:
The glorious Prancing Horse that returned Ferrari to the top category and delivered victory at Le Mans after a 50-year absence.

The Ferrari 499P was a prototype developed for the Le Mans Hypercar (LMH) category. Its advanced hybrid all-wheel-drive system combined a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine with a front-mounted MGU to produce a total output of 500kW. Upon Ferrari’s return to Le Mans in 2023, the car went up against a field of its strongest rivals and came out on top, securing overall victory. This would mark Ferrari’s first victory at Le Mans in 58 years.
zh:
一匹承载荣耀的奔马，不仅带领品牌重返顶级赛事，更在阔别50年后，再次在勒芒赛场上夺得胜利。

Ferrari 499P是一款为“勒芒终级跑车”（LMH）组别打造的原型赛车。这款先进全轮驱动赛车的混合动力系统由一台3.0升V6双涡轮增压引擎和一台前置电机发电单元（MGU）组成，总输出功率达500 kW。2023年，Ferrari重返勒芒赛场，与一众劲敌展开激烈角逐，最终脱颖而出，拿下了全场冠军。这是Ferrari 58年来在勒芒赛场上的首场胜利。

en:
The world's first hatchback found great success through utilitarian design.

The Renault 4 (Quatre), introduced in 1961, was designed to replace the best-selling 4CV. By 1978, the car reached its full potential with the GTL variant. This model added a plastic grille, a more powerful 1.1-liter engine, and a modernized instrument panel. Amassing more than 8.1 million units by the end of its production in 1992, the Renault 4 became a French cultural icon. It was a car for the people, a symbol of practical, efficient design from France.
zh:
世界上第一款通过多功能、多用途设计取得巨大成功的掀背车型。

Renault 4（Quatre）于1961年推出，用以取代Renault的畅销车型4CV。这款现代掀背车鼻祖在1978款GTL上将性能发挥到极致。这款车型新增塑料前格栅和强大的1.1升引擎，以及现代化仪表盘。Renault 4获得巨大拥趸，截至1992年总计生产了约813万5000辆。作为一台国民之车，它是法国汽车设计的丰碑之一。

en:
This road car version of the Gr.3 4C sold 1000 units as soon as it was released to the public.

The 4C Gr.3 is a homologation version of Alfa Romeo’s 4C mid-engine sports car that was developed to meet Gr.3 standards. The already agile base model has been transformed with a wider body, and the engine's power was boosted from 200 to 450 horsepower.
zh:
这款Gr.3 4C公路车型一经推出，就售出了超千辆。

4C Gr.3基于Alfa Romeo新一代中置跑车4C制造，是一款经改装后满足Gr.3组别标准的赛事认证车型。基础车型原本出色的过弯能力在本次高速化全面升级中得到强化，功率输出从200马力提升至450马力，车身也得到了加宽处理。

en:
The launch edition of the 4C, limited to 1000 units, sold out almost immediately after going on sale. 

The 4C Gr.3 is a Gran Turismo original model based on Alfa Romeo's new-generation mid-engine sports car, the 4C, modified to meet Gr.3 standards. To boost stability and aerodynamics, its wheelbase has been lengthened by 4.3 inches and its revised front overhang grew 1.2 inches. The Gr.4 4C is essentially a refined, tuned variant of the base model. Although less powerful, it exploited its light weight and small footprint to remain competitive in corners.
zh:
1000台车瞬间销售一空。4C的限量版，性能达到超级跑车水平。

4C Gr.3基于Alfa Romeo新一代中置跑车4C制造，是一款经改装后满足Gr.3组别标准的赛事认证车型。该车在稳定性和空气动力学方面得到了精心考量，轴距延长了110毫米，前悬延长约30毫米。4C Gr.3在蜕变成一款能够承受强大动力的赛车的同时，仍保留了原版出色的过弯能力。

en:
The launch edition of the 4C, limited to 1000 units, sold out almost immediately after going on sale.

The 4C Gr.4 is a Gran Turismo original model based on Alfa Romeo's new-generation mid-engine sports car, the 4C, modified to meet Gr.4 standards. Essentially a refined version of the production model, it may have lacked outright power, but its compact footprint and sharp handling gives it a distinct edge on technical circuits.
zh:
1000台车瞬间销售一空。4C的限量版，性能达到超级跑车水平。

4C Gr.4基于Alfa Romeo新一代中置跑车4C制造，是一款经改装后满足Gr.4组别标准的赛事认证车型。本质上它是基础车款的调校版本，因此尽管动力稍显不足，但这台过弯猛兽利用其小巧车身天生的敏捷性在赛道上占尽优势。

en:
The launch edition of the 4C, limited to 1000 units, sold out almost immediately after going on sale.

Alfa Romeo’s first mass-produced mid-engine sports car, the 4C made its debut in 2013. Its design paid tribute to the timeless lines of the Tipo 33/2 Stradale. The 1742 cc 4-cylinder engine, producing 236.7 HP and 253.2 ft-lb of torque, was paired with an exceptionally lightweight body, enabling the car to accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 4.5 seconds and reach a top speed of 160.3 mph. A special "Launch Edition" was also released, limited to just 1,000 units worldwide.
zh:
1000台车瞬间销售一空。4C的限量版，性能达到超级跑车水平。

Alfa Romeo于2013年发布的首款量产中置引擎跑车。该车从经典的Tipo 33/2 Stradale的造型中汲取了大量灵感。1,742 立方厘米的4缸引擎可输出240 PS/35.7 公斤力米，与极致轻盈的车身相结合，使该车能够在4.5秒内加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速达258 公里/小时。“Launch Edition”是一款特别版车型，全球限量1000台。

en:
The Italian version of the people's car makes a comeback after a 50-year hiatus.

Thanks to its affordable pricing and endearing styling, the original FIAT 500 sold more than four million units over its 20-year production run starting in 1957. Half a century after the second-generation model, the third-generation FIAT 500 arrived. Making its debut at the 2004 Geneva Motor Show, the new Fiat 500 launched to widespread acclaim in the summer of 2007. It was affectionately known around the world as the Cinquecento—Italian for “500."
zh:
阔别50年的第3代Cinquecento，保留了2代的可爱造型。

得益于亲民的价格与迷人的造型，Fiat 500自1957年推出后的20年间累计售出400万台。第2代发布50年后，第3代Fiat 500问世。这台车在2004年日内瓦车展上迎来首秀，并在2007年夏季上市后迅速风靡全球。全球汽车爱好者亲切称其为“Cinquecento”——意大利语“500”之意。

en:
Small, versatile and inexpensive, this minimalist car could also be raced.

The car symbolized FIAT’s original mission of delivering accessible, everyday mobility. The first 500, born in 1957, featured an extremely compact body housing a 497 cc engine with just 14.8 HP, mounted at the rear. Despite its modest power, the car offered surprising practicality and affordability, quickly gaining popularity and spawning numerous Abarth-tuned variants. The F model introduced front-hinged doors for the first time.
zh:
功能全面，价格合理，还能用于竞速。一款充满乐趣的极简原创车型。

这款车标志着FIAT公司实现了为大众市场制造汽车这一目标。诞生于1957年，这款车以极其紧凑的车身在尾部搭载了15 PS的497 立方厘米引擎。这台车虽然小巧，但非常实用，且凭借低廉的价格广受欢迎，甚至催生了众多Abarth的改装版本。F车型首次采用前铰链式车门。

en:
A priceless unrestored example of a Gran Turismo Award winner. 

The 500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe, a car built for the 1954 Tour de France, featured a chassis and engine developed by Ferrari and bodywork by Pininfarina. Although it never competed in the Tour as intended, an unrestored example later won the prestigious Gran Turismo Award at the 2012 Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance.
zh:
Gran Turismo奖得主。一个无法再现的珍贵案例。

500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe采用Ferrari的底盘和引擎以及Pininfarina的车身，是为参加1954年环法汽车赛而打造的一款双门轿车。虽未能在环法汽车赛上如期取得成功，现存的一台保存完好的原车仍在2012年圆石滩经典车展中获得“Gran Turismo Award”大奖。

en:
One of the cars that defined the supercar boom in the 1970s, this car was considered the world's fastest, along with the Lamborghini Countach.

This modified version of Ferrari’s 365 GT4/BB was notable for being the brand’s first mid-engine 12-cylinder road car. The most significant revision was the enlargement of the engine to 5.0 liters; however, due to emissions regulations, power output was reduced by 19.7 HP, bringing the total to 355 HP. Torque was increased by 28.9 ft-lb, resulting in a formidable 332.7 ft-lb. One of Ferrari’s most iconic creations, this car—along with Lamborghini’s Countach—came to symbolize the exotic Italian supercars of the 1970s.
zh:
引领20世纪70年代超跑潮流的标杆之一，与Countach争夺最高时速的桂冠。

这是365GT4/BB的改装版，是Ferrari的12缸公路车，也是品牌首款采用中置引擎布局的车型。此次升级的主要亮点是将12缸引擎排量扩容至5升，不过为符合排放法规所做的改动导致动力输出减少20 PS至360 PS。但扭矩还是增加了4.0 公斤力米至46.0 公斤力米。作为Ferrari最令人难忘的经典车型之一，这款车与Lamborghini Countach一起，成为20世纪70年代意大利超级跑车的象征。

en:
The rear-mid-engine layout and ultra-wide rear fenders of this Renault hatchback set the 1980s auto industry on the right track.

The Renault R5 ("Cinq") Turbo drew major attention when it was introduced at the 1978 Paris Motor Show. Initially developed as a prototype for the World Rally Championship (WRC), a production version followed in 1980. The transformation was dramatic, its front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout replaced with a mid-engine/rear-wheel-drive one. The new engine delivered 1.5 times the power and more than three times the torque compared to the standard model. Making its debut at the 1980 WRC Tour de Corse, the R5 Turbo dominated the field, establishing Renault as a serious WRC force.
zh:
在功能车的基础上经过极限改装，成为一辆怪物级的中置引擎前轮驱动紧凑车型。

Renault R5 ('Cinq') Turbo在1978年巴黎车展首次亮相时就备受瞩目。这款最初为征战世界拉力锦标赛打造的原型车于1980年推出量产版本。设计上经过了大改，从前置前驱布局改为中置后驱布局。相较普通版Renault 5，新引擎动力输出提升了1.5倍，扭矩增加了3.3倍。1980年世界拉力锦标赛，它自科西嘉站首秀起，横扫多项赛事，为Renault在世界拉力锦标赛历史中留下了浓墨重彩的一笔。

en:
The 650S supercar came loaded with F1 technology. 

The McLaren 650S was introduced in 2014. Its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8, inherited from earlier models, was tuned to produce 641 HP and 499.1 ft-lb of torque to match its name. Paired with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission for seamless gear changes, it accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in 3.0 seconds, covered 1312.3 ft in 10.5, and reached a top speed of 206.9 mph.
zh:
当MP4-12C进化成了豪华超跑。

650S是McLaren在2014年发布的超级跑车。前代车型的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎被调校为650 PS/69.0 公斤力米的动力输出，算是“名”副其实。搭配7档双离合变速箱后换挡更加顺畅，该车可在3.0秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速，0-400 米所需时间仅为10.5秒，最高时速达333 公里/小时。

en:
Here is the Gran Turismo original Gr.4 spec-version of the McLaren 650S super sports car.

In the virtual world, the 650S inspired a Gran Turismo Original—the Gr.4 version, modeled on McLaren’s mid-tier supercar. Finished in McLaren’s factory racing color, this virtual machine offered well-balanced handling and predictable behavior. Its cockpit elements, fuel cap, and jack points were faithfully modeled after GT3-level race equipment.
zh:
跑车浪漫旅原创Gr.4规格的McLaren 650S超级跑车。

作为原创的跑车浪漫旅赛车，这款Gr.4赛车是基于McLaren中级超跑650S打造而成的。这款色彩艳丽的赛车采用McLaren厂队涂装，极佳的操控性和稳定性能帮助它轻松征服任何弯道。内饰装饰、油箱盖和千斤顶支点均为GT3级别的配置。

en:
The GT3 successor to the remarkable MP4-12C race car.

The 650S GT3 was developed as a full FIA-GT3 compliant race car, derived directly from the production McLaren 650S. While it retained the same twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8, power output was reduced to 493.1 HP to comply with GT3 regulations, similar to the MP4-12C GT3. Additional upgrades included extensive endurance-focused refinements throughout the car. The 650S GT3 earned significant victories in 2015, winning at GT Asia and later claiming top honors at the 2016 Bathurst 12 Hour.
zh:
在凶猛而性感的野兽的排气共鸣声中沉迷。

650S GT3是基于McLaren 650S超级跑车开发的符合FIA-GT3规则的车型。尽管使用的是相同的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎，但为符合GT3规则降低了调校。它和MP4-12C GT3一样，动力被限制到500 PS。全车还进行了多项针对耐力赛的改进。2015款650S GT3于同年在GT Asia赛事中获胜，并于2016年初在巴瑟斯特12小时耐力赛中夺冠。

en:
The legendary Mazda 787B was the first Japanese-manufactured race car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

Mazda’s 787B completed the 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans without a single mechanical issue, making history as the first Japanese manufacturer to secure an overall win at the event. Mazda, which had entered Le Mans with rotary engines beginning in 1974, developed the 787 as its final bid for rotary-powered victory, before regulations would turn against such powertrains. Although the effort fell short at the 1990 race, the 787 underwent extensive revisions and emerged as the 787B.
zh:
帮助Mazda成为首家赢得勒芒大赛的日本生产商，成就一代传奇。

1991年，787B成为日本制造商中首台在勒芒24小时耐力赛获得总冠军的赛车，并且全程未出现任何机械故障。Mazda于1974年开始一直使用转子引擎征战勒芒，但由于禁止使用转子引擎的技术规范即将到来，开发787是Mazda在勒芒凭借转子引擎获胜的最后机会。由于787在1990年的比赛中未能实现目标，次年，经过全面改进的787B由此诞生。

en:
Adopting the classic V-12 FR layout, this Ferrari possesses remarkable performance while retaining practicality.	

The Ferrari 812 Superfast, introduced in 2017, carried on the company's tradition of front-engined V-12 grand tourers. It marked Ferrari’s first use of electric power steering and adopted an evolved version of the 4-wheel steering system from the F12berlinetta. Despite its substantial 107.1 inches wheelbase, the car remained impressively agile through tight corners.
zh:
这款Ferrari采用了经典的V12前置后驱布局，在实现闪电般速度的同时保持实用性。

812 Superfast于2017年推出，延续了Ferrari前置V12车型的血脉。这是Ferrari首款采用电动助力转向系统的车型，它还配备了F12berlinetta的四轮转向系统的升级版，这意味着尽管轴距较长（2,720毫米），车辆仍可灵活通过急弯。

en:
Equipped with DOHC V-8, this exquisite coupe was produced by Alfa Romeo in the pre-war period.

As its name suggested, the Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta was a stunning coupe, its body hand-shaped by Carrozzeria Touring using the lightweight superleggera method. The "8C" badge referred to the car’s 8-cylinder engine. Designed by the legendary Vittorio Jano, the water-cooled inline-8 delivered performance that placed the machine firmly in race-car territory. It's believed that only five examples were ever produced.
zh:
这款精致的双门跑车配备了双顶置凸轮轴8缸引擎，由Alfa Romeo在战前时期生产。

顾名思义，Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta是由Carrozzeria Touring用超轻结构技术打造的精致双门轿跑。“8C”指的是引擎的8个气缸。液冷直列式8缸引擎出自天才设计师维托瑞·加诺之手，性能表现直逼赛车。据说这台车总共仅生产了5台。

en:
This car marked Alfa Romeo's return to the rear-drive coupe and possessed a top speed of 180.2 mph plus.

The original 8C took its name from the 8-cylinder engine designed by the legendary Vittorio Jano. Beneath its timeless bodywork lay a 4.7-liter V-8, tuned by Alfa Romeo to deliver 443.8 HP. With a top speed of 180.2 mph and a 0–62.1 mph sprint time of under 4.2 seconds, it rivaled—and in some cases surpassed—contemporary supercars. Limited to just 500 units worldwide, the car sold out almost immediately upon its release.
zh:
Alfa Romeo后轮驱动双门轿车回归，最高速度超过290 公里/小时。

初代8C得名于维托瑞·加诺设计的8缸引擎。在其经典造型下，隐藏着Alfa Romeo调校的4.7升V8引擎，动力输出达450 PS，最高时速可达290 公里/小时，0-100 公里/小时加速时间不到4.2秒，让不少同期的超级跑车都相形见绌。这台车全球限量仅500台，发售的一瞬间便被抢购一空。

en:
A masterpiece that brought great success to Porsche's GT race efforts in the 1960s

In 1963, Porsche developed the Carrera GTS in response to the World Sportscar Championship regulations of the era. To meet the 100-unit production homologation requirement, the car employed a ladder-frame chassis paired with a lightweight fiberglass body. It delivered strong performance and achieved numerous victories, beginning with the Targa Florio, ultimately becoming the foundation of Porsche’s GT racing efforts throughout the 1960s.
zh:
Porsche在1960年代赖以统治GT赛事的杰作。

1963年，Porsche为迎合当时世界跑车锦标赛的规则开发了Porsche Carrera GTS。为了满足100台量产车的赛事认证条件，该车采用了梯形框架底盘与轻量化玻璃纤维车身。这款车型性能卓越，从塔格·佛罗热大奖赛开始便在众多顶级赛事中夺冠，成为1960年代Porsche GT车队的中流砥柱。

en:
This Peugeot LMP took the top four spots in qualifying for the 2010 24 Hours of Le Mans, but not one finished the race.

Peugeot developed the 908 HDi FAP to compete at the highest level of prototype racing. During 2007 and 2008, it took part in events such as the Le Mans Series, serving as a platform for ongoing research and development. In 2009, the car finally triumphed over its chief rival—Audi’s diesel-powered R10—securing a dominant 1–2 finish at Le Mans. Although it was unable to repeat the feat in 2010, the 908 HDi FAP continued to deliver commendable results.
zh:
在2010年勒芒24小时耐力赛资格赛中包揽前几名的Peugeot LMP赛车。

Peugeot开发908 HDi FAP，旨在攀上原型车赛车领域的巅峰。2007至2008年，这台车征战LMS等赛事来进一步推动研发工作。2009年，它在勒芒24小时耐力赛中取得了辉煌的战果，击败了宿敌——Audi的柴油车R10，实现一二带回。2010年虽未能蝉联冠军，表现依然可圈可点。

en:
A first in Porsche 911 history, the elusive Rennsport.

The first Porsche 911 to carry the RS badge was the 911 Carrera RS 2.7, released in 1973. The "RS" stood for Rennsport, meaning racing sport in German. Developed to meet FIA Group 4 homologation requirements, the car was designed with motorsports in mind. It quickly proved to be a hit—its initial production run of 500 units sold out immediately. Due to high demand, Porsche expanded production, ultimately building a total of 1,580 examples.
zh:
Porsche 911历史上首款冠以稀有的Rennsport之名的型号。

Porsche 911史上首款冠以“RS”徽标的车型是1973年发布的911 Carrera RS 2.7。RS代表“Rennsport”，也就是“比赛运动型”的意思。这款车是专为满足国际汽联Group 4组别赛事认证而开发的。上市后反响极为热烈，原计划生产的500台瞬间售罄。Porsche随后增产并总计生产了1580台。

en:
This Porsche was a lighter version of the third-generation 911 Carrera 2 and came with a 3.6-liter flat-6.

In 1989, Porsche introduced the third-generation 911, known internally as the Type 964. Although it retained the familiar shape of its predecessor, it was a major leap forward, with about 80 percent of its components being newly developed. The Carrera 4, featuring 4-wheel drive, debuted first, followed by the rear-wheel-drive Carrera 2 in 1990. The Carrera RS of this generation was a performance-tuned variant based on the Carrera 2.
zh:
引擎排气量增加到3.6L。这款跑车车型是第三代911 Carrera 2的轻量化版本。

1989年，Porsche推出第3代911，这便是Type 964。造型上虽然与前代911颇为相近，实则约80%的零部件都是全新设计。四驱款Carrera 4率先发布，后驱款Carrera 2于1990年问世。Carrera RS是在Carrera 2基础上衍生的性能车型。

en:
The most powerful version of the 993, the last air-cooled Porsche, came with a 3.8-liter flat-6 producing 295.9 HP.

Porsche introduced the fourth-generation 911 in 1993 with the launch of the Type 993. Alongside revised styling, the model featured significant suspension improvements that enhanced handling. The most powerful variant of the series was the Carrera RS, released in 1995, which featured a more rigid yet lighter body. Powering the car was the final air-cooled engine used in the 911—a 3.8-liter flat-6 producing 295.9 HP. The track-focused Carrera RS Clubsport was also made available.
zh:
搭载一台3.8L水平对置6缸引擎，可产生300 PS动力。作为993最强大的车型，这是最后一款采用风冷的Porsche。

Porsche 911于1993年推出了代号为993的第四代车型。在造型设计更新的同时，悬挂系统也得到了改良，进一步提升了操控性能。最高性能版本是1995年推出的Carrera RS，采用了更加坚固，同时也更轻量化的车身结构。该车还搭载了993系列最后一款风冷引擎——一款3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，最大动力300 PS。同时还提供了专为赛道设计的Carrera RS Clubsport版本。

en:
This version of the Type 993, the final air-cooled Porsche 911, was designed specifically for the race track.

The fourth-generation Type 993 Porsche 911 was introduced as an all-new model in 1993. In 1995, the Carrera RS followed, featuring a lighter yet more rigid body and a 295.9 HP 3.8-liter flat-6 engine. The lineup also included the track-focused Carrera RS Clubsport. Specifically designed for circuit use, it came equipped with a large front spoiler, a prominent rear wing, and a welded roll cage.
zh:
专为赛道打造的Type 993，最后一款911风冷车型。

第四代Porsche 911（代号993）于1993年进行了全面改款换代。1995年推出的Carrera RS采用了更加坚固和轻量的车身，搭载300 PS的3.8升水平对置6缸引擎。车系中还包括了Carrera RS Clubsport版本。后者专为赛道使用而调校，配备了大型前扰流板、尾翼以及焊接式防滚架。

en:
A road-going version of the 911 GT1 was developed by Porsche to compete in GT racing.

Porsche also developed the 911 GT1 Strassenversion—a road-legal counterpart to the 911 GT1 race car built for GT competition between 1996 and 1998. While the headlights were updated to match those of the Type 996, the core construction of the car remained nearly identical to its racing sibling. To comply with emissions regulations, the engine was detuned to 536.5 HP, yet the car still managed a 0–62.1 mph sprint in just 3.7 seconds and reached a top speed of 191.4 mph.
zh:
911 GT1的公路版，此车是Porsche为GT赛事而专门开发的。

Porsche在1996至1998年间为GT赛事开发了911 GT1赛车，911 GT1 Strassenversion是该车的道路合法版本。车灯改为与type 996相同的配置，但车辆的基础结构与赛车版本几乎别无二致。为符合排放法规，引擎动力下调至544 PS，但该车依然能够实现3.7秒的0-100 公里/小时加速时间，最高时速达308 公里/小时。

en:
The 911's first GT3 spec model was introduced for the Type 996. It proved to be very popular, selling 1889 units.

The 996-generation Porsche 911, introduced in 1997, was the first to feature a GT3 variant. Using the rigid Carrera 4 chassis as a foundation, it incorporated race-grade upgrades to the suspension and brakes, while the engine took on a GT1-spec crankcase for high-rev performance. A total of 1,889 units were produced.
zh:
Type 993引入了911系列中的首款GT3规格车型。这款车深受消费者的喜爱，现已售出1,889辆。

最初于1997年推出的996款911是首款GT3车型。以高刚性的Carrera 4车身为基础，悬挂和刹车均升级为赛车级部件，而引擎则用适合更高转速的GT1曲轴箱来搭配。此车总共生产了1889台。

en:
Featuring adjustable dampers as standard equipment, this GT3 version of the Type 997 made its debut in 2006.

In 2006, Porsche introduced the GT3 variant for the Type 997. As with its predecessor, it used the Carrera 4 platform, along with upgraded suspension and braking systems. The engine, originally a 3.6-liter unit, was enlarged to 3.8 liters in 2008, increasing output to 428 HP. Electronically controlled PASM dampers were included as standard equipment.
zh:
这款GT3版本的Type 997于2006年发布，标配可调式避震。

2006年为997款911推出的GT3规格车型。以Carrera 4车型为基础，底盘和刹车得到了和前代996车型一样的升级。最初的3.6升引擎排量在2008年扩容至3.8升，动力输出达435 PS。此外，还标配了电控PASM可变式减震器。

en:
This is a pure racing machine from the 8th generation 911 catalogue.

The 911 GT3 R was a pure racing machine developed from the 992-model 911, the eighth generation of Porsche’s everyday sports car. Introduced in 2022, this machine was equipped with a naturally aspirated 4.2-liter flat-6 engine, producing a maximum 557.2 HP. It also featured lightweight carbon body panels and aramid-fiber components, as well as the double-wishbone/multilink suspension setup derived from the 911 RSR.
zh:
脱胎于第八代911车系的纯粹竞速机器。

911 GT3 R是一款纯粹为赛道而生的跑车，基于Porsche面向日常使用的911跑车的第八代车型992来研发。这款于2022年发布的赛车装备了一台自然进气的4.2升水平对置六缸引擎，可产生高达565 PS的动力。其车身还采用了轻量化的碳纤维车身板件和芳纶纤维部件，以及沿袭自911 RSR的双摇臂/多连杆悬挂配置。

en:
The ultimate 991, rebuilt from the ground up.

This high-performance model served as a further evolution of the 991-generation Porsche 911 GT3. Starting with the wide-body shell of the 911 Turbo, Porsche increased front and rear track widths, while also implementing major weight reductions and aerodynamic enhancements. The engine, enlarged to 4.0 liters, produced 493.1 HP and enabled the car to record a Nürburgring Nordschleife lap time of 7 minutes and 20 seconds.
zh:
从零开始全新打造的终极版911。

这款高性能车型是991系列中的Porsche 911 GT3的改进版。基于911 Turbo的宽体车身，前后轮距加宽，同时进行了大幅减重和空气动力学方面的改进。如今引擎排量扩容至4升，动力输出达500 PS，得以在纽博格林北侧赛道创下7分20秒的圈速。

en:
A hyper-performance road car packed with race car features.

The Porsche 911 GT3 RS (992) was a high-performance road car that incorporated aerodynamic components from the 911 GT3 R race car. It was fitted with a range of advanced aerodynamic systems, including a large swan-neck rear wing with DRS (drag reduction system) and an active diffuser that functioned as an air brake under hard braking.
zh:
一辆配备各种赛车特性的终极性能公路车。

Porsche 911 GT3 RS（992）是一款高性能公路跑车，采用了源自911 GT3 R赛车的空气动力学套件。该车配备了多种先进的空气动力学系统，包括搭载DRS（可变尾翼减阻系统）的大型天鹅颈式尾翼，以及在急刹车时可起到气动减速作用的可调主动式扩散器。

en:
This 911, the first in history to feature a mid-engine layout, is a full competition spec machine.

This race-bred machine carried the spirit of the RSR. And it was developed through an entirely different process than the production 911 road car. Its 4.0-liter naturally-aspirated engine, the first in 911 history to be mid-mounted, delivered 502 HP. At the 2017 Nürburgring 24 Hours, the car delivered a standout performance, holding the top spot for much of the race.
zh:
911史上第一款中置引擎车型。和最终的量产车型不同，这是一款高规格赛车。

这台赛车继承了RSR的精神。其开发过程完全不同于911公路车。这款4升自然进气引擎是911历史上首款中置引擎，输出马力为510 PS。在2017年纽博格林24小时耐力赛中，它拿出强劲表现，大部分时间都占据杆位。

en:
This top-of-the-line version of the vaunted 911 possessed a more muscular look and a turbocharged engine.

Introduced in 1975, the 911 Turbo was the first production Porsche to wear the now-iconic "Turbo" badge. True to its name, the car’s 3.0L air-cooled flat-6 engine was equipped with a KKK turbocharger, producing 256.4 HP. This setup enabled the car to cruise at speeds of up to 155.3 mph—a remarkable feat for its era. Beginning in 1977, the engine’s displacement was increased to 3.3 liters and paired with an air-to-air intercooler, which further boosted performance.
zh:
911系列当中的旗舰款，拥有强大的车身设计和同等强劲的涡轮增压引擎。

1975年推出的这款911 Turbo是Porsche量产车历史上首款使用“Turbo”标识的车型。正如其标识所示，3升风冷水平对置6缸引擎搭载了KKK涡轮增压器，最大动力达260 PS。这些配置还能让该车达到250 公里/小时的巡航速度，在当时堪称惊人的成就。从1977年起，引擎排量提升至3.3升并增配了空对空式中间冷却器，进一步提升了动力输出。

en:
The top performance version of the eighth-generation 911.

Having stood as the symbol of the Porsche brand since the 1960s, the 911 entered its eighth generation in 2018 with the Type 992. In April 2020, Porsche introduced the Turbo S variant to the 992 lineup as its top-performing model. Powered by a twin-turbocharged 3745 cc flat-6 engine, the Turbo S delivered 641 HP and 590.2 ft-lb of torque, channeled through all four wheels, enabling a 0–62.1 mph time of just 2.7 seconds and a top speed of 205.1 mph.
zh:
第八代911的高性能车型。

自1960年代起便成为Porsche品牌象征的911，于2018年推出了代号992的第八代车型。2020年4月，Turbo S作为顶级性能版本加入了992车系。双涡轮增压3,745 立方厘米水平对置6缸引擎输出650 PS最大动力和81.6 公斤力米峰值扭矩，通过四轮驱动系统传递澎湃动力，0-100 公里/小时加速仅需2.7秒，最高时速达330 公里/小时。

en:
The 911 Turbo S reimagined as a safety car.

This 992-generation Porsche 911 Turbo S was a virtual model created by Gran Turismo and reimagined as a safety car. Built on Porsche’s updated 911 platform, the wide-body design incorporated a higher percentage of aluminum components. Its exceptional traction and stability made the 911 Turbo ideally suited for leading the field as a safety car.
zh:
重新设计为安全车的911 Turbo S。

这款992车型911 Turbo S是《跑车浪漫旅》创作的一款虚拟车型，在原车型基础上重新设计为安全车。基于全新开发的MMB平台，其宽体车身设计采用了更高比例的铝制部件。出色的牵引力与稳定性，让911 Turbo S担任安全车、引领车阵的不二之选。

en:
The third-generation 911 Turbo was virtually all new with 80 percent new parts. 

The 964 represented the third generation of the 911 series, following the Type 901 and 930. The lineup included a “Turbo” model for those seeking greater performance, as well as the 911 Turbo S Leichtbau, a special variant created to commemorate Porsche’s success in the 1993 IMSA series. True to its “Leichtbau” (lightweight) name, the Turbo S featured high-lift camshafts and a revised turbocharger with increased boost, producing 375.7 HP/361.6 ft-lb. Weight was also significantly reduced compared with the standard Turbo model.
zh:
第三代911，首次采用全轮驱动，超过80%的零部件经过重新设计。

在911系列中，964是继Type 901和930之后的第三代车型。在这一代的车系阵容中，主打的“Turbo”车型用于满足用户对强劲动力的需求，同时也推出了特别版的911 Turbo S Leichtbau，用于纪念Porsche在1993年IMSA系列赛中夺冠。这款Turbo S被赋予“Leichtbau”（轻量化）之名，搭载了高升程凸轮与一台可提供额外增压的特制涡轮引擎，能够爆发出381 PS动力和50.0 公斤力米扭矩。与标准的Turbo车型相比，其重量也得到了显著减轻。

en:
This extreme hyper car is an updated version of the legendary 917, one of the most celebrated race cars in Porsche history.

The Porsche 917 earned a celebrated place in motorsport history by securing seven victories out of ten races during the 1970 World Sportscar Championship season. The Porsche 917 LIVING LEGEND was a hypercar concept inspired by the 917. Its classic exterior design masked cutting-edge technology beneath the surface. Its blend of top speed and aerodynamic downforce resulted in remarkable stability, even at speeds exceeding 186.4 mph.
zh:
这款极限超跑是对经典917的现代重塑，后者是Porsche历史上最辉煌的机器之一。

917为Porsche创造了诸多辉煌战绩，包括在1970年世界跑车锦标赛中10场比赛斩获7场胜利。Porsche 917 LIVING LEGEND是一款以经典917为灵感打造的终极跑车。经典的外观设计下蕴藏着前沿的技术内核。极速与下压力的完美结合，即使在超过300 公里/小时的速度下也能保持如磐石般的稳定性。

en:
This prototype race car that gave Porsche its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The 917K was a prototype race car developed by Porsche specifically for sports car competition. Despite weighing under 1764 lbs, the 1970 version was capable of producing up to 591.7 HP in its most powerful configuration. In its second year of competition, 1970, the 917K proved nearly unbeatable, winning seven out of ten rounds in the International Championship for Makes. It also delivered Porsche its long-awaited first overall victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
zh:
这款原型赛车帮助Porsche在勒芒24小时耐力赛中首次获胜。

917K是Porsche为跑车赛事专门设计的原型赛车。车重仅800 公斤，1970款917的引擎在最强配置下可输出高达600 PS的动力。1970年是其参赛的第二年，几乎鲜有对手可以匹敌。在国际车厂锦标赛10轮比赛中豪取7场胜利，并为Porsche赢得了期盼已久的勒芒24小时耐力赛首冠。

en:
This super sports car represents the first plug-in hybrid flagship from the famed German car maker. 

The Porsche 918 Spyder was a high-performance sports car introduced in 2011. It succeeded the Carrera GT and was produced in a limited run of 918 units, in keeping with its name. Its most defining feature was its plug-in hybrid powertrain. The mid-mounted 4.6-liter V-8 engine, producing 599.6 HP, was paired with two electric motors on the front axle and one on the rear, delivering a combined system output of up to 873.8 HP.
zh:
这款超级跑车以插电式混合动力的形式重新诠释了光彩夺目的Carrera GT。

Porsche 918 Spyder是Porsche于2011年推出的超级跑车。作为Carrera GT的继任者，正如其名称所示，限量生产918台。其最值得一提的特点是采用了插电式混合动力系统。中置的608 PS 4.6升V8引擎配合前轴双电机和后轴单电机，总输出动力可达886 PS。

en:
The consecutive Le Mans champion & hybrid prototype sports car.

This prototype sports car was developed specifically to compete in the World Endurance Championship (WEC) and at Le Mans. It utilized a turbocharged 2.0-liter V-4 as part of a hybrid system that included energy recovery technology, with a total output of 887.6 HP. From 2015 through 2017, it dominated the WEC, capturing both the constructors’ and drivers’ championships in those years.
zh:
连续夺得勒芒冠军和混动原型车比赛的跑车。

这是一款为参加世界耐力锦标赛和勒芒赛事而开发的原型跑车。2升V4涡轮增压引擎是混合动力系统中的一部分，配备有能量回收系统，总马力为900 PS。它称霸了2015年到2017年间的世界耐力锦标赛，每年均夺得车厂和车手双料冠军。

en:
A four-wheel-drive road car that shines bright in automotive history.

The Porsche 959 was the production evolution of the original Gruppe B prototype, which Porsche had engineered for competition in Group B, the top category of the WRC at the time. It featured an advanced, electronically controlled 4-wheel-drive system that allowed drivers to adjust drivetrain settings to suit various conditions, delivering exceptional stability and ride comfort. Although Group B was disbanded before the car could compete in the WRC, the 959 still achieved remarkable success in other forms of motorsports.
zh:
一辆在汽车历史上熠熠生辉的四轮驱动公路车。

Porsche 959是基于“Gruppe B”原型车打造的量产版本，该原型车是Porsche为参加当时世界拉力锦标赛最高级别的B组别赛事而开发的。该车配备了先进的电子控制四轮驱动系统，驾驶者可根据路况选择不同的驱动模式，既保证了出色的稳定性，又兼顾了舒适性。由于B组别赛事的取消，该车最终未能在世界拉力锦标赛中参赛，但在其他赛车领域取得了令人瞩目的成绩。

en:
These Group C cars scored numerous endurance racing championships for Porsche.

The Porsche 962 C was a prototype race car that made its debut in the World Endurance Championship (WEC) in 1985. Over the course of its career, the car delivered Porsche numerous race victories and championship titles. In its debut WEC season, it won seven out of ten races. The following year, in 1986, it claimed four wins from nine rounds in the newly renamed World Sports Prototype Championship (WSPC). At the 1987 WSPC, it secured a win at Le Mans and followed it up with a 2nd-place finish the year after.
zh:
在无数场耐力赛中为保时捷带来胜利的C组别赛车。

Porsche 962 C是于1985年在世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）中首次登场的原型赛车。在整个参赛生涯中，其为Porsche夺得了众多分站胜利和锦标赛冠军。此车在其WEC首秀之年便赢得了10场比赛中的7场胜利，1986年在WEC更名后的世界运动原型车锦标赛（WSPC）中又夺得9轮比赛中的4场胜利。1987年WSPC赛季，它在勒芒收获冠军，次年又获得亚军。

en:
A new category LMDh hypercar created by Porsche, the masters of endurance.

Porsche’s Le Mans Daytona h (LMDh) contender, the 963, carried forward the legacy of the legendary 962 and 919 Hybrid. After making its debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona, it quickly amassed victories and podiums in IMSA and the WEC before Porsche claimed both the Drivers’ and Manufacturers’ titles in the 2024 IMSA season. For 2025, the car received further development in its suspension and rear aerodynamic package to improve balance and stability on any circuit.
zh:
由耐力赛大师Porsche打造的全新LMDh终极跑车。

Porsche的勒芒-戴通纳混合动力（LMDh）终极跑车，延续了传奇车型962和919 Hybrid的辉煌血脉。自2023年戴通纳24小时耐力赛首秀后，该车便迅速在WEC和IMSA两项赛事中斩获无数冠军并多次登上领奖台，最终在2024年IMSA赛季中包揽了车手和车厂双料冠军。2025年，该车迎来了进一步升级，通过对悬挂系统和后部空气动力学套件的更新，确保在任何赛道上都能保持平衡与稳定。

en:
An electric hypercar that represents the racing spirit of Peugeot.

Peugeot returned to the top class of endurance racing under Le Mans Hypercar (LMH) regulations in 2022 after previously stepping away in 2011. Its return was marked by the arrival of the all-wheel-drive hybrid 9X8. The original aerodynamic concept eliminated the need for a rear wing, although one was introduced as part of the car’s 2024 evolution package. The 2025 version further refined those developments, resulting in the most complete form of the 9X8. It demonstrated its potential with a 2nd place finish at Fuji during the 2025 FIA World Endurance Championship season.
zh:
淋漓尽致诠释Peugeot赛车精神的电动终极跑车。

Peugeot在2022年依据勒芒终极跑车（LMH）规则重返耐力赛事的巅峰组别，这是自品牌2011年退出后，时隔11年的回归。该品牌为这次回归打造了全轮驱动混合动力车型9X8。最初的空气动力学设计成功省去了尾翼，但在2024年加装了这一部件。2025款车型在这些改进基础上进一步优化，最终呈现出现在的最终形态。在2025年国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛富士站中，它以第二名的成绩完赛，证明了自己的竞速潜力。

en:
The original hot hatch, with excellent power and agile handling, paved the way for a new genre.

The A112 Abarth, introduced in 1971, was widely regarded as one of the original hot hatches. Based on the Autobianchi A112, the car was tuned by Abarth. Continuously refined throughout its production run, the car's engine displacement was increased in 1975, raising output to 70 HP, and in 1979, a 5-speed transmission was added. Although production ended in 1985, the A112 Abarth maintained a loyal following among enthusiasts drawn to its lively character.
zh:
这款以高动力操控性而著称的车型是所有小钢炮的先驱。

1971年问世的A112 Abarth通常被视为最初的高性能掀背车之一。该车基于Autobianchi A112打造，并经Abarth之手调校。此后历经多次升级，1975年引擎排量增大，动力提升至71 PS，1979年更换为5速变速箱。虽然该车在1985年停产，但其凭借充满激情的驾驶特性赢得了车迷们的长久喜爱。

en:
The ultimate hot hatch based on the third-generation A Class.

This high-performance model joined the third-generation A-Class lineup one year after the platform's debut. Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine tuned by AMG, it delivered 355 HP and 325.5 ft-lb of torque. It accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in 4.6 seconds and reached its electronically limited top speed of 155.3 mph. To manage its power, the car employed a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission routed through a 4-wheel-drive system. Both the braking system and suspension were also upgraded.
zh:
第三代A-Class中的终极高性能小钢炮。

这款高性能车型在首次亮相一年后进入第三代A-Class产品线。AMG调校后的2升涡轮增压引擎可输出360 PS/45.0 公斤力米。该车可在4.6秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速，最高时速可达250 公里/小时。为驾驭这股动力，该车采用7档双离合变速箱，并通过四驱系统进行动力传输。刹车和悬挂也得到了升级。

en:
A beautiful streamlined 2-seat sports car that won the Gran Turismo Trophy

The Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder earned the Gran Turismo Trophy at the 2014 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance. Its elegant aluminum bodywork was crafted by Carrozzeria Fantuzzi, while power came from a 167.7 HP engine designed by Gioacchino Colombo. Raced under the official Maserati factory team, it secured five class victories and three overall wins during the 1954 season.
zh:
一辆绝美的流线型双座跑车，曾赢得过Gran Turismo奖杯

这辆Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder在2014年圆石滩经典车展中荣获Gran Turismo奖杯。优雅的铝制Spyder车身由Carrozzeria Fantuzzi打造，170 PS的引擎则出自乔亚基诺·科伦坡之手。该车代表Maserati厂队参赛，在1954赛季中夺得5次组别冠军和3次总成绩第一。

en:
A futuristic-looking design featuring a large central headlight, this Abarth was first shown at the 1952 Turin Motor Show.

Another Maserati highlight, an aerodynamic test vehicle, was unveiled at the 1952 Turin Motor Show. Based on a FIAT platform, the car showcased strikingly original styling by Franco Scaglione and was powered by a 1.5-liter engine tuned by Abarth to deliver 73 HP. The only example ever built was later shown at the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in recent years, where it earned the prestigious Gran Turismo trophy.
zh:
个性化兼具精密计算的美，标志着汽车设计中融入空气动力学研究的车型。

这是1952年在都灵车展上展出过的空气动力学测试车。这台基于FIAT车型打造的测试车采用了弗朗哥·斯凯荣内魅力独具的造型风格，搭载的1.5升引擎经Abarth调校后可输出75 PS。唯一的样车在近年来参加了圆石滩经典车展，荣获Gran Turismo奖杯。

en:
The Abarth returned yet again with bolder looks and performance, this time in the form of the timeless "500."

This was a factory-tuned version of the FIAT 500, developed by the iconic Italian performance brand Abarth, which returned to the scene in 2007. Powered by a turbocharged 1.4-liter DOHC engine delivering 133.1 HP and 151.9 ft-lb of torque. Tipping the scales at just 2447 lbs, the car accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in 7.9 seconds and reached a top speed of 127.4 mph. The design carried the unmistakable presence of an Abarth, with aggressive bumpers, flared side skirts, and a roof-mounted spoiler.
zh:
Abarth的第二次回归带来了永恒经典的500，外观大方，性能卓越。

这是意大利传奇调校品牌Abarth于2007年回归后生产的FIAT 500工厂调校版。配备1.4升双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压引擎，可输出135 PS/21.0 公斤力米，车身重量极轻，仅有1,110 公斤，该车能够在7.9秒内由0加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速达205 公里/小时。这台车配备的大尺寸保险杠、车身侧裙和车顶扰流板展现了Abarth的不屈精神。

en:
A hardcore sports version of the FIAT 500.

The FIAT Abarth 595 made its debut in 1963. It was derived from the second-generation FIAT 500 tuned by Abarth. An even more potent variant of the 595 later emerged as the 595 Esseesse. While it retained the same engine displacement, engineers raised compression to boost output to 31.6 HP. Thanks to this added performance, the 595 lineup made its mark in European racing, dominating the under 600 cc category.
zh:
FIAT 500的硬核运动版。

FIAT Abarth 595于1963年问世。该车基于第二代FIAT 500打造，经Abarth调校。595的进一步调校版本——595 Esseesse随后登场。虽然引擎排量相同，但通过提高压缩比将动力输出提升至32 PS。凭借这一性能提升，595系列在欧洲各项赛事中大放异彩，在600 立方厘米以下组别中所向披靡。

en:
A new era of mobility that reimagines transportation.

The AFEELA 1 was unveiled at CES® 2025. This production model was offered in two distinct trims—Origin and Signature. The cabin was envisioned as a Creative Entertainment Space that challenged traditional notions of what travel could be. Advanced technologies were embedded throughout the BEV, including an array of external sensing devices and an intelligent personal agent capable of holding natural, conversational dialogue.
zh:
全新“移动出行”座驾，颠覆传统交通理念。

AFEELA 1在CES® 2025展会上正式亮相。这款量产车型根据装饰级别共有两个配置版本可选：Origin版和Signature版。这款纯电动汽车以“创意娱乐空间”为设计理念打造豪华内饰，颠覆了传统的出行体验。它搭载了众多先进技术，包括集成在车身外部的感知设备，以及支持自然语言对话的智能助理。

en:
A revolutionary "mobility device" set to change how we spend time commuting.

The AFEELA Prototype 2024 was a BEV introduced by Sony Honda Mobility during CES® 2024. An array of sensing technologies delivered intuitive driver assistance, while dashboard and rear-seat displays offered abundant in-car entertainment. AFEELA turned the notion of waiting during travel into an enjoyable experience.
zh:
将会改变我们驾乘体验形态的革新性“移动性设备”。

AFEELA Prototype 2024是Sony Honda Mobility在2024年CES®展会上发布的纯电动汽车。该车通过众多传感设备提供自然的驾驶辅助功能，内饰方面则在仪表板和座椅靠背设置了显示屏，提供丰富的娱乐内容。AFEELA让旅途从单纯的等待变成了充实的美好时光。

en:
Japan's premium minivan that evolved into a high-class luxury car.

Since its original launch in 2002, the Toyota Alphard had continuously aimed to define the luxury minivan segment. The third-generation Alphard, launched in 2015, introduced the Executive Lounge trim, delivering exceptional comfort to second-row passengers. It offered a higher level of luxury and refinement than ever before. A 2017 facelift brought updates to the 4.5-liter V-6 engine and further enhancements to overall ride comfort.
zh:
已经演化成高档豪车的日本最高品质厢式旅行车。

Toyota Alphard自2002年初代车型问世后，便孜孜不倦地追求设计出极致的豪华厢式旅行车。2015年推出的第3代Alphard新增“Executive Lounge”豪华升级配置，将第二排座椅的舒适性提升至顶级。这台车带来了前所未有的豪华感与舒适性。2017年改款车型新增4.5升V6引擎，舒适性得到了进一步提升。

en:
The swoopy rear-engined Alpine was powered by a Renault engine.

The Alpine A110 was a classic French sports car with a celebrated heritage in rally racing. With its rear-engine layout and lightweight construction, it delivered superb traction and quickly rose to prominence in international rally events, claiming numerous victories. First introduced in 1963 with a 1.1-liter engine, the A110 saw gradual increases in displacement to remain competitive over time. The pinnacle of the lineup was arguably the 1600S, which came equipped with a 1.6-liter engine.
zh:
Alpine汽车的典范，超轻后驱跑车的巅峰。

Alpine A110这台经典法国跑车在拉力赛领域拥有辉煌的历史传承。凭借后置式引擎布局带来的卓越牵引力与超轻车身，它席卷国际拉力赛事，斩获无数胜利。A110在1963年首次出战时搭载的是1.1升引擎，此后为应对竞争，引擎排量逐年提升。终极型号当属采用1.6升引擎的1600S。

en:
This lightweight sports car from the reborn Alpine brand combined elegance with performance.

The original Alpine A110 proved itself across the globe, performing admirably in rally competition. In 2017, Renault revived the Alpine name to carry the torch forward, revealing the modern Alpine A110. This new version, clad in an aluminum body echoing the original, featured a mid-mounted turbocharged 1.8-liter 4-cylinder engine producing 248.5 HP and 231.5 ft-lb of torque. A special Première Édition was created, with production limited to 1,955 units worldwide.
zh:
Alpine品牌复活后出品的轻型跑车杰作，兼具优雅的外观和高超的性能。

经典的Alpine A110在全球拉力赛中表现出色。2017年，Renault重振Alpine品牌，推出新一代Alpine A110，延续这一传奇。这款新车型采用的铝制车身让人联想到经典的A110，中置1.8升4缸涡轮增压引擎可输出252 PS/32.0 公斤力米。特别版“Première Édition”全球限量1955台。

en:
Not only a maker of dominant rally cars, the noted French car company also forayed into road machines.

While Alpine earned fame through rallying success with the A110, the 1960s also saw the marque build competitive prototype racers that achieved results on the track. Among them, the A220 stood as Alpine’s strongest contender for overall victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, making its debut in 1968. Although the car was beset by mechanical issues and failed to deliver the expected result, it remained a fan favorite and a cherished part of Alpine’s legacy.
zh:
Alpine的另一面：搭载3升V8引擎的LeMans赛车。

得益于A110的卓越表现，Alpine作为拉力赛品牌广为人知。而到了20世纪60年代，Alpine还研发过原型赛车，这些车型在赛道上同样战绩斐然。其中，1968年首秀的A220最具问鼎勒芒24小时耐力赛总冠军的潜力。尽管正赛中该车故障频发，成绩未达预期，但至今仍被车迷视为Alpine经典车型之一。

en:
A legendary brand's glimpse of the ultimate future sports car.   

This was a single-seater concept created by the famed French marque Alpine, developed specifically for Gran Turismo players. Its design reflected Alpine’s core philosophy of “speed and excitement, embodied in style,” while simultaneously paying tribute to the brand’s iconic past. The result was a groundbreaking machine that blended road and track, and bridged the divide between the virtual and the real.
zh:
融合Alpine汽车过去与未来的瑰宝。

这是法国著名品牌Alpine为《跑车浪漫旅》玩家专门设计的单座跑车。它的设计秉承了Alpine“速度与激情融于造型”的理念，同时也是对经典Alpine车型的致敬。这台革命性的车架起了公路与赛道、虚拟与现实之间的桥梁。

en:
A legendary brand's glimpse of the ultimate future sports car.   

This was a single-seater sports car created by the renowned French marque Alpine, developed specifically for Gran Turismo players. Its styling followed Alpine’s core philosophy of “speed and excitement, embodied in style,” while paying tribute to the brand’s storied past. This groundbreaking machine bridged the divide between road and track, and between the digital world and physical reality.
zh:
融合Alpine汽车过去与未来的瑰宝。

这是法国著名品牌Alpine为《跑车浪漫旅》玩家专门设计的单座跑车。它的设计秉承了Alpine“速度与激情融于造型”的理念，同时也是对经典Alpine车型的致敬。这台革命性的车架起了公路与赛道、虚拟与现实之间的桥梁。

carNameEn: Alpine Vision Gran Turismo Race Mode
sourceName: Alpine Vision Gran Turismo Race Mode
en:
A legendary brand's glimpse of the ultimate future sports car.   

This was a single-seater sports car developed by the celebrated French brand Alpine, crafted specifically for Gran Turismo players. Its styling followed Alpine’s core philosophy of “speed and excitement, embodied in style,” while paying tribute to the brand’s storied past. This groundbreaking machine bridged the divide between road and track, and between the digital world and physical reality.
zh:
融合Alpine汽车过去与未来的瑰宝。

这是法国著名品牌Alpine为《跑车浪漫旅》玩家专门设计的单座跑车。它的设计秉承了Alpine“速度与激情融于造型”的理念，同时也是对经典Alpine车型的致敬。这台革命性的车架起了公路与赛道、虚拟与现实之间的桥梁。

en:
Saving lives faster and more safely.

Since the 1950s, Toyota had been producing ambulances based on specially adapted passenger and commercial vehicles. The most recent of these was the third-generation Himedic, a high-standard ambulance introduced in 2006. Its platform was built on the 200 Series HiAce Super Long. With improvements such as an expanded patient compartment, this vehicle was engineered for maximum functionality in critical, life-saving situations.
zh:
更快、更安全地拯救生命的急救车辆。

自1950年代起，Toyota便开始改装旗下的乘用车及其他商用车辆来生产救护车。最新款是2006年推出的第3代“Himedic”高规格救护车。该车车身基于200系列HiAce Super Long改造而成。相较于前代车型，这款车通过扩大后厢急救区域等改进，充分考量了在紧急救援的情况下所能提供的极致功能性。

en:
The Amemiya FD3S was another stylish RX-7 created by master tuner, RE Amemiya.

The Amemiya µ Boost up 7 was a street machine built by RE Amemiya, the legendary rotary tuner known for their presence in Super GT and D1GP. This car was engineered to fully exploit the FD3S platform’s capabilities as a cornering specialist. Celebrated for its performance on winding roads, it was featured in the Japanese DVD magazine Hot Version, where it earned the nickname “demon-lord of mountain paths” for its unmatched speed.
zh:
经过传奇调校工坊RE Amemiya调校的RX-7。

Amemiya μ Boost up 7是由RE Amemiya打造的公路车，该公司是转子引擎调校领域的传奇，它所经手的车辆在Super GT和D1GP比赛中均表现不俗。这款车以极致挖掘FD3S的过弯潜力而著称。出色过弯能力让其获赞无数——其中，日本DVD杂志《Hot Version》因为这台车无可比拟的速度将其称为“山道魔王”。

en:
Modified by Amuse, this Z car not only looked great, but also underwent a major weight reduction.

The Version NISMO Type 380RS was a fully tuned Z33 Fairlady Z developed by NISMO. Power House Amuse took it a step further, crafting the Amuse NISMO 380RS Super Leggera. The standout upgrade was its weight reduction of 309 lbs, a nod to the Super Leggera name—Italian for "super light."
zh:
一辆由Amuse改装的380RS。Z系列中的杰作，经过了大幅的减重。

Version NISMO Type 380RS是NISMO基于Z33 Fairlady Z打造的改装完成车。Power House Amuse进一步调校出了Amuse NISMO 380RS Super Leggera。正如它名字中的“Super Leggera”标签（意大利语中“超轻”的意思）所说，最显著的改进是高达140 公斤的减重。

en:
Development engineers of Gran Turismo contributed with Amuse to build this ultimate S2000.

While Power House Amuse was well known for tuning the S2000, its most refined build was the S2000 GT1. Its body kit was constructed with carbon fiber developed in collaboration with Polyphony Digital. Despite an increase in width to 72.0 inches, the car’s overall weight dropped to around 2469 lbs. Performance was further enhanced with engine upgrades, resulting in a remarkable power-to-weight ratio of just 4 lbs per 1 horsepower.
zh:
跑车浪漫旅的开发工程师参与了Amuse的终极S2000开发。

Power House Amuse以丰富的S2000调校经验而著称，其终极成就便是S2000 GT1。这套碳纤维车身套件是与Polyphony Digital合作开发的。尽管车身宽度增加至1,829毫米，但整车的重量降低到大约1,120 公斤。引擎也得到了优化，马力重量比实现了每1 PS仅1.79 公斤。

en:
More economical than the larger Prius, this model is helping to expand the hybrid vehicle market.

After making hybrids mainstream with the Prius, Toyota introduced the Aqua, a smaller, more fuel-efficient hybrid. Its hybrid system was a lighter, optimized version of that used in the third-generation Prius. In JC08 fuel economy tests conducted in Japan, it reached a maximum efficiency of 83.3 MPG. Internationally, the car was marketed as the Prius C.
zh:
比Prius更小更经济。一款开拓混动车市场的车型。

发布Prius普及混动汽车之后，Toyota开发了更小、更节能的混动汽车Aqua。所采用的混动系统是第3代Prius的轻量化版本。在日本JC08模式的燃油经济性测试中，其行驶里程达到了2.9 升/百公里。在日本以外的市场，它以Prius C的型号名发售。

carNameEn: Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo
en:
A glimpse of the ultimate British sports car of the future.

The Vision Gran Turismo model was conceived by Marek Reichman’s design team at Aston Martin. It was developed using the same processes as Aston Martin’s production models, at the company’s Gaydon facility in Warwickshire. Power came from a twin-turbo V-12 producing 800 BHP (799.8 HP). The DP-100 also functioned as a testbed for Aston Martin’s future design language and advanced technologies.
zh:
真正的高性能跑车，让人一窥Aston Martin未来的方向。

这款Vision Gran Turismo由Aston Martin的马雷克·瑞克曼带领的设计团队亲手完成。该车在沃里克郡盖登的Aston Martin总部以与量产车相同的流程进行开发。它的动力单元是一台800BHP（811 PS）V12双涡轮增压引擎。DP-100还被用作Aston Martin未来技术和设计的先行探索车型。

en:
The third-generation Mazda6 featured a curvaceous body style and SkyActiv technology.

This is a Gr.3 homologation model of the Atenza, derived from Mazda’s global market sedan and adapted to comply with Gr.3 racing regulations. Engineered as a true race machine, it has been transformed into a high-performance sedan producing more than 400 horsepower. Its design stands out for considering even the flow of reflections across the bodywork.
zh:
这款第3代Atenza赛车因其优美的车身线条和SkyActiv科技脱颖而出。

这是一台Atenza的Gr.3认证车型，基于Mazda全球市场版轿车并按照Gr.3组别规则进行改装。作为赛车车型的原型车，这款轿车经过改装后成为动力输出超过400马力的猛兽。值得注意的是，设计师连车身表面反射效果的流动也考虑到了。

en:
This is an original racing version of the Mazda6 for Gr.3 competition.

Mazda’s Atenza global sedan has been specifically modified for Gr.3 competition as part of this Gran Turismo Original. The exterior showcases aggressive yet refined aerodynamics shaped by Mazda’s "KODO" design philosophy. To boost structural rigidity, a bulkhead has been added behind the cockpit, along with a rearview camera to enhance visibility.
zh:
一款以Mazda的旗舰车型Atenza打造的原创赛车，专为Gr.3竞赛打造。

Mazda Atenza全球版轿车按照Gr.3组别进行改装后，成为这台跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。外观上激进的空气动力学流线遵循Mazda的“魂动”设计理念。驾驶舱后部增添了一块隔板以增加车身刚性，以及一个后视摄像头以扩大视野。

en:
This is an original racing version of the Mazda6 for Gr.4 competition.

Mazda’s Atenza global sedan has been tailored for Gr.3 use in this Gran Turismo Original. Utilizing a 4-wheel-drive platform, the car delivers exceptional traction. A Gr.3-style front grille and hood vents are fitted to assist the turbocharged 4-cylinder engine in producing its impressive 394.5 HP.
zh:
一款以Mazda的旗舰车型Atenza打造的原创赛车，专为Gr.4竞赛打造。

Mazda Atenza全球版轿车按照Gr.3组别进行改装后，成为这台跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。搭载四轮驱动系统，这款轿车具有出色的牵引力。新增的Gr.3风格大型前格栅和引擎盖通风口让4缸涡轮增压引擎得以发挥潜力，输出惊人的400 PS动力。

carNameEn: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
en:
The third-generation Mazda 6 features a flowing body style and SKYACTIV technology.

The third-generation Atenza also came equipped with Mazda’s SKYACTIV-D diesel engine. Nicknamed XD (cross-d), it was offered in three trims, with the L package as the highest specification. Thanks to features like idle-stop and i-ELOOP regenerative braking, SKYACTIV-D models achieved fuel economy figures of 52.7 MPG under Japan’s JC08 test cycle.
zh:
第三代Atenza（Mazda 6），车身线条流畅，还拥有SKYACTIV技术。

第三代Atenza搭载Mazda SKYACTIV-D柴油引擎。昵称XD（cross-d），拥有3种配置，L为最高配。利用怠速自动启停功能和i-ELOOP制动动能回收系统等环保方面的改进，配备SKYACTIV-D引擎的车辆在“JC08模式”测试中能够实现4.5 升/百公里的高燃油经济性。

en:
This Toyota/Lexus race car competed under joint regulations between the Super GT Series and DTM.

The Lexus RC F competed in the Super GT GT500 class from 2014 to 2016. New regulations introduced that year required the monocoque and key components to be shared with DTM counterparts. It ran the same turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 used in Super Formula competition. In 2016, the au TOM’S RC F scored points throughout the season, including a 2nd place finish in Round 6, ultimately placing 5th overall in the standings.
zh:
这款Toyota/Lexus Super GT赛车同样参加了德国房车大师赛。

Lexus RC F参加了2014年至2016年期间的Super GT GT500组别赛事。2014年引入的新规意味着单体车壳和主要部件的重量要与德国房车大师赛车辆等同。而使用的引擎也是Super Formula赛车同款，为2升直列4缸涡轮增压引擎。au TOM'S RC F在2016年整个赛季中有大笔积分入账，包括在第6轮中取得了第2名，赛季总成绩位列第5位。

en:
This Vision Gran Turismo is a thrilling embodiment of Audi's electric mobility initiative.

Audi Design created an all-electric Vision Gran Turismo concept. Throughout its body, design cues from the legendary 90 IMSA GTO are prominently featured. The vehicle employed a 4-wheel-drive layout powered by three electric motors—one at the front and two at the rear—delivering a total system output of 600kW (803.7 HP). Audi Sport developed a fully functional e-tron prototype, which went on to demonstrate its formidable performance at tracks worldwide.
zh:
这辆Vision Gran Turismo完美呈现了奥迪在电动汽车领域的创新性。

Audi Design设计的电动Vision Gran Turismo。纵观全车，到处都能找到Audi赛道传奇90 IMSA GTO的元素。该车的四轮驱动系统由3台电机驱动，1台在前，2台在后，系统总功率输出为600千瓦（815 PS）。Audi Sport打造的一台功能齐全的e-tron，它将在世界各地的赛道上大显身手。

en:
Taking cues from its IMSA race cars, this Vision Gran Turismo machine represents the future of Audi.

A Vision Gran Turismo model was developed by Audi Design. Two versions were conceived: one hybrid, the other fully electric. In the hybrid, a turbocharged 3.4-liter V-6 drove the rear wheels, while the front wheels were powered by an electric motor/generator unit, together delivering an impressive 950kW (1274.2 HP). The design of the car paid tribute to the iconic Audi 90 IMSA GTO race machine.
zh:
这辆Vision Gran Turismo继承了IMSA赛事车辆的精髓，代表着奥迪的未来。

Audi Design打造的一台Vision Gran Turismo。设计师设想了两个版本：混合动力版和纯电动版。混合动力版本中，后轮由3.4升V6涡轮增压引擎驱动，而前轮则连接到动能电机上，两者结合可产生惊人的950千瓦（1,292 PS）。这台车的外观来自于经典的Audi 90 IMSA GTO赛车。

en:
A unique coupe that tests the boundaries of monoform design.	

The Avantime was a specialty car penned by Patrick Le Quément of Renault Design. Its distinctive body blended the proven underpinnings of the third-generation Espace, a favorite across Europe, with a striking three-door fiberglass shell. Although coupe-like in silhouette, what set the Avantime apart were its B-pillarless side windows and large sunroof, which could be opened. A pure expression of Renault’s design philosophy, the Avantime was proof that the monoform concept need not be limited to minivans.
zh:
探索单体车身设计边界的独特双门轿跑车。

Avantime是由Renault设计部门的帕特里克·勒·奎芒设计的特色车型。大胆采用了创新的车身设计，将在欧洲大受欢迎的第三代Espace底盘与玻璃纤维三门车身相结合。虽然外观酷似双门轿跑车，但真正让这款车与众不同的是无B柱侧窗设计和可完全开启的大尺寸天窗。作为Renault品牌个性的完美诠释，这款车证明了单体车身设计不只是厢式旅行车的专属。

en:
The new flagship of the heralded supercar company was nothing short of awesome.

The original Aventador made its debut at the 2011 Geneva Motor Show, taking over from the Murciélago. Its chassis was thoroughly reengineered, now utilizing a carbon monocoque paired with aluminum subframes at both ends, replacing the steel tube frame of its predecessor. Thanks to the extensive use of carbon fiber and aluminum, the SV achieved an impressively low dry weight of just 3472 lbs for a car in this class.
zh:
Lamborghini全新研发的旗舰车型。

Aventador接棒Murcielago，在2011年日内瓦车展首次亮相。车身几乎完全重新设计，采用碳纤维单体车壳，前后铝材副车架取代了前代车型的钢管空间车架。由于车体主要由碳纤维和铝制成，它相对于同车型来说也非常轻，净重仅为1,575 公斤。

en:
The top-of-the-line version of the Aventador wore the revered SV badge.

Lamborghini’s flagship models had long featured V-12 engines, but their most extreme variants carried the Superveloce (SV) badge. Translated as "super fast" in Italian, the designation traced its origins back to the legendary Miura. The Aventador SV variant was introduced in 2015, delivering 49.3 HP more than the base model for a total output of 739.6 HP.
zh:
Aventador的旗舰车型，装饰有尊贵的SV徽标。

Lamborghini旗舰车型传统上一直搭载的是V12引擎，只有具备最高性能的车型才能冠以“Superveloce” （SV）徽标。这一“超快”之名最早被传奇经典Miura系列所采用。Aventador SV版在2015年推出，最大动力相较基础版提升了50 PS，达到750 PS。

en:
This wonderful kei sports car offered style and driving excitement never before seen in Japan.

Launched in 1991, the Honda Beat helped spark the boom in lightweight two-seat sports cars. Tipping the scales at just 1675 lbs, it also delivered near-perfect balance with a 43:57 front-to-rear weight ratio. Its engine, infused with F1-derived technology and paired with a short-stroke transmission, delivered a driving experience like no other. And you didn’t need mountain roads to enjoy it—the Beat brought pure sports car fun to your everyday drive.
zh:
可爱的2座轻型车，开起来乐趣十足。

1991年推出的Honda Beat开创了轻量型两座跑车的风潮。整车重量仅有760 公斤，并拥有理想的43:57前后重量分配。这台车凭借搭载了F1技术的引擎和短行程变速箱带来独一无二的驾驶体验。不必远赴蜿蜒颠簸的路段才能享受到Beat的乐趣，日常驾驶中同样能充分感受到这款跑车的魅力。

en:
This Gr.3 race version of the Volkswagen Beetle is on an entirely different level to the road-going model.

The Beetle Gr.3 is a racing variant of Volkswagen’s iconic compact, engineered to comply with Gr.3 regulations. The once-playful road car has been thoroughly reworked into a serious contender, with major changes including a switch from front- to rear-wheel drive and a lowered roofline to reduce frontal area and improve aerodynamics.
zh:
这辆Gr.3竞赛级别Beetle与可爱的公路版本Beetle完全是两个层次。

Beetle Gr.3是Volkswagen标志性紧凑型车Beetle的赛车版，经改装后符合Gr.3组别规则。通过将动力传动系统从前驱改为后驱，降低车顶减小正面横截面等大量改装，这台小巧的基础车型摇身一变，成为顶级赛车。

en:
This lightweight model of the 3.0 CS was stripped of all creature comforts to maximize performance.

In 1968, BMW introduced the 2800 CS sports coupe, powered by a robust 2.8-liter inline-6 engine. By 1971, the 3.0 CS arrived, an updated version with a larger engine. To compete in motorsport, BMW created a lightweight homologation model based on the 3.0 CS, naming it the 3.0 CSL. The "L" in CSL stood for “light,” reflecting the car’s reduced weight for racing.
zh:
3.0 CS运动型轿跑车的轻量化版本，去除了所有多余的配置，以最大限度地提高赛道性能。

BMW在1968年推出搭载了强劲2.8升直列6缸引擎的2800 CS双门运动轿跑。而后在1971年发布排量更大的升级版3.0 CS。为满足赛事认证需求，BMW开发出轻量车型3.0 CSL。名称中的“L”代表“轻量”。

en:
This lightweight model of the BMW 3.0 CS was developed to compete in touring car racing.

Unveiled in 1971, the 3.0 CSL served as the homologation version of the BMW 3.0 CS, featuring a powerful 3.0-liter inline-6 engine. Engine displacement grew from 2985 cc to 3003 cc in 1972, and to 3155 cc in 1973 for the evolution models, which achieved remarkable success on the European touring car stage.
zh:
这款3.0 CS的轻量级车型是为了参加房车赛而开发的。

3.0 CSL于1971年作为BMW 3.0 CS（一台搭载强大的3升直列6缸引擎的双门运动轿跑）的赛事认证车型推出。这台车的引擎排量在1972年从2,985 立方厘米增至3,003 立方厘米，并在1973年的升级车型上再次扩容至3,155 立方厘米，随后在欧洲房车赛场上取得了惊人成功。

en:
The ultimate road racer that draws its heritage from the glorious touring cars of the '70s.

This modern road racer was developed by BMW’s design team. Its exterior was sculpted to convey a striking sense of speed, even at a standstill. Power came from a 3.0-liter inline-6 delivering 404kW and 680Nm of torque (541.4 HP/499.1 ft-lb). Remarkably lightweight at just 2601 lbs, the car also achieved ideal 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution. This Vision Gran Turismo represents a striking blend of BMW’s racing heritage and advanced technology.
zh:
终极公路赛车，汲取了70年代著名房车的传承。

由BMW设计团队打造的现代公路赛车。其外观设计让车辆即使在静止时也能给人带来难以置信的速度感。强劲的3升直列六缸引擎可输出404千瓦/680牛米（549 PS/69.0 公斤力米）。整车仅重1,180 公斤，并实现了完美的50:50前后重量分配。这台Vision Gran Turismo是BMW赛车传统与最新技术的惊人融合。

en:
More than 10,000 labor hours went into this 2016 Gran Turismo Award winner.

The Gran Turismo Award was presented to standout custom cars showcased at SEMA. In 2016, the 14th award went to the Wicked Fabrications GT 51—a 1951 Ford Custom Club Coupe crafted by a team of specialists for former racing driver Bruce Leven. The project required an estimated 10,000 hours to complete.
zh:
这辆2016年Gran Turismo奖得主车款总共耗费了10000小时的设计与制造工时。

“Gran Turismo Award”大奖授予美国汽车用品改装协会大展上的最佳改装车。2016年第14届奖项颁发给了这辆由定制专家团队为前赛车手布鲁斯·莱文以1951 Ford Custom Club Coupé为基础打造的汽车。改装工程耗时约1万个小时。

en:
Cornering better than ever before. A BRZ for the Super GT.

Starting in 2012, Subaru entered the BRZ into Japan’s domestic Super GT series, competing in the GT300 class. After the release of the second-generation BRZ in 2021, Subaru transitioned to a new GT machine based on the updated model. The new car retained proven elements like the EJ20 engine, while incorporating enhancements to weight distribution and aerodynamics. That same year, the BRZ claimed the GT300 class championship, marking a historic first for Subaru.
zh:
为Super Gt系列赛开发的BRZ，弯道性能进一步增强。

从2012年起，Subaru开始携BRZ车型征战日本国内的“Super GT”系列赛中GT300组别的比赛。2021年第2代基础车型发布后，Subaru将转而开发基于第2代BRZ打造的新GT赛车。这台车在继承前代车型EJ20引擎等优势外，还优化了重量分布与空气动力学效应。2021年，BRZ为Subaru夺下GT300级别历史首冠。

en:
Subaru's first FR sports car featured a boxer engine, giving it a low center of gravity and excellent handling.

The Toyota 86 and Subaru BRZ sports cars were developed through a collaborative effort between Toyota and Subaru. "BRZ" stood for "Boxer engine, Rear-wheel drive, Zenith." The car was powered by a Subaru 2.0-liter boxer engine paired with Toyota’s D-4S direct injection system. Following its 2012 debut, the car received near-annual updates. The 2015 model notably improved both handling and ride comfort.
zh:
Subaru的首款前置后驱跑车，搭载水平对置引擎，重心降低，操控运动性十足。

Toyota 86和Subaru BRZ跑车是Toyota与Subaru携手合作开发的成果。“BRZ”分别代表“水平对置引擎（Boxer engine）”、“后轮驱动（Rear-wheel drive）”和“究极品质（Zenith）”。引擎融合了经典的Subaru 2升水平对置引擎与Toyota的“D-4S”直喷技术。该车自2012年上市后几乎每年都有升级改进。2015车款在操控性和驾驶感受方面有了显著提升。

en:
The second-gen FR sports car features a larger 2.4-liter engine.

The Toyota 86 and Subaru BRZ, both rear-wheel drive sports cars powered by boxer engines, were developed through a close collaboration between Toyota and Subaru. The series evolved into its second generation with the ZD8 in 2020. The updated platform featured a lighter yet more rigid body, while the engine was an all-new 2.4-liter boxer unit. Its peak output reached 231.8 HP. The Subaru BRZ "S" grade was positioned as a premium trim, offering enhanced interior and exterior appointments.
zh:
采用排量更大的2.4L引擎的第二代紧凑型前置后驱跑车。

搭载水平对置引擎、采用后轮驱动的Toyota 86和Subaru BRZ跑车是Toyota与Subaru携手合作开发的成果。该车系于2020年进化为第二代ZD8车型。新车身实现了重量更轻却更坚固的设计，引擎则是全新开发的2.4升大排量水平对置引擎。最大动力为235 PS。此处展示的Subaru BRZ “S”版本是配备升级版内外饰件的高端车型。

en:
Numerous chassis performance and visual enhancements by STI gave the BRZ sports car unprecedented flair. 

In 2017, Subaru introduced the BRZ STI Sport as the flagship of the BRZ lineup. It was co-developed with Subaru’s motorsports division, STI (Subaru Tecnica International). The most notable upgrade was the revised chassis setup. Handling and stability were enhanced through STI’s proprietary Flexible V-Bar and Flexible Draw Stiffener components, while custom-developed suspension parts boosted overall agility.
zh:
STI为BRZ开发的最高级别车型，进行了大量的底盘性能和外观改进。

BRZ STI Sport于2017年推出，是BRZ车系中的顶配车型。这款车型由Subaru与其赛车运动部门STI（Subaru Tecnica International）联合开发。最显著的改进是车身结构的调整。通过采用STI专有的弹性V型杆和弹性拉力加强杆部件，操控响应速度和稳定性得到显著提升，同时特别开发的悬挂部件进一步增强了车辆的灵活性。

en:
This Vision Gran Turismo machine pays homage to the Type 57 Tank, one of the glorious cars that define Bugatti's history.

This machine was conceived as a tribute to Bugatti’s storied racing heritage. Designers and engineers collaborated to craft the vehicle using cutting-edge technologies and advanced aerodynamic theory. Powered by a W16 engine with four turbochargers, it produced an astonishing 1230kW and 1580Nm of torque (1649.9 HP/1165.2 ft-lb), enabling it to exceed 248.5 mph in four sections of Circuit de la Sarthe, home of the 24 Hours of Le Mans. This immense power allowed the car to achieve a top speed of 278.1 mph.
zh:
这辆致敬Type 57 Tank的Vision Gran Turismo象征着Bugatti的光辉历史。

这台车是对Bugatti历史赛车车型的致敬。设计师和工程师携手合作，利用最新技术和空气动力学理论打造了这台车。配备足足4个涡轮增压器的W16引擎可输出难以置信的1230千瓦/1580牛米（1,673 PS/161.1 公斤力米），让它得以在勒芒24小时耐力赛的主场萨森赛车场的四个计时点中，速度可超过400 公里/小时（250英里/小时）。强劲且充裕的动力使其能够达到447.6 公里/小时（278英里/小时）的最高时速。

en:
A dream machine made to be the pinnacle of race cars and a true Bugatti.

A version of the Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo concept car has been developed in collaboration with Gran Turismo and adapted to meet Gr.1 regulations. Thanks to its wide track and 4-wheel-drive system, the base platform delivers excellent stability, resulting in a surprisingly approachable race car.
zh:
Bugatti梦幻赛车，力争立于赛车之巅。

这是Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo概念车的一个版本，由《跑车浪漫旅》与Bugatti合作开发，并按Gr.1组别规则进行了改装。基础车型的宽轮距和四轮驱动系统带来的出色稳定性，让这台赛车相对易于驾驶。

en:
A digital concept car infused with the DNA of BVLGARI.

The BVLGARI Aluminium Vision Gran Turismo draws its inspiration from the "BVLGARI Aluminium," a watch that reshaped the industry in 1998, carrying the same spirit—sporty, intelligent, essential and precise. Its design remains timeless and distinctive, reflecting a bold, conceptual approach while staying true to BVLGARI’s design DNA, rising above fleeting trends and fashion cycles.
zh:
融入BVLGARI血统的数字概念车。

BVLGARI Aluminium Vision Gran Turismo的设计灵感源自1998年颠覆腕表界的“BVLGARI Aluminium”，承袭了相同的理念：运动、智能、简约而精准。这种永恒而独特的设计体现了创新的概念精神与风格，完美诠释了BVLGARI的设计基因，超越了一时的风潮和时尚。

en:
Citroën’s versatile tourer receives a modern makeover.

The BX made its debut at the 1982 Paris Salon. It carried forward the spirit of Citroën’s iconic GS and CX models while introducing a modern, geometric design language. The styling was penned by Marcello Gandini during his tenure at Bertone. True to Citroën tradition, the car featured the brand’s signature hydropneumatic suspension system. The 19 TRS model featured here was a grand tourer-style variant powered by a 1.9-liter gasoline engine.
zh:
全面的Citroën旅行车迎来焕然一新的现代外观

BX于1982年巴黎车展首次亮相。它承继了Citroën历史悠久的GS和CX车型的设计精髓，同时呈现出现代几何美学。它由马塞罗·甘迪尼在Bertone工作期间设计。悬挂系统采用Citroën经典的液压气动技术。这里展示的19 TRS车型是搭载1.9升汽油引擎的豪华旅行车风格版本。

en:
An unconventional crossover SUV that took on the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

Following a series of internationally-focused models such as the Corolla and Yaris, Toyota introduced the C-HR crossover SUV in 2016, designed as a global vehicle for the modern era. This distinctive SUV also hinted at sporting ambitions, with a prototype version taking part in the Nürburgring 24 Hours race. Built on Toyota’s next-generation TNGA platform, the C-HR came with a choice of a 1.8-liter hybrid powertrain or a turbocharged 1.2-liter inline-4. The C-HR would go on to earn broad acclaim, becoming a bestseller.
zh:
这款非传统跨界SUV曾征战过纽博格林24小时耐力赛。

继Corolla和Yaris等多款面向国际市场的车型之后，Toyota于2016年推出了C-HR跨界SUV，这是专为21世纪打造的全新全球化车型。这款非传统SUV同样展现出作为跑车的野心，其原型车曾参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛。车身采用新一代TNGA平台，搭载1.8升混合动力单元或1.2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。C-HR获得了广泛认可，成为畅销车型。

en:
The sports grade model of the 6th generation Camaro with the 6.2-liter LT1 engine.

The sixth-generation Camaro made its debut in 2015. While the exterior continued the retro-modern theme of its predecessor, the underlying structure featured an entirely new design. Built on the new Alpha platform, the car employed aluminum extensively, resulting in 28 percent more rigidity and a weight reduction of 198 lbs. The SS performance model came equipped with a 6.2-liter V-8 engine, and included 20-inch wheels and Brembo brakes as standard.
zh:
第6代Camaro的跑车车型，搭载6.2升LT1引擎。
