第六代Camaro于2015年首次亮相。外观上沿袭了上一代的现代复古概念，内部结构则是全新设计。基于新的“Alpha”平台，遍布全车的铝制部件将车身刚性提高28%的同时，还削减了90 公斤的重量。SS跑车级车型标配6.2升V8引擎、20英寸车轮和Brembo刹车。

en:
The Z28 is one of the most popular muscle cars ever, thanks to its good looks and high performance.

The original Ford Mustang was an unprecedented success upon its debut as a compact sports coupe. In response, Chevrolet set out to surpass Ford’s achievement, unveiling the Camaro as a direct competitor in the autumn of 1966. The Z28 represented the Camaro at its performance peak. This special variant featured a larger-displacement engine and an enhanced chassis, developed to meet the regulations of the Trans-Am production-based race category.
zh:
它凭借外观和速度，成为第1代Camaro系列中最受欢迎的车型。

初代Ford Mustang作为一款紧凑型双门运动跑车一经问世便引发空前热潮。为超越Ford的佳绩，Chevrolet在1966年秋推出Camaro与其竞争。“Z28”高性能车型将Camaro的实力展现得淋漓尽致。这款特别版车型搭载了更大排量的引擎，并对底盘进行了升级，以符合基于量产车的“Trans-Am”赛事组别标准。

en:
This is a restomod of the classic Trans-Am hero Camaro Z28.

The Chevrolet Camaro 1968 Race-Mod was Gran Turismo’s modern interpretation of the Camaro Z28, a car originally developed for homologation in the SCCA’s Trans-Am Series. Adorned with carbon black trim, the exterior featured a wide-mouth bumper, a large ducktail spoiler, and a center-exit exhaust. The interior featured a sequential shifter and roll cage, along with Alcantara bucket seats.
zh:
经典泛美系列赛传奇赛车Camaro Z28的复原改装。

Chevrolet Camaro 1968 Race-Mod是《跑车浪漫旅》对Camaro Z28的现代演绎。此车最初是为了满足SCCA泛美房车系列赛的认证要求而开发的。车身外侧多处点缀了碳纤维饰件，并配备了宽体前杠、大型鸭尾式扰流板以及中置排气系统。座舱内配置序列式变速器和防滚架，以及Alcantara麂皮桶椅。

en:
This version of the sixth-generation Camaro lived up to the hype, thanks in part to its 649.9 HP LT1 engine.

The sixth-generation Chevrolet Camaro made its debut in 2015. At the top of the lineup stood the ZL1, powered by the same supercharged 5.7-liter LT4 V-8 engine found in the Corvette Z06. It delivered an impressive 649.9 HP and 649.5 ft-lb of torque. In 2018, a version equipped with the 1LE performance package—which included upgrades to the suspension and drivetrain—recorded a Nürburgring lap time of 7:16.04, outperforming a number of supercars.
zh:
第6代Camaro的巅峰之作，其装配的LT1引擎可实现659 PS的马力，在纽博格林赛道上表现突出。

第六代Chevrolet Camaro于2015年发布。车系中最强劲的车型是ZL1，搭载与Corvette Z06相同的5.7升V8机械增压LT4引擎。可输出659 PS最大动力和89.8 公斤力米峰值扭矩。此外，搭载1LE性能套件的2018款车型还通过升级悬挂和传动系统组件，在纽博格林北环赛道创下了7分16秒04的佳绩，超越了众多超级跑车。

en:
The rear-drive Cappuccino roadster kickstarted the two-seat kei-car trend.

The Cappuccino was Suzuki’s entry into the kei-class sports car segment, launched in November 1991. Alongside the Honda Beat and Mazda’s Autozam AZ-1, it helped define the two-seater kei sports car boom of the era. It featured a long-nose, two-seat convertible body paired with a front-mounted engine producing 63.1 HP—the maximum output allowed under kei-car regulations. With a near-perfect 51:49 front-to-rear weight distribution, the Cappuccino left no doubt that it was a true rear-wheel-drive sports car.
zh:
前置引擎、后轮驱动的敞篷小车，在日本掀起了双座轻型车的潮流。

Cappuccino是Suzuki在1991年11月推出的轻型运动跑车。与Honda Beat、Mazda Autozam AZ-1一起掀起了当时的双座轻型跑车热潮。Cappuccino采用长车头双座敞篷车身，搭载的前置式64 PS引擎是轻型汽车法规下的最强规格。51:49的前后重量分配比印证了其纯正后驱跑车的血统。

en:
A formidable vehicle that blurred the boundaries of the compact SUV class.

The Captur was a compact crossover SUV produced by Renault. The second-generation model, introduced in 2019, measured 13.9 ft in length, 5.9 ft in width and 5.2 ft in height, giving it the stance of an SUV while preserving the agility of a compact car. It offered a broad range of powertrain options, spanning conventional gasoline engines as well as diesel and hybrid variants. Most notable among them was the E-Tech PHEV system, which incorporated hybrid technology developed by Renault’s Formula 1 team.
zh:
模糊了紧凑型SUV车型边界的全能型汽车。

Captur是一款Renault生产的紧凑型跨界SUV。2019年推出的第二代车型长4.2 米，宽1.8 米，高1.6 米，使其拥有了SUV的身量，同时仍能保持紧凑型车的灵活。它还提供了多样化的动力单元方案可选，从传统的汽油引擎到柴油或混动引擎。最为吸引人的是“E-Tech”PHEV系统，该系统主打由Renault F1车队开发的混动技术。

en:
Only 1270 examples of this mid-engine supercar were produced from 2003 to 2006.

The Porsche Carrera GT was a mid-engine super sports car produced from 2003 to 2006, with a total of 1,270 units built. Its chassis centered on a lightweight yet rigid carbon-fiber monocoque, complemented by carbon fiber subframes supporting the engine and rear suspension. Power came from a naturally-aspirated 5.7-liter V-10, derived from a race engine, producing 603.5 HP. This was paired with a 6-speed manual gearbox.
zh:
从2003年到2006年，这款中置超级跑车只生产了1270辆。

Porsche Carrera GT是2003至2006年间生产的中置布局超级跑车，总共仅生产了1270台。其底盘以轻质高刚性碳纤维单体车壳为核心，搭配碳纤维副车架用于安装引擎与后悬挂。引擎为基于赛车引擎开发的5.7升自然进气V10，输出高达612 PS。搭配6速手动变速箱。

en:
A quintessential example of the micro-truck trend that has become a hit all over the world.

Japan’s micro-car segment, known locally as kei-cars, has become an indispensable part of everyday life throughout the country. The Suzuki Carry compact truck is a classic example of the commercial kei-car segment, which includes a wide range of cargo vans and mini trucks. Introduced in 1961, the Carry has built a long-standing reputation. The model shown here is the 2012 version, the final evolution of the 10th generation. With its endearing styling and everyday practicality, the Carry has begun to attract attention from enthusiasts and users overseas as well.
zh:
这款车是席卷整个世界的“微型卡车”风潮中的典范。

日本的微型车市场在其国内被称为轻型车，已成为该国民众日常生活不可或缺的一部分。Suzuki Carry小型卡车是商用轻型车的典型代表，这一细分市场涵盖了各种货车和卡车。Carry拥有悠久的历史，最初于1961年问世。此处展示的是2012款车型，也就是第十代的最终版本。凭借其迷人的外观和出色的实用性，Carry近年来在海外市场也赢得了众多拥趸。

en:
A new design with a lower center of gravity was the key to victory for this JGTC champion.

The 2000 All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC) GT500 class saw fierce competition among Japan’s top three automakers: Honda, Toyota, and Nissan. That year, five teams fielded the NSX. They included the Castrol MUGEN NSX and Takata Dome NSX, running as official factory entries. While the Takata Dome NSX demonstrated remarkable potential, it was the Castrol MUGEN NSX, featured here, that claimed the championship. Its success came through strategic management of the weight handicaps, showcasing speed and discipline over the course of the season.
zh:
重心更低的全新设计成为了JGTC夺冠路上的基石。

2000年全日本GT锦标赛（JGTC）GT500组别由日本三大汽车制造商Honda、Toyota和Nissan展开激烈角逐。同年，共有5支车队驾驶NSX参赛。其中，Castrol Mugen NSX和Takata Dome NSX作为“厂队车”上场。Takata Dome NSX展现出惊人的潜力，但最终夺得赛季冠军的依然是此处展示的Castrol Mugen NSX。该车通过巧妙应对因积分排名靠前而增加的压舱物限制，最终夺得冠军头衔。

en:
This car brought an end to the GT-R's domination by taking the title in 1997.

The All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC) ran until 2004, after which it evolved into the current Super GT series. Toyota entered the Supra into JGTC competition in 1994. During that era, the series was largely dominated by the Nissan Skyline GT-R; however, in 1997, the Supra finally broke through, capturing the season title with the No. 36 Castrol TOM'S Supra.
zh:
这台机器正是终结GT-R王朝的勇士。

全日本GT锦标赛（JGTC）一直举办到2004年，随后演变为现在的Super GT系列赛。Toyota Supra于1994年开始参加JGTC赛事。当时赛事由Nissan Skyline GT-R统治，但1997年Supra终于从GT-R手中夺回了当季的冠军。这辆具有历史意义的赛车正是36号Castrol TOM'S Supra。

en:
The ultimate version of the extremely lightweight Caterham.

This car was produced by Caterham in 1996, more than two decades after the company inherited production rights to the Seven from Lotus in 1973. As the Superlight name implied, weight was trimmed throughout the car, making it between 77 lbs and 110 lbs lighter than the standard Seven, depending on trim. The later models from 2008 and after, were powered by a 2.0-liter Ford engine producing 262.3 HP, giving it 0-to-62.1 mph acceleration of 2.88 seconds and performance that could rival supercars.
zh:
轻量化Caterham的终极版本。

这台车由Caterham于1996年打造，该公司自1973年从Lotus手中接过“Seven”的生产权后，便一直持续生产该车型至今。正如其名“Superlight”所示，这款车在每一处都进行了减重处理，比标准版Seven轻了约35 公斤到50 公斤（具体幅度因配置而异）。2008年及之后的后期型号搭载了2升Ford引擎，输出可达266 PS，0-100 公里/小时加速时间仅需2.88秒，足以让一众超级跑车不敢小觑。

en:
A Cayman designed for motorsports and possessing all the competitive flair of the 911.

The Cayman GT4 joined the Porsche Cayman lineup in 2015 as a motorsports-focused model. It was powered by a 3.8-liter flat-6 derived from the 911 Carrera S, paired with a 6-speed manual transmission. With an output of 379.7 HP, it surpassed the base 911 Carrera in performance and incorporated braking and suspension components from the 991-generation 911 GT3. Optional equipment included a roll cage and 6-point harnesses.
zh:
为赛车运动而生的Cayman，包含了911所有的领先技术。

Cayman GT4赛车版本于2015年加入Porsche Cayman系列产品线。这台车采用了源自911 Carrera S的3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，配备6速手动变速箱。385 PS的输出远超基础车型911 Carrera，刹车和悬挂也采用了911车型911 GT3的一些部件。追加了防滚架与六点式安全带作为选装项。

en:
The highest performance model of the Cayman series in its naturally aspirated flat 6 generation.

A pure racing version was also introduced for the Cayman’s GT4 class. While it retained the same 379.7 HP 3.8-liter flat-6, it was fully optimized for competition, stripped of all comfort features and fitted with components from the 911 GT3 Cup car to maximize track performance.
zh:
Cayman系列中性能最高的车型，采用自然进气水平对置6缸引擎。

专为GT4级别Cayman赛车推出的纯赛车版本。它使用与GT4型号相同的385 PS输出3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，除此之外，还经过了完美的赛车调校，移除了所有与舒适度有关的部件的同时，采用了911 GT3 Cup上的部件。

en:
This is the WRC base model of the popular sporty coupe, complete with aluminum hood and rear spoiler.

The sixth-generation Toyota Celica made its debut in October 1993. Its futuristic design was sharpened by the distinctive quad round headlights, while a larger body emphasized its identity as a front-wheel-drive specialty car. In 1994, the GT-FOUR (ST205) appeared as a homologation model for the WRC. Its 3S-GTE turbocharged 2.0-liter engine produced 251.5 HP.
zh:
采用了铝制引擎盖和后扰流器的世界拉力锦标赛基础车型。

第六代Toyota Celica于1993年10月推出。Celica的未来主义造型因四个圆形大灯而更加鲜明，加上车身尺寸的增大等改变，进一步强化了其前轮驱动专精车型的形象。1994年，GT-FOUR（ST205）作为世界拉力锦标赛参赛基础车型问世。搭载的3S-GTE 2升涡轮增压引擎经过调校可输出255 PS动力。

en:
The rally machine that left an impression on many fans, though it only competed for a short time.

The car followed the success of the previous ST185 model, which had secured both the manufacturers' and drivers' titles in the 1993 WRC. The ST205 entered the 1994 season aiming for another championship. However, during Round 7 in Catalonia, the car was disqualified for an engine regulation violation, and all championship points were revoked. In response, Toyota withdrew from the WRC, bringing the ST205’s competition career to an abrupt end after just one season. Despite its brief time on the stage, the ST205’s bold, rally-bred appearance won it a lasting place in the hearts of enthusiasts.
zh:
尽管参赛时间不长，但在车迷心中留下深刻印象的拉力赛机器。

ST185 Celica为Toyota在1993年WRC中夺得了车厂和车手双料冠军。1994年，全新的ST205问世，志在赢得下一个锦标赛冠军头衔。然而在第7轮加泰罗尼亚站的比赛中，Celica被发现违反引擎规定，遭到取消该赛季全部积分的处罚。Toyota对此决定的回应是退出世界拉力锦标赛，ST205的征战生涯仅持续了一个赛季便告终。尽管征战时间短暂，但这款车型的英姿飒爽为其赢得了众多拥趸。

en:
The top-grade model of the Challenger, which impressed with its performance and bold styling.

This Dodge sports coupe was introduced in 1970, built on the same E-body chassis as the Plymouth Barracuda. Targeting the booming pony car segment favored by younger drivers, it was offered in both hardtop and convertible variants. The high-performance R/T (Road/Track) trim sat at the top of the range, positioned above the standard inline-6 and V-8 models.
zh:
顶级Challenger，用设计抓住了大量用户的心。

于1970年推出的这款Dodge双门轿跑，采用了与Plymouth Barracuda相同的E-body底盘。针对当时深受年轻驾驶者喜爱的小马车市场，这台车以硬顶和敞篷两种选择进行销售。“R/T”（Road/Track）是Challenger的高性能版本，在“6”和“V8”版本之上。

en:
A Demon born simply to run the quarter mile as fast as possible.

In 2008, Dodge revived the Challenger nameplate for a new third generation, honoring the legacy of the original muscle car icon. Since its return, several high-performance variants have been introduced, but the standout came in 2018. The SRT Demon was an uncompromising machine built for drag racing dominance. Tuned to deliver 840.2 HP on 100-octane or higher fuel, the Demon could storm through the quarter mile in a jaw-dropping 9.65 seconds.
zh:
这辆名副其实的Demon是为了以最快速度跑完四分之一英里而生的。

第三代Dodge Challenger于2008年推出，旨在传承初代Challenger这一经典肌肉车的传奇。此车自问世以来推出了众多高性能车型，但真正的巅峰之作诞生于2018年。这就是SRT Demon，一台专为统治直线加速赛而生的怪兽级赛车。使用100或更高辛烷值燃油时可输出852 PS，四分之一英里加速仅需惊人的9.65秒。

en:
Dubbed by some as "the vacuum cleaner," this car became an American racing icon.

The Chaparral 2J was a highly unconventional race car that competed in the 1970 SCCA Can-Am series. Nicknamed the “vacuum cleaner,” it featured a groundbreaking design with two fans mounted at the rear of the car. Powered by a separate secondary engine, these fans created powerful suction by extracting air from beneath the chassis. In effect, it became the world’s first active ground-effect race car. However, for the 1971 season, a change in SCCA regulations banned the use of auxiliary engines, leading to the retirement of the 2J.
zh:
这款车被戏称为“吸尘器”，曾让整个运动赛车界大吃一惊，成为竞速史上的一个标志。

Chaparral 2J是一款独特的赛车，曾参加1970年SCCA Can-Am（加拿大-美国挑战杯）系列赛。此车因其在车身后部安装两个风扇的独特构造而被戏称为“吸尘器”。这两个风扇由辅助引擎驱动，能够强力吸出车底空气。实际上，这是世界上首款主动式地面效应赛车。然而1971年SCCA规则的修改禁止使用任何辅助引擎，迫使这款赛车退出历史舞台。

en:
Experience rocket-like speed produced by laser pulse shock waves!

Chaparral is a legendary name in motorsport, known for producing unique race cars, and the 2X is unlike anything that came before it. The driver is enclosed within a carbon fiber body, positioned headfirst in a prone posture, as if hovering just centimeters above the track. Power comes from a radical laser pulse propulsion system, which generates thrust and downforce through the rapid expansion of air.
zh:
体会激光脉冲震荡波带来的火箭般的速度！

传奇品牌Chaparral创造了许多独特的赛车，2X这台车更是前所未见。驾驶者被包裹在碳纤维车身中，头部朝前，仿佛仅悬浮在赛道表面上方几厘米处。前所未有的激光脉冲系统利用空气的快速膨胀产生推进力和下压力来驱动赛车。

en:
This true 1960s muscle car is the envy of collectors everywhere.

Introduced in 1966, the Dodge Charger was Chrysler’s response to the muscle car wave that swept across the United States during the 1960s. It quickly gained popularity for its laid-back styling and the widespread availability of powerful, large-displacement V-8s across the lineup. In 1968, the high-performance R/T (Road/Track) variant was introduced, featuring upgraded suspension and brakes, along with the option of the legendary 426 Hemi engine.
zh:
一款真正的1960年代肌肉车，令全世界收藏家垂涎不已。

Dodge Charger于1966年问世，是Chrysler对1960年代席卷美国的肌肉车热潮的回应。这款车凭借其从容的造型以及全系搭载大排量V8引擎而广受欢迎。1968款车型推出了高性能的R/T（公路/赛道）版本，配备升级版悬挂和制动系统，并可选装426 Hemi引擎。

en:
Dodge pulls no punches with the Charger SRT Hellcat, one of the most potent sedans in the world.

The car shown here represents the most extreme performance version of the third-generation Charger, which originally launched in 2005. Developed by SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance division, the Charger SRT Hellcat adds a supercharger to the 6.2-liter Hemi V-8, resulting in 707.1 HP and 585.9 ft-lb of torque. Capable of accelerating from zero to 60 mph in just 3.7 seconds and reaching a top speed of 203.8 mph, it briefly held the title of the world’s fastest 4-door sedan.
zh:
顶级性能的Charger，速度创下世界纪录。

这款车是2005年首次亮相的第三代Charger系列中性能最极致的车型。Chrysler的高性能车开发团队SRT开发的Hellcat为6.2升V8 Hemi引擎加装了机械增压器，从而得以输出天文数字般的717 PS/81.0 公斤力米。能够在3.7秒内完成0-60英里/小时的加速，最高时速可达328 公里/小时，Hellcat曾一度是世界上最快的4门轿车。

carNameEn: Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat Safety Car
en:
This ultra high performance Charger set a world speed record, going 222 mph on the Bonneville Salt Flats.

Introduced in 2014, the Charger SRT Hellcat stands as one of the most powerful and extreme models in the Charger’s long-running legacy, which dates back to 1966. Developed by SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance division, the car produces 707.1 HP and reaches a top speed of 204 mph. This safety car version is a Gran Turismo Original model.
zh:
这款超高性能的Charger创下了全球最高速度纪录。

2014年推出的Charger SRT Hellcat或许是自1966年延续至今的Dodge Charger历史上最强劲的车型。由Chrysler高性能开发团队SRT开发，可输出717 PS，最高时速达328.3 公里/小时。这款安全车版本是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。

en:
This sister to the Toyota Mark II provides an intense drive.

The Chaser was Toyota’s midsize sedan, sharing the Mark II’s fundamental design but wearing different exterior styling. The Tourer V performance model was powered by the second-generation 1JZ-GTE engine with variable valve timing, and flooring the pedal launched this beast forward with ferocious boost. The front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout provided excellent control, making the car responsive to the driver’s inputs.
zh:
这款Toyota Mark II的姊妹车型驾驶手感极为扎实而强劲。

Chaser是Toyota的一款中型轿车，与Mark II共享基本设计，但采用了不同的外观造型。Tourer V运动版搭载了第二代1JZ-GTE引擎，配备可变气门正时系统。踩下油门踏板，这头猛兽便伴随着强劲的增压推背感向前猛冲。前置引擎、后轮驱动的布局带来了出色的操控性，能够灵敏地响应驾驶者的每一个操作指令。

en:
This monster Nova was a 2013 GT Award winner, equipped with the highest quality performance parts available.

It's an imaginative custom hot rod that made its debut at SEMA 2013. Based on a 1967 Chevrolet Nova body, it was outfitted with the supercharged 6.2-liter LS9 engine from the Corvette, paired with racing-grade components across the braking and suspension systems. It took home the prestigious GT Award that year.
zh:
2013年GT大奖获胜者，这辆狂野的Nova倾尽全力，用上最顶级的部件。

这是2013年SEMA展上亮相过的定制改装肌肉车。1967款Chevrolet Nova的车身内容纳了Corvette的6.2升机械增压引擎LS9，刹车和悬挂系统也更换了大量的赛车级部件。该车赢得了当年的“GT大奖”。

en:
A massive engine that produced plenty of power made this car a favorite for drag racing.

The Chevelle was introduced in 1964 as Chevrolet’s first intermediate-size model. The Chevelle also offered the "SS" performance trim, which reached its peak with the introduction of the 1970 model. That year saw the debut of the SS 454, powered by the LS6 engine, the most powerful production engine listed in any American car catalog at the time. It's no wonder that the SS 454 quickly became one of the most formidable and dependable contenders on the drag racing circuit.
zh:
直线加速赛的宠儿——巨大的引擎提供难以置信的动力。

Chevelle于1964年推出，是Chevrolet首款中级车型。Chevelle还推出了SS运动版，随着1970款的发布，它最终成为量产中级车中最强劲的车型。SS 454搭载LS6引擎，按当时的官方数据，这是美国汽车史上动力最强的引擎。这使得SS 454成为直线加速赛场上最具竞争力的车型之一。

en:
The successor to the ultra-high-performance Veyron.

The Chiron is a super sports car by Bugatti, introduced in 2016. Limited to a global production run of just 500 units, it serves as the spiritual successor to the groundbreaking Veyron. Built around a carbon-fiber chassis with rigidity comparable to that of an LMP1 race car, the Chiron is powered by the Veyron’s quad-turbo 8.0-liter W16, tuned to produce 1479.3 HP and 1179.7 ft-lb of torque. It can accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 2.5 seconds, and a prototype version recorded a top speed of 304.8 mph.
zh:
超高性能跑车Veyron的后继者。

Chiron是Bugatti于2016年推出的超级跑车。全球限量500台，这款车实际上是Veyron的继任者。碳纤维底盘具备与LMP1赛车同等的刚性，源自Veyron的8升W16四涡轮增压引擎经过调校可输出1,500 PS最大动力和163.1 公斤力米峰值扭矩。该车0-100 公里/小时加速仅需2.5秒，原型车曾创下490.5 公里/小时的实测最高时速纪录。

en:
One of the world's most beloved pocket rockets comes back with a vengeance.

The Civic Type R has thrilled driving enthusiasts worldwide since its debut in 1997. A new model was developed on the ninth-generation European-market 5-door hatchback, undergoing extensive wind tunnel and circuit testing in the pursuit of pure performance. It set a benchmark at the Nürburgring Nordschleife with a lap time of 7 minutes and 50.63 seconds, establishing a new record for front-wheel-drive production cars.
zh:
人气车型成功回归，在纽博格林北侧赛道创下商业前驱赛车的单圈纪录。

自1997年首次亮相以来，Civic Type R跑车便一直让全球车迷兴奋不已。新车基于第9代车型开发而成。也就是面向欧洲市场的5门款，并为追求性能经过了严格的风洞和赛道测试。该车在纽博格林北侧赛道上跑出了7分50.63秒的圈速，创下消费级前驱车新纪录。

en:
Driving feel comes first. The legendary R badge returns for the 11th generation Civic.

The sixth-generation Honda Civic Type R was unveiled in September 2022. It was based on the FL 5-door hatchback variant of the 11th-generation Civic. Powering the car was a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 K20C engine, delivering 325.4 HP and 309.6 ft-lb of torque, surpassing the previous generation in both output and response. Updates to the 4-wheel independent active damper system further enhanced chassis performance, sharpening the car’s dynamic capability on both road and track.
zh:
传奇R标在第11代Civic回归，以操作手感为先。

Honda Civic Type R历史上的第六代车型于2022年9月发布。该车基于已经发布的第十一代Civic FL五门掀背版打造。动力系统为一台2升直列四缸涡轮增压“K20C”引擎，动力和扭矩均超越第五代Type R，分别达到330 PS和42.8 公斤力米。四轮独立主动避震器系统的控制参数同样经过调整，带来更出色的底盘性能。

en:
This car represented the first Type R model that eventually dominated circuits around the world.

First introduced in 1972, the Civic is Honda’s longest-running model. In 1997, the first Civic Type R made its debut, based on the sixth-generation Civic. At its heart was the B16B—a 1.6-liter naturally-aspirated inline-4 DOHC engine that delivered an impressive 182.4 HP. True to the Type R philosophy, the car featured extensive weight reduction and upgraded suspension components. The result was a car that found success across the spectrum of motorsport, from professional racing series to grassroots competition.
zh:
第一款称霸全球赛道的Type R。

自1972年初代车型问世以来，Civic是Honda销售时间最长的车型。1997年推出了基于第六代Civic的首款Type R车型。B16B 1.6升直列四缸DOHC引擎虽为自然进气，但仍可输出185 PS。秉承Type R的传统，车身轻量化和悬挂升级等改进同样得到应用。该车深受欢迎，广泛活跃于各种专业赛事和业余比赛中。

carNameEn: Honda Civic Type R (EK) Touring Car
en:
The first Type R model tuned by Gran Turismo.

First introduced in 1972, the Civic is Honda’s longest-running model. In 1997, the first Civic Type R made its debut, based on the sixth-generation Civic. At its heart was the B16B—a 1.6-liter naturally-aspirated inline-4 DOHC engine that delivered an impressive 182.4 HP. This version is an original Gran Turismo-tuned model based on the 1997 Civic Type R (EK).
zh:
跑车浪漫旅特别调校的第一款Type R车型。

自1972年初代车型问世以来，Civic是Honda销售时间最长的车型。1997年推出了基于第六代Civic的首款Type R车型。B16B 1.6升直列四缸DOHC引擎虽为自然进气，但仍可输出185 PS。这是跑车浪漫旅基于1997年Civic Type R（EK）的原创调校车型。

en:
This car represented the first Type R model that eventually dominated circuits around the world.

In Honda’s lineup, the "Type R" designation signified production models specifically tuned for high performance. The Civic Type R first appeared in August 1997. Based on the sixth-generation EK Civic, it was powered by the B16B 1.6-liter inline-4 DOHC 16-valve engine. Thanks to Honda’s VTEC system, it produced 182.4 HP at 8200 rpm without any forced induction. The model quickly earned a reputation in motorsports, becoming a favorite among amateur racers.
zh:
第1款称霸全球赛道的Type R。

在Honda量产车中，“Type R”代表性能得到强化的车型。Civic史上首款Type R亮相于1997年8月。这款Type R基于第6代EK Civic打造，搭载B16B型1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸16气门引擎。借助VTEC系统，这台引擎无需增压即可在8,200 转每分转速下输出185 PS。这台引擎被广泛投入到了赛车比赛中，亦成为业余车手的挚爱。

carNameEn: Honda Civic Type R Limited Edition (FK8) '20
en:
What will no doubt be a collector car someday, the limited-edition Civic Type R sold out in minutes.

The fifth-generation Civic Type R made its debut in 2017. While previous models focused on enhancing the base Civic’s performance, the fifth-generation Type R was developed in parallel with the standard model from the ground up. In 2020, the lineup was further refined with the introduction of the Limited Edition model. Weight was reduced by 44 lbs through the removal of soundproofing materials and the adoption of specially forged wheels. Subtle suspension tweaks were also made to sharpen handling. With only 1,000 units produced worldwide, the Limited Edition sold out almost immediately.
zh:
经过特殊调校的限量版Civic Type R。

第五代Honda Civic Type R于2017年发布。以往车型只是单纯提升基础版Civic的性能，但第五代Type R是与基础车型同步从零开发的。2020年发布的“限量版”车型在性能上得到了进一步提升。通过拆除隔音材料并采用特殊锻造轮毂，整车减重20 公斤。悬挂系统也经过了细微调校。全球限量生产的1000台车几乎瞬间售罄。

en:
A dominating force on the touring car circuit, this fourth-generation Civic features the famous ZC engine.

In 1987, Honda introduced the all-new fourth-generation Civic. It was known as the Grand Civic, with the model code EF. Its most significant advancement was a complete platform overhaul, bringing double wishbone suspension to all four corners. The sporty Si model and the more luxurious Si Extra both featured the 1.6-liter DOHC ZC inline-4 engine. These models also found success on the track, competing in the Japan Touring Car Championship and securing championship titles.
zh:
这款称霸房车赛场的第四代Civic搭载了久负盛名的ZC发动机。

1987年，Honda Civic迎来全面换代，第4代车型正式登场。这一代被称为Grand Civic，车型代号为EF。最显著的变化在于平台升级，四轮均采用双叉臂独立悬挂系统。运动版“Si”和豪华版“Si Extra”均搭载1.6升直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴“ZC”引擎。Si和Si Extra还征战日本房车锦标赛，并成功夺得冠军头衔。

en:
The top-of-the-line fifth-generation Civic balances speed with comfort.

The Civic is Honda’s longest-running model line. The fifth-generation EG Civic, introduced in September 1991, was promoted as the “sports Civic.” At the top of the range sat the SiR grade, equipped with a 1.6-liter DOHC VTEC engine. Building on the success of the previous SiR, which had already achieved the benchmark of 100 horsepower per liter, this model delivered an additional 9.9 HP, bringing total output to 167.7 HP.
zh:
在速度和舒适性之间取得完美平衡的第5代Civic顶配版本。

Civic是Honda最长青的车型。1991年9月推出的第5代“EG” Civic以“运动Civic”之名为人所知。运动Civic车系中的明星车型当属搭载了1.6升双顶置凸轮轴VTEC引擎的SiR级别车型。这款车型在前代SiR每升排量输出100匹马力的基础上，动力提升了10 PS至170 PS。

carNameEn: Renault Sport Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy '15
en:
This super fast Clio set the compact hatch lap record at the Nürburgring.

The Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy is a high-performance variant of the fourth-generation Clio, developed by Renault Sport. This model, known as the R.S. Vision, introduced a distinctive new front bumper design inspired by the pattern of a checkered flag. It also featured updated LED headlights and taillights, along with various other design enhancements throughout.
zh:
这辆风驰电掣的Clio保持着紧凑型掀背车在纽博格林赛道上的圈速记录。

Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy是Renault Sport开发的第4代Clio的跑车版本。推出的这一版本被称为R.S. Vision，其新颖的前保险杠设计让人脑海里不禁浮现方格旗的画面。除了新的LED前大灯和尾灯，其他创新设计在车身上随处可见。

carNameEn: Renault Sport Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy '16
en:
This Clio sports model, tuned by Renault Sport, excelled on the race track. 

The Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy is a high-performance variant of the fourth-generation Clio, developed by Renault Sport. The 2016 model, known as the R.S. Vision, introduced a distinctive new front bumper design inspired by the pattern of a checkered flag. It also featured updated LED headlights and taillights, along with various other design enhancements throughout.
zh:
这辆Clio跑车接受了Renault Sport的专门调校，以实现在赛道上的最佳表现。

Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy是Renault Sport开发的第4代Clio的跑车版本。2016年推出的这一版本被称为R.S. Vision，其新颖的前保险杠设计让人脑海里不禁浮现方格旗的画面。除了新的LED前大灯和尾灯，其他创新设计在车身上随处可见。

en:
Built by Tom Walkinshaw Racing, this sporty Lutecia featured a mid-mounted 3.0-liter V6.

Originally developed for motorsports, the Renault Clio R.S. V6 possessed the 3.0-liter V-6 from the luxury Laguna, producing up to 229.8 HP. In 2002, the updated Phase 2 model raised output to 251.5 HP and introduced changes to the exterior, interior, and tire size.
zh:
由TWR开发的极致小钢炮，搭载3升中置引擎。

专为赛车运动打造的Renault Clio R.S. V6采用了豪华汽车Laguna的3升V6引擎，最大动力输出达233 PS。2002年“Phase 2”小改款动力输出提升至255 PS，外观、内饰及轮胎尺寸也都迎来更新。

en:
Making the switch from a heavy V12 engine to a lighter V8 helped this Mercedes-Benz dominate the FIA GT championship.

To compete in the newly established FIA GT Championship in 1997, Mercedes-Benz and AMG developed the CLK-GTR in just 128 days. Equipped with a V-12 engine, the car proved immediately successful, securing both the team and driver championships in its debut season. The following year, Mercedes introduced the CLK-LM as an evolution model. It made its debut at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, going on to dominate the FIA GT Championship, winning all 10 rounds and clinching the season title.
zh:
用V8引擎取代了沉重的V12引擎，这是一辆在FIA GT比赛中获得压倒性优势的赛车。

为了征战1997年创立的FIA GT锦标赛，Mercedes-Benz和AMG联手在短短128天内打造出了CLK-GTR。这台搭载V12引擎的车随后包揽了车队和车手双冠。升级款CLK-LM于次年推出。在勒芒24小时耐力赛初试身手后，CLK-LM横扫FIA GT锦标赛全10站并问鼎赛季总冠军。

en:
Lightweight and powerful, the Cobra is an American sports car icon.

Shelby developed the Cobra 427 with the goal of winning the FIA Speed World Challenge, where the team was actively competing at the time. The car was powered by a formidable 7.0-liter 427 “Side Oiler” V-8—a purpose-built race engine originally designed for stock car competition. To handle its impressive 493.1 HP output, the Cobra 427 replaced its signature side-mounted leaf springs with a modern double wishbone suspension, greatly enhancing its handling and stability.
zh:
美国跑车的典范，采用大排量引擎。

为了赢得当时所参加的FIA速度世界挑战赛，Shelby Cobra专门开发了Cobra 427。这辆车搭载了7升427 “Side Oiler”引擎，一款专门用于原厂改装车比赛的引擎。为了适配惊人的500 PS输出，该车放弃了标志性的侧边安装的钢板弹簧悬挂系统，转而采用新的双叉臂布局。

en:
Only 6 units of the legendary, and very successful, Shelby Daytona Coupe race car were ever made.

The AC Cobra had already made a name for itself on the racing scene in the 1960s, and its closed-roof variant was the Shelby Cobra Coupe. While the open-bodied Cobra excelled in acceleration and handling, it lagged behind in top speed due to poor aerodynamics. That changed with a coupe body designed by Pete Brock, which dramatically improved the car’s airflow and added more than 18.6 mph to its top speed. With its full potential unlocked, the Cobra Coupe went on to win numerous races over the following two years.
zh:
成功改进了原版Cobra的空气动力学性能，是当时横扫各大比赛的传奇。

AC Cobra在1960年代的赛车界占据了统治地位，Shelby Cobra是这辆车的双门轿车版本。AC Cobra凭借卓越的加速能力与操控性在赛场上驰骋，但由于开放式车身带来的空气动力学效率低下，让其在与对手的竞争中落入下风。得益于皮特·布洛克设计的双门轿跑车身，这台车的空气动力学得到显著优化，最高速度提升超过30 公里/小时。在真正的潜力得以施放之后，这台车在两年内横扫多项赛事。

en:
A kei car with a sports car heart, this little convertible was at home on the racetrack.

First unveiled as the Kopen at the 1999 Tokyo Motor Show, this model entered production in 2002 as the Daihatsu Copen, becoming the company’s first fully convertible kei-class car. With a rigid yet lightweight body and a specially tuned suspension, the Copen delivered sharp and responsive handling. It also drew significant attention for being the first kei-car in the world to feature a power-operated retractable hardtop. Its unique charm led to exports to markets such as the UK and Australia.
zh:
轻型敞篷车，可以参加赛道比赛。

这款车最初在1999年东京车展上以“Kopen”之名推出后，2002年作为Daihatsu首款全敞篷“轻型”车换以“Copen”之名发布。高强度轻量化的车身和特别调校的悬挂为这台车带来令人艳羡的操控性。作为世界上首台配备电动伸缩顶棚的“轻型”车，这台车备受关注，后续将出口到英国和澳大利亚等国家。

en:
A Coronet, equipped with a 7.0-liter V8 Hemi, this was one of the standout cars in the muscle-car era. 

The Dodge Super Bee was introduced in 1968 as a performance-focused yet affordable muscle car. It offered a range of powerful engine options, with the 7.0-liter V-8 producing 425 HP at the top of the lineup. True to its purpose, the car came with minimal comfort features. A facelifted version appeared in 1970, followed by the second-generation model in 1971, which was based on the Charger.
zh:
搭载了一台7升的V8 Hemi引擎的Coronet，这辆“Super”车型创下了肌肉车历史。

Dodge Super Bee是1968年亮相的一台性能十足却又有高性价比的肌肉车。该系列包含3款高性能引擎可选，其中431 PS的7.0升引擎位列性能之首。这款车的内饰相对简朴，舒适配置较少。小改款于1970年发布，在1971年这款车又全面升级为了基于Charger打造的2代车型。

en:
The origin of the American sports car: the glorious first-generation Corvette.

In the early 1950s, the American sports car market was largely ruled by European imports. It was during this time that Chevrolet introduced the original Corvette. The first models featured a forward-thinking design, combining a steel frame with lightweight fiberglass body panels. Power came from a 3.8-liter inline-6 producing 149.9 HP. Initially built as a limited run of just 300 units, the Corvette quickly captured public interest, leading to full-scale production beginning in 1954. That year, output was increased slightly to 152.9 HP, and by 1958, the Corvette gained distinctive quad headlights.
zh:
美国跑车的起源，光荣的第一代Corvette。

1950年代初，美国跑车市场多由欧洲车型所占据。Chevrolet便是在那一时期推出初代Corvette。首批车型采用了钢制车架搭配玻璃纤维板材的先进车身设计，搭载一台动力输出达152 PS的3.8升直列6缸引擎。这台车最初仅限量生产了300台，但却大获成功，最终于1954年开启大规模量产。动力输出提升至155 PS，1958款车款还新升级为4盏大灯。

en:
The seventh-generation Corvette is the first to wear the "Stingray" badge since the 1976 third-generation model. 

The Stingray name returned with the launch of the seventh-generation Corvette. Built using lightweight materials, the car maintained a nearly perfect 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution, even with its powerful 6.2-liter LT1 V-8, matching the benchmark set by the world’s finest sports cars. \r
Equipped with the Z51 performance package, with features such as an electronic LSD, dry sump lubrication, and high-performance brakes, the car was able to accelerate from zero to 60 mph in just 3.8 seconds.
zh:
第7代Corvette，传奇魔鬼鱼的徽标名不虚传。

“Stingray”之名随着第7代Corvette再度登场。车身采用了轻量化材料，因此即便搭载了6.2升V8 LT1引擎，也能实现所有世界最佳车型具备的接近50:50前后重量比的黄金标准。Z51性能套件增加了电子防滑差速器、干油底壳润滑系统、一体式制动器等功能，让这台车能够在3.8秒内完成0-60英里/小时（0-100 公里/小时）的加速。

carNameEn: Chevrolet Corvette C7 Gr.3 Road Car
en:
The daunting Stingray badge returns with the 7th-gen Chevrolet Corvette. 

A homologation model of the C7 Gr.3, a race-prepped version of the final front-engine Corvette, meets Gr.3 competition standards. Visually, it stands out with a bold design that pushes right up to the 80.7 inches width limit allowed in the category. Despite its broad stance, the car is exceptionally agile, with race-spec suspension allowing for quick and precise cornering, revealing its true identity as a purpose-built performance machine
zh:
第7代Corvette，传奇魔鬼鱼的徽标名不虚传。 

C7是Corvette最后一款引擎前置的车型，C7 Gr.3按照Gr.3组别规则接受了改装，而这是它的赛事认证车型。这台车充分利用了Gr.3组别2,050毫米的宽度限制，实现了引人注目的外观。性能方面，庞大的车身丝毫不影响其出色的过弯本领，而赛车级悬挂让其能够快速、灵活地做出动作。

en:
The daunting Stingray moniker was resurrected with the seventh-generation Chevrolet Corvette. 

This Gran Turismo Original took the final front-engine Corvette—the C7—and transformed it to meet Gr.3 regulations. Its exterior has been purpose-built for endurance racing, featuring prominent fog lamps and a distinctively shaped rear wing. Underneath, the raw acceleration of the large-displacement V-8 combined with the sharp, balanced handling of a front-mid-engine layout showcases what a front-engine/rear-drive race car should be.
zh:
第7代Corvette，传奇魔鬼鱼的徽标名不虚传。

C7是Corvette最后一款引擎前置的车型，这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型将其按照Gr.3组别规则进行了改装。配备了用于耐力赛的大型雾灯和形状独特的后扰流板。大排量V8引擎的加速性能和前中置布局带来的灵活过弯能力，让其成为“FR”赛车的教科书级典范。

en:
The daunting Stingray badge returns with the 7th-gen Chevrolet Corvette. 

This Gran Turismo Original reimagines the C7—the final front-engine Corvette—to meet Gr.4 regulations. It retains the base car’s predictable cornering behavior, resulting in a confidence-inspiring driving experience. With impressive straight-line speed to match, it allows drivers to stay competitive across every section of the track.
zh:
第7代Corvette，传奇魔鬼鱼的徽标名不虚传。 

C7是Corvette最后一款引擎前置的车型，这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型将其按照Gr.4组别规则进行了改装。原型车出色、可控的过弯特性带来了非常良好的驾驶体验。它还拥有出色的直线速度，让车手能在赛道的任何位置轻松赶上对手。

en:
One of the last of the C7 Corvettes and also the most powerful.

The ZR1 was introduced near the end of the C7 Corvette’s production run, becoming the most powerful version of the generation. Under the hood, the supercharged 6.2-liter LT5 V-8 delivered 754.4 HP and 969 Nm (714.6 ft-lb) of torque. Its aerodynamic components were developed in collaboration with Pratt & Miller Engineering, which campaigned the C7 in GT racing. Buyers could choose between a model focused on lap times, or one maximizing top speed. A ZR1 equipped with the high-speed package was capable of reaching an impressive 214.9 mph.
zh:
C7 Corvette的最后一批车型之一，也是性能最强大的车款。

在C7 Corvette生命周期尾声推出的ZR1是该系列的最强版本。6.2升V8机械增压“LT5”引擎现能够输出765 PS/969牛米（98.8 公斤力米）。该车的空气动力学部件是与Pratt & Miller Engineering（设计制造了用于参加GT比赛的C7）共同开发的，总共有两款套件，一款是为了实现最快的单圈速度，另一款专为达到最高时速设计。采用最高时速套件的车辆速度可达345.8 公里/小时。

en:
A new generation mid-engine Corvette.

Released in 2019, the eighth-generation Corvette became the first in the lineup to adopt a mid-engine layout—a major departure from the traditional front-engine design. At its core was the new 6.2-liter LT2 V-8, producing 495.1 HP and 470.1 ft-lb of torque, paired with an 8-speed dual-clutch gearbox. Although it left behind the Corvette’s signature long-nose silhouette, the C8 delivered outstanding performance, particularly in GT racing.
zh:
全新一代中置布局Corvette。

2019年发布的第8代Corvette在动力总成上迎来重大变革，成为该系列首款采用中置布局的车型。全新6.2升V8“LT2”引擎输出可达502 PS/65.0 公斤力米，搭配8速双离合变速箱。虽然标志性的长车鼻不复存在，但凭借现代化的性能特质，它在GT赛事的核心组别里表现尤为惊艳。

en:
The Stingray version of the alluring 3rd-gen Corvette translated to more performance all around.

The 1968 Corvette Stingray drew its design inspiration from the Mako Shark II concept, which reimagined the Corvette as a sleek grand tourer. In 1969, the base engine displacement was increased from 327 to 350 cubic inches, although output remained at 295.9 HP. The following year, Chevrolet introduced the LT1 engine, producing 364.9 HP. This version earned praise for being the best handling C3 Corvette.
zh:
第3代Corvette，出类拔萃的内饰与外形设计均传承自Mako Shark II型的设计理念。

1968款Corvette Stingray设计承袭“Mako Shark II”概念车，后者重新诠释了高性能豪华旅行车的理念。1969年基础车型的引擎排量从327ci增至350ci，但动力输出指标维持在300 PS。次年引入的370 PSLT1引擎被誉为所有C3 Corvette中操控性最佳的一款。

carNameEn: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63
en:
This second-generation Corvette sports car was based on the Stingray race machine.

This generation played a pivotal role in cementing the Corvette’s reputation as the king of American sports cars. Its futuristic yet refined design captivated audiences worldwide. Its performance was equally impressive, thanks to a 5.4-liter OHV V-8 engine producing more than 295.9 HP, combined with 4-wheel independent suspension and a short wheelbase.
zh:
第2代Corvette，基于Stingray Racer打造的一款跑车。

正是这款车让Corvette成为了美国跑车之王。由Stingray启发，兼具未来感和优雅的车身让全世界为之着迷。性能方面也非常出色：搭载的5.4升顶置阀门V8引擎输出超过300 PS，配备四轮独立悬挂和短轴距。

en:
An electric hypercar that offered a glimpse into the future of the Corvette.

The Corvette CX Concept was an all-wheel drive electric hypercar. At its core was a fan-powered downforce system, using fighter jet–style thrust vectoring to precisely balance aerodynamic forces between the front and rear.  This advanced setup allowed for more than 2,000 horsepower generated by four electric motors. Engineered to feel equally at home on both road and track, the CX Concept represented a bold new vision for the Corvette legacy.
zh:
令人窥见Corvette未来的电动终极跑车。

Corvette CX Concept是一款采用全轮驱动的电动终极跑车。该车配备风扇驱动下压力系统，通过类似战斗机的推力矢量控制技术，实现前后下压力的精确平衡。这一系统可以有效控制四台电机输出的超过2000马力的强劲动力。这款车既能轻松应对公路驾驶又适合赛道竞技，代表了美国跑车的未来发展方向。

carNameEn: Chevrolet Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept
sourceName: Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept
en:
A futuristic GT racer born from the Corvette lineage.	

The Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept is a track-only model based on the Corvette CX Concept. With enhanced aerodynamics and a dramatically lower ride height, it offers even greater performance capability. Under the skin, a hybrid powertrain combines electric motors with an e-fuel–driven engine, delivering the speed, endurance, and efficiency demanded by endurance racing.
zh:
诞生自Corvette车系的未来主义GT赛车。

Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept是基于Corvette CX Concept打造的纯赛道版本。相比其原型CX Concept，这款车拥有更出色的空气动力学性能和更小的离地间隙。该车搭载混合动力系统，电子燃料与电力驱动的组合，满足了耐力赛对高性能和长续航的双重要求。

en:
The Stingray version of the alluring 3rd-gen Corvette translated to more performance all around.

The 1968 Corvette Stingray drew its design inspiration from the Mako Shark II concept, which reimagined the Corvette as a sleek grand tourer. In 1969, the base engine displacement was increased from 327 to 350 cubic inches, although output remained at 295.9 HP. The following year, Chevrolet introduced the LT1 engine, producing 364.9 HP. This version earned praise for being the best handling C3 Corvette.
zh:
第3代Corvette，出类拔萃的内饰与外形设计均传承自Mako Shark II型的设计理念。

1968款Corvette Stingray设计承袭“Mako Shark II”概念车，后者重新诠释了高性能豪华旅行车的理念。1969年基础车型的引擎排量从327ci增至350ci，但动力输出指标维持在300 PS。次年引入的370 PSLT1引擎被誉为所有C3 Corvette中操控性最佳的一款。

en:
The '59 concept embodied a styling that swept the world and remains a part of Corvette history.

The original Chevrolet Corvette earned numerous race victories. The Corvette SS, a purpose-built race car developed under the direction of GM engineer Zora Arkus-Duntov, featured a 364.9 HP fuel-injected 283 cubic inch engine, and was capable of reaching a top speed of 181.4 mph. However, following a major incident in NASCAR, the AMA imposed a ban on factory-backed race programs. The Stingray Racer was introduced as the successor to the Corvette SS and went on to win the SCCA Class C Modified title in 1959 and 1960.
zh:
席卷全球的先进设计风格持续数年，也未见衰减。

初代Chevrolet Corvette获奖无数。由GM工程师佐拉·邓托夫主导设计的Corvette SS搭载370 PS的燃油助喷283引擎，最高速度达292 公里/小时。然而，在NASCAR发生的一起重大事故后，美国汽车制造商协会开始禁止汽车制造商参与比赛，该项目也被迫中止。Stingray Racer接替SS，在1959和1960年蝉联SCCA Class C改装车比赛的冠军。

en:
The top-of-the-line variant of the fifth-generation Corvette revives the classic Z06 moniker.

The Corvette C5 lineup expanded in 1999 with the addition of a hardtop model, which increased body rigidity and improved performance. Even more appealing to enthusiasts was its lower price point compared to the standard model, which helped it gain strong support. In 2001, Chevrolet pushed the C5 platform even further with the Z06. Inspired by the spirit of the C2, it delivered outstanding performance and held the highest top speed of any production Corvette of its time.
zh:
第五代Corvette产品线中的巅峰之作，让Z06这个经典名字重新问世。

1999年增列的Corvette C5硬顶车型利用新增的车体刚度优化了驾驶性能。更重要的是，新车型的售价低于标准车型，这也为它赢得了爱好者的广泛支持。2001年性能再度升级后的进化车型Z06让人联想到C2，并跻身全球量产车时速巅峰。

en:
The 6th-gen Corvette ZR1 set one of the fastest lap times ever for a production car at the Nürburgring.

From the debut of the C6 Z06 in 2005, the Chevrolet Corvette began to show not only the styling but also the performance credentials of a true supercar. By 2008, the ZR1 had taken things even further, matching its high-end rivals from Ferrari and Lamborghini in raw performance. Its supercharged 6.2-liter V-8 produced 638.1 HP, and with a curb weight of just 3325 lbs, it posted a Nürburgring lap time faster than that of the Nissan GT-R.
zh:
这台高性能版C6 Corvette曾在纽博格林赛道上创下最快圈速纪录。

自2005年C6 Z06问世以后，Chevrolet Corvette便展现出超级跑车级的性能与风范。2008款ZR1在性能上比肩Ferrari与Lamborghini的同级别车型。这台车搭载的6.2升V8机械增压引擎能迸发出647 PS强劲动力，整车重量更是只有1,508 公斤，在纽博格林赛道上一举刷新了Nissan GT-R创下的圈速纪录。

en:
The daunting ZR1 badge on the 4th-gen Corvette assured world-beating performance.

The ZR-1 name first appeared in 1990 as a special high-performance package for the Corvette. At its heart was the LT5 engine, which featured an aluminum alloy block and a DOHC 4-valve head co-developed by Chevrolet and Lotus. While the standard Corvette engine produced 246.5 HP, the LT5 delivered 374.8 HP. Despite its price tag—twice that of a base Corvette—it’s said that Chevrolet made very little profit from the model, underscoring its role as a halo car rather than a volume seller.
zh:
这款C4 Corvette种类繁多的加配选项正好与他的特殊名号不谋而合。

1990年，ZR-1作为Corvette的特殊性能套件首次亮相。其核心是Chevrolet与Lotus联合开发的“LT5”引擎，该引擎采用铝制缸体配4气门双顶置凸轮轴气缸盖。标准引擎动力输出只有250 PS，而新引擎单元高达380 PS。其售价也是标准版Corvette的两倍，成为当时极为昂贵的车型。但即便如此，坊间传闻Chevrolet并未从该车型中获取多少利润。

en:
The final model of the Countach, commemorating the 25th anniversary of Lamborghini.

First unveiled at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show, the Lamborghini Countach became the prototypical supercar. The first production version, the LP400, launched in 1974 in a limited run of just 150 units. In 1985, Lamborghini introduced the 5000 Quattrovalvole, powered by a 5.2-liter engine producing 448.7 HP. The final version of the Countach was the 25th Anniversary model, released in 1988, with a total production run of 657 units.
zh:
这是Countach的最后绝唱，专为纪念Lamborghini 25周年而制造。

1971年在日内瓦车展上亮相的Lamborghini Countach堪称超级跑车的典范。首个量产型号LP400于1974年推出，限量150台。1985年推出的5000 Quattrovalvole所采用的5,200 立方厘米排量引擎能输出达455 PS的动力。1988年发布的25周年版是Countach的最后一款车型，总计仅生产了657台。

en:
The futuristic styling of this exotic car attracted quite a bit of attention from all around the world. 

First unveiled at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show, the Lamborghini Countach became a landmark in supercar history, drawing global attention with its groundbreaking design and performance. Named after a word from the Piedmontese dialect meaning “surprise,” the Countach lived up to its name in every sense. Marcello Gandini’s bold, near-futuristic styling left an indelible mark on the design language of high-performance cars for generations to follow.
zh:
一辆别具一格的汽车，其未来主义的造型吸引了全世界的目光。

在1971年日内瓦车展首次亮相的Lamborghini Countach是一款真正的史诗级超级跑车，以设计和性能吸引全世界的目光。“Countach”一词源自意大利皮埃蒙特方言，意为“惊喜”，Countach也名副其实，带来了十足的惊喜。马塞罗·甘迪尼那令人惊叹的近未来主义设计对之后多年的超级跑车领域产生了深远影响。

en:
The 14th-generation Crown sported a bold front-end design, giving the sport sedan an extra dose of flair. 

In 2012, the Toyota Crown underwent a full model change, entering its 14th generation with a bold new front-end design. The lineup was split into two distinct versions: the more conservative "Royal" and the sportier "Athlete." The Royal featured design elements inspired by a crown, while the Athlete adopted a more aggressive look with lightning bolt motifs. Together, they introduced a fresh visual identity while preserving the core values that had defined the Crown nameplate for generations.
zh:
属于第14代车型的Crown采用了大胆而新颖的前脸设计，风貌焕然一新。

2012年Toyota Crown迎来全新改款推出第14代车型，前脸得到了焕新。这一代产品线涵盖稳重的“Royal”版与运动的“Athlete”版。Royal版以皇冠为设计元素，而Athlete版则以闪电为主题，造型更加锐利。在延续历代核心理念的同时开创出全新的风貌。

carNameEn: Toyota Crown Athlete G Safety Car
en:
This Crown Athlete, converted into a safety car, was designed to patrol the race track.

In 2012, the Toyota Crown underwent a full model change, entering its 14th generation with a bold new front-end design. The lineup was split into two distinct versions: the more conservative "Royal" and the sportier "Athlete." Four different powertrains were offered across the series: a 3.5-liter V-6, a 2.5-liter V-6, a 2.5-liter inline-4 hybrid, and a 2.0-liter inline-4 turbo. This safety car version was a Gran Turismo Original design.
zh:
Crown Athlete的安全车版本，专为赛道设计。

2012年Toyota Crown迎来全新改款推出第14代车型，前脸得到了焕新。这一代产品线涵盖稳重的“Royal”版与运动的“Athlete”版。全系提供4种动力单元：3.5升和2.5升V6引擎、2.5L直列4缸混合动力引擎和2升直列4缸涡轮增压引擎。这款安全车是跑车浪漫旅的原创设计。

sourceName: CR-V  e HEV EX BLACK EDITION  ’21
en:
The fifth-generation model of this popular SUV is the first to feature a hybrid system.

In the 1990s, Honda introduced the “Creative Mover” category, launching the original CR-V in 1995 as part of that vision. By 2021, the fifth-generation CR-V had evolved significantly, with this model becoming the first in the series to feature a hybrid powertrain. A 4-wheel-drive option remained popular, offering added versatility. Its larger body improved interior space and expanded cargo capacity to over 1,100 liters. A 3-row, 7-seat configuration further enhanced practicality. Equipped with a wide range of safety features and advanced driver assistance systems, it proved to be an ideal vehicle for daily use.
zh:
这款高人气SUV的第五代车型是系列中的首款混动车。

在90年代，Honda开创了“Creative Mover”车型，并在1995年推出初代CR-V。2021年问世的第5代CR-V首度搭载混动单元。其四驱版本亦备受追捧。更大的车身尺寸不仅提升了乘用舒适性，更将货物空间拓展至1100L以上。3排7座车型也于同期推出。丰富的安全配置与驾驶辅助系统让这台车成为完美的日常座驾。

en:
The third-generation CTR was thoroughly re-engineered by Ruf, including being converted to a mid-engine layout. 

Released in 2007, the RUF CTR3 served as the successor to the iconic CTR and CTR2. Unlike its predecessors, which were based on the Porsche 930 and 993 Turbo, the CTR3 was designed entirely from the ground up by RUF. It adopted a mid-engine layout and was powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter flat-6 with intercooling. Performance was staggering, with a top speed of 236.1 mph and zero-62.1 mph acceleration in just 3.2 seconds.
zh:
第3代CTR，大量继承了来自Ruf的原创设计，包括中置引擎底座。

2007年发布的RUF CTR3是其CTR与CTR2的继任者。前代车型基于Porsche 930和993 Turbo打造，而CTR3却是由RUF从零开始设计研发。这台车采用中置引擎布局，搭载的是一台3.8升水平对置6缸中冷式双涡轮增压引擎。最高时速为380 公里/小时，0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.2秒。

en:
This crossover SUV from Mazda featured a revolutionary engine design.

The CX-30 is a crossover SUV introduced to fill the gap between the CX-3 and CX-5. Although compact in size, it showcased Mazda's signature "KODO" design, evident in its sculpted front end and the way light flowed across its sleek body lines. In 2021, Mazda released the CX-30 X Smart Edition. This version featured the innovative SKYACTIV-X engine, paired with enhanced driver assistance systems and refined pedal feedback.
zh:
这是一款搭载革命性引擎设计的Mazda跨界SUV。

CX-30作为一款跨界SUV，正是为了填补CX-3和CX-5之间的产品线空缺。车型虽紧凑，却将“魂动”设计理念中的流动美学，在前脸与车身交错的光影间展现得淋漓尽致。CX-30 X Smart Edition版本于2021年推出。该版本搭载了SKYACTIV-X引擎，配备多项驾驶辅助，踏板反馈也得到了优化。

en:
With three consecutive victories at Le Mans, this racing Jaguar featured a large fin that helped lateral stability at high speed.

The Jaguar D-Type was a racing sports car introduced in 1954 as the successor to the C-Type, with just 64 units produced in total. It's built on a tubular frame with monocoque construction. Its sleek bodywork, penned by Malcolm Sayer, was instantly recognizable by the aerodynamic fin positioned behind the driver’s seat. It made its debut at the 1954 24 Hours of Le Mans and went on to dominate the event, securing victory three years in a row through 1957.
zh:
这辆在勒芒耐力赛中连夺三冠的Jaguar跑车辨识度极高，从车手位置向后延伸的后鳍曲线显得如此高雅且流畅。

1954年推出的Jaguar D-Type竞速跑车延续了C-Type的血统，总共生产了64台。这台车采用管状车架与单体车壳结构。驾驶座后方的竖鳍让人能轻易辨别出马尔科姆·塞尔的设计。它在1954年勒芒24小时耐力赛上迎来首秀，并在1955至1957年实现三连冠。

carNameEn: DAIHATSU COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: DAIHATSU COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo
en:
A Vision Gran Turismo that represents the potential of kei cars.

The Daihatsu Copen is a compact convertible that delivers a full sports car experience while staying within Japan’s kei-car regulations. The Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo is based on the second-generation model, which debuted in 2014. While it retains the kei-standard 660 cc engine, boost efficiency has been significantly improved, allowing it to produce 146.9 HP and 149.0 ft-lb of torque. Further weight reduction brings the car down to just 1323 lbs, enabling it to perform on par with larger-displacement sports cars. This bold, aspirational machine carried forward Daihatsu’s fighting spirit.
zh:
代表微型车潜力的Vision Gran Turismo。

Daihatsu Copen是一台符合“轻型车”标准的敞篷汽车，提供完整的跑车体验。Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo基于2014年发布的第2代车型打造。在满足660 立方厘米“轻型车”排量规范下，涡轮增压效率得到了提升，带来149 PS/20.6 公斤力米的动力输出。车身进一步减重至600 公斤，从而具备与大排量跑车一较高下的能力。这台车是一部延续Daihatsu战斗精神的雄心勃勃之作。

en:
Both Toyota and Honda provide engines for the Super Formula series. This is the one from Honda.

The Japanese Super Formula series transitioned to the Dallara SF19 chassis in 2019. Equipped with a halo system that met F1 safety standards, the SF19 also featured aerodynamic enhancements over its predecessor, the SF14, making overtaking easier and improving race action. Power came from a turbocharged 2.0-liter direct-injection inline-4, with separate versions independently developed by Toyota and Honda. Despite tight regulations, a fierce development battle unfolded between the two manufacturers.
zh:
Toyota和Honda都是超级方程式比赛的引擎供应商，这辆使用的是Honda的引擎。

日本Super Formula系列赛在2019年启用Dallara SF19赛车底盘。这款底盘引入了与F1安全标准相当的HALO系统，空气动力学上较前代SF14的优化则让超车更加容易。搭载的引擎为2升直列4缸直喷涡轮增压引擎，Toyota和Honda各自开发了一个版本。两家引擎生产商在严苛的规则下展开着激烈的研发竞赛。

en:
Both Toyota and Honda provide engines for the Super Formula series. This is the one from Toyota.

The Japanese Super Formula series transitioned to the Dallara SF19 chassis in 2019. Equipped with a halo system that met F1 safety standards, the SF19 also featured aerodynamic enhancements over its predecessor, the SF14, making overtaking easier and improving race action. Power came from a turbocharged 2.0-liter direct-injection inline-4, with separate versions independently developed by Toyota and Honda. Despite tight regulations, a fierce development battle unfolded between the two manufacturers.
zh:
Toyota和Honda都是超级方程式比赛的引擎供应商，这辆使用的是Toyota的引擎。

日本Super Formula系列赛在2019年启用Dallara SF19赛车底盘。这款底盘引入了与F1安全标准相当的HALO系统，空气动力学上较前代SF14的优化则让超车更加容易。搭载的引擎为2升直列4缸直喷涡轮增压引擎，Toyota和Honda各自开发了一个版本。两家引擎生产商在严苛的规则下展开着激烈的研发竞赛。

en:
The next evolution of Super Formula cars aims to bring sustainability to motorsports

The Dallara SF23 Super Formula made its debut in the spring of 2023 as the latest machine for the Super Formula series. Developed under the “SUPER FORMULA NEXT50” initiative, the car aimed to promote sustainability in motorsports. It incorporated biocomposite materials, while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions. Engines were supplied by Toyota and Honda.
zh:
全新进化的超级方程式赛车旨在为赛车运动提供更高的可持续性。

2023年春季，新款Dallara SF23在Super Formula系列赛亮相。按照“SUPER FORMULA NEXT50”赛事可持续计划的目标，这台车采用了诸多生物复合材料，大幅降低二氧化碳排放量。引擎由Toyota与Honda独立开发制造。

en:
The next evolution of Super Formula cars aims to bring sustainability to motorsports

The Dallara SF23 Super Formula made its debut in the spring of 2023 as the latest machine for the Super Formula series. Developed under the “SUPER FORMULA NEXT50” initiative, the car aimed to promote sustainability in motorsports. It incorporated biocomposite materials, while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions. Engines were supplied by Toyota and Honda.
zh:
全新进化的超级方程式赛车旨在为赛车运动提供更高的可持续性。

2023年春季，新款Dallara SF23在Super Formula系列赛亮相。按照“SUPER FORMULA NEXT50”赛事可持续计划的目标，这台车采用了诸多生物复合材料，大幅降低二氧化碳排放量。引擎由Toyota与Honda独立开发制造。

en:
This "poisonous" 240Z, which won the 2015 GT Award, packed a naturally-aspirated RB26 engine.

This car was the winner of the GT Award at SEMA 2015. Built by actor Sung Kang, it started with a 1973 Nissan 240Z as its foundation. It was powered by an RB26DETT engine sourced from a GT-R, which was converted to natural aspiration and tuned to produce 216 HP. The car’s aggressive styling was enhanced with wide over-fenders and front and rear spoilers crafted by Rocket Bunny.
zh:
2015年GT大奖获胜者，这款“有毒的”240Z使用的是自然进气的RB26引擎。

2015年SEMA展“GT大奖”得主。这台基于1973款Nissan 240Z的定制车由演员姜成镐一手打造而成。动力单元来自GT-R的RB26DETT引擎，改为自然进气后仍然能输出220 PS的动力。宽挡泥板和前后扰流板来自Rocket Bunny。

en:
Aston Martin's successor to the DB9 featured a new futuristic design theme.

Unveiled at the 2016 Geneva Motor Show, the DB11 represented the quintessential Aston Martin. While retaining the brand’s signature silhouette, it distinguished itself from its predecessors with modern design cues. At its heart was a newly developed twin-turbo 5.2-liter V-12 producing 599.6 HP and 513.5 ft-lb of torque, paired with a ZF 8-speed automatic transmission, allowing the car to accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.9 seconds and reaching a top speed of 206.3 mph.
zh:
阿斯顿·马丁的下一代DB9，外观新颖，未来感十足。

在2016年日内瓦车展上亮相的这台车便是最典型的Aston Martin。在延续品牌标志性轮廓的同时，这台车新颖的现代设计细节与过往车型形成鲜明对比。搭载一台新开发的5.2升V12双涡轮增压引擎，输出可达608 PS/71.0 公斤力米，搭配ZF 8速自动变速箱，DB11能够实现超级跑车级别的速度，0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.9秒，最高时速可达332 公里/小时。

en:
This historic 1950s race car won the Pebble Beach Gran Turismo Trophy.

This car was a staple of the 1950s race scene. Starting with the base DB3, this car underwent extensive modifications, including a shortened wheelbase, reduced body weight, and refined aerodynamics. Its inline-6 engine, which originally produced 224.9 HP, was later tuned to deliver up to 239.6 HP. It was awarded the Gran Turismo Trophy at Pebble Beach in 2013.
zh:
来自1950年的赛车，曾荣获圆石滩车展的Gran Turismo奖项。

20世纪50年代赛车场上的常客。以基础版DB3为范本，这辆车拥有更短的轴距，更轻的车身重量和优化后的空气动力学效应。直列6缸引擎最初可输出228 PS，但经过调校后达到243 PS。这台车在2013年圆石滩车展荣获“Gran Turismo奖杯”。

en:
This classic sports car from the 1960s, as well as its most famous driver, James Bond, put Aston Martin on the international sports-car map.

The DB5 was a sports car introduced by Aston Martin in 1963. Designed by Italy’s Carrozzeria Touring, it featured superleggera construction that helped reduce overall weight. The standard model’s engine produced 282 horsepower (281.1 HP), while the Vantage variant delivered 314 horsepower (313.6 HP). It was praised as one of the standout sports cars of the early 1960s. It also gained iconic status as one of the original “Bond cars,” famously appearing in the James Bond 007 film series.
zh:
这辆60年代跑车设计的杰作因成为邦德专用座驾而名声大噪。

Aston Martin DB5于1963年问世。这台跑车由意大利Carrozzeria Touring设计，采用Superleggera超轻结构技术降低车身重量。标准车型引擎能输出285英制马力（285.9 PS），而Vantage版的动力更是高达314英制马力（318.4 PS）。它被誉为60年代初超级跑车的代表作之一。该车还因多次成为詹姆斯·邦德系列电影中的“邦德座驾”而声名鹊起。

en:
This GT1 race car based on the Aston Martin DB9, commemorated the marque's return to international motorsports.

The Aston Martin DBR9 GT1 was developed by Aston Martin Racing in 2005 for competition in the GT1 category, based on the road-going DB9. Its body was significantly lightened using carbon-fiber construction, and it was powered by a 5.9-liter V-12 engine paired with a 6-speed sequential transmission. The DBR9 made an immediate impact, winning its debut race at the 12 Hours of Sebring. It went on to secure GT1 class victories at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in both 2007 and 2008.
zh:
Aston Martin回归国际赛车运动，带来一辆基于DB9改装的GT1赛车。

Aston Martin DBR9 GT1由Aston Martin Racing专为GT1组别打造，以DB9为基础，于2005年投入生产。车身采用碳纤维结构实现轻量化，与之搭配的是一台5.9升V12引擎以及6速序列式变速箱。初战即在赛百灵12小时耐力赛夺冠，并在2007至2008年蝉联勒芒24小时耐力赛GT1组冠军。

en:
This last and most potent Delta set the WRC record for consecutive wins.

Following a dominant run of victories in the World Rally Championship, powered by the exceptional performance of the Lancia Delta, Lancia faced rising pressure from a resurgent Toyota team in 1991. In response, the marque developed the ultimate evolution of its rally icon: the HF Integrale Evoluzione. This version not only featured increased engine output but also introduced a reworked front-to-rear power distribution and significantly enhanced handling characteristics. Making its debut in the 1992 WRC season, the Evoluzione extended Lancia’s record-setting streak of consecutive championship victories.
zh:
以连续胜利创下新WRC纪录的终极Delta。

在1991年Toyota带来激烈的竞争压力之前，Lancia凭借性能出色的Lancia Delta在世界拉力锦标赛斩获连胜。这催生了Delta终极型号——HF Integrale Evoluzione。除了提升引擎的输出外，前后动力分配也得到了全面优化，操控性更是显著提升。Evoluzione在1992年世界拉力锦标赛首次亮相，为Lancia的连胜立下汗马功劳。

carNameEn: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92
sourceName: DELTA HF Integrale WRC Group A (1992)
en:
The Lancia Delta, a six-time consecutive WRC Champion.

Lancia transformed the Delta into a high-performance machine by introducing 4-wheel drive and adding a turbocharger, resulting in the HF 4WD, which first appeared in the 1987 WRC Group A class. The Delta HF 4WD would later evolve into the legendary Integrale, featuring widened blister fenders and increased engine output. With each passing year, the body and suspension received significant upgrades. Thanks to these developments, the car secured eight victories during the 1992 season, earning its sixth consecutive World Rally Championship title.
zh:
Lancia Delta的巅峰之作，连续六届WRC冠军得主

Lancia将Delta改为四轮驱动并配备涡轮增压器，打造出HF 4WD高性能车型，征战1987年WRC A组赛事。Delta HF 4WD后来再次进化为Integrale，增加了凸起轮拱罩，引擎动力也更强悍。车身和悬挂系统每年都会进行重大升级。凭借这些努力，这款车在92赛季赢得8场比赛，为品牌夺得连续第6个世界拉力锦标赛冠军。

en:
This compact diesel model from Mazda offered more luxury than you would expect from a car in its class.

The Mazda Demio underwent a full model change in 2014, entering its fourth generation with a bold new direction. Adopting Mazda’s KODO design philosophy, it showcased styling sharp enough to rival its European counterparts. One of its standout features was the newly developed turbocharged 1.5-liter diesel engine, the SKYACTIV-D 1.5. Praised for its excellent fuel efficiency, the diesel variant quickly gained popularity, accounting for more than 60 percent of total orders.
zh:
Mazda的紧凑车型，使用柴油引擎，带来远胜于同级别车型的豪华体验。

Mazda Demio在2014年迎来全面改款，推出第4代车型。新车采用全新“魂动”设计理念，造型上与欧洲车型相媲美。最瞩目的莫过于新研发的1.5升柴油涡轮增压“SKYACTIV-D 1.5”引擎。卓越的燃油经济性使其广受欢迎，柴油车型订单占比超60%。

en:
The 80-car limited-edition model that was positioned as "The Ultimate Diablo."

Based on the Diablo GT2—a full race car built for FIA GT championships—the Diablo GT was a street-legal version that had been detuned and modified for road use. Its 6.0-liter V-12 engine produced 567.1 HP and 462.9 ft-lb of torque. Weighing in at just 3285 lbs—88 lbs lighter than the Diablo SV—the GT was capable of reaching an astonishing top speed of 210 mph.
zh:
只生产80辆的限量车款，也被称为“终极Diablo”。

Diablo GT的原型为Diablo GT2，后者是专为FIA-GT锦标赛而设计的纯粹赛车。为了适应城市道路驾驶，Diablo GT不得不接受降级调校和改装。其搭载的6升V12引擎可输出575 PS和64.0 公斤力米的扭矩。1,490 公斤的重量比Diablo SV轻40 公斤，让它的最高时速达到了惊人的338 公里/小时。

en:
This collector's car took the nickname of Enzo Ferrari's son, Alfredo "Dino," who passed away at the age of 24.

An evolution of the Dino 206GT introduced in 1968, the Dino 246GT was named in honor of Enzo Ferrari’s late son. The aluminum body was replaced with a steel construction, and the wheelbase was extended to enhance control and high-speed stability. The cast-iron block V-6 was enlarged to 2.4 liters, producing 192.3 HP and 166.4 ft-lb of torque.
zh:
以Enzo Ferrari的儿子Alfredo 'Dino' Ferrari命名的特殊公路车型。年轻的他不幸在24岁就去世了。

1968年推出的Dino 206GT再度进化，并以自恩佐·法拉利已故的儿子命名。铝制车身改为钢制，延长的轴距改进了操控稳定性。铸铁缸体引擎扩容至2.4升，输出达到195 PS/23.0 公斤力米。

en:
At the request of DeLorean owners, the tuned-up Series 2 was created.

Formerly a vice president at GM, John Z. DeLorean struck out on his own to establish DeLorean Motor Company (DMC). The company’s first and only production model, the DMC-12, stood out with its bold stainless-steel body. Its signature gullwing doors quickly made it an icon, but despite its distinctive styling, the company went bankrupt in 1983. The owner of the newly reformed DMC, now dedicated to servicing and restoring original DeLoreans, answered the call from fans by releasing the Series 2 DeLorean, equipped with a 197.2 HP powerplant.
zh:
二代DeLorean，根据车主的要求进行了调校。

前GM副总裁John Z. DeLorean自立门户创立DMC。首款量产车DMC-12大胆地采用了不锈钢车体。鸥翼车门设计同样夺目，但公司却在1983年宣告破产。重组的DMC（负责DeLoreans车的维护保养）应车迷需求推出Series 2 DeLorean，搭载调校至200 PS的引擎。

en:
A performance car that boasted exceptional quality and a high level of uniqueness.

This premium compact was introduced in 2009. Although it shared its platform with the Citroën C3, it carried the DS badge and stood out with distinctive styling and a notably higher level of quality. The DS 3 Racing was a special edition released to commemorate the brand’s entry into the WRC in 2011. Developed by Citroën Racing, it featured a boost in engine output along with chassis enhancements.
zh:
赢得交口称赞的特殊车型，因为优异的性能、独特的设计和高品质而备受欢迎。

这是一台2009年发布的高档紧凑型车。尽管共享了Citroën C3的平台，承载了DS品牌的这台车造型独具、品质卓越。DS 3 Racing特别版车型的推出是为了纪念其从2011年开始征战世界拉力锦标赛的荣耀历史。这台车由竞赛部门Citroën Racing开发，引擎动力得到大幅提升，底盘也得到了改装。

en:
A historic vision of the future from France.

The Citroën DS made its debut at the 1955 Paris Salon, introduced as a groundbreaking front-wheel-drive vehicle that combined a sleek aerodynamic profile with advanced hydropneumatic suspension. It quickly earned the nickname “flying saucer” for its appearance. Development was led by André Lefèbvre, while the striking body was the work of designer Flaminio Bertoni. In 1964, Citroën introduced the upscale Pallas trim, followed by the addition of quad headlights in 1967. The DS 21 Pallas delivered refined performance from its 2.1-liter engine and remained in production for two decades.
zh:
畅想未来的法国历史车型。

Citroën DS前驱车在1955年巴黎车展上首次亮相，革命性地集空气动力学车身与液压气动悬挂系统于一身。被用户昵称为“飞碟”。这台车的开发由安德雷·勒菲弗主导，而车身则由弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼设计。1964年这款车推出“Pallas”级车型，并在1967年升级为4盏大灯。2.1升的引擎让DS 21 Pallas在性能上优雅从容，这台车也持续生产了足足20年。

en:
The masterpiece 2-seater sports car continues to inspire car designers around the world.

A 2-seater sports car released in 1961. Its refined stylings had a profound impact on sports car design all over the world. The 3.6L inline-6 DOHC engine produces 265.3 HP, propelling the lightweight 2687 lbs body to speeds of up to 130.5 mph. 7820 Series I models were produced, with most of them carried over to the United States.
zh:
这辆顶级的双座跑车是世界各地以及各个时代的汽车设计师的灵感源泉。

1961年问世的经典双座跑车。其优雅的造型风格对全世界的跑车外观设计都产生了深远影响。搭载3.6升直列六缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎，最大输出269 PS。同时，轻量化车身仅重1,219 公斤，最高速度可达210 公里/小时。第一代共生产7820台，其中多数销往美国市场。

en:
This Mustang, a 2012 GT Award Winner, possessed the heart of a Ford GT.

This is a wild Mustang build crafted by one of Oregon’s most respected custom shops. Everything from the rear seats to the trunk was stripped out to make room for a mid-mounted supercharged 5.4-liter V-8 from a Ford GT—an engine capable of producing up to 850.1 HP. Unveiled at SEMA 2012, the car took home the prestigious GT Award.
zh:
2012年GT大奖获胜者，这辆令人惊叹的Mustang体内藏着一颗Ford GT的心脏。

这台拥有猛兽性能的Mustang由俄勒冈州最受欢迎的改装厂之一打造。从后排座椅到后备箱的一切都被清空，只为了腾出空间放置Ford GT的中置式5.4升V8机械增压引擎，这将马力输出冲到了862 PS。这台车在2012年SEMA展上亮相并赢得了GT大奖。

en:
This track-ready Elantra is brought to you by the letter "N."

Introduced as the high-performance model of the seventh-generation ELANTRA, the ELANTRA N was developed to embody the N brand philosophy of “making cornering fun.” Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine producing 276.1 HP and 289.3 ft-lb of torque, it accelerated from 0-62.1 mph in just 5.3 seconds, despite its front-wheel-drive layout. It was offered with either a 6-speed manual transmission or an 8-speed DCT. Its running gear featured electronically controlled dampers and an eLSD, complemented by a robust braking system.
zh:
以“N”为名的ELANTRA，专为赛道而生。

作为第七代ELANTRA的高性能车型，ELANTRA N的开发理念秉承N品牌“弯道顽童”的精神。该车搭载可输出280 PS动力与40.0 公斤力米扭矩的2升涡轮增压引擎，尽管为前驱布局，其0-100 公里/小时加速仅需5.3秒。车型提供6速手动和8速双离合两种变速箱选择。此外，其底盘配备电子控制减震器和eLSD电子限滑差速器，并搭载了高性能刹车系统。

en:
This track-oriented Elantra was meticulously crafted to achieve victory.

The Hyundai ELANTRA N TC was a special model built for racing. Based on the ELANTRA N, which could accelerate from 0–62.1 mph in just 5.3 seconds despite using a front-wheel-drive layout, the TC model was specially outfitted according to touring-car race regulations. The wide body was equipped with a carbon-fiber splitter and a large rear wing to greatly improve high-speed cornering stability. This model was also fitted with a 6-speed sequential gearbox, with the braking and cooling parts upgraded to endurance-racing standards.
zh:
这台为赛道而生的ELANTRA，每一处细节都经过细心雕琢，只为决胜于赛场。

Hyundai ELANTRA N TC是一款专为赛道竞速而打造的特殊定制车型。其基础车型ELANTRA N虽然使用了前驱布局，仍能在5.3秒内完成0-100 公里/小时的加速。TC版本则按照房车赛规则进行了特殊定制改装。其宽体车身配备了碳纤维分流板和大型尾翼，以显著提升高速过弯稳定性。此车型还换装了6速序列式变速箱，并对刹车和冷却部件进行了升级，以满足耐力赛标准。

en:
Christened with the name of the founder, this car celebrated the company's 55th anniversary and had a limited 399-production run.

This limited-production supercar, with only 399 units built, was launched in 2002 to commemorate Ferrari’s 55th anniversary. Its sharp-nosed, Formula 1-inspired design was the work of Ken (Kiyoyuki) Okuyama, then a designer at Pininfarina. The car was constructed with extensive use of carbon composites for both the body panels and much of the framework. At its heart was a specially developed 6.0-liter V-12 producing 650.9 HP and 484.6 ft-lb of torque, allowing the car to reach a top speed of more than 217.5 mph.
zh:
作为55周年纪念，总共生产了399辆的限量版。继承了Ferrari创始人之名。

2002年，Ferrari为了庆祝成立55周年发布了这款限量399台的超级跑车。其酷似F1赛车的尖鼻车身是当时任职Pininfarina的设计师奥山清行的杰作。车身板件和大部分车体框架都是采用碳纤维复合材料制成。定制开发的6升V12引擎可输出660 PS/67.0 公斤力米，最高时速可超过350 公里/小时。

en:
The special race NSX brings to mind the bold driving styles of racers Loic Duval and Katsuyuki Hiranaka. 

This is a version of the NSX that competed in the 2008 Super GT championship. Despite facing disadvantages that season—including running with the previous year’s chassis, weight handicaps, and a restricted air intake—the car remained competitive thanks to significant improvements in both engine performance and aerodynamics. In Round 8 at Autopolis, the EPSON NSX secured a 2nd-place finish.
zh:
看到这台车，就让人联想起Loic Duval和平中克幸勇敢无畏的驾驶风格。

这台车是参加过2008年Super GT锦标赛的NSX的一个版本。在那个赛季，NSX需要面对重重不利条件，除了连续两年使用相同的主车架，还要安装配重和更小的引擎限制器，但引擎和空气动力学上的改进让其依旧保持竞争力。Epson NSX在第8轮的AUTOPOLIS/奥托波里斯赛道中斩获第2名。

en:
A WRC homologation special with a unique double-decker wing design.

Introduced in 1992, the Escort RS Cosworth was a homologation model built to support Ford’s campaign in the WRC. It inherited the 2.0-liter twin-cam engine from the Sierra, producing 223.9 HP, and featured a 4-wheel-drive system that delivered exceptional rally performance. The car proved its capability with a 1-2 finish at the Rally de Portugal, followed by back-to-back victories in the Tour de Corse and Acropolis Rally, firmly reestablishing Ford as a force in the world of rallying.
zh:
一款装有独特双层尾翼的世界汽车拉力锦标赛赛事认证车型。

1992年推出的Escort RS Cosworth是Ford为征战世界拉力锦标赛而打造的认证车型。承袭自Sierra的双凸轮轴2升引擎（227 PS）搭配上四驱系统，让这台车在拉力赛场展现出惊人性能。这台车在葡萄牙拉力赛中取得了一二带回的成绩，并在科西嘉岛拉力赛与雅典卫城拉力赛中连续获胜，重振了Ford的拉力赛豪门地位。

carNameEn: Suzuki V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special '98
sourceName: V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special spec.98
en:
A monster made for the Pikes Peak Hillclimb.

The Pikes Peak International Hill Climb is the world’s most renowned hill climb race, covering a demanding 12.4 miles course with an elevation gain of 4721.1 ft. To take on this extreme challenge, Suzuki developed the V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special—a purpose-built machine equipped with a mid-mounted twin-turbo 2.5-liter V-6 engine producing 981.3 HP. With its lightweight construction and advanced aerodynamics, Nobuhiro Tajima piloted the car to overall victory, becoming the first Japanese driver to win the prestigious event in 1995.
zh:
为传奇爬坡赛而生的怪兽车。

派克峰国际爬坡赛是全球最大的爬坡赛，赛程长达20 公里，高度变化达1,439 米。这辆搭载了中置式995 PS2.5升V6双涡轮引擎的Suzuki V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special就是专为该项赛事而开发的。凭借轻量化的优势与卓越的空气动力学，田岛伸博在1995年取得日本车手有史以来的首次全面胜利。

en:
Renault's rebellious minivan carries an F1 engine.

Ten years after the debut of Europe’s first minivan came the Renault Espace F1—an unprecedented creation that redefined the limits of imagination. At its heart resided the RS4 3.5-liter V-10 from the 1992 Formula 1 championship–winning FW14B, mounted amidships within a body crafted from aluminum and carbon fiber. Producing 788 HP, it rocketed from 0-62.1 mph in just 2.8 seconds and reached a top speed of 196.4 mph. This extraordinary machine was even driven on a real circuit by F1 legend Alain Prost, among others.
zh:
Renault旗下一款特立独行的MPV，搭载F1赛车引擎。

欧洲首款MPV问世十年后，Renault Espace F1横空出世，这是一款前所未有的性能猛兽。源自1992年F1冠军车FW14B的“RS4”3.5升V10引擎采用中置布局，车身则由铝合金和碳纤维材料打造。在800 PS的动力驱动下，该车能够在2.8秒内从0加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速可达316 公里/小时。这辆车还由F1传奇车手阿兰·普罗斯特等人在真实赛道上进行了试驾。

en:
The flagship model of Ferrari wasn't just fast, it was a technological marvel.

The F12berlinetta was introduced in 2012 as Ferrari’s new flagship grand tourer, succeeding the 599 GTB Fiorano. Built around an all-new aluminum space frame and body shell, it featured a front-mid-mounted V-12 engine. With its optimized layout, it accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.1 seconds and reaching a top speed of 211.3 mph. It also claimed the lap record at Ferrari’s Fiorano test track.
zh:
采用了F1技术的Ferrari旗舰车型。

F12berlinetta是Ferrari于2012年公开的599 GTB Fiorano的后继旗舰车型。该车采用新型铝制空间车架与车壳，配备一台前中置式V12引擎。优化后布局带来性能上的提升：0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.1秒，最高速度达340 公里/小时。这台车还一举刷新Fiorano试车赛道的圈速纪录。

en:
This original formula car adopted the spirit and performance of the mid-1980s Formula 1 race cars. 

The Gran Turismo F1500T-A was a modern tribute to the mid-1980s era of Formula 1, widely regarded as the golden age of F1 design. Its carbon-fiber chassis measured 166.7 inches in length, 84.5 inches in width, with a wheelbase of 107.0 inches. Power came from a turbocharged 1.5-liter V-6, a hallmark of 1980s F1, producing a staggering 986.2 HP at 11,000 rpm.
zh:
一款原创方程式汽车，重现了80年代中期一级方程式赛车的性能。

Gran Turismo F1500T-A是对20世纪80年代中期F1赛车设计的现代诠释，该时期常被称为F1造型的黄金时期。碳纤维制成的底盘长4,235毫米，宽2,146毫米，轴距为2,718毫米。来自20世纪80年代F1赛车经典的1.5升V6引擎在11000转/分时可输出1,000 PS。

en:
With 411.2 HP on tap, this was one of the most potent pickup trucks ever created, thanks to Ford's Special Vehicle Team.

The F-Series is Ford’s line of full-size pickup trucks, introduced in 1948. Over the decades, it became a staple of American roads and has held the title of the best-selling vehicle in the U.S. for more than 30 years. The F-150 SVT Raptor, developed by Ford’s Special Vehicle Team (SVT), was a purpose-built off-road variant of the F-150, using the same 4-wheel-drive system as its base model, for high-speed desert racing.
zh:
这款出自Ford的Special Vehicle团队之手的高性能皮卡有着417 PS的超强马力。

F系列是Ford自1948年起销售至今的全尺寸皮卡系列车型。30多年来，该广受欢迎的车款一直是美国最为畅销的皮卡车。由Ford特殊车辆开发团队“SVT”开发的F-150 SVT Raptor是一款基于相同四轮驱动系统打造的特殊越野车型，专为沙漠赛车而生。

en:
This Mercedes-Benz Formula 1 car dominated the 2017 season with Lewis Hamilton winning the championship.

The W08 EQ Power+ was developed by Mercedes AMG Petronas Motorsport to compete in the 2017 Formula 1 season.

Mercedes made a full return to F1 in 2010 after a 55-year hiatus. It splashed onto the scene as among the top four contenders in that first year, and then showed marked improvement in the ensuing years. By 2014, Team Mercedes had conquered F1, winning both the Drivers and Constructor's titles from 2014 to 2016.

But because of new regulations in 2017, there were some initial minor problems. Drivers were struggling to establish their preferred setup, and although the car was fast in mid- to high-speed corners, it didn't fare as well on tracks with lots of low-speed corners. But leave it to Mercedes to overcome its issues.

The power unit reportedly produced approximately 950ps, making it the most powerful in the field, which explained the car's excellent speed throughout the 2017 season. Drivers Lewis Hamilton and Valtteri Bottas achieved a fantastic 15 pole positions and 12 victories out of 20 races, giving Mercedes its fourth straight double titles.
zh:
这款强调动力的Mercedes F1以其无与伦比的速度主导了2017赛季。

W08 EQ Power +是梅赛德斯奔驰为参加2017年世界一级方程式锦标赛制造的车款。

在缺席长达55年之后，梅赛德斯奔驰于2010年重返F1赛事。在回归的第一年，梅赛德斯奔驰便成为了名列前四的车队，并在接下来的几年里不断增强实力，于2014到2016年间完成了车手与车队总冠军三连霸的壮举。因此，除了针对2017赛季新技术规则进行的改动之外，这款赛车似乎没有显著的设计思路变化。

但是相比去年，车手们多次出现对这款赛车的设定的不适应。它在中高速弯道中的表现很出色，却在有着大量低速弯道的赛道上表现挣扎。

它的动力单元可输出约950ps马力的动力，也是2017赛季所有赛车中最为强大的、也是最快的赛车。由刘易斯·汉密尔顿和瓦尔特利·博塔斯组成的车手阵容在20站比赛中拿下了惊人的15个杆位与12个分站冠军。梅赛德斯也在当年再一次完成了车手车队双料冠军的伟业。

carNameEn: Mercedes-AMG F1 W08 EQ Power+ (Color Variation) 2017
en:
This Mercedes-Benz Formula 1 car dominated the 2017 season with Lewis Hamilton winning the championship.

The W08 EQ Power+ was developed by Mercedes AMG Petronas Motorsport to compete in the 2017 Formula 1 season.

Mercedes-Benz made a full return to F1 in 2010 after a 55-year hiatus. It splashed onto the scene as among the top four contenders in that first year, and then showed marked improvement in the ensuing years. By 2014, Team Mercedes-Benz had conquered F1, winning both the Drivers and Constructor's titles from 2014 to 2016. But because of new regulations in 2017, there were some initial minor problems. Drivers were struggling to establish their preferred setup, and although the car was fast in mid- to high-speed corners, it didn't fare as well on tracks with lots of low-speed corners. Still, the M-B overcame these issues in time for the start of the season.

The power unit reportedly produced approximately 950ps, making it tops in the field, which explained the car's excellent speed throughout the 2017 season. Drivers Lewis Hamilton and Valtteri Bottas achieved a fantastic 15 pole positions and 12 victories out of 20 races, giving Mercedes-Benz its fourth straight double titles.
zh:
这款强调动力的Mercedes F1以其无与伦比的速度主导了2017赛季。

W08 EQ Power +是梅赛德斯奔驰为参加2017年世界一级方程式锦标赛制造的车款。

在缺席长达55年之后，梅赛德斯奔驰于2010年重返F1赛事。在回归的第一年，梅赛德斯奔驰便成为了名列前四的车队，并在接下来的几年里不断增强实力，于2014到2016年间完成了车手与车队总冠军三连霸的壮举。因此，除了针对2017赛季新技术规则进行的改动之外，这款赛车似乎没有显著的设计思路变化。

但是相比去年，车手们多次出现对这款赛车的设定的不适应。它在中高速弯道中的表现很出色，却在有着大量低速弯道的赛道上表现挣扎。

它的动力单元可输出约950ps马力的动力，也是2017赛季所有赛车中最为强大的、也是最快的赛车。由刘易斯·汉密尔顿和瓦尔特利·博塔斯组成的车手阵容在20站比赛中拿下了惊人的15个杆位与12个分站冠军。梅赛德斯也在当年再一次完成了车手车队双料冠军的伟业。

en:
An original formula car created in the image of classic F1 cars.

The F3500-A, a Gran Turismo original, was born from a deep admiration for early 1990s Formula 1 machines. It was built around a carbon-fiber chassis and equipped with pushrod suspension. Its naturally-aspirated 3.5-liter V-12 screamed to 15,000 rpm and was paired with a 6-speed semiautomatic transmission. Formula cars continue to evolve. The F3500-A stands as a benchmark—an idealized representation of just how far performance and design had advanced during that era.
zh:
一款以经典F1赛车为灵感打造的原创方程式赛车。

F3500-A是一款跑车浪漫旅原创的方程式赛车，源自团队对上世纪90年代初F1赛车的深切景仰和致敬。车辆采用碳纤维底盘与推杆悬挂。3.5升自然进气V12引擎能够达到15,000 转每分的转速，搭配6速半自动变速箱。方程式赛车始终在不断进化。F3500-A完全可以被视为衡量方程式赛车发展的标杆。

en:
Here's a V-8 version of the GT original formula car.

The F3500-A was conceived as a tribute to the early 1990s Formula 1 race cars, and the F3500-B proudly carries that legacy forward. Its most significant evolution lies in the powertrain. While the F3500-A was powered by a V-12, the F3500-B adopts a compact, lightweight V-8. Although smaller in displacement, this engine revs to an astonishing 13,800 rpm, generating more than 700.2 HP in the process. The F3500-B also offers three distinct front wing configurations for its high-nose layout.
zh:
GT系列原创方程式赛车的V8版本。

F3500-A是一款向90年代初期的F1赛事致敬的原创赛车，F3500-B则为其继任者。两者最大的变化在于动力总成。与F3500-A搭载的V12引擎不同，F-3500-B采用了更轻量化、结构更紧凑的V8引擎。虽然V8引擎通常功率较低，但这台引擎的转速最高可达13,800 转每分，从而实现超过710 PS的动力输出。F3500-B还为高鼻锥提供了三种不同的前翼选择。

en:
This special exotic machine was the last one produced under the guidance of company founder Enzo Ferrari.

This special model was created to commemorate the 40th anniversary of Ferrari’s founding. Developed using the same construction techniques as the race cars of its era, it featured a steel tubular frame combined with composite materials, including carbon-Kevlar and aluminum honeycomb structures. Its powerplant was derived from the twin-turbocharged V-8 used in the 288 GTO, tuned to produce 478.3 HP and 419.5 ft-lb of torque. This car would become the final road-going project overseen by Enzo Ferrari, and it continues to enjoy enduring admiration around the world.
zh:
Ferrari创始人Enzo Ferrari参与设计的最后一款公路车。

这是为纪念Ferrari成立40周年而推出的特别版车型。全车开发完全参照当时的赛车制造方式，采用了钢管车架和碳纤维凯夫拉及铝质蜂窝结构等复合材料。动力单元基于288 GTO的V8双涡轮增压引擎调校，输出可达485 PS/58.0 公斤力米。它也是恩佐·法拉利参与开发的最后一款公路车，至今仍拥有极高的人气。

en:
The rolling piece of mechanical art was capable of reaching a top speed of 195.7 mph.

The Ferrari F430 was a mid-engine V-8 supercar that made its debut in 2004. The newly developed 4.3-liter V-8 engine produced 483.2 HP. The chassis was developed from the 360 Modena, with key improvements in stability and aerodynamic downforce, constructed using Extra Super Duralumin aluminum alloy. This top-tier sports car reached a top speed of 195.7 mph and was available with carbon-ceramic brakes.
zh:
顶级的中置引擎跑车，最高速度可达315 公里/小时。

Ferrari F430是一台2004年亮相的中置引擎V8超级跑车。新开发的4.3升引擎动力输出达490 PS。底盘基于360 Modena开发，由超高强度钢铝制成，在稳定性与下压力方面均有提升。这款顶级超级跑车最高时速可达315 公里/小时，并选配碳化陶瓷刹车。

en:
This Italian masterpiece, equipped with a naturally-aspirated V-12 and Formula 1 technology, celebrated Ferrari's 50th anniversary.

This special model was created to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Ferrari’s founding. Developed under the concept of a “road-going F1 car,” it featured an engine derived from the V-12 in Ferrari’s 1990 "641" F1 machine, enlarged to 4.7 liters and mounted directly to the chassis. With an output of 512.8 HP and 347.2 ft-lb of torque, the car could accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.87 seconds and reach a top speed of 201.9 mph.
zh:
装备了F1惯用的自然进气V12引擎，专为庆祝法拉利50周年而打造。

这是为纪念Ferrari成立50周年推出的特别版车型。打造一台“公路版F1赛车”便是这台车的开发理念，它选择了1990年“641” F1赛车的V12引擎，扩容至4.7升后直接安装在底盘上。在520 PS/48.0 公斤力米的动力驱动下，该车能够在3.87秒内从0加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速可达325 公里/小时。

en:
At the heart of this exotic, an update to the 488GTB, is a powerful V-8 that was also in the 488 Pista.

The Ferrari F8 Tributo was unveiled in 2019 as the successor to the 488 GTB. While it retained a shape similar to its predecessor, significant changes to the aerodynamic elements gave it a refreshed, aggressive character. Its twin-turbo 3.9-liter V-8 produced 710.1 HP, resulting in a zero-to-62.1 mph of 2.9 seconds and a top speed of 211.3 mph—making it the fastest V-8-powered road car Ferrari had ever produced. Equipped with the latest in body control systems, the F8 Tributo also offered remarkable ease of drivability.
zh:
Ferrari的V8巅峰之作，拥有一颗488 Pista的心脏。

Ferrari F8 Tributo在2019年接替488 GTB首次亮相。外观上虽与488颇为相似，但围绕空气动力学的诸多细节设计上的重大变化，重塑了这款车的形象。3.9升V8双涡轮引擎动力输出达720 PS，0-100 公里/小时加速时间为2.9秒，最高速度达340 公里/小时，为V8车型之最。搭载的最新车身控制技术使其驾驭起来格外轻松。

en:
The top-of-the-line version of Jag's pure sports car has a distinctive British flair.

A Gran Turismo Original, Jaguar’s new-generation F-type coupe has been reimagined to comply with Gr.3 regulations. This race machine preserves the elegance of the production model’s design, while adopting a more aggressive stance with wide fenders. A key highlight is the swan-neck rear wing, extending from the tail lights, delivering both structural rigidity and increased downforce.
zh:
纯粹高性能跑车的终极车型，延续了著名的E-type的优点。

作为跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，Jaguar新一代F-type coupé已按照Gr.3组别规则进行了改装。这款赛车保留了原设计美感的同时，增加了如外扩的挡泥板等激进的美学元素。另一个突出特点是从尾灯处探出的，能够提供强度和下压力的天鹅颈尾翼。

en:
The top-of-the-line version of Jag's pure sports car has a distinctive British flair.

A Gran Turismo Original, Jaguar’s new-generation F-type coupe has been reimagined to comply with Gr.4 regulations. This model features a bold new look, finished in matte gray with the front grille garnishes removed. Despite its styling, the car remains approachable behind the wheel, offering stable cornering and impressive straight-line performance.
zh:
纯粹高性能跑车的终极车型，延续了著名的E-type的优点。
