作为跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，Jaguar新一代F-type coupé已按照Gr.4组别规则进行了改装。移除前格栅装饰后，哑光灰的涂装让这台车看上去力量十足，犀利万分。它在性能方面也不遑多让，具备相当的过弯能力以及出色的直线速度。

en:
The top-of-the-line version of Jag's pure sports car has a distinctive British flair.

Introduced in 2012, this sports car was created as a spiritual successor to the legendary E-type, which ended production in 1975. Initially offered only as a convertible, a coupe version was added just over a year later. This particular model is the high-performance F-type R Coupé, unveiled alongside the hardtop variant. Powered by a supercharged 5.0-liter V-8 producing 542.4 HP, it could accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 4.2 seconds, with an electronically limited top speed of 186.4 mph.
zh:
纯粹高性能跑车的终极车型，延续了著名的E-type的优点。

这款2012年推出的跑车是1975年停产的著名跑车E-type的精神续作。该车一开始只有敞篷版可供选择，一年多后增加了轿跑车款。这款车型便是与之同期发布的高性能车款——F-type R Coupé。5升V8机械增压引擎可输出550 PS，能够在4.2秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速，不过最高时速被限制到300 公里/小时。

en:
With its 'G-nose' and fender flares, this car epitomized Japanese sports car cool in the 1970s.

Making its debut in 1969, the Fairlady Z was among the first Japanese automobiles to make a mark on the international stage. The standout variant was the Z 432, which featured the S20 inline-6 DOHC engine—borrowed from the Prince R380—rather than the standard L-type unit. Producing just under 157.8 HP, it also proved its mettle in motorsports competition. The 240Z, the U.S.-spec version powered by a 2.4-liter engine, helped cement the Z’s reputation after strong showings in the Safari and Monte Carlo rallies.
zh:
挡泥板外包围和“G字鼻”，70年代最具代表性的日系跑车。

1969年问世的Fairlady Z是首批征战国际舞台的日本车型之一。标志性车型Z 432弃用标准的L型引擎，转而采用源于Prince R380的S20直列6缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎。这台动力输出达160 PS的引擎也被投入到了赛车比赛中。240Z是搭载2.4升引擎的美规车型，这台车在东非拉力赛与蒙特卡洛拉力赛上的成功更是让“Z”成为跑车代名词。

en:
This special Datsun Z was equipped with the same engine as the Skyline GT-R.

Introduced in 1969 as the top-grade variant of the Fairlady Z, the Z 432 was powered by the S20 inline-6 DOHC engine, producing 157.8 HP. Based on the powerplant of Nissan’s R380 race car, the engine gave the car a zero-to-1312.3 ft time of 15.8 seconds and registered a top speed of 130.5 mph. The Z 432 also proved itself in competitive racing. A lightweight version—the Z 432 R—was produced in limited numbers, featuring fiberglass panels and acrylic components to shed weight.
zh:
这辆Fairlady Z配备了与Skyline GT-R相同的S20引擎，只为比赛而生。

Z 432在1969年作为Fairlady Z的顶配版推出，搭载直列6缸双顶置凸轮轴“S20”引擎（160 PS）。该引擎源自Nissan R380赛车，0-400 米加速时间为15.8秒，最高时速达210 公里/小时。这台引擎也被投入到了赛车比赛中。此外，还有一款采用玻璃纤维与亚克力材料进行部件减重的Z 432 R车型，但销量寥寥。

en:
This refined Z33 model came powered by the next-generation VQ35HR engine.

An enhanced version of the Z33 Fairlady Z arrived in 2007. At its heart was the new VQ35HR engine, which raised output to 308.7 HP. A redesigned intake manifold and reduced internal friction refined the engine’s character, especially at high revs. Revised suspension settings further contributed to a flatter, more composed ride, while maintaining the car’s trademark agility.
zh:
经过调校的Z33配备了新一代的VQ35HR引擎。

这台车是2007年发布的Z33 Fairlady Z的改进版。全新的VQ35HR引擎将动力输出提升至313 PS，进气歧管的改进和摩擦的降低改善了引擎高转速时的体验。悬挂设定改进后让车身姿态更加平稳、灵活。

en:
A shortened wheelbase plus larger engine equals driving fun in this sixth-gen Z car.

Unveiled in 2008, the sixth-generation Fairlady Z (Z34) was an all-new model, although it retained a strong resemblance to its Z33 predecessor. Built on the same platform as the V36 Skyline Coupé, it featured a lighter chassis paired with a series of performance enhancements. At its core was the VQ37VHR engine, delivering an impressive 331.4 HP. Suspension and braking systems were also finely tuned, underscoring the model’s performance-focused character.
zh:
排量提高，缩短轴距，第6代Fairlady z更专注驾驶体验。

2008年推出的第6代Fairlady Z （Z34）虽与前代Z33在外观上神似，实则为全面改款。这台车与V36型Skyline的双门轿跑共享研发平台，但车身更轻、性能更强。VQ37VHR引擎动力输出达336 PS。这款性能车型还对悬挂与刹车进行了优化。

en:
This BRZ competition machine was piloted by Formula Drift champion Daijiro Yoshihara in 2017.

The 2017 Falken Tire / Turn 14 Distribution BRZ was piloted by Formula Drift champion Daijiro Yoshihara. Based on the Rocket Bunny V3 aero kit, the car housed a 7.0-liter turbocharged V-8 that delivered approximately 986.2 HP. A 4-speed transmission and reinforced drivetrain components ensured it could handle the immense power.
zh:
由2017年Formula Drift冠军吉原大二郎所驾驶的BRZ。

2017款“Falken Tire/Turn 14 Distribution BRZ”是漂移方程式冠军“阿大”吉原大二郎的座驾。该车基于Rocket Bunny V3的空气动力学套件打造，搭载7升涡轮增压V8引擎（动力约1,000 PS）。这台车采用4速变速箱与升级版传动部件，在2017赛季虽只获得第6名，但给观众留下了深刻的印象。

en:
A single-seat concept that pushes the boundaries of the hypercar genre.

The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo marks Ferrari’s first-ever virtual-only single-seater concept, drawing design cues from the marque’s legendary sports prototypes of the 1960s and 1970s. Its turbocharged 3.0-liter V-6 hybrid powertrain, working in concert with three electric motors, delivers a total system output of 1015.8 HP. Blending the DNA of Ferrari’s past icons with a bold vision of endurance racing’s future, the design is both a tribute and a statement.
zh:
一辆突破终极跑车界限的单座概念车。

Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo是Ferrari首款纯虚拟单座概念车，设计灵感来自于60年代和70年代的一众赛车原型车。3升涡轮增压V6混动引擎与3台电机配合，综合动力输出达1,030 PS。这台车的设计传承了经典赛车的基因，并昭示了耐力赛在未来的重磅发展方向。

en:
Made famous by Burt Reynolds in "Smokey and the Bandit," this was one of the leading '70s muscle cars.

This was a quintessential example of a 1970s American muscle car. The bold firebird decal emblazoned across the hood became a cultural icon, especially popular among younger enthusiasts of the era. Although it shared its underpinnings with the Chevrolet Camaro, the top-tier Trans Am distinguished itself with an exclusive 6.6-liter engine, not offered on its Chevrolet sibling, making it the pride of Pontiac.
zh:
来自1970年的头号肌肉车，核心是一颗自行研发的特殊引擎。

这是一台20世纪70年代极具代表性的肌肉车。引擎盖上的大型火鸟贴花在当时深受年轻车迷喜爱。它是Chevrolet Camaro的兄弟车型，但这台顶配Trans Am版本搭载了Camaro上不可选的特殊6.6升引擎，代表了Pontiac的骄傲。

en:
The third-generation hybrid Fit utilized i-DCD to maximize energy efficiency.

The original Fit Hybrid debuted in 2010, drawing considerable attention as the first hybrid offering in the B-segment. In 2013, the second-generation Fit Hybrid arrived, built upon the third-generation Fit platform. This updated model featured the Sport Hybrid i-DCD system, paired with a 1.5-liter i-VTEC engine to deliver a combined 137.1 HP. In Japan’s JC08 fuel efficiency cycle, it achieved an impressive rating of 85.7 MPG.
zh:
第3代Fit混合动力车型，使用了i-DCD，节能效果更好。

2010年推出的初代Fit Hybrid作为B级车中首款混动车型而备受关注。2013年基于第3代Fit打造的第2代混动版上市推出。搭载Sport Hybrid i-DCD系统，配合1.5升i-VTEC引擎能输出139.5 PS的动力。在日本JC08模式燃油经济性测试下，其油耗低至2.8 升/百公里。

en:
The RS model of the third-generation Ford Focus was the first to get 4-wheel drive. 

Introduced in 2018, the fourth-generation Ford Focus included a high-performance RS variant in its lineup. This iteration marked the first time the RS featured 4-wheel drive, complete with adjustable torque distribution for enhanced handling. New selectable drive modes, such as "Track" and "Drift," were introduced, complementing an improved chassis and damping system. At its core was a 2.3-liter inline-4 EcoBoost engine producing 345.2 HP. With a zero–62.1 mph time of 4.7 seconds and a top speed of 165.3 mph, the car delivered remarkable performance in a compact package.
zh:
这款第三代Focus的RS车型是首款使用四轮驱动的车型，已获得更高的比赛性能。

2018年推出的第4代Ford Focus系列包含高性能“RS”车型。这台第4代RS首次配备四驱系统并支持扭矩分配调节。该车新增“赛道”与“漂移”等驾驶模式，底盘与避震器也得到了同步优化。其搭载的是一台2.3升直列4缸“EcoBoost”引擎（350 PS）。0-100 公里/小时加速时间为4.7秒，最高速度达266 公里/小时，性能极其卓越。

en:
Ford's Sport Technology was on full display in this late-model, compact performance car. 

Since its debut in 1998, the Focus ST—the performance model in the Focus lineup—has remained a favorite among driving enthusiasts. The “ST” designation stands for “Sports Technology." In its third generation, the ST adopted a smaller engine than its predecessor, yet output was increased by 24.7 HP, bringing the total to 246.5 HP. Aimed squarely at purists, it retained a 6-speed manual transmission, a rare offering in a market increasingly dominated by two-pedal alternatives.
zh:
这款新型高性能紧凑车型充分展示了Ford的跑车技术。

Focus ST作为Focus系列的运动车型，自1998年首次亮相以来一直备受喜爱。ST代表“Sports Technology”。尽管第3代ST的引擎比前代更小，但动力输出反而增加了25 PS，达到250 PS。当市场很多车型开始采用双离合变速器时，这款车型坚持以全六速手动变速箱等特点迎合硬核车迷。

en:
The chassis performance of the late third-generation model shines in this rally special.

A Gran Turismo Original, Ford’s Focus global hatchback has been reimagined to meet the demands of Gr.B regulations. To accommodate the changes, air intakes have been added just ahead of the rear fenders, channeling airflow to a rear-mounted radiator. Relocating the radiator to the trunk improved weight distribution, making it one of the most easy-to-drive machines in the Gr.B category.
zh:
这款最新的第3代拉力特别款车型将底盘性能发挥得淋漓尽致。

作为跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，Ford Focus全球掀背车已按照Gr.B组别规则进行了改装。该车在后挡泥板前方增加了能将空气输送到后置散热器的进气口。散热器移至后备箱后，车身重量分配得到了相应改善，使其成为Gr.B组别中最容易操控的车型之一。

en:
The final-year model of this potent supercar came right after the company's 100th anniversary.

Built to commemorate Ford’s 100th anniversary, the Ford GT drew both its silhouette and spirit from the iconic GT40—a legend born from its sweep of the top three positions at the 1966 24 Hours of Le Mans, and its unprecedented four-year winning streak that followed through 1969. With a 0–60 mph time of just 3.3 seconds and a top speed of 205.1 mph, the GT delivered performance worthy of its heritage. A total of 4,038 units were produced over a three-year span, concluding in 2006.
zh:
这款接受了精心调校的百年纪念版车型于该年度停产。

庆祝公司成立100周年的Ford GT的造型和精神汲取自GT40，后者在1966年勒芒24小时耐力赛中包揽前三名，并在此后（直至1969年）连续四年间蝉联冠军，缔造了不朽的传奇。该车能在3.3秒内完成0-60英里/小时的加速，最高时速可达330 公里/小时。在截至2006年的3年间，Ford GT一共生产了4038辆。

carNameEn: Ford GT LM Spec II Test Car
sourceName: Ford GT LM Spec II Test Car
en:
Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.

This LM-spec race car took the 2004 Ford GT and reengineered it for the rigors of Le Mans competition. Power output was raised from the street version’s 550.3 HP to 591.7 HP, while the body—faithful in size and shape to the production GT—was reconstructed entirely in carbon fiber, bringing curb weight down to just 2535 lbs.
zh:
Gran Turismo梦幻车型，代表着勒芒传奇的回归！

这款勒芒比赛规格的赛车以2004年夏季发布的Ford GT为基础，经改装后用于征战勒芒赛事。动力输出从公路版的558 PS提升至600 PS，车身在保持原有尺寸和造型的同时，全部改为碳纤维材料，使得整车重量仅为1,150 公斤。

en:
The second-generation Ford GT came complete with reengineered aerodynamics.

Between 2005 and 2006, Ford produced the GT, a modern homage to the legendary GT40. A decade later, in 2015, a second-generation model was unveiled. While retaining the unmistakable lineage of the GT40, it introduced an aggressively aerodynamic form and cutting-edge engineering. Built around a carbon-fiber monocoque with aluminum subframes, it was significantly lighter and delivered a top speed of 216.2 mph.
zh:
Ford GT的回归，空气动力学性能经过了大幅改善。

Ford在2005和2006年间复刻了GT40，推出Ford GT，并在2015年宣布推出第2代车型。该第2代车型延续了GT40神韵的同时，在空气动力学设计上做到了极致。碳纤维单体车壳配合铝制副车架减轻车重，让最高时速来到了348 公里/小时。

carNameEn: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
sourceName: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
en:
Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.

This LM-spec machine represented a Le Mans–style reinterpretation of the Ford GT—an evolution of the 1960s GT40 legacy, infused with modern technology. Under the rear deck sat a supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V-8 producing 591.7 HP. It also featured a double wishbone suspension and a race-ready 6-speed gearbox.
zh:
Gran Turismo打造的梦幻车型，代表着勒芒传奇的回归！

这台LM GT赛车是Ford GT按照符合勒芒赛事规格打造的重制版，而Ford GT本身则是运用现代技术对上世纪60年代经典GT40的重新诠释。这台车延续了GT40在勒芒24小时耐力赛的传奇征程，并同样搭载了5.4升机械增压V8双顶置凸轮轴引擎，动力输出达到了600 PS。并且也配备了双叉臂悬挂及赛车规格的6速变速箱。

en:
This race car claimed numerous World Endurance Championship titles. 

Unveiled in 2015, the second-generation Ford GT focused on aerodynamics and speed, with a compact twin-turbo V-6 engine delivering zero–to -62.1 mph in 3.0 seconds and a top speed of 216.2 mph. In racing, Chip Ganassi Racing represented the United States in both the FIA World Endurance Championship and IMSA starting in 2016.
zh:
赢得世界耐力锦标赛的Ford车厂车队专属赛车。

2015年发布的第2代Ford GT重制版专注于空气动力学技术与极速表现，搭载紧凑的V6双涡轮引擎，0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.0秒，最高时速高达348 公里/小时。赛事表现方面，美国车队Chip Ganassi Racing从2016年起开始征战国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛与IMSA赛事。

en:
This "High Boy"-style hot rod was displayed at the Henry Ford Museum.

The car’s spirit is deeply rooted in American custom car and hot rod culture, a tradition that traces back to the 1930s. Model T and Model B Fords were often boldly modified, with exterior customizations and engine swaps for more powerful units. The V-3883, displayed in the Henry Ford Museum, features a Chrysler 331 Hemi engine producing 177.5 HP. A relatively simple yet striking example, its exposed engine cover serves as a key visual accent, capturing the essence of early American hot rod craftsmanship.
zh:
在亨利·福特博物馆展出的“高脚橱”风格的改装车。

这台车的根源可追溯至20世纪30年代美国的定制车与高性能改装车文化。在当时，Ford的Model T与Model B常被玩家进行大胆的外观改造，并换上更强力的引擎。Henry Ford博物馆展出的“V-3883”换装了180 PS Chrysler 331 Hemi引擎。此车是简约美学的典范，引擎盖本身就足以成为外观上的亮点。

en:
Toyota's sports design concept presented at the January 2014 Detroit Auto Show.

The Toyota FT-1 is a concept car created by CALTY Design, Toyota’s North American design studio, offering a glimpse into the potential future of the brand’s sports car philosophy. Its projected dimensions are: overall length, 184.1 inches; width 77.6 inches; height 48.2 inches; with a wheelbase of 107.9 inches. The design draws inspiration from Toyota’s rich sports car heritage, beginning with the iconic Toyota 2000GT.
zh:
Toyota在2014年1月的北美国际车展上推出的概念跑车。

Toyota FT-1是由其北美设计部门CALTY DESIGN设计的概念车款，用以展示Toyota跑车未来设计方向的一个切面。预计尺寸为：长度4,675毫米，宽度1,970毫米，高度1,225毫米，轴距2,740毫米。该设计让人想起由Toyota 2000GT开启的品牌跑车悠久传统。

en:
This high-powered front-wheel-drive sports car featured a number of new systems.

The FTO made its debut in 1994, marking a return 23 years after the release of the original model. Its body adopted mid-size proportions suited to the Japanese market—uncommon for its time—and stood out for its generous width and athletic stance. Three engine options were offered: the 4G93, a 1.8-liter inline-4 SOHC; the 6A12, a 2.0-liter DOHC V-6 , and a higher-tuned version of the same V-6, producing 197.2 HP. The GP Version R was a high-performance variant, featuring sport-tuned suspension, a limited-slip differential, and front and rear strut tower bars as standard equipment.
zh:
搭载多项创新系统的高性能前驱运动跑车。

FTO问世于1994年，是在初代车型发布23年后重归市场的经典之作。车身采用日本市场的中型车比例设计，这在当时颇为罕见——其相对宽大的车身尺寸尤为引人注目。该车提供三种引擎选项：包括“4G93”型1.8升直列四缸单顶置凸轮轴引擎、“6A12”型2升V6双顶置凸轮轴引擎，以及性能更强的6A12高功率调校版本，输出功率达200 PS。GP Version R是一款高性能车型，配备运动悬挂、限滑差速器以及车头和车尾支撑杆。

en:
The production run of this Ferrari was limited to only 32 units. 

The FXX K, a track-only evolution of the LaFerrari, was produced in a limited run of just 32 units in 2014. It pairs the LaFerrari’s 6.3-liter V12 with a 187.4 HP electric motor, delivering a combined output of 1035.5 HP. With enhanced aerodynamics—further amplified by the optional EVO kit, which adds 75 percent more downforce. Free from the constraints of racing regulations, this car delivers pure, uncompromised driving performance at its highest level.
zh:
这款Ferrari进化版车型只限量生产了32辆。

FXX K是基于LaFerrari开发的一款赛道专用车型，在2014年限量生产了32台。该车采用LaFerrari的6.3升V12引擎以及可产生190 PS的电机，综合动力输出达1,050 PS。车辆的空气动力学也同步得到了升级，加装EVO套件后下压力提升75%。这台车摆脱了赛事规则的限制，带来终极驾驶体验。

en:
An AWD Genesis sports sedan powered by a potent twin-turbo V-6.

Introduced in 2017, the Genesis G70 sports sedan marked the brand’s entry-level offering. It came with three powertrain options: a 3.3-liter twin-turbo V-6 producing 364.9 HP, a turbocharged 2.0-liter gasoline, and a 2.2-liter turbodiesel. A major facelift followed in 2020, incorporating design cues from Genesis’ flagship models. In 2021, a shooting brake variant—offered exclusively in Europe—further elevated the G70’s appeal.
zh:
一辆Genesis运动型轿车，四轮驱动，均由双涡轮增压V6引擎提供动力。

Genesis G70运动轿车在2017年作为入门级的Genesis车型推出。该车提供三种动力单元：3.3升V6双涡轮增压引擎、2升汽油涡轮增压引擎与2.2升柴油涡轮增压引擎，其中V6引擎动力输出达370 PS。2020年的重大改款引入了诸多豪华车型的设计元素。2021年，专供欧洲市场的猎装车型再度引发关注。

en:
A Gr.3 machine that combines luxury with competition performance.

In April 2021, Genesis revealed its vision for the future of grand touring with the Genesis X Concept. Showcasing the brand’s "Athletic Elegance" design language, it featured the signature crest grille and clean, straight body lines. The Genesis X GR3 carries this design philosophy into the world of motorsports. This innovative Gr.3 machine embodies the fusion of luxury and racing prowess.
zh:
一台将奢华气质与竞赛级性能结合在一起的Gr.3赛道机器。

Genesis在2021年4月发布未来GT跑车愿景之作——Genesis X概念车。该车采用的徽章格栅与笔直车身线条诠释了Genesis“运动优雅”的设计语言。Genesis X GR3则是传承了这一设计精髓的竞速机器。这款创新之作专为Gr.3组别打造，实现了豪华质感与竞技性能的融合。

en:
An AWD Genesis sports sedan powered by a potent twin-turbo V-6.

As the entry point to the Genesis lineup, the G70 plays a key role in introducing drivers to the brand’s appeal. Its design was refreshed in 2020 with styling cues from flagship models, and in 2021, a sleek shooting brake variant was launched exclusively for the European market. The Genesis G70 GR4 is a Gran Turismo-spec machine, finely tuned for Gr.4 competition.
zh:
一辆Genesis运动型轿车，四轮驱动，均由双涡轮增压V6引擎提供动力。

作为入门级车型，G70肩负着让驾驶者感受Genesis品牌魅力的使命。该车型在2020年进行了设计更新，采用了高端车型的美学理念，并于2021年专为欧洲市场推出了猎装版。这款Genesis G70 GR4是专为Gr.4组别比赛调校的《跑车浪漫旅》版本。

en:
A vicious hot rod with 1200HP and a nostalgic body

The 1971 Ford Maverick, winner of the 2018 SEMA “Best of Show,” was crafted by Greening Auto Company into a striking custom build. Its ride height was dropped to the limit for maximum visual impact. The 7.0-liter Windsor V-8 was equipped with twin turbochargers to generate 1199.2 HP, yet it also offered flexibility—its engine control logic could be adjusted for a more relaxed, street-friendly cruise.
zh:
在怀旧车身中塞进1200BHP马力引擎的改装神车。

这辆荣获2018年SEMA车展“最佳巡展”奖项的1971年Ford Maverick由Greening Auto Company精心打造。车身高度被降至极限，营造出极具视觉冲击力的外观效果。7升Windsor V8引擎搭载双涡轮增压系统，输出功率达1,216 PS，同时保留了一定的灵活性，可调节引擎控制逻辑，适应城市悠闲驾驶。

en:
No longer a "baby Lambo," this car possessed top-tier performance.

Released in 2008, the Lamborghini Gallardo LP 560-4 delivered a 39.4 HP boost over its predecessor. It retained the 4-wheel-drive system but introduced a new 6-speed E-gear transmission, offering gear shifts 40 percent quicker than before. Weight was also trimmed, bringing the body down to 3108 lbs, while top speed rose to 201.9 mph. With its sleek design and elevated performance, it embodied the peak of refined speed.
zh:
不再是Lambo的小号，Gallardo以顶级的性能甩掉了这个绰号。

Lamborghini Gallardo LP 560-4于2007年发布，相比前代车型功率提升了40 PS。虽然延续了四驱动力系统，但换上了6速E-gear变速箱，换挡速度提升了40%。减重同样受到重视，车身重量降至1,410 公斤，使得最高时速提升至325 公里/小时。这款车以流线型设计实现了卓越的性能表现。

en:
Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.

This sports coupe used the same platform as the Genesis luxury sedan. It was 13.6 inches shorter overall, with a wheelbase 4.5 inches shorter. Combined with a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout and 4-wheel independent suspension, the car possessed sharp handling dynamics. In 2012, the model received updates that increased engine output. With its 3.8-liter V-6 producing around 345.2 HP, it achieved performance approaching supercar territory.
zh:
配备有赛道专用部件的高性能双门跑车。

这款运动轿跑与Genesis豪华轿车共享平台，其车身比轿车车型短345毫米，轴距缩短了115毫米，搭配上前置引擎、后驱布局和四轮独立悬挂，实现了卓越的敏捷性。在2012年，这台车进行了小幅改款，引擎动力输出得到增强。凭借动力输出接近350 PS的3.8升V6引擎，该车的性能直逼超级跑车。

en:
Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.

Hyundai’s rear-wheel-drive Genesis sports car has been modified to meet Gr.3 regulations for this Gran Turismo Original. With a wheelbase exceeding 110.2 inches, it delivers excellent stability and strong downforce thanks to its expansive floor surface. The naturally-aspirated V-6 produces more than 493.1 HP, offering impressive performance without forced induction. It was a well-balanced machine, capable of excelling through both corners and straights.
zh:
配备有赛道专用部件的高性能双门跑车。

这台跑车浪漫旅的原创车型Hyundai后驱Genesis跑车已按照Gr.3组别规则进行了改装。超过2,800毫米的长轴距为这台车带来高稳定性，巨大的底板提供了强劲的下压力。自然进气V6引擎仍可输出超过500 PS。这台各方面性能均衡的赛车能够兼顾弯道和直道。

en:
Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car. 

Hyundai’s rear-wheel-drive Genesis sports car has been adapted to meet Gr.4 regulations for this Gran Turismo Original. Although it appears externally as a touring car, features like its paddle-shift transmission brought it closer in spirit to a Gr.3 machine. In the real world, this car earned a strong reputation in the drifting scene, and this Gr.4 version proves just as capable for racing as it was for sliding sideways.
zh:
配备有赛道专用部件的高性能双门跑车。

这台跑车浪漫旅的原创车型Hyundai后驱Genesis跑车已按照Gr.4组别规则进行了改装。尽管外观上酷似一台房车，但它拥有许多与Gr.3组别对标的特征，如拨片式换挡变速箱。在现实世界中，Genesis是漂移赛车运动的热门选择，而这款Gr.4同样擅长漂移，不只为赛道而生。

en:
Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.

Hyundai’s rear-wheel-drive Genesis sports car has been reengineered to meet Gr.B regulations for this Gran Turismo Original. A 4-wheel-drive conversion has been added, along with design elements inspired by modern rally machines. The front fenders feature smooth, organic curves to maximize downforce, while the wide track, measuring more than 80.7 inches, enhanced maneuverability, complementing the car’s long wheelbase.
zh:
配备有赛道专用部件的高性能双门跑车。

这台跑车浪漫旅的原创车型Hyundai后驱Genesis跑车已按照Gr.B组别规则进行了改装。除了四轮驱动改装，该车还融入了许多现代拉力赛车的潮流设计。前挡泥板的有机曲线能最大化下压力，而超过2,050毫米的宽轮距为长轴距车身提供了额外的操控性。

carNameEn: Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept
sourceName: Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept
en:
The racing version of the Gran Berlinetta adorned with aerodynamic parts.

The Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept is the ultimate expression of Genesis’ "Athletic Elegance." This Racer version dramatically increases downforce to enhance lap times. Its hybrid powertrain paired a V-6 engine with electric assists to deliver a staggering 1518.7 HP and 1,015 ft-lb (1014.8 ft-lb) of torque.
zh:
加入各种空气动力学部件的Gran Berlinetta赛车版本。

Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept概念车完美诠释了Genesis品牌“运动优雅”的设计理念。赛车版本显著增强了下压力，有效提升了圈速表现。动力系统采用V6引擎配合电动助力的混合动力架构，综合输出功率达1,540 PS，扭矩为140.3 公斤力米。

carNameEn: Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept
sourceName: Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept
en:
A sports coupe that embodies the athletic elegance sought by Genesis.

The Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept embodies the pinnacle of the brand’s design philosophy. It features Genesis’ signature anti-wedge profile, introducing fresh design ideas for future sports models. Powered by the Lambda II V-6 with electric assist, it produces 1,071 hp (1071 HP). It represents a perfect balance of sculpted beauty and raw performance.
zh:
体现出Genesis所追求的运动优雅理念的运动型双门跑车。

Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept概念车是Genesis品牌“运动优雅”设计理念的终极诠释。设计采用了Genesis标志性的反楔形造型，展现了Genesis跑车系列的全新设计思路。动力系统结合Lambda II V6引擎和电动助力，输出功率达1071英制马力（1,086 PS）。最终呈现出一款外观与性能完美平衡的杰作。

en:
The top-of-the-line model in the Giulia lineup celebrated 110 years of Alfa Romeo.

In 2020, Alfa Romeo marked their 110th anniversary with the release of the special Giulia GTA and GTAm models. The twin-turbo 2.9-liter V-6 saw its output raised to 532.5 HP, accompanied by weight reduction and a wider track for enhanced performance. The GTAm, built with circuit driving in mind, featured a large front splitter, carbon fiber rear wing, and integrated roll bars—delivering a truly hardcore setup.
zh:
这款车是Giulia系列的巅峰之作，也是对Alfa Romeo 110年历史的纪念。

2020年，Alfa Romeo为庆祝品牌成立110周年，特别推出了Giulia的“GTA”和“GTAm”特别版车型。2.9升V6双涡轮增压引擎的功率提升至540 PS，同时通过减重和加宽轮距进一步强化性能表现。GTAm车型专为赛道使用而设计，配备了大型前定风翼、碳纤维尾翼和防滚架等极致的硬核配置。

carNameEn: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Veloce '67
sourceName: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Veloce '67
en:
An iconic 1960s high-performance coupe from Alfa Romeo

Introduced in 1962, Alfa Romeo’s first Giulia series began as a 4-door sedan, with the Sprint GT coupe joining the lineup in 1963. Designed by Giugiaro, the body featured elegant lines and subtly curved surfaces. The Sprint GT quickly gained popularity as a high-performance sports coupe and remained in production until 1977.
zh:
Alfa Romeo在1960年代推出的标志性高性能双门跑车。

Alfa Romeo首代Giulia系列于1962年问世，最初为四门轿车，1963年增加了Sprint GT双门轿跑版本。车身由乔治亚罗设计，线条流畅，表面弧度柔美。Sprint GT凭借出色的高性能跑车表现深受喜爱，生产周期持续至1977年。

en:
This grandfather of hot hatches balanced everyday usability with a fun-to-drive nature.

Released in 1974, the Volkswagen Golf quickly rose to popularity as a pioneer of the compact car segment. The sporty GTI variant featured a 1.6-liter inline-4 SOHC engine with Bosch fuel injection, producing 108.5 HP. Blending performance with everyday practicality, the GTI redefined the concept of sporty driving.
zh:
小钢炮车型的鼻祖，在日常用途的同时提供更多驾驶乐趣。

Volkswagen Golf于1974年推出，作为紧凑型车型的开拓者获得了巨大成功。运动版“GTI”搭载1.6升直列四缸顶置单凸轮轴引擎，配备Bosch燃油喷射系统，输出功率可达110 PS。GTI完美融合了高性能与实用性，开创了运动驾驶的全新标准。

en:
The GTI version of the 7th-generation Golf ups its handling performance.

Unveiled in 2012, the seventh-generation Golf was built on a new platform that introduced a host of advancements. Handling was notably enhanced through the use of XDS—an electronically controlled differential lock—alongside DCC adaptive chassis control and progressive steering. These technologies improved stability and allowed for much higher cornering speeds.
zh:
7代高尔夫的GTI版本，操作性能达到巅峰。

2012年首次亮相的第7代Volkswagen Golf基于新平台打造，从而将各种改进化为现实。最值得一提的是，该车的操控性在“XDS”（一种工作原理与限滑差速器类似的电子差速器锁定系统）、“DCC”适应性底盘控制和渐进式转向的加持下得到了改善。这些改进提升了车辆的稳定性和高速过弯性能。

en:
Four consecutive wins at Le Mans for Toyota with this prototype race car

The TOYOTA GR010 HYBRID 2021 succeeded the TS050, developed in response to the new regulations introduced that year. It featured a twin-turbo 3.5-liter V-6 engine producing 670.6 HP, paired with a 268.2 HP electric motor at the front in a 4-wheel-drive layout. Driver lineups including Kamui Kobayashi and Kazuki Nakajima went on to win all six rounds of the WEC season, including Le Mans, ushering in the beginning of the hypercar era.
zh:
Toyota的这款原型赛车在勒芒比赛中获得4连胜，从而在超跑时代伊始登上了舞台的正中央。

TOYOTA GR010 HYBRID 2021是TS050的后继车型，专为适应2021年引入的新赛事规则而开发。引擎更换为3.5升V6双涡轮增压机组，输出680 PS，采用四驱布局，前轴配备272 PS电机。包括小林可梦伟和中岛一贵在内的车手阵容横扫了勒芒站在内的WEC赛季全部6站比赛，标志着终极跑车时代的开启。

en:
This version of Japan's signature lightweight sports car boasts a bigger engine, but it remains true to its heritage.

Toyota’s lightweight 86, a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car, was introduced in 2012 and sold more than 200,000 units worldwide. Nine years later, it was reborn as the GR86, now equipped with a larger naturally-aspirated 2.4-liter flat-4 DOHC engine producing 231.8 HP and 184.4 ft-lb of torque. With enhanced body rigidity, reduced weight, and an aerodynamic design shaped by motorsport experience, the GR86 delivered an even more engaging and dynamic driving experience.
zh:
排量与动力更大的引擎，不变的理念。日本最具代表性的轻量级前置后驱跑车。

Toyota轻量化前置后驱跑车“86”于2012年发布，全球销量突破20万辆。发布9年后，该车以“GR86”的身份重生，搭载2.4升自然进气四缸双顶置凸轮轴水平对置引擎，输出235 PS的动力和25.5 公斤力米的最大扭矩。通过强化车身刚性、削减车身重量，以及采用汲取自赛车运动的全新空气动力学设计，这款车带来了前所未有的驾驶乐趣。

en:
A 2-seat model that takes the GR Corolla to the extreme.

The GR Corolla was developed by Toyota’s high-performance GR division as a hot hatch aimed squarely at outperforming its rivals. Already the most powerful model in Corolla history, it was taken even further with the hardcore MORIZO Edition. At a time when the automotive world moves toward electrification and advanced systems, the GR Corolla stood out as a rare celebration of the pure, mechanical thrill of the internal combustion engine.
zh:
一款将GR Corolla推向极致的双座车型。

GR Corolla是Toyota旗下高性能品牌“GR”打造的高性能掀背车，旨在在性能上超越所有竞争对手。虽然这已是Corolla历史上最强车型，但厂家还是在此基础上推出了更加极致的“MORIZO Edition”版本。在汽车行业迈向电气化和智能化的今天，GR Corolla难能可贵地展现了内燃机的纯粹魅力。

en:
The Supra returned after a 17-year hiatus, with this racing version competing at the Nürburgring in 2019.

The GR Supra marked the return of Toyota’s flagship sports car, 17 years after production ended. It retained a rear-wheel-drive layout and inline-6, but came wrapped in a modern two-seat body with advanced construction and a twin-scroll turbocharger. It made its Nürburgring 24 Hours debut in 2018 and, in 2019, finished 3rd in the SP8T class and 41st overall. This cementing its image as a true performance contender.
zh:
Supra暌违17年后再次归。这款跑车曾参与过2019年的纽博格林赛事。

消失17年的Toyota旗舰跑车重获新生，GR Supra延续了经典的后驱布局和直列六缸引擎，以全新双座设计、先进车身和双涡管涡轮增压技术回归。该车于2018年首次征战纽博格林24小时耐力赛，2019年参加SP8T组别竞技，获得组别第三名、总成绩第41名的佳绩。这确立了GR Supra作为纯粹战斗跑车的形象。

en:
First seen at the 2018 Geneva Motor Show, this race Supra represented a preview of the production model.

The GR Supra Racing Concept reimagined the Supra as a race car, appearing 16 years after the model's production ceased in 2002. Its compact two-door coupe body, with classic long-nose, short-deck proportions, utilized cutting-edge materials and engineering to deliver outstanding aerodynamics and handling.
zh:
这辆Supra跑车首次亮相于2018年的日内瓦车展，是量产车型的前瞻。

自2002年停产16年后，GR Supra Racing Concept概念车将Toyota Supra以赛车身份复活，帮助其再度回归。这款双门轿跑的紧凑车身沿用传统的长鼻加短尾跑车比例，采用的尖端材料和工程技术创造了卓越的空气动力学和操控性。

carNameEn: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
en:
This new WRC race car was created to carry the torch for Toyota's strong rallying tradition.

Developed by Toyota for the WRC, the GR Yaris may have appeared as a simple compact car, but underneath was a serious competition machine. With increased rigidity, reduced weight, and a dramatically lowered center of gravity, it was engineered for peak performance. The 4-wheel-drive RZ model featured a 1.6-liter 3-cylinder turbo engine paired with a 6-speed manual transmission. The RZ High Performance variant added a limited-slip differential, delivering rock-solid traction. In January 2020, the "1st Edition" was introduced as a special edition model, marking the launch with exclusive features.
zh:
这款全新的WRC赛车将延续Toyota一贯强大的拉力赛夺冠传统。

Toyota为征战WRC而开发的GR Yaris，表面上是一款朴素的紧凑型车，实际上却是一台强悍的赛道机器。车身刚性得到强化，重量实现轻量化，重心尽可能降低。四驱版RZ车型搭载1.6升三缸涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速手动变速箱。RZ High performance版本进一步配备限滑差速器，提供稳如磐石的抓地性能。2020年1月，厂家推出了“1st Edition”特别版车型。

en:
True to its Italian heritage, this grand tourer was defined by class, performance and elegance.

This was the high-performance variant of the GranTurismo, introduced at the 2008 Geneva Motor Show. Its DOHC V-8 engine had its displacement increased to 4.7 liters, while the transmission and rear differential were integrated into a transaxle layout. It also became the first in the series to adopt the two-pedal semi-automatic MC Shift system.
zh:
传统杰作，强大的赛车性能隐藏在并不明显的外观之下。

这是2008年日内瓦车展上推出的GranTurismo高性能版本。V8双顶置凸轮轴引擎的排量扩容至4.7升，变速箱和后限滑差速器被整合进一个变速驱动桥单元中。它也是该系列中首款使用双踏板半自动“MC Shift”系统的车型。

en:
This highly collectible Mustang earned a great track record in SCCA racing.

This high-performance Mustang was developed by Ford in collaboration with Carroll Shelby to compete in the SCCA, a premier American sports car racing series. The lightened body was equipped with race suspension and an LSD, while at its heart sat the 289 engine, producing 301.8 HP. Beginning in 1965, it went on to dominate the series for three consecutive years.
zh:
这款Mustang在SCCA赛事中的表现尤为出色。

这台高性能Mustang由Ford和卡罗尔·谢尔比合作打造，用于征战美国跑车系列赛SCCA。轻量化的车身配备了赛车级悬挂和限滑差速器，其核心是能输出306 PS的289引擎。从1965年开始，它连续3年蝉联系列赛宝座。

en:
This historic machine achieved a much-desired Le Mans victory with an incredible 1-2-3 finish.

In a bold move to leave its mark on the racing world, Ford partnered with Lola Cars to develop the Mark I, which was completed in 1964. Based on the Lola-designed Mk6, the car was introduced as the Ford GT. The name "GT40" was coined by a reporter, amazed by the car’s height—just 40 inches from the ground. At the 1966 24 Hours of Le Mans, the improved Mark II version achieved a legendary 1-2-3 finish.
zh:
众望所归地在勒芒大赛中夺得胜利，包揽全部领奖台，为传奇拉开帷幕，极具历史意义。

为了跻身赛车界，Ford与Lola汽车共同开发了Mark I。1964年，这台以Lola设计的“Mk6”为基础的赛车完成了开发，并以Ford GT的名号在大众面前亮相。“GT40”其实是一位记者为它起的昵称，后者对总车身高度仅有40英寸的事实惊讶万分。在1966年的勒芒24小时耐力赛中，改进后的Mark II车型奇迹般地包揽前三名完赛。

en:
This race car represented Ford's last effort to challenge for the 24 Hours of Le Mans title.

Following this triumph, Ford responded to updated FIA regulations by developing the Mark IV—a new test car with a highly aerodynamic body. This redesign pushed the top speed to 215.6 mph and significantly improved high-speed stability, crucial to its success in the 1967 Le Mans. There, the Mark IV outpaced its rival by five laps, securing a second consecutive victory for Ford at the famed endurance race.
zh:
Ford最后一次参加勒芒锦标赛的车型。

在称霸1966年勒芒24小时耐力赛后，为了适应FIA颁布的车辆技术规范的变化，Ford开发了一台新的测试车Mark IV。凭借出色的空气动力学车身，该车兼具了高速稳定性和高达347 公里/小时的极速，帮助其在1967年再度夺冠。它在勒芒24小时耐力赛中以整整5圈的优势击败对手，拿下冠军。

en:
This concept car for the virtual world was developed in collaboration with Citroën.

A Gran Turismo Original, this Gr.3-spec version of the GT by Citroën is born from a unique collaboration between Gran Turismo and Citroën. Unlike the stock model, its aggressive exterior—reminiscent of a battle-ready machine—leaves a striking impression. Fitted with multiple aerodynamic winglets across the body, it delivers exceptional downforce.
zh:
跑车浪漫旅与Citroën联合研发的一辆虚拟概念赛车。

这款《跑车浪漫旅》原创版本是Gr.3规格的“GT by Citroën”，后者本身就是由《跑车浪漫旅》与Citroën合作开发的。它与原厂车的外观截然不同，如同战斗机器人般极具攻击性，给见过它的每个人留下了深刻印象。它的空气动力学性能也十分出色，车身多处安装的侧翼片能提供强劲的下压力。

en:
This concept car for the virtual world was developed in collaboration with Citroën.

Designed for competition in the Gr.4 category, this race car is a modified version of the GT by Citroën, originally unveiled at the 2008 Paris Motor Show. The updates were overseen by Takumi Yamamoto, the designer behind the original concept. Its exterior features a striking six-color livery and a prominent rear wing. Also, the interior has been revised with a new steering wheel and updated HUD to suit its motorsports focus.
zh:
跑车浪漫旅与Citroën联合研发的一辆虚拟概念赛车。

这是专为Gr.4组别赛事打造的赛车，是2008年在巴黎车展上亮相的“GT by Citroën”的改装版。依旧由原型设计师山本卓一操刀打造。外观推出6种不同的涂装，还配备了大型尾翼。同时，内饰部分对方向盘和HUD都进行了改装。

en:
From dream to reality, the supercar concept developed by Citroën and Gran Turismo becomes a V8-powered mid-engine sports car.

Based on the GT by Citroën, first shown at the 2008 Paris Motor Show, this model has been reimagined as the ultimate road-going version. The most significant change lay in the powertrain, transformed from a high-performance EV into a V-8-powered, mid-engine sports car. Its distinctive, armor-like styling was preserved, creating a uniquely striking and high-performance machine built for the road.
zh:
化作公路赛车的梦幻概念车型，采用中置V8引擎。

该车以2008年巴黎车展上展出的“GT by Citroën”为基础，致力于打造极致的公路驾驶体验。最大的变化在于动力系统，从一台高性能电动车变身为一台由中置V8引擎驱动的跑车。独特的盔甲式造型得以保留，成就了这台魅力独具的高性能跑车。

en:
Toyota's endurance race machine that achieved a class win at Le Mans in 1999.

In 1998, Toyota developed the GT-One (TS020) with the singular goal of winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Designed by André de Cortanze, the car incorporated Formula 1-inspired aerodynamics and suspension. Although mechanical issues prevented a result in its debut year, the GT-One returned in 1999 as an evolved LM GTP machine. Ukyo Katayama and company finished 2nd overall—the highest-ever at Le Mans for a team composed entirely of Japanese drivers.
zh:
Toyota耐力赛赛车于1999年在勒芒赢得组别冠军

1998年，Toyota开发了GT-One（TS020），目标是征服勒芒24小时耐力赛。GT-One由安德烈·德·科尔但泽设计，采用了源自F1的空气动力学和悬挂技术。1998年的技术故障让车队铩羽而归，但在1999年GT-One进化为LM GTP规格赛车。片山右京领衔的车队获得总成绩亚军，创造了日本车手在勒芒历史上的最佳战绩。

en:
This pure-bred sports car by Mitsubishi featured advanced AWD technology.

Introduced in 1990, the GTO marked Mitsubishi’s return to the true sports car segment after many years. Its bold, wide-bodied styling was clearly aimed at the American market. The car packed a suite of advanced technologies for its time, including all-wheel control, 4-wheel steering, electronically controlled suspension, and active aerodynamic elements. Under the hood was a 3.0-liter V-6 engine, offered in both naturally-aspirated and twin-turbocharged forms. It was sold overseas as the 3000GT, where it gained popularity for its bold styling and aggressive performance.
zh:
由Mitsubishi全力打造的纯正跑车，采用了其久负盛名的四驱技术。

GTO于1990年问世，是Mitsubishi多年来推出的首款真正意义上的跑车。宽大华丽的车身造型主要面向美国市场。该车还配备了多项先进技术，包括全时四驱、四轮转向、电子控制悬挂和主动空气动力学组件。引擎为3升V6规格，提供双涡轮增压和自然进气两种版本。该车在海外以3000GT名称销售，凭借强悍的性能表现赢得广泛赞誉。

en:
Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.

In 2016, the Nissan GT-R underwent its most significant facelift since its 2007 debut. The updated exterior achieved a refined balance of aerodynamics, downforce, and cooling efficiency. Its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-6 engine, now producing 565.1 HP, was paired with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, delivering smoother acceleration and sharper cornering performance. These deeper, more focused refinements embodied the essence of Japanese sports car engineering.
zh:
2017年的车型做出了更深入的改进。

2016年，Nissan GT-R迎来了自2007年问世以来最大幅度的改款升级。外观设计在空气阻力、下压力和散热性能之间达到完美平衡。同时，输出573 PS的3.8升V6双涡轮增压引擎配合改进的6速双离合变速箱，带来更顺畅的加速和更优异的过弯表现。这些深层次的进化完美体现了日本跑车的独有特质。

en:
This Nissan GT-R, converted into a safety car, was made to patrol the race track.

This Gran Turismo Original transformed the R35 GT-R supercar into a dedicated safety car. Equipped with roof-mounted LED patrol lights and additional light arrays on the front and rear bumpers, it offered significantly enhanced visibility. The center console was also fitted with exclusive switches unique to its safety car role.
zh:
Nissan GT-R的安全车版本，专为赛道设计。

这个跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是以Nissan R35 GT-R超级跑车为基础进行开发的一款安全车。车顶安装的LED巡逻灯和前后保险杠上的灯组极大增强了其醒目程度。中控台还设有该车型独有的额外按钮。

en:
Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.

Nissan’s "multi-performance" R35 GT-R has been adapted for Gr.4 competition in this Gran Turismo Original. Its 4-wheel-drive system delivered exceptional handling stability, while endurance racing features—such as integrated fog lamps—make it a well-rounded machine built for long-distance performance.
zh:
2017年的车型做出了更深入的改进。

这是Nissan的“全能超级跑车”R35 GT-R的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，专门针对Gr.4组别进行了改装。四轮驱动系统带来稳定的操控，而雾灯等各种耐力赛部件让这台车成为长距离比赛的完美车款。

en:
A front-wheel-drive prototype hybrid racer designed by Ben Bowlby.

In spring 2014, Nissan announced its return to the 24 Hours of Le Mans with a car bearing the GT-R nameplate. The GT-R LM NISMO broke convention with its radical front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout. Its carbon-fiber body, designed by Ben Bowlby—the mind behind the DeltaWing and ZEOD RC—housed a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 paired with an energy recovery system. Weighing in at the minimum 1940 lbs, it contended for overall victory on motorsports' most demanding stage.
zh:
前轮驱动混动车原型，由本·鲍尔比设计。

2014年春季，Nissan宣布将派遣GT-R赛车征战勒芒24小时耐力赛。这辆GT-R LM Nismo采用了颠覆性的前置引擎前轮驱动架构。碳纤维车身由DeltaWing和ZEOD RC的设计师本·鲍尔比操刀设计，搭载3升V6双涡轮增压引擎和能量回收系统。车重达到最低限重880 公斤，此车参加了争夺总冠军的角逐。

en:
The 2017 GT-R was a smoother, more refined version of the previous model. 

The 2017 GT-R NISMO featured a host of refinements throughout the car. While retaining its bonded body construction and engine specifications, the front window frame was reinforced to improve chassis rigidity. Comfort was also enhanced, making it more livable in urban settings while remaining sharp on the circuit. Aerodynamics saw notable improvements as well, and thanks to a comprehensive redesign, the body generated increased downforce at high speeds, further enhancing performance.
zh:
这款2017年的车型将GT-R的性能提升到了新的高度。

2017款GT-R Nismo对全车上下进行了改良。在保留其粘合车身结构和引擎规格的同时，前车窗框架的刚性得到了强化，城市和赛道的驾驶舒适性也获得改善。得益于工程师对外观进行全方位的重新设计，空气动力学效应也优化了不少，让车身在高速时也能产生更多下压力。

en:
Kazunori Yamauchi and this GT-R NISMO GT3 fought hard in the Nürburgring race in 2013. 

In 2013, Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi partnered with Schulze Motorsport to take on the Nürburgring 24 Hours. The GT-R GT3 was specially prepared for the race, with support from Polyphony Digital’s technical team. Data gathered from the car’s performance was later used to enhance the realism of Gran Turismo’s simulation engine.
zh:
在2013年里与山内一典共同征战纽博格林赛道的GT3。

2013年，《跑车浪漫旅》系列制作人山内一典与Schulze Motorsport携手开始合作。依托于Polyphony Digital的技术实力支持，打造出了专门用于参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛的GT-R GT3。从这辆车收集的数据将被用于改进《跑车浪漫旅》的模拟引擎。

en:
This racing spec version of the GT-R was created for GT3 category competition.

The Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3 was a production-based race machine built to FIA GT3 regulations, derived from the R35 GT-R. Later iterations were based on the GT-R NISMO, incorporating a dry sump system to lower the center of gravity and optimize weight distribution. Enhanced front-end rigidity and a newly designed suspension setup improved handling response. A revised engine bay layout boosted cooling efficiency, contributing to greater stability at high speeds.
zh:
这是GT-R的赛车规格版本，用于参加GT3组别的比赛。

Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3是基于R35 GT-R开发的FIA GT3规格量产赛车。后期又将基础车型更换为GT-R NISMO，后者采用了干式油底壳系统以降低重心并优化配重。强化的前部刚性和全新设计的悬挂系统提升了操控响应度。引擎舱布局的调整提升了散热效率，同时有助于高速行驶下的稳定性。

en:
This Gr.B design reimagines the Nissan GT-R as a dedicated off-road race machine.

Nissan’s "multi-performance" R35 GT-R has been reimagined for Gr.B competition in this Gran Turismo Original. The most striking exterior changes includes quad fog lamps mounted on the bonnet and large auxiliary lamps flanking the front bumper, perfect for illuminating night rally stages. Its already exceptional 4-wheel-drive system gives the GT-R a distinct advantage in the world of rallying.
zh:
以Gr.B规格设计的这款车型将Nissan GT-R重新塑造成了一辆火力全开的越野赛车。

这是Nissan的“全能超级跑车”R35 GT-R的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，专门针对Gr.B组别进行了改装。外观上最显著的改变就是为了在夜间赛场上照亮赛道，在引擎盖上加装了四盏雾灯，以及在保险杠两侧分别加装了一盏大号雾灯。GT-R的四轮驱动系统原本已经非常优越，让它在拉力赛场上也独具优势。

en:
News of the Nissan GT-R R35's demise was evidently greatly exaggerated.

The arrival of the 2024 GT-R silenced speculation that production had ended with the 2022 model. A newly designed exhaust silencer allowed the car to meet noise regulations without compromising performance. Aerodynamic refinements enhanced downforce. Also, the addition of high-sensitivity G-sensors in the electronically controlled suspension improved both traction and ride comfort, elevating the GT-R’s performance and refinement to new heights.
zh:
R35 GT-R系列的巅峰之作粉碎了停产的传言。

2024款GT-R的推出使得该车系在2022款后停产的传言不攻自破。全新的排气消音系统让该车在满足噪音法规的同时保持卓越性能。外观设计同样得到改善，下压力进一步增强。此外，电子控制悬挂系统引入的高灵敏度加速度传感器，不仅提升了抓地性能，同时也改善了乘坐舒适性。

en:
The cab-over commercial van was equally capable of moving people and cargo.

The Hiace has long stood as Toyota’s flagship commercial vehicle, earning widespread support around the globe. Introduced in 2004 and continually refined, the fifth-generation H200 model became a record-setting seller. Offered in various configurations based on body size, it came with a choice of 2.0-liter or 2.7-liter gasoline engines, or a 2.8-liter diesel engine. The Van DX variant featured a standard roof height and rear-wheel drive. It accommodated up to nine passengers, or, with the seats folded, transforming into a spacious cargo carrier.
zh:
这款前置驾驶室的商用厢型车在载人和载货方面同样出色。

Hiace是Toyota商用车的代表车型，在全球范围内都有大量拥趸。第五代H200车型于2004年推出并持续更新，已成为创纪录的长青畅销车型。H200根据车身尺寸提供多档选择，可选2升或2.7升汽油引擎，或2.8升柴油引擎。Van DX是标准车顶高度的后轮2轮驱动车型。最多可容纳9人乘坐，座椅也可折叠收起，形成宽敞的载货空间。

en:
A new species with the openness of a motorcycle and the handling of an automobile.

The "Honda Project 2&4 powered by RC213V" was the result of a collaboration between Honda’s design team and Gran Turismo. It combined the 212 HP engine from the Honda RC213V-S with an ultra-lightweight 893 lbs body, creating a unique form of mobility that offered the open-air freedom and agility of a motorcycle, combined with the handling precision and lateral G-forces of a 4-wheeled vehicle.
zh:
既有摩托车的开放感，又有4轮车的横向重力加速度，带来全新的驾驶体验。

这款“Honda Project 2&4 powered by RC213V”诞生自Honda设计团队和《跑车浪漫旅》的合作项目。它的设计结合了215 PS的Honda RC213V-S引擎和仅重405 公斤的超轻量车身，实现了一种新形态的运动体验，结合了摩托车的开放性与敏捷性和四轮汽车的操控性及横向重力加速度。

en:
This lightweight mid-engine sports car embodied Honda's "Power of Dreams" philosophy.

The Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo is a two-seater coupe born from a collaboration between Honda’s design team and Gran Turismo. It embodies Honda’s "Human Centered Design" philosophy, featuring a driver-focused package that prioritized engagement and usability. With bold, athletic proportions, the car delivers the striking presence and excitement expected of a true sports car.
zh:
这辆轻型中置引擎跑车传达着Honda“极致马力”的理念。

“Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo”是一款Honda设计团队与《跑车浪漫旅》合作开发的双座轿跑。这款车采用了以驾驶者为中心的整体设计，让Honda“以人为本”的设计理念得到了清晰的体现。设计师还力图打造出带来强烈视觉冲击、令人兴奋不已的车身比例，呈现地道的跑车外观。

en:
A car with bold styling, a lavish interior and a 6.0-liter twin-turbo Mercedes-AMG V12.

Pagani introduced the Huayra in 2011 as the successor to the Zonda. Its monocoque chassis combined carbon fiber and titanium, delivering both exceptional strength and lightness, while gullwing doors added to its striking design. Powered by an AMG-built twin-turbo 6.0-liter V-12 paired with a 7-speed sequential transmission, the Huayra could accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.2 seconds and reach a top speed of 234.9 mph.
zh:
奢华的内饰，杰出的性能。这款高档超级跑车是高品质杰作的代表。

Pagani于2011年推出Huayra车型，用以接替Zonda。车身采用碳纤维与钛合金混合打造的单体车壳结构，配备鸥翼式车门，完美融合了精致设计与卓越性能。搭载AMG 6L V12双涡轮增压引擎，匹配7速序列式变速箱，0-100 公里/小时加速时间仅需3.2秒，最高时速可达378 公里/小时。

en:
Dallara took the best elements of the Huracán and created a radical competition GT3 machine.

Unveiled in January 2015, the Huracán GT3 was a dedicated racing version of the Huracán, built to FIA GT3 specifications. While it retained the aluminum and carbon fiber hybrid construction of the road car, the body width was increased. Numerous aerodynamic enhancements were added, giving it a more aggressive and purposeful appearance.
zh:
Dallara攫取了Huracán的顶级元素，并提升了这款GT3车型的竞争潜力。

这款Huracán GT3在2015年1月首次公布。顾名思义，它是Huracán的赛车版本，专为FIA GT3规格进行了改装。尽管它的车身与公路车版本一样，采用了铝合金和碳纤维混合材料，但车身得到了进一步加宽。加装的多个部件既能提升空气动力学性能，又让它相较于公路车版本外观更具霸气。

en:
With aesthetics inspired by the Gallardo, this AWD supercar's powerful and lightweight nature makes it ideal for the race track.

The Huracán was unveiled in 2014 as the replacement for the Gallardo. Its construction shifted from an aluminum space frame to a hybrid structure of aluminum and carbon fiber, resulting in a 50 percent increase in rigidity and a 10 percent reduction in weight. Positioned amidships, the 5.2-liter V-10 engine delivered 601.6 HP and 412.3 ft-lb of torque. Power was routed through a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and sent to the pavement via the Haldex 5 all-wheel-drive system.
zh:
这辆四驱超级跑车继承了Gallardo的美学设计，并且更加轻巧，马力也更强。

作为Gallardo的后续车型，Huracán在2014年首次公布。其车身材料从铝合金空间车架改为了铝合金与碳纤维混合材料，成功实现了50%的刚性提升和10%的减重。其中置布局引擎采用了一部5.2升V10发动机，能够输出610 PS的动力和57.0 公斤力米的扭矩。这股澎湃动力通过7档双离合变速箱以及Haldex 5全轮驱动系统，高效地施加在路面上。

en:
With aesthetics inspired by the Gallardo, this AWD supercar's powerful and lightweight nature makes it ideal for the race track.

Lamborghini’s entry-level, mid-engine, all-wheel-drive Huracán has been reimagined as a Gr.4-spec machine for this Gran Turismo Original. Its 4-wheel-drive layout provides exceptional stability, while the balanced weight distribution of the mid-engine design delivers sharp cornering, resulting in a well-rounded and highly composed race car.
zh:
这辆四驱超级跑车继承了Gallardo的美学设计，并且更加轻巧，马力也更强。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型Huracán将Lamborghini的入门级中置四轮驱动车型升级成了符合Gr.4规格的赛车。其四轮驱动布局能够提供极高的稳定性，而中置引擎布局带来的车身配重比也实现了非常灵敏的过弯能力，最终呈现出一辆平衡性优秀、操控感非凡的赛道机器。

en:
An extreme monster machine that embodies the passion and future of Hyundai's "N".

Created to commemorate Hyundai’s 50th anniversary, this model also embodied the spirit and ambition of the company's high-performance "N" division. It was powered by hydrogen fuel cells paired with supercapacitors that stored energy recovered through regenerative braking, delivering a combined output of 650 kW (871.8 HP) via electric motors at each wheel. Thanks to compact, lightweight fuel-cell stacks and a CFRP monocoque chassis, the car tipped the scales at just 2143 lbs.
zh:
这款奔逸绝尘的赛车代表着Hyundai的N系列赛车的热忱与未来。

这款车是专为Hyundai的50周年纪念所打造，也代表了Hyundai高性能部门“N”对汽车研发倾注的热情。它采用了氢燃料电池供能，还配备了超级电容，能够储存由再生制动系统产生的能量，四个车轮上的电机能够输出总计650千瓦（884 PS）的动力。此外，得益于它的紧凑车身和轻量化燃料电池组，以及碳纤维复合材料单体车壳框架，这辆车仅重972 公斤。

en:
This extreme car embodies the passion and future of Hyundai's "N" brand. 

Originally created through a collaboration between Hyundai and Gran Turismo, the N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo has been reworked to meet Gr.1 regulations in this original model. In accordance with Gr.1 rules, the variable rear wing is fixed in place. The 4-wheel-drive system remains unchanged, giving the car exceptional grip and allowing it to handle as if it were glued to the tarmac.
zh:
这款奔逸绝尘的赛车代表着Hyundai的N系列赛车的热忱与未来。

N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo原本是Hyundai和《跑车浪漫旅》合作打造的车型，而这个原创版本则按照Gr.1组别规则对其进行了改装。按照Gr.1规则，其可变式尾翼被改成了固定式。它的传动系统也与四轮驱动配置配合良好，让这辆车能够像被粘在地上一样行驶。

en:
BMW’s first mass-produced production vehicle has a sports-car heart.

This electric vehicle was unveiled by BMW in 2013. Its distinctive, boxy 4-door body featured small, pillarless rear doors, and weighed just 2634 lbs, thanks to an aluminum alloy chassis paired with a carbon-fiber cabin. The electric motor produced 167.7 HP and 180.8 ft-lb of torque, enabling the car to accelerate from zero to 37.3 mph in 3.7 seconds, and to 62.1 mph in 7.2 seconds. With a top speed exceeding 93.2 mph, it proved it can compete with its internal combustion-powered counterparts.
zh:
BMW的第一款市售电动车，拥有跑车级别的加速性能。

2013年，BMW公布了一款电动车。方正的四门车身采用了小尺寸无柱后门设计，底盘使用铝合金材质，而驾驶舱则使用碳纤维，使得全车仅重1,195 公斤。它的电机能够输出170 PS/25.0 公斤力米的性能，从静止状态加速到60 公里/小时仅需3.7秒，加速到100 公里/小时也仅需7.2秒。再加上超过150 公里/小时的最高时速，这款车在其他采用内燃引擎的竞争车型面前也丝毫不落下风。

en:
The prototype EV that rewrote speed records around the world.

Volkswagen’s prototype race car stood as a symbol of carbon reduction and future performance. Its carbon-fiber body featured prominent front and rear wings, while two electric motors powered both the front and rear axles for all-wheel drive. The car delivered astonishing performance, setting record-breaking times at Pikes Peak, the Nürburgring Nordschleife, and Goodwood.
zh:
这款原型电动车在世界各地“刷圈速”。

Volkswagen的原型赛车堪称碳减排的典范。碳纤维车身前后配备大型扰流翼，采用双电机布局分别驱动前后车轴。此车同时拥有惊人的性能表现，在派克峰爬坡赛、纽博格林北侧赛道以及古德伍德速度节等赛事中创下了令人瞩目的圈速记录。

carNameEn: Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo Street Mode
sourceName: Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo Street Mode
en:
A high-performance luxury car prepared as a "beautifully wrapped gift."

This Vision Gran Turismo came from a renowned Italian design house. Its name was derived from the Latin word xenium, meaning “gift for the guest.” Its design encases both driver and engine in layered carbon fiber and aluminum, resulting in a distinctive wrapped appearance. A V-10 engine has been mounted behind the cockpit, while two electric motors powered the front wheels. To adapt to various terrain conditions, the chassis can be adjusted into four different configurations.
zh:
一辆按照“包装精美的礼物”思路设计的高性能豪华跑车。

出自著名意大利设计工作室的Vision Gran Turismo概念车型。车名源自拉丁语“xenium”，意为“赠予宾客的礼物”，其设计理念是用碳纤维和铝材将驾驶员与引擎完美“包裹”其中。驾驶舱后方搭载V10引擎，前部则配置了双电机系统。底盘可调节为4种不同配置模式，以适应各种路况和地形。

carNameEn: Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo Off-road Mode
sourceName: Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo Off-road Mode
en:
A high-performance luxury car prepared as a "beautifully wrapped gift."

This Vision Gran Turismo came from a renowned Italian design house. Its name was derived from the Latin word xenium, meaning “gift for the guest.” Its design encases both driver and engine in layered carbon fiber and aluminum, resulting in a distinctive wrapped appearance. A V-10 engine has been mounted behind the cockpit, while two electric motors powered the front wheels. To adapt to various terrain conditions, the chassis can be adjusted into four different configurations.
zh:
一辆按照“包装精美的礼物”思路设计的高性能豪华跑车。

出自著名意大利设计工作室的Vision Gran Turismo概念车型。车名源自拉丁语“xenium”，意为“赠予宾客的礼物”，其设计理念是用碳纤维和铝材将驾驶员与引擎完美“包裹”其中。驾驶舱后方搭载V10引擎，前部则配置了双电机系统。底盘可调节为4种不同配置模式，以适应各种路况和地形。

en:
Essentially a road-going version of Subaru's WRC car, this car’s production was limited to only 400 units (and sold out immediately).

This limited-edition model, based on the Impreza WRX STi Version IV, featured wide blister fenders identical to those of the World Rally car and was powered by a 2.2-liter boxer engine producing 276.1 HP and 267.6 ft-lb of torque. Despite its five million yen price tag, all 400 units sold out within days, securing its status as one of the most coveted models among Subaru enthusiasts.
zh:
拥有与WR赛车完全相同外观的Impreza，限量400台。刚一上市就被抢购一空。

这是一款基于Impreza WRX STi Version IV打造的限量版车型。其车身上安装了与世界拉力锦标赛赛车同款的鼓起式挡泥板，并由一部能够输出280 PS/37.0 公斤力米的2.2升水平对置引擎提供动力。尽管定价高达500万日元，但限量生产的400台在几天内就销售一空，使其成为了全球车迷最趋之若鹜的车型之一。

carNameEn: Subaru Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99
sourceName: Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99
en:
After six years of evolution, this car represented the final form of the GC8 Impreza coupe.

Released in September 1999, this was the coupe version of the Impreza Version VI. In addition to its rally-inspired styling, it came equipped with the Driver’s Control Center Differential (DCCD), an intercooler water sprayer, specially tuned stiff suspension, and a reinforced rear axle—all as standard. Its iconic EJ20 engine was tuned to deliver 276.1 HP, making this one of the most complete and refined GC8 models ever produced.
zh:
经过6年的发展，这款基于GC8平台的Impreza双门轿车终于问世。

这是1999年9月发布的Impreza Version VI的双门轿跑版本。除了拉力赛车风格的外观设计，还标配驾驶员可控中央差速器、中间冷却器喷水系统、专业调校的运动悬挂以及强化后轴。经典的EJ20引擎经过精心调校，最大功率达到280 PS，成就了这台完美的GC8车型。

en:
Subaru's triple race winning Impreza World Rally car from the 1998 season.

This WRC machine was based on the 2-door Impreza. Beginning with the 1997 model, this evolution introduced computer-controlled active differentials at the front, rear, and center. Although it didn’t secure Subaru a fourth consecutive constructors’ title, Colin McRae’s wins in Portugal, the Tour de Corse, and the Acropolis rallies proved its formidable potential.
zh:
在1998赛季中为Subaru三夺分站冠军的Impreza世界拉力赛车

这台世界拉力锦标赛战车以双门Impreza为基础开发。自1997年款开始，这一进化版本新增了前、后、中央三组电脑控制的主动差速器系统。虽然未能帮助Subaru蝉联第四个制造商冠军，但车手科林·麦克雷在葡萄牙拉力赛、科西嘉岛拉力赛和希腊卫城拉力赛中夺冠，充分证明了这台赛车的实力。

en:
The second-generation Impreza was developed alongside the rally spec model.

The first facelift of the GD-generation Impreza was marked by its distinctive teardrop-shaped “blob eye” headlights. Engine efficiency was improved with the adoption of equal-length, matched exhaust headers. Also, some manual variants featured a Driver's Control Center Differential with an automatic mode. A minor update in 2004 brought larger tires and boosted torque output to 303.8 ft-lb.
zh:
第二代Impreza，与拉力赛规格车型同时开发。

GD Impreza首次改款最显著的特征是采用了泪滴造型的“泡泡眼”前大灯。采用等长排气歧管设计，有效提升了引擎工作效率。部分手动挡车型还配备了具有自动模式的驾驶员可控中央差速器。2004年的小幅改款进一步增大了轮胎规格，同时将最大扭矩提升至42.0 公斤力米。

en:
High performance made possible with a V8 engine and electrical motor. A GT machine packed with the motorsport passion of Asia.

The INFINITI CONCEPT Vision Gran Turismo was developed by the Infiniti premium brand under the guiding philosophy of “designing a pure INFINITI GT car.” The design team set out to create a full-fledged race machine, while also crafting a seductive and distinctive race design language.
zh:
依托于V8引擎和电机的高性能。洋溢着亚洲赛车激情的GT车型。

这辆INFINITI CONCEPT Vision Gran Turismo是高端品牌Infiniti秉持“设计一款纯粹的Infiniti GT赛车”理念所打造的作品。设计师们旨在全面打造一辆充满野性的赛车机器，也为Infiniti塑造一个理想的赛车形象。

en:
The first Type R model of the Integra, this car was built to be the ultimate front-wheel drive sports car.

This high-performance version of the Integra was introduced in 1995. Its B18C engine, derived from the Si model, was enhanced with high-compression pistons, reinforced connecting rods, and dual valve springs, all assembled by hand for maximum precision. The body saw increased rigidity alongside weight reduction, while the suspension was completely reworked to deliver sharp, balanced handling with virtually no understeer. It earned the nickname “the road-going race car.”
zh:
Integra的首个Type R车型，旨在成为终极的前轮驱动跑车。

1995年推出的Integra高性能车型。Si版本的B18C引擎经过全面升级，采用高压缩比活塞、强化连杆以及双气门弹簧，所有部件均为纯手工精密装配。在减轻车身重量的同时大幅提升车身刚性，悬挂系统经过彻底改造，实现了稳健精准的操控表现，完全消除了转向不足的倾向。此车也作为可上路的赛车而广为人知。

en:
This third-gen Integra Type R received more power and hand-crafted tuning.

This car introduced the concept of the Type R, a road-going race car. At its heart was the 1.8-liter VTEC B18C engine, hand-built with a high-compression head and carefully matched connecting rods to produce 197.2 HP. While performance parts like the helical LSD added weight, it was offset by stripping out comfort features, resulting in pure speed.
zh:
经过人工调校，第3代Integra Type R的性能升级。

这台车将“Type-R”公路赛车的概念普及给了全世界。首先，它配备了一部手工打造的1.8升VTEC B18C引擎，并采用了高压缩活塞头和高强度连杆，能够输出200 PS的动力。尽管增加了螺旋限滑差速器等分量较重的零件，但还是通过去除舒适性内饰等方式大幅减轻了车重，进而实现难以置信的速度性能。

en:
A fearsome driving machine that challenges the preconceptions of BEVs.

This performance model was introduced two years after the original launch of the IONIQ 5. It featured a 4-wheel-drive system powered by electric motors on the front and rear axles, allowing for freely adjustable torque distribution. When set to a rear-wheel bias, the system enabled the over two-ton SUV to be drifted with ease. In an effort to preserve the excitement of traditional combustion-engine cars, this unique electric SUV also offered a simulated 8-speed dual-clutch transmission and synthetic exhaust sounds.
zh:
一款颠覆纯电动车型传统认知的性能怪兽。

这款IONIQ 5的高性能版本在其首发两年后正式推出。四驱系统采用前后轴双电机布局，可实现扭矩的自由调节和分配。当调节为偏向后驱时，即便是这台超过2吨的车也能轻松实现漂移驾驶。这款独特的电动SUV力图保持传统燃油车的驾驶激情，特别配备了模拟8速双离合变速箱以及仿真排气声效。

en:
A new paradigm for high-performance EV.

This was the second high-performance EV from Hyundai N. Equipped with a power unit with 770 Nm of torque and 641 HP of total system output, in a body tuned for aerodynamic performance, it accelerates from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.2 seconds. Features such as N Active Sound+ and N e-Shift, which gave the feeling of gear shifts in an EV, showed Hyundai N’s dedication to preserving the fun of driving.
zh:
高性能电动车的全新标杆。

这是Hyundai N的第二款高性能电动车。最大扭矩达到770 Nm，总动力输出更是高达650 PS，车身经空气动力学优化至极致，从0加速到100 公里/小时仅需3.2秒。“N Active Sound+”声浪和“N e-Shift”换挡模拟等功能的加入，充分体现了Hyundai对驾驶乐趣的执着追求。

en:
This fully electric sports car combines Jaguar's rich racing tradition with the latest in EV technology.

This Vision Gran Turismo was created by Jaguar Advanced Design. A fully electric model, it carries forward the legacy of Jaguar’s legendary race cars like the C-type, D-type, and E-type, not only in elegance, but also in engineering, with a low center of mass and near-perfect weight distribution. Inside the cockpit, all essential driving information has been seamlessly projected ahead of the driver, delivering a thrilling racing experience through advanced digital integration.
zh:
全电动跑车，结合了Jaguar的赛车理念和最新的技术。

这款Vision Gran Turismo概念车由Jaguar Advanced Design设计部门打造。这款纯电动车型传承了Jaguar经典赛车C-Type、D-Type和E-Type的设计血统，不仅外观优雅，更具备低重心和完美的前后配重。坐进驾驶舱，所有必要的驾驶信息都会无缝投射在前方路面上，通过数字化技术营造出身临其境的赛车体验。

en:
A roadster that's an heir to the legendary D-Type.

Jaguar’s third Vision Gran Turismo paid homage to the iconic Jaguar D-type. This futuristic electric open single-seater with an aero screen is powered by three electric motors generating more than 986.2 HP. Behind the seat is a modern take on the D-type’s signature fin, while the focused, minimalist cockpit controls reflected Jaguar’s storied racing legacy.
zh:
一辆源于传奇D-type的跑车。

Jaguar第三款Vision Gran Turismo概念车的设计灵感源自经典的Jaguar D-Type赛车。这款配备导流风挡的开放式电动单座赛车采用三电机驱动，最大功率超过1,000 PS。座椅后方采用了经典D-Type标志性尾鳍的现代化演绎，简洁专业的座舱控制系统也充分体现了Jaguar的历史底蕴与传统。

en:
This virtual electric race car provides a glimpse into the future of Jaguar.

Jaguar’s second Vision Gran Turismo was developed with engineering input from Jaguar Special Vehicles (SV). While retaining its elegant silhouette, the car received a complete aerodynamic overhaul to maximize downforce. The powertrain features four electric motors, drawing from Jaguar’s Formula E expertise. The battery system utilizes state-of-the-art liquid nitrogen cooling.
zh:
这辆虚拟电动赛车是对Jaguar未来的一瞥。

Jaguar第二款Vision Gran Turismo概念车由Jaguar设计，并融合了Jaguar特种车辆部门（SV）的工程技术。在保持优雅车身设计的同时，空气动力学系统经过彻底重新设计，以获得最大下压力。动力系统充分运用了该公司在Formula E赛事中积累的技术经验，采用四电机驱动布局。电池组还配置了最先进的液氮冷却系统。

en:
A stouter Jimny with an eye on global success.

This 3-door model of the Jimny was lengthened and widened to better suit international markets. Now mated to a 1460 cc DOHC inline-4, the part-time 4WD system with a mechanical transfer case delivers uncompromising off-road performance. The third-generation JB74, counting from the original Sierra, earned widespread acclaim for its boxy, elongated design.
zh:
面向全球市场的“更强壮”的Jimny。

这款3门版Jimny经过车身加长加宽处理，以更好地适应国际市场需求。配备机械分动箱的分时四驱系统搭配1,460 立方厘米直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎，成就了卓越的越野性能。这款第三代JB74车型（从最初的Sierra算起）凭借方正硬朗的拉长造型设计获得了广泛赞誉。

en:
Japan's mighty micro off-roader boasts amazing all-terrain ability beyond its size. 

This was Japan’s premier micro off-roader. Since its debut in the 1970s, the Jimny consistently adhered to kei-car regulations, featuring a ladder frame chassis, 4-wheel drive with rigid axle suspension, and large-diameter tires. In 2018, the boxy fourth-generation model was introduced, maintaining its rugged charm while gaining popularity both as a leisure vehicle and as a reliable workhorse in Japan’s mountainous regions.
zh:
超越其规格的惊人全地形能力。日本最强大的微型越野车。

日本微型越野车的代表。自1970年代首次亮相以来，Jimny始终采用符合轻型车规格的边梁式底盘结构，配备四驱硬轴非独立悬挂和大尺寸轮胎。2018年推出的第四代方形车身设计，不仅成为热门的休闲越野车，更在山区地带发挥着实用工具车的作用。

en:
This popular leisure activity vehicle began its life as a commercial van.

In French, small vans are called "fourgonnettes." And the Kangoo gained popularity for embodying that spirit, with sliding passenger doors and split-folding rear seats that made it ideal not only for commercial tasks but also for personal and recreational use. It became a pioneer of the ludospace segment—vehicles designed for leisure activity. While its engine delivered only modest power, the soft suspension gave it a surprisingly lively and enjoyable driving character.
zh:
这是一款由商用厢式车演变而来的人气休闲车型。

在法语中，小型厢式货车被称为“fourgonnette”。Kangoo凭借侧滑车门和可折叠后排座椅的实用设计获得了广泛认可，既适合商用也完美满足个人休闲用车需求。它成为了“ludospace”休闲空间车型的开创者。虽然引擎功率不算强劲，但舒适的悬挂调校营造出轻松动感的驾驶感受。

en:
This car, dubbed the "Hako-Suka," became a legend after winning 50 races in a row.

This high-performance version of the C10 Skyline—affectionately known as the “Hakosuka”—was introduced in February 1969. It featured bolt-on overfenders and the S20 DOHC engine, derived from the R380 race car, bringing true motorsport pedigree to the street. Its racing success was extraordinary, claiming 52 victories—49 of them consecutively—before the factory team withdrew from competition. The legend of the Skyline began here.
zh:
Skyline传奇的开启者。连续赢得50场比赛的传奇Hakosuka（方盒Skyline）。

这是C10 Skyline的高性能版本，昵称“Hakosuka”，于1969年2月正式发布。配备螺栓式宽体轮拱和源自R380赛车的S20双顶置凸轮轴引擎。此车创造了史无前例的赛车战绩，在其车厂车队停止参赛前共夺得52场胜利，其中包括49场连胜。Skyline的传奇历史正是由它开启的。

en:
Only 197 examples of this GT-R were made before it was discontinued because of stricter emissions standards.

This high-performance version of the fourth-generation C110 Skyline was built to carry on the legacy of the GT-R. Larger than its predecessor, it retained the same S20 inline-6 found in the iconic “Hakosuka” GT-R, and was upgraded with 4-wheel disc brakes for improved stopping power. Although it was designed with motorsport in mind, tightening emissions regulations forced its early retirement before it could compete in a single race. Only 197 were produced.
zh:
这款GT-R只生产了197辆，就因更严格的排放标准而不得不停产。

这是第四代“C110”Skyline的高性能车型。相比前代车型体型更大，搭载与“Hakosuka”GT-R相同的S20直列六缸引擎，并首次配备四轮碟式刹车系统。这款车旨在延续GT-R的辉煌传统，但新的排放法规导致其未能参加任何一场比赛就不得不结束赛车生涯。该车总共仅生产了197台。

en:
Ferrari’s first hybrid car, built with the same materials and processes as an F1 racing machine.

This was one of Ferrari’s flagship special models—continuing the legacy of the F40, F50, and Enzo Ferrari. It was built using the same materials and techniques found in Ferrari’s Formula 1 program, with a carbon monocoque chassis and a specially tuned version of the 6.3-liter V-12 engine from the F12berlinetta, producing 788 HP, enhanced further by the HY-KERS hybrid system. Performance was nothing short of astounding: 0–62.1 mph in under 3 seconds, 0–124.3 mph in under 7 seconds, and a top speed exceeding 217.5 mph.
zh:
Ferrari的第一款混动车型，完全使用F1赛车的材料和工艺打造。

Ferrari历史上生产过无数特殊车型，譬如F40、F50以及Enzo Ferrari，这款车也是其中之一。该车的材料与制作工艺与Ferrari F1赛车相同，采用了碳纤维单体车壳设计，并配备了调校后可输出800 PS的6.3升V12 F12berlinetta引擎，此外还辅以一套HY-KERS混合动力系统。这辆车的加速从0-100 公里/小时仅需不到3秒，0-200 公里/小时也只要不到7秒，而极速则可以达到令人咂舌的350 公里/小时。

en:
This futuristic single-seat sports concept possesses the core concepts of Lamborghini's design DNA.

This Vision Gran Turismo concept was born from the passion and technical expertise of the team at Centro Stile Lamborghini. Built around Lamborghini’s signature design language, highlighted by bold "Y" elements and hexagonal forms, it also pays tribute to the iconic Stratos Zero with a side profile that echoed its striking silhouette. Power comes from a V-12 engine paired with a supercapacitor-based hybrid system, derived from the Sián FKP 37. In a refined detail, part of this advanced system is visible from the outside, blending high-performance engineering with unmistakable style.
zh:
这款近未来主义的单座运动概念车的核心设计理念带有深深的Lamborghini 基因。

这款Vision Gran Turismo凝聚了Centro Stile Lamborghini团队的炽热激情与精湛技艺。虽然主要设计语言采用“Y”形和六边形元素，但侧面轮廓却与经典的Stratos Zero有着异曲同工之妙。动力系统采用V12引擎配合超级电容混合动力技术，技术源自Sián FKP 37。最为精妙的设计细节在于，这套系统的运作状态可以从车外清晰看到。

en:
Improved aerodynamics and cooling make for the ultimate first-gen  "Evo."

The third-generation Lancer Evolution was introduced in January 1995. With a focus on improving racing performance, it received aerodynamic and cooling enhancements, including a wider front bumper intake and a prominent rear wing mounted on the trunk. The legendary 4G63 engine was further refined to produce 266.3 HP, delivering sharper response and increased power. In the 1996 World Rally Championship, Tommi Mäkinen drove this very model to victory, securing the drivers' title.
zh:
改进的空气动力学和冷却系统催生出首批巅峰“Evo”跑车。

第三代Lancer Evolution于1995年1月正式发布。为了提升竞技性能，针对空气动力学和散热系统方面进行了重点优化，这从前保险杠更大的进气口和后备箱上的大型扰流板可见一斑。经典的4G63引擎经过进一步调校，最大功率达到270 PS。在1996年世界拉力锦标赛中，托米·马基宁驾驶这款赛车夺得了车手总冠军。

en:
The 4th-gen Evo's handling got a boost from electronic Active Yaw Control and power now up to 276.1 HP.

In August 1996, the second-generation Lancer was introduced, bringing with it the Lancer Evolution IV. The 4G63 engine was rotated 180 degrees compared to previous models and delivered 276.1 HP with a peak torque of 260.4 ft-lb. A major advancement came with the rear differential, where the traditional mechanical LSD was replaced by an electronically controlled AYC (Active Yaw Control) system—greatly enhancing handling precision.
zh:
采用电子AYC，马力达到280 PS的第四代Lancer Evo。

1996年8月，第二代Lancer公布，随之公布的还有Lancer Evolution IV。不同于前代车型，其4G63引擎的安装方向翻转了180度，能够产生280 PS，最大扭矩也提高到36.0 公斤力米。而在后差速器方面，前代的机械限滑差速器被换成了电控主动偏航系统，从而大幅提升了操控性。

en:
The 5th-gen Evo impressed with its bolder-looking flared fenders and an engine that produced more torque.

The fifth-generation Lancer Evolution was introduced in January 1998. Developed with the World Rally Championship in mind, the body was widened and the 4G63 engine received further tuning to boost torque. The AYC system (Active Yaw Control) from the Evolution IV was retained, while new inverted dampers and a front helical LSD were added to further elevate performance and cornering ability.
zh:
第五代的Lancer Evo，加上了挡泥板，更增添了扭矩。

第五代Lancer Evolution于1998年1月正式推出。针对世界拉力锦标赛的参赛需求，车身进行了加宽处理，4G63引擎也经过重新调校以提升扭矩输出。延续了前代车型的电子控制AYC（主动偏航控制）系统，并新增了倒置式避震器和前螺旋齿轮限滑差速器，进一步提升了性能表现。

carNameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '99
sourceName: Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '00
en:
Optional body graphics stood out on this rare Tommi Mäkinen Edition Evo.

This special edition of the Lancer Evolution VI was introduced to celebrate Tommi Mäkinen’s remarkable achievement of four consecutive WRC drivers’ championships. Tailored for tarmac rallies, its ride height was lowered by 0.4 inches, and low-end torque was increased to enhance everyday drivability. Limited to 2,500 units, it featured an exclusive red body color and matching seats, special alloy wheels, and a large-diameter exhaust silencer, making it as distinctive as it was capable.
zh:
可选的车体条纹让这款Tommi Makinen版显得尤为亮眼。

这款Lancer Evolution VI特别版是为纪念托米·马基宁连续四年夺得世界拉力锦标赛车手总冠军的辉煌成就而推出。针对柏油路面拉力赛进行调校，车身高度降低10毫米，并提升了低转速扭矩输出以增强实用性。此车限量生产2500台，配备专属红色车身涂装和内饰，以及特制合金轮毂和大口径排气消声器。

carNameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
sourceName: Lancer GSR Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
en:
The final evolution of the Lancer Evo VIII with updated suspension and low center of gravity.

The eighth-generation Lancer Evolution was introduced in January 2003. Refinements to the ACD (Active Center Differential) and AYC (Active Yaw Control) systems improved both handling and ride comfort. The 4G63 engine delivered up to 289.3 ft-lb of torque, and with the addition of a new 6-speed manual transmission, the car was better equipped than ever to perform in a wide range of driving conditions.
zh:
Lancer Evo VIII的最终进化，更新了悬架系统，具有更低的重心。

第八代Lancer Evolution于2003年1月正式发布。相比上一代车型，ACD（主动中央差速器）和AYC（主动偏航控制）控制系统经过优化改进，显著提升了驾乘舒适性。4G63引擎的最大扭矩现已达到40.0 公斤力米，搭配全新6速手动变速箱，让这款车在各种驾驶环境下都能展现出卓越性能。

carNameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR GSR '06
en:
The "9.5," the final 4G63-powered Lancer Evolution.

The Lancer Evolution IX GSR bears the MR initials for Mitsubishi Racing. Performance was enhanced in every area. The MIVEC system was tuned to sharpen turbo response, while the suspension benefited from Eibach springs and an updated AYC calibration for improved cornering stability. Marking the final appearance of the legendary 4G63 engine, this model stood as the pinnacle of the third wave of Lancer Evolution cars.
zh:
9.5代Lan Evo，是采用4G63引擎的最后一款Lancer Evolution。

“LanEvo”的IX GSR车型融入了Mitsubishi Racing（MR）的标识元素。整体性能全面提升，引擎MIVEC系统经过精心调校以优化涡轮响应特性，悬挂系统则采用Eibach弹簧并配备新版AYC（主动偏航控制）调校，带来更出色的操控表现。这是最后一款搭载经典4G63引擎的Evo车型，堪称第三代LanEvo系列的集大成之作。

en:
An icon bodes farewell with a special Final Edition model.

Limited to just 1,000 units, this was the final edition of the Lancer Evolution X, although the X itself was omitted from the body, subtly suggesting its role as the last of the legendary line. Based on the 5-speed manual GSR model, it featured an upgraded engine producing 308.7 HP and 311.0 ft-lb of torque, equipped with sodium-filled exhaust valve stems for improved durability. It also came standard with the "high-performance package," which included Bilstein dampers and Eibach springs.
zh:
真正的最终车型，为其漫长的WRC征战历史画上句号。

这款Lancer Evolution X是系列中的终极车型，仅限量推出1000台。其车型名称中的“X”甚至没有出现在车身上，暗示着它将是Lancer Evolution的最后一款车型。它基于采用5档手动变速箱的GSR型号打造，改为加装了钠冷排气阀杆，其引擎可以输出313 PS/43.0 公斤力米。它还提供了一套“高性能套装”，包含Bilstein减震器和Eibach弹簧等等。

carNameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Final Edition Gr.3
en:
Saying goodbye to the Evo was made easier by the awesome prowess of the "Final Edition" model.

This Gran Turismo Original reimagines Mitsubishi’s high-performance Lancer Evolution Final Edition as a machine built to meet Gr.3 racing regulations. Stripped of all non-essential elements, the design focuses purely on function. Slits on the front fenders channel turbulent air out of the wheel wells, while an array of winglets inside the fenders carefully manage airflow across the entire body.
zh:
真正的最终车型，为其漫长的WRC征战历史画上句号。

这款车是Mitsubishi的高性能轿车——Lancer Evolution Final Edition的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，针对Gr.3规格进行了改装。它秉持着功能第一的设计思路，移除了所有不必要的装饰。前挡泥板上的沟槽可以将空气乱流提前导出，挡泥板内部的诸多小翼片也能引导拂过整个车身的气流。

carNameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Final Edition Gr.4
en:
This final model closed the curtain on a long and historic WRC career.

This Gran Turismo Original reinterpreted Mitsubishi’s high-performance Lancer Evolution Final Edition for Gr.4 competition. Building on the Lancer’s proven success in real-world touring car racing, this version carries over the model’s advanced electronically controlled 4-wheel-drive system, delivering exceptional cornering performance and stability on the track.
zh:
这个终版车型为其漫长而精彩的世界拉力锦标赛旅途拉下了帷幕。

这款车是Mitsubishi的高性能轿车——Lancer Evolution Final Edition的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，针对Gr.4规格进行了改装。在真实世界的房车赛领域，Lancer已经取得了辉煌的成功，而这个版本采用了Lancer的专利电动控制四轮驱动系统，能够实现不可思议的转向，相信在竞技成绩方面也不遑多让。

carNameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Final Edition Gr.B Road Car
sourceName: Lancer Evolution Final Edition    Gr.B Road Car
en:
This Gr.B rally machine is a highly tuned version of the final Lancer Evolution.

A homologation model of the Lancer Evolution Final Edition Gr.B, this version has been originally developed as a rally base car. Thanks to its near-perfect 50:50 weight distribution and extended rear wing, it delivers handling on paved roads that few other 4-wheel-drive vehicles could match.
zh:
这款B组别拉力赛车是最后一版Lancer Evolution的高性能调校版本。

这款车基于Mitsubishi的高性能轿车——Lancer Evolution Final Edition打造，是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型的Gr.B认证车型。尽管原车的设计定位是拉力赛车，但它拥有完美的50:50配重比和宽大的尾翼，意味着它在公路上同样性能拔群，能够以其他四轮驱动车型无法做到的方式过弯。

carNameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Final Edition Gr.B Rally Car
sourceName: Lancer Evolution Final Edition    Gr.B Rally Car
en:
An icon bodes farewell with a special Final Edition model.

This Gran Turismo Original is a Gr.B-spec reinterpretation of Mitsubishi’s high-performance sedan, the Lancer Evolution Final Edition. Its white, silver, and red livery pays tribute to the iconic rally machines of Mitsubishi’s storied World Rally Championship past. Fitted with Gr.3-style aerodynamic components, it generates substantial downforce that can challenge even today’s WRC contenders.
zh:
真正的最终车型，为其漫长的WRC征战历史画上句号。

这款车是Mitsubishi的高性能轿车——Lancer Evolution Final Edition的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，专门针对Gr.B规格进行了改装。这辆拉力赛车的白、银、红三色涂装是对过去那辆世界拉力锦标赛赛车的致敬。它安装了Gr.3风格的空气动力学部件，能够提供强大的下压力，让这辆车拥有了能够与现代拉力赛车分庭抗礼的性能。

en:
A best-selling Land Cruiser with a 24-year production run.

Renowned for its all-terrain performance and reliability, the Toyota Land Cruiser has become among the world’s most beloved off-road vehicles. Introduced in 1960, the third-generation “40” series also offered a surprising degree of on-road comfort. The 2-door hardtop variant shown here was powered by a 3.9-liter F-model gasoline engine, paired with a part-time 4-wheel-drive system. Its popularity only grew in 1974 with the introduction of the 3.0-liter B-model diesel engine. The 40 series went on to become a massive success, remaining in production until 1984.
zh:
这款经典畅销的Land Cruiser生产周期长达24年。

凭借卓越的全地形性能与可靠性，Land Cruiser已成为全球最受喜爱的越野车型。1960年问世的第三代“40”车型还同时兼顾了舒适的公路驾驶体验。这台双门硬顶车型搭载3.9升F型汽油引擎和分时四驱传动系统。但1974年推出3升B型柴油引擎让这台车的人气进一步提升。该系列热销不衰，持续生产至1984年。

en:
This stylish sports coupe attracted plenty of attention with its low nose and short overhang design.

The LC500 is a luxury sports coupe that made its debut at the 2016 Geneva Motor Show. While its design featured sleek, flowing lines, the front and rear overhangs were shortened to accommodate a front mid-engine layout with 2+2 seating. A mix of lightweight materials was used throughout the body, achieving a balance of reduced weight and high structural rigidity.
zh:
这款时尚的双门跑车以其较低的车鼻和紧凑的前后悬间距吸睛无数。

LC500是一款豪华跑车，最初在2016年日内瓦车展上亮相。虽然其前悬和后悬进行了缩短，以实现2+2座位的前中置布局，但其依然保留了流畅的轿跑车身设计。另外，它的车身还运用了多种先进材料，在降低车重的同时还提升了刚性。

en:
The now legendary AE86, a compact rear-drive coupe that emphasized driving excitement.

The fourth-generation Corolla Levin was introduced in 1983. It carried over the floor panel from the previous TE71 and was the only model of its generation to retain a rear-wheel-drive layout, while all other Corollas had transitioned to front-wheel drive. The 1.6-liter 4A-GEU DOHC engine and lightweight body delivered a sharp, responsive driving experience. After production ended, demand for affordable rear-wheel-drive cars only grew, securing this model’s legacy as one of the greatest sports cars ever produced by Toyota.
zh:
紧凑型后轮驱动车的传奇，带来令人颤栗的驾驶体验。

这是1983年首次亮相的第四代Corolla Levin。该车型延续了前代TE71的底盘结构，在同代车型中独树一帜地保持了后轮驱动布局，而其他所有Corolla车型都已改为前轮驱动。1.6升4A-GEU双顶置凸轮轴引擎与轻量化车身的完美结合，成就了灵敏迅捷的驾驶体验。停产后市场对经济型后驱车的需求反而日益高涨，进一步确立了它作为Toyota史上最经典运动车型之一的不朽地位。

en:
A beautiful high performance machine for participation in the Nürburgring 24 hour race.

The Lexus LF-LC GT Vision Gran Turismo is a dream car crafted by Lexus with aspirations for competition in Super GT and the 24 Hours of Nürburgring. Inspired by the LF-LC luxury coupe concept, it merges CALTY DESIGN’s design philosophy with the technical practicality of Lexus Racing.
zh:
优雅的高性能赛车，参赛纽博格林24小时耐力赛。

这辆Lexus LF-LC GT“Vision Gran Turismo”是Lexus设计的梦幻车型，专为参加Super GT和纽博格林24小时耐力赛而打造。这款车基于LF-LC豪华双门概念车打造，其开发创意起源于CALTY DESIGN提出的Lexus设计哲学，并结合了Lexus Racing部门的实用型设计思路。

en:
This ultra high-tech sports car achieved ultimate performance with mass-production quality.

This ultimate sports car aimed to carry forward the spirit and performance legacy of the Toyota 2000GT. Its carbon-fiber body was produced through automated processes, and the transaxle and radiator were mounted at the rear to achieve a near-perfect 48:52 front-to-rear weight distribution. Under the hood was a 4.8-liter V-10 with a 72-degree bank angle. Its distinctive sound was tuned in collaboration with Yamaha. Only 500 units were produced, making it as rare as it was ambitious.
zh:
一辆以量产品质实现了终极性能的极致高科技水平跑车。

这款顶级跑车承载着传承Toyota 2000GT辉煌成就与卓越性能的使命而诞生。采用自动化工艺制造的碳纤维车身，变速驱动桥和散热器后置布局，实现了48:52的理想前后配重比例。搭载4.8升V10引擎，采用72度气缸夹角设计。引擎优美的轰鸣声经由乐器制造商Yamaha精心调校打造。全球限量生产500台。

en:
A hardboiled FR that hides the power of a demon in its compact body.

This ferocious beast housed the S55 twin-turbo 3.0-liter inline-6 from the M3 and M4 within the compact body of the 2 Series coupe. Its flared fenders hinted at the performance lurking beneath, and a brief press of the throttle was all it took to unleash the full force as the turbochargers came alive. The suspension incorporated aluminum components to reduce unsprung weight. Meanwhile, the torque-vectoring Active M Differential allowed it to tackle any corner with confidence and precision.
zh:
一辆在紧凑车身下隐藏着恶魔般动力的彪悍前置后驱车。

这台性能猛兽将来自M3/M4的S55 3升直列六缸双涡轮引擎移植到2系双门轿跑的紧凑车身中。外扩的轮拱暗示着澎湃的内在动力，只需短暂加速，涡轮增压器即可完全释放这股狂暴力量。悬挂系统采用铝合金部件，有效降低簧下质量。扭矩矢量分配主动M差速器让这台车能够游刃有余地应对各种弯道挑战。

en:
Featuring BMW's high-revving engine technology, this sports car represented the epitome of the E46 3 Series.

The third-generation M3 was introduced with the E46 3 Series. Its 3.2-liter S54 Inline-6 delivered more than 98.6 HP per liter, peaking at 338.3 HP at 7900 rpm. In 2003, the high-performance CSL variant was launched. It featured a carbon-fiber roof to reduce weight and a retuned engine pushing output to 355 HP. This model went on to achieve significant success in touring car racing and various other motorsport events.
zh:
这款跑车采用了BMW的高转速引擎技术，堪称E46 3系的巅峰之作。

第三代M3基于3系E46车型打造。3.2升S54直列六缸引擎的单升功率超过100 PS，在7,900 转每分转速下输出最大343 PS功率。2003年推出了高性能CSL版本。除采用碳纤维车顶实现轻量化外，引擎也经过深度调校，最大功率提升至360 PS。这款车日后在房车锦标赛及各项赛事中取得了辉煌战绩。

en:
A virtual race car for the street, this homologation model once claimed victory in the DTM. 

This homologation model was developed from the 3 Series platform of its time, specifically to compete in touring car racing. Built on the 2-door sedan, it featured a widened track and aerodynamic enhancements, including an adjustable rear wing to improve performance. It initially came with a 2.3-liter DOHC inline-4 engine, with continuous yearly refinements leading to the 2.5-liter Sport Evolution model.
zh:
曾在DTM中屡获殊荣的赛事认证车型。微微鼓起的挡泥板正是其性能的见证。

这款符合赛事认证要求的车型基于当时的3系开发，专为征战房车锦标赛而生。以双门轿车为基础，加宽轮距并进行空气动力学优化，包括精心调整尾翼的开启角度。最初搭载2.3升直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎，经过逐年改进升级，最终推出了2.5升“Sport Evolution”终极版本。

en:
From race car to luxury grand tourer, the second-generation M3.

The second-generation M3 was based on the E36 3 Series. It marked a shift from pure motorsport focus to a more refined grand tourer. This model offered a broader appeal with multiple body styles, including a 2-door coupe, 4-door sedan, and cabriolet. Originally equipped with a 3.0-liter engine, the M3 received an upgrade in 1995 to a 3.2-liter unit, along with the introduction of a 6-speed manual and an optional 2-pedal SMG (Sequential Manual Gearbox).
zh:
3.2L的第二代M3：从赛车到豪华旅行车。

第二代M3基于3系E36车型打造。相比初代车型的纯粹竞技风格，这一代车型更偏向于豪华旅行跑车的定位。新增直列六缸引擎选项的同时，提供双门、四门以及敞篷等多种车身形式可选。首发搭载3升引擎，1995款升级为3.2升，同时传动部分引入6速手动变速箱和双踏板SMG变速系统两种选择。

en:
Based on the E92 3 Series coupe, this 4th-gen M3 featured a 414.2 HP V8.
