Across multiple generations of the 3 Series, the M3 has consistently been positioned as a high-performance variant with a deep motorsports heritage. The E92 M3 paired a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission (DCT) with a high-revving 4.0-liter V-8 delivering 414.2 HP. Despite its larger body, extensive weight-saving measures kept the road car’s weight down to just 3593 lbs. It could sprint from zero to 62.1 mph in 4.8 seconds.
zh:
配备420 PS马力V8引擎的第四代M3，基于E92 3系双门跑车开发。

M3的定位是与赛车运动有着紧密联系的高性能车型，3系的每代产品都有它的身影。这辆E92车型搭载了7档双离合变速箱和能够输出420 PS的4升V8引擎。为了减轻较大尺寸车身的重量，开发团队作出了巨大的努力，使其公路车版本仅重1,630 公斤。它可以在4.8秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速。

en:
BMW's M3 GT2 raced in premier endurance contests including the ALMS and ILMC series as well as the 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

The GT version, developed from this high-performance base, was extensively modified for racing. Many body panels were replaced with carbon fiber, cutting weight down to 2745 lbs, while the fenders were flared, widening the body by 4.3 inches. Even with a restrictor in place, the 4.0-liter V-8 still produced an impressive 493.1 HP.
zh:
基于M3开发的竞赛车型，在纽博格林24小时耐力赛、亚洲勒芒系列赛和勒芒洲际大奖赛中屡有斩获。

这款GT车型基于高性能M3打造，专门针对比赛进行了改装。其大部分车身板件都更换为碳纤维材料，将车重降低到1,245 公斤，而其挡泥板也进行了加宽，让车身宽度来到了110毫米。即便安装了动力限制器，它的4升V8引擎依然可以输出500 PS的动力。

en:
This highly modified homologation version of the E30 3 Series served as a small hint of what was to come from BMW.

This coupe was designed for touring car racing and developed by BMW M, based on the E30 3 Series. It featured blistered fenders, front and rear spoilers, and distinctive side skirts, giving it a bold, aggressive appearance. The Sport Evolution was the final version of this M3 generation. Its enlarged 2.5-liter engine produced 234.7 HP and 173.6 ft-lb of torque, making it a formidable force on the circuit.
zh:
E30，一代传奇的开始。这款E30 3系认证车型经过了大幅改造。

这辆专为房车赛设计的双门轿跑是由BMW M部门基于3系的E30车型打造。它周身安装了鼓起式挡泥板、前后扰流翼和侧裙，营造出锐意进取的震撼外观。这辆Sport Evolution堪称M3的终极型号。它采用了更大排量的2.5升引擎，能够输出238 PS/24.0 公斤力米，成为一股赛道上不容小觑的力量。

en:
The BMW M4 becomes the 2-door version of the daunting M3.

The 3 Series coupe and cabriolet models were split off to form the new 4 Series lineup, with this car serving as the flagship. While its sleek 2-door coupe proportions made it visually striking, its true emphasis was on performance. Under the hood was a twin-turbocharged inline-6 producing 425 HP and 405.8 ft-lb of torque. Paired with an active M differential, adaptive M suspension, and M-specific DSC, it delivered a driving experience worthy of the M badge.
zh:
从起步加速到100 公里/小时仅需4.1秒。传奇M系列的高性能车型。

3系的双门轿跑与敞篷型号从车系中独立出来，成为了4系，而这辆车就是其中的旗舰型号。只看它匀称的双门轿跑车身比例，就已吸引到众多目光，然而这辆车真正的魅力却在于它的性能。它安装了一台直列六缸双涡轮引擎，动力输出达到431 PS/56.1 公斤力米。再搭配主动式M差速器、自适应M悬挂和M系专用动态稳定控制系统，共同打造出了终极的驾乘体验。

en:
A special safety-car version of the BMW M4.

This Gran Turismo Original safety car is based on BMW’s latest-generation high-performance M4 coupe. Building on the M Performance Edition, it features a range of specially designed components, including a front lip spoiler, hood pins, grille garnishes, a rear spoiler, and a rear diffuser.
zh:
用作安全车的特殊M4车型。

这辆跑车浪漫旅的原创车型的安全车基于BMW的最新一代高性能M4轿跑打造。它采用了“M Performance Edition”的外观，并为其加入了若干特别设计的部件，包括前唇扰流板、引擎盖销、格栅饰条、后扰流翼和扩散器。

en:
This Gran Turismo original Gr.4 race car maximizes the performance of the M4.

This Gran Turismo Original reimagines BMW’s new-generation high-performance M4 coupe as a Gr.4-spec machine. Although styled like a touring car, it retains the precise cornering ability and rock-solid stability that define BMW’s performance legacy. Its well-balanced handling and approachable dynamics make it an ideal choice even for novice drivers.
zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅原创Gr.4跑车将M4的性能发挥到了极致。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型基于BMW的新一代高性能M4轿跑打造，并针对Gr.4规格进行了改装。尽管采用了房车风格的外观，它依然保留了BMW众所称道的过弯能力和稳定性，其表现久经考验。它拥有极其可靠的驾驶性能，意味着即便是新手司机也能毫不费力地在赛道上行驶。

en:
A powerful GT3 race machine with a 4.4-liter twin-turbocharged V8.

This car succeeded the Z4 GT3, which had been BMW’s flagship GT3 racer since 2010. In stark contrast to the compact Z4, it featured a commanding presence, measuring nearly 16.4 ft long and more than 6.6 ft wide. Under the hood, a twin-turbo 4.4-liter V-8 delivered 576.9 HP in its stock configuration. Built primarily from carbon fiber, the car also featured a completely redesigned frame and suspension, setting it far apart from the production M6.
zh:
配备4.4升双涡轮增压的新一代BMW GT3。

自从2010年起，Z4 GT3一直是BMW GT3赛车的中流砥柱，而这款车正是其后继车型。与紧凑的Z4不同，这款车拥有更具威慑力的外观，车身长度约为5 米，宽2 米。它的内核是一台4.4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，在原厂设置下能够输出585 PS的动力。其车身大多采用了碳纤维材料打造，其框架和悬挂也得到了彻底改造，让它与消费级M6车型天差地别。

en:
The car driven by Kazunori Yamauchi in the 2016 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

BMW announced its entry into the FIA GT3 category with the M6 GT3, beginning in the 2016 season. At 16.4 ft long and 6.6 ft wide, it presented a noticeably larger footprint compared to its predecessor, the compact Z4 GT3. Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi competed in the Nürburgring 24 Hours behind the wheel of the Walkenhorst Motorsport M6 GT3, finishing the race and placing 22nd overall.
zh:
山内一典在2016年纽博格林赛道24小时耐力赛中驾驶的赛车。

BMW宣布，他们将从2016年起派出这辆M6 GT3参加FIA-GT3组别的比赛。这辆车的车身尺寸长5米，宽2米，相比起前代的紧凑型赛车Z4 GT3大了一圈。《跑车浪漫旅》系列制作人山内一典曾驾驶这辆Walkenhorst Motorsport M6 GT3参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛，并取得了总排名第22名的成绩。

en:
A new category sports prototype that carries the lineage of the celebrated V12 LMR.

This cutting-edge Le Mans Daytona h (LMDh) prototype used a Dallara-built carbon-fiber monocoque and a hybrid system built around the DTM-derived P66/3, a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8 engine. During the 2025 season, the car competed in both the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship and the FIA World Endurance Championship, highlighted by a 1-2 finish at Road America in the eighth round of IMSA In the WEC, it also showed strong pace at rounds such as Imola, proving itself at the highest level of endurance racing.
zh:
参与全新组别的原型跑车，继承传奇车型V12 LMR血脉。

这款前沿的勒芒-戴通纳混合动力（LMDh）原型车，采用了Dallara制造的碳纤维单体车身，并搭载混合动力系统，整合源自DTM的“P66/3”4升V8双涡轮增压引擎。该车在2025赛季参加了IMSA跑车锦标赛和国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛，并在IMSA第八轮美国之路站的比赛中，以精彩的表现包揽了冠亚军。在世界耐力锦标赛中，这款车在伊莫拉等分站赛上同样表现出色，驰骋于耐力赛事的巅峰舞台。

en:
This mid-engine sports car set the stage for the famous Pantera.

This was De Tomaso’s second production mid-engine sports car. To address the lack of power in the earlier Vallelunga, it was fitted with a Ford V-8 engine. Weighing approximately 1.3 tons, the car could reach a top speed of 155.3 mph, thanks to its lightweight construction. The exterior, notable for its gullwing-opening rear section, was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro during his time at Carrozzeria Ghia. Production was limited to just 401 units.
zh:
这台中置引擎跑车为声名卓著的Pantera的登场铺平了道路。

De Tomaso品牌第二款量产中置引擎跑车。为解决前代Vallelunga动力孱弱的问题，该车搭载了Ford V8引擎。凭借约1.3吨的轻盈车重，最高时速可达250 公里/小时。采用鸥翼式开启后舱盖的外观设计出自乔盖托·乔治亚罗在Carrozzeria Ghia时期的手笔。全球仅生产401台。

en:
This sports sedan's refined looks hide sharp teeth.

The Tourer V was a performance model added to the eighth-generation Mark II lineup. Its biggest selling point was its power unit: a turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-6 engine that produced 276.1 HP and 278.5 ft-lb of torque. A 5-speed manual transmission was also available, and the roar of the 6-cylinder engine, combined with tremendous boost, hit as soon as the throttle pedal was floored. Even so, the interior was lavish and comfortable, bringing two seemingly opposite characters together in the Tourer V.
zh:
这款运动轿车精致的外表下暗藏锋芒。

Tourer V是第8代Mark II系列车款中新增的一款运动版车型。其最大卖点是动力单元：一台涡轮增压2.5升直列六缸引擎，可输出280 PS动力和38.5 公斤力米扭矩。该车还提供了5速手动变速箱。当你将油门踏板踩到底时，六缸引擎的轰鸣声，伴随着强大的增压推背感，向你瞬间袭来。有如此澎湃动力，Tourer V的内饰依然堪称奢华舒适，将两种看似矛盾的特质集于一身。

en:
Exploring the potential of internal combustion, a next-generation bio-diesel-powered race car.

This GT Original draws inspiration from the MAZDA3 Bio concept that competed in the ST-Q class of Japan’s Super Endurance Series. It runs on next-generation 100-percent biodiesel fuel derived from waste cooking oil. The body also incorporates environmentally friendly hybrid materials. This ambitious project aims to merge carbon neutrality with top-tier race car performance.
zh:
下一代生物燃料赛车，继续发掘内燃机的潜力。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型的设计灵感源自曾征战日本超级耐力锦标赛ST-Q组别的“MAZDA3 Bio concept”概念车。该车采用从废弃食用油中提取的新一代100%生物柴油作为燃料。车身同样采用了环保型复合材料。这一雄心勃勃的项目致力于在赛车运动中实现碳中和与顶级竞技性能的完美融合。

en:
An elegant fastback with a revolutionary combustion system.

The fourth-generation MAZDA3 made its debut in 2018. A standout addition to the lineup was the mild hybrid M Hybrid, which gained global attention for its SKYACTIV-X engine, utilizing spark-controlled compression ignition. The X Burgundy Selection is a limited-edition variant based on the X grade, featuring the advanced SKYACTIV-X powertrain paired with a rich burgundy interior, offering a mature sense of elegance.
zh:
采用了革命性的新引擎、外观优雅的斜背车。

第四代MAZDA3于2018年正式发布。随后推出的轻混动力“M Hybrid”车型搭载采用火花控制压燃技术的“SKYACTIV-X”引擎，引起全球瞩目。这款“X Burgundy Selection”限量版基于搭载SKYACTIV-X引擎的X级别车型打造，酒红色内饰营造出成熟典雅的氛围。

en:
A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.

The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo was crafted as Mazda’s futuristic vision of endurance racing excellence, with its sights set on total victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Its striking silhouette was shaped by Mazda’s KODO design philosophy, and the front grille echoes the modern face of Mazda’s production lineup with a bold reinterpretation.
zh:
速度和优雅的融合，源自挑战者百折不挠的精神。

这辆Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo是Mazda对未来的畅想，更是在勒芒24小时耐力赛争冠的赛道机器。这款车的外形轮廓充满动感，其设计灵感来源于Mazda的“魂动”设计哲学，甚至前格栅的形状也是对多年来Mazda量产车的标志性前脸的演绎。

en:
A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.

This Gr.1-spec evolution of the LM55 Vision Gran Turismo represents Mazda’s vision of a modern rotary-powered prototype. It delivers the razor-sharp cornering Mazda is known for, enhanced by the exceptional grip of a 4-wheel-drive system. With the ability to dart through corners and surge down straights, it stands as a true modern embodiment of the legendary "rotary rocket."
zh:
速度和优雅的融合，源自挑战者百折不挠的精神。

LM55 Vision Gran Turismo是Mazda构想的一款现代转子引擎原型车，而这辆车则是它的Gr.1改装版本。这辆车拥有超凡转向性能，不负Mazda的盛名，其四轮驱动系统也能提供强大的牵引力。看到它贴地冲过弯道，在直道上一骑绝尘的样子，你就能明白——这就是“转子火箭”梦想化为现实的样子。

en:
A special super car that embodies the tradition and passion of Maserati.

This marked Maserati’s first mid-engine sports car in 15 years, following the MC12. Designed with Dallara, the streamlined body was engineered to generate significant downforce without relying heavily on external aerodynamic elements. At its core was a lightweight carbon monocoque chassis weighing less than 220 lbs, paired with a newly developed twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine, featuring F1–inspired pre-chamber combustion.
zh:
一台承载了Maserati决心与激情的极致超级跑车。

这是Maserati继MC12之后时隔15年推出的首款中置引擎跑车。由Dallara设计的流线型车身无需依赖外置空气动力套件即可产生强劲下压力。碳纤维单体车架自重仅100 公斤，搭载全新开发的3升V6双涡轮引擎，采用F1级别预燃室技术。

en:
The ultra-exotic McLaren F1 exemplified the genius of its designer, Gordon Murray.

The McLaren F1 was a groundbreaking supercar conceived by legendary Formula 1 designer Gordon Murray. From its unique 3-seat configuration, with the driver positioned at the center, to its balanced weight distribution, the F1 introduced a host of innovations that redefined what a road car could be. Celebrated worldwide, it earned acclaim not only as the fastest production car of its time but also for its usability in everyday driving.
zh:
跑车的终极，汲取了天才戈登·穆雷的理念。

McLaren F1是一辆由Formula 1设计师戈登·穆雷打造的超级跑车。从将驾驶者置于中央位置的三座布局，到精心调校的配重比，这款极具革命性意义的车型拥有许多值得大书特书的优点。它不仅是全世界最快的超级跑车之一，在日常驾乘场景中也具备实用性，因而受到了全世界汽车爱好者的盛誉。

en:
The ultimate automobile by McLaren would go on to win both the BPR series and the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

This race version was based on McLaren’s first full-scale road car, the F1. At the rain-soaked 1995 24 Hours of Le Mans, the F1 GTR defied the odds, outperforming purpose-built prototype racers to claim overall victory. Car No. 59, backed by the factory and driven by Yannick Dalmas, Masanori Sekiya, and JJ Lehto, etched its name into motorsports history.
zh:
终极机器，BRP GT系列赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

这台赛车基于McLaren首款量产公路跑车F1打造。在1995年勒芒24小时耐力赛中，面对几乎持续一整天的降雨，McLaren力压本应更具优势的开放式原型赛车，勇夺总冠军。夺冠的59号赛车来自获得McLaren工厂支持的客户车队，由雅尼克·达尔马斯、关谷正德和J.J.莱托共同驾驶。

carNameEn: BMW McLaren F1 GTR Race Car '97
en:
This F1 GTR race car took many racing titles around the world, including the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

Masterminded by Gordon Murray, this car is the racing evolution of the high-performance road-going McLaren F1. After its debut in 1995, the car underwent continuous development, culminating in the introduction of this aerodynamically enhanced Long Tail version in 1997. The F1 GTR enjoyed a long racing career, remaining at the forefront of GT competition under privateer teams all the way through to 2003.
zh:
这辆F1 GTR在勒芒和全球各地的多项GT赛事中都拿下了桂冠。

由戈登·穆雷主导开发，这是基于“公路版F1”高性能跑车打造的竞赛版本。自1995年首度登场以来逐年改进升级，1997年迎来了这款空气动力学性能卓越的长尾版本。作为一款赛车，此车拥有相对悠长的竞赛生涯，在私人车队手中继续征战赛场直至2003年。

en:
This track-only model further defines the potential of the P1 hybrid supercar.

This circuit-only version of the McLaren P1 was created to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the F1 GTR and its race career throughout the 1990s. The hybrid powertrain, combining electric motors with a twin-turbo V-8, was tuned to produce 986.2 HP. To further enhance its track performance, the car received extensive aerodynamic upgrades, including a prominent rear wing.
zh:
专为赛道而设计的车型，进一步提升了P1混合动力超级跑车的潜力。

这辆车是P1的纯赛道版本，也是为了庆贺F1 GTR赛车诞生20周年，及其自1990年代起的辉煌生涯所特别开发。它的动力系统结合了多台电机和一台V8双涡轮增压引擎，总共可以输出高达1,000 PS的动力。另外，为了优化它的赛道性能，设计师还为其配备了宽大的尾翼，并做出了其他各种空气动力学改良。

en:
Putting the driver before all else, this car is the ultimate realization of the McLaren philosophy.

The McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo was developed as McLaren’s vision of high-performance motoring in 2030 and beyond. Behind the cabin, where the driver lay in a motorcycle-like position, resides a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8. The engine is assisted by high-performance electric motors housed in each of the front wheel pods, bringing the total output to 1134.1 HP.
zh:
这辆跑车实现了McLaren以车手为中心的终极设计哲学。

这款McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo是由McLaren着眼于2030年乃至更久以后未来而开发的汽车。车手将以类似于驾驶摩托车的坐姿驾驭这台机器，而在座舱后方则安置了一台4升V8双涡轮增压引擎。包裹两个前轮的舱室里还各安装有一部高性能电机，在它们的辅助下，整套系统可以输出高达1,150 PS的动力。

en:
This version of McLaren's future is realized in Gr.1 form with Vision Gran Turismo.

A Gran Turismo Original, this Gr.1 machine is based on the McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo, born from a collaboration between McLaren and Gran Turismo. While Gr.1 regulations restrict the use of active aerodynamic elements, the car still delivers exceptional cornering performance thanks to its inherently high-downforce body design and formidable mechanical grip.
zh:
McLaren的近未来设计Vision Gran Turismo的Gr.1版本。

McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo是McLaren和《跑车浪漫旅》联合开发的一款概念型号，而这辆跑车浪漫旅的原创车型的Gr.1赛车正是基于前者打造。虽然它的主动式空力部件严格按照Gr.1规定进行了限制，但其设计巧妙的车身外壳和强大的机械抓地力能够提供无与伦比的下压力，让这辆车依然能够游刃有余地通过弯道。

en:
This limited-edition Renault set a lap record at the Nürburgring.

Based on the third-generation Mégane 3-door coupe, the Mégane R.S. was factory-tuned by Renault Sport for high performance. With bespoke ground effects and a newly developed chassis, it delivered exceptional cornering capability—earning its reputation as one of the fastest front-wheel-drive cars of its time. In 2011, the Mégane R.S. Trophy was introduced. With just 500 units produced worldwide, it made headlines by setting a new Nürburgring lap record for mass-produced front-wheel-drive cars, clocking in at 8 minutes and 7.97 seconds.
zh:
这款限量版车型曾在纽博格林赛道上刷出了量产前驱车的圈速纪录。

这辆Mégane R.S.基于第三代Mégane三门轿跑打造，并由Renault Sport进行了精心的原厂调校。这辆车采用了全新开发的底盘，足以实现独特而优秀的地面效应，能够以相对较高的速度通过弯道，让它轻松摘得了速度最快的前轮驱动车的桂冠。Mégane R.S. Trophy于2011年正式上市，全球仅限量生产500辆。之后它在纽博格林赛道上跑出了8分7.97秒的圈速，创下了量产前轮驱动车的新纪录。

carNameEn: Renault Sport Mégane R.S. Trophy Safety Car
en:
This safety car version of the Mégane RS Trophy was created to patrol the race track.

This fictional safety car is based on that very Mégane R.S. Trophy. Developed by Renault Sport, the "R.S." was the high-performance version of the Mégane, but the Trophy edition pushed even further with increased engine output and finely tuned suspension, all in pursuit of becoming the fastest front-wheel-drive production car in the world.
zh:
Mégane RS Trophy比赛的安全车版本，专为赛道而设计。

这款虚构安全车以2011年限量500台发售的Mégane R.S. Trophy为原型。“R.S.”是Renault Sport打造的Mégane高性能版本，而Trophy版本在此基础上更进一步，通过提升引擎功率和全面的悬挂调校，力争成为世界最快的前驱量产车。

en:
This limited-edition Renault set a lap record at the Nürburgring.

This Gran Turismo Original is a Gr.4-spec version of Renault’s fastest hatchback, the Mégane. Having already proven itself with a blistering Nürburgring lap time, the Mégane's transformation into a race car felt like a natural progression. With outstanding traction and sharp cornering capabilities, it delivers such precise performance that you’ll forget it’s front-wheel drive at all.
zh:
这款限量版车型曾在纽博格林赛道上刷出了量产前驱车的圈速纪录。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是Renault最快的掀背车之一——Mégane的改版，针对Gr.4组别规则进行了改装。作为在纽博格林赛道上跑出创纪录圈速的Mégane，自然拥有无穷的赛车改装潜力。它所表现出的优秀牵引力和过弯能力，会让你忘记它本是一辆前驱车。

en:
Aggressive looks topped off by gullwing doors highlight this Mégane Trophy.

The Renault Sport Mégane Trophy was developed specifically for the Mégane Trophy race series, which began in 2005. While retaining the overall silhouette of the production Mégane, the Trophy version featured far more aggressive styling and a mid-mounted 355 HP 3.5-liter V-6 in a lightweight 2194 lbs package. A 6-speed two-pedal manual transmission with paddle shifters delivered quick, precise gear changes. The suspension and brakes were full racing spec.
zh:
Mégane Trophy车型，鸥翼车门为霸气外观更添魄力。

这辆Renault Sport Mégane Trophy是专为参加自2005年起创办的Mégane Trophy比赛所打造。在保留Mégane的整体风格之余，这辆Trophy版本加入了更富有进攻性的外观元素，并在其仅重995 公斤的车身内配备了一台调校至360 PS动力输出的3.5升V6引擎。它的传动系统采用了一套配有换挡拨片的6速双踏板手动变速箱。而悬挂和刹车也统统升级成完整的赛车规格。

en:
This high-output model of the Merak has been tuned for even sharper performance.

This mid-engine sports car made its debut in 1972 as the sister to the Bora. While the Bora was equipped with a V-8, the Merak utilized a smaller 3.0-liter V-6 sourced from the Citroën SM, allowing a 2+2 seating layout by making use of the extra space freed up in the rear. The SS was a high-performance variant introduced in 1975. By increasing the engine’s compression ratio, output was boosted, raising the top speed from 139.8 mph to 155.3 mph.
zh:
Merak的这款高动力车型经过调校后，性能更加犀利。

这款中置引擎跑车于1972年首度登场，与Bora互为姊妹车型。相比搭载V8引擎的Bora，Merak采用了来自Citroën SM的3升V6引擎，尺寸小了一号，并利用节省的空间打造了2+2座椅布局。SS是1975年推出的高性能版本。通过提高压缩比增强引擎输出，最高时速从225 公里/小时提升至250 公里/小时。

en:
The most powerful model of the fourth-generation C-Class boasts a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8. 

This was the high-performance variant of the fourth-generation C-Class. While it carried the familiar C63 name, it introduced significant changes, most notably replacing the naturally-aspirated 6.2-liter V-8 with a more compact and efficient twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8. Shared with the AMG GT, the engine was specially tuned, featuring increased maximum torque and a broader low-end range to better suit the C63’s weight and everyday performance needs. The C63 S Coupé is a circuit-focused performance model.
zh:
第四代C-Class阵容中的最强音，采用4升双涡轮增压V8引擎。

第四代C级车型的高性能版本。虽然沿用了C63的命名，但进行了重大升级，包括将自然进气6.2升V8引擎替换为4升双涡轮增压配置。这款新引擎与AMG GT搭载的相同，但针对车辆重量和定位特点，提高了最大扭矩并降低了扭矩输出转速区间。“C63 S Coupé”是专为赛道而生的高性能版本。

en:
An improved and more cost effective GT3 machine

This FIA-homologated GT3 race car was based on the AMG GT. While performance and aerodynamics were improved, development also prioritized reducing running costs for client teams. This led to longer engine life, improved radiator protection, and several other enhancements. In 2020, the EVO model was introduced alongside a facelift for the road car, bringing with it a host of new features.
zh:
一辆性能更强、更经济的GT3赛车。

这款获得FIA赛事认证的GT3赛车以AMG GT为基础打造。除了性能和空气动力学的提升外，开发过程中还重点考虑了客户车队的运营成本。这样的理念带来了更长的引擎寿命、更好的散热器保护等诸多改进。2020年，EVO车型伴随着公路版车型的改款升级和其他新功能一同发布。

en:
This ultimate version of the AMG GT is laden with Formula 1 technology.

It represents one of the ultimate evolutions derived from the AMG GT lineage since its debut in 2014. Its 4.0-liter V-8 has been specially tuned to deliver an impressive 719.9 HP and 800 Nm (590.0 ft-lb) of torque. The suspension system has been completely reengineered with upgraded materials and construction, optimizing handling and cornering precision. Adding to its appeal is aggressive, race-inspired bodywork.
zh:
注入了无数赛车运动的经验和知识，这就是AMG GT的终极版本。

这款终极跑车是AMG GT自2014年问世以来众多进化版本中的一款。4升V8引擎经过特别调校，功率和扭矩分别提升至730 PS和800牛米（81.6 公斤力米）。悬挂系统的结构和材料均经过全面革新，力求实现极致的操控和过弯性能。赛车风格的车身造型是另一大亮点。

en:
This race car dominated the 24 Hours of Nürburgring in its very first outing.

The AMG GT3 was Mercedes-Benz’s dedicated GT3 race car. It was introduced in 2016 and designed for global GT3 category competition. It quickly proved its worth by securing a remarkable 1-2-3-4 finish in its debut race at the Nürburgring 24 Hours. One of its most successful campaigns came through HTP Motorsport, a top contender in the Blancpain GT Series.
zh:
第一年参赛就称霸纽博格林赛道24小时耐力赛的领奖台。

AMG GT3是Mercedes-Benz旗下的GT3赛车。自2016年首次亮相后，便开始参与全世界范围内的各项GT3组别赛事。优越的性能帮助它在第一次出战纽博格林24小时耐力赛时就包揽了前四名。在使用这款车的客户车队中，最成功的便是HTP Motorsport，他们是Blancpain GT Series赛事中争冠行列的常客。

en:
This 'road-legal race car' evokes the image of the much-celebrated 300SL sports car.

This was a true “road-going race car” derived from the AMG GT. Its aggressive wide-body design included flared fenders and an active aerodynamic system, while the front grille featured bold vertical slats that echoed AMG’s motorsport DNA. Under the hood, the twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8 had been tuned to deliver an impressive 576.9 HP and 515.7 ft-lb of torque. It also marked a technical milestone, becoming the first Mercedes-AMG model to feature 4-wheel steering.
zh:
这款“能合法上路的赛车”唤起了对曾备受瞩目的300SL跑车形象的追思。

基于AMG GT打造的“公路赛车”。外观采用宽体设计，搭配外扩轮拱和主动空气动力学系统，前格栅采用带有强烈冲击感的垂直线条设计。4升V8双涡轮引擎经过调校，可输出585 PS功率和71.3 公斤力米扭矩。这款车还是首款配备四轮转向系统的Mercedes-AMG车型，意义非凡。

en:
With a 192.6 mph top speed, this Mercedes-Benz is a race car in street-car clothes.

The AMG GT was a supercar introduced in 2014 by Mercedes-Benz. Beneath its signature long-nose design sat a rigid aluminum space frame, housing the M178 3982 cc twin-turbo V-8 engine. The high-performance "S" variant pushed output to 502 HP, pairing that power with stiffer suspension and wider tires.
zh:
最高时速310 公里/小时。尽显Mercedes精神的超跑。

AMG GT是一款Mercedes-Benz于2014年公布的超级跑车。经典长车头造型下搭载坚固的铝制空间车架结构，配备3,982 立方厘米的M178 V8双涡轮引擎。这款“S”高性能版本将功率输出提升至510 PS，并搭配更硬朗的悬挂配置和更宽的轮胎以匹配强劲性能。

en:
With a 192.6 mph top speed, this Mercedes-Benz is a race car in street-car clothes.

The AMG GT was a supercar introduced in 2014 by Mercedes-Benz. Beneath its signature long-nose design sat a rigid aluminum space frame, housing the M178 3982 cc twin-turbo V-8 engine. The high-performance "S" variant pushed output to 502 HP. This particular model was modified as a Safety Car.
zh:
最高时速310 公里/小时。尽显Mercedes精神的超跑。

AMG GT是一款Mercedes-Benz于2014年公布的超级跑车。它拥有品牌标志性的长车头外观和坚固的铝合金空间车架，并由一台3,982 立方厘米排量的M178双涡轮增压V8引擎作为心脏。其型号名称中的“S”代表高性能版本，其功率输出达到了510 PS。这一车型接受了特别改装，作为安全车使用。

en:
The start of something very special: The very first "Vision Gran Turismo."

This vehicle marked the launch of the "Vision Gran Turismo" project. Its elegant silhouette was inspired by a feline on the hunt, and it featured a hybrid structure of an aluminum space frame and carbon fiber. At just 2994 lbs, it remained relatively lightweight and was powered by an AMG twin-turbo 5.0-liter V-8 producing 430kW (576.9 HP) and 800Nm (590.2 ft-lb) of torque. Specialists also tuned the engine sound, making this machine as thrilling to hear as it was to behold.
zh:
体验精致的概念跑车。Vision Gran Turismo的头号车型。

这辆车标志着“Vision Gran Turismo”项目的开启。它的车身造型极致优雅，灵感来源于正在捕猎的大型猫科动物，在材料方面则混合采用了铝合金空间车架和碳纤维。作为一款仅重1,358 公斤的车型，它轻盈灵活，但动力十足，配备了一台AMG 5升V8双涡轮增压引擎，可以输出430千瓦/800牛米（585 PS/81.6 公斤力米）的动力。这部引擎的声音还由专家团队进行了特别调校，让这款车不仅外观摄人心魄，发出的轰鸣声也令人心潮澎湃。

carNameEn: Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo Racing Series
sourceName: Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo Racing Series
en:
Another "Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo" ready for competitive racing.

This is a racing version of the Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo. All interior comforts were removed to bring the weight down to 2866 lbs, while a large fixed rear wing increases downforce for circuit use. The AMG twin-turbo 5.5-liter V-8 has been tuned to produce 591.7 HP. The transmission has been upgraded from the 7-speed dual-clutch to a full sequential system for optimal performance on the track.
zh:
又一款可以立即投入比赛的Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo车型。

这是Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo的赛车版本。全车削减了所有的内饰和舒适性部件，将车重拉低到1,300 公斤，此外还配备了一部大尺寸固定式尾翼，能够产生赛道所需的大量下压力。它的AMG 5.5升V8双涡轮增压引擎出力也有一定提升，达到了600 PS。其传动性能也进行了优化升级，将原本的7档双离合变速箱改为了全序列系统变速箱。

carNameEn: Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo LH Edition
en:
Another "Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo" ready for competitive racing.

This is a racing version of the Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo. All interior comforts were removed to bring the weight down to 2866 lbs, while a large fixed rear wing increases downforce for circuit use. The AMG twin-turbo 5.5-liter V-8 has been tuned to produce 591.7 HP. The transmission has been upgraded from the 7-speed dual-clutch to a full sequential system for optimal performance on the track.
zh:
又一款可以立即投入比赛的Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo车型。

这是Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo的赛车版本。全车削减了所有的内饰和舒适性部件，将车重拉低到1,300 公斤，此外还配备了一部大尺寸固定式尾翼，能够产生赛道所需的大量下压力。它的AMG 5.5升V8双涡轮增压引擎出力也有一定提升，达到了600 PS。其传动性能也进行了优化升级，将原本的7档双离合变速箱改为了全序列系统变速箱。

en:
This legendary, fully tuned GT-R gained a new following after an ambitious restoration.

Created by Mine’s, the BNR34 GT-R N1 base is a finely tuned expression of the R34 GT-R’s purity, capturing its beauty while remaining true to the spirit of a street car. From the refined RB26DETT engine to the lowered suspension and understated exterior, every detail reflected the philosophy of Mine’s CEO, Michizo Niikura — to create “a first-class street car.” This example was fully restored in 2021 by Garage Yoshida.
zh:
经过全面翻新修复后，这款传奇的全面改装版GT-R重新赢得了车迷青睐。

“BNR34 GT-R N1 base”由Mine's打造，在恪守街车风格理念的同时，对R34 GT-R的美学设计进行了深度探索。从RB26DETT引擎的精心调校，到低趴式悬挂系统，再到简约的外观设计，所有细节均遵循Mine's首席执行官新仓通藏的理念，旨在打造“一流街车”。这辆车于2021年由GARAGE YOSHIDA完成了全面修复。

en:
This hopped-up MINI Cooper S featured a supercharged engine.

This was the hot hatch version of the new MINI developed after BMW’s takeover. Its 1.6-liter inline-4 was supercharged to produce 167.7 HP and 159.1 ft-lb of torque, an increase of 53.3 HP and 50.6 ft-lb over the base Cooper. Paired with an exclusive 6-speed manual transmission, the car delivered pure driving fun in a compact, spirited package.
zh:
MINI的热门车型，配备了机械增压引擎。

这款车型是Mini在被BMW收购之后推出的全新高性能掀背车。它的1.6升直列四缸引擎配备了机械增压器，能够输出170 PS/22.0 公斤力米的动力，高于Cooper的54 PS/7.0 公斤力米。另外，它还采用了一套专用6速手动变速箱，将所有的驾驶乐趣都塞进了紧凑的车身之中。

en:
A race spec Clubman able to reach 0-62.1 mph in just 3.5 seconds, with a top speed of 180.2 mph.

This Vision Gran Turismo represents a MINI built purely for racing. Weighing just 2315 lbs and producing 389.5 HP, it launches from zero to 62.1 mph in a mere 3.5 seconds. Power is sent to all four wheels. Its low-slung silhouette—with the wheels pushed to the very edges—delivers the signature go-kart-like handling MINIs are known for. The result is an exhilarating, track-ready driving experience.
zh:
竞赛配置的Clubman，从0到100 公里/小时加速仅需3.5秒，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。

这款Vision Gran Turismo车型向我们展示了专为竞速打造的Mini会是什么样的。它拥有1,050 公斤的超轻量车身和395 PS的动力性能，在仅仅3.5秒内完成0-100 公里/小时的加速。其传动系统会向全部四个车轮输出动力。它的车身轮廓极低，几乎像是俯卧在地面上，四个车轮也已经向两侧外扩到了极限，这样的设计让它实现了类似卡丁车的极致操控性能，这也是Mini品牌赖以闻名的特点，更为驾驶者提供了无与伦比的驾驶体验。

en:
A hypercar concept to celebrate the 75th anniversary of Porsche.

This all-electric hypercar was unveiled on June 8, 2023—exactly 75 years after the original Porsche 356 "No.1" Roadster received approval. Its exterior design incorporated motifs from Porsche’s storied racing heritage, while the cockpit focused entirely on the driver experience. This car achieved a power-to-weight ratio of 1 horsepower per 2 lbs and downforce far exceeding that of the 992-generation 911 GT3 RS.
zh:
这是为庆祝Porsche成立75周年推出的概念超跑。

这款全电动终极跑车于2023年6月8日正式发布，恰逢Porsche首款汽车356“No.1”Roadster获得批准的75周年纪念日。外观设计融入了该公司悠久赛车历史的经典元素，配备了专为运动驾驶打造的高性能座舱。这款车型的马力重量比达到了每1 公斤  1 PS，下压力比992款911 GT3 RS显著提升。

en:
Alfa Romeo's MiTo hatchback brings a dash of Italian flair to the compact car segment. 

This 3-door hatchback was released in the B-segment as a replacement for Alfa Romeo’s previous entry-level model, the 147. Its name was inspired by Milan and Torino—two cities central to Alfa Romeo’s history. The standard powerplant was a turbocharged 1.4-liter DOHC, with the 1.4 Sport variant producing 152.9 HP and 166.4 ft-lb of torque, paired with a 6-speed manual transmission. With a top speed of 133.6 mph and a zero-62.1 mph time of 8.0 seconds, it delivered more than respectable performance for its class.
zh:
外形可爱，操控性能和可控性都极佳。

这是一款市场定位为B级车的三门掀背车，也是Alfa Romeo的前代入门级车型147的替代者。它的名字来源于两座在Alfa Romeo发展史上非常重要的城市，米兰和都灵。1.4 Sport车型的标准动力单元是一部1.4升双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压引擎，能够输出155 PS/23.0 公斤力米，并配以一套6速手动变速箱。它拥有215 公里/小时的最高时速，并且能够在8.0秒内完成0-100 公里/小时的加速，在同级别车中拥有鹤立鸡群的实力。

carNameEn: Mitsubishi Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION Vision Gran Turismo
en:
A hybrid concept packed with know-how and spirit gained through motorsports.

This Vision Gran Turismo was created by Mitsubishi Motors, a brand with a strong legacy in events like the Dakar Rally and World Rally Championship (WRC). Inspired by the Mitsubishi Concept XR-PHEV shown at the 2013 Tokyo Motor Show, the concept evolved into a purpose-built racing machine. As a plug-in hybrid EV, it combines electric motors with a conventional engine, delivering massive power to all four wheels through the advanced S-AWC vehicle dynamics control system.
zh:
将赛车经验和精神注入其中的混动概念车。

Mitsubishi Motors拥有辉煌的竞技履历，在如达喀尔拉力赛和世界拉力锦标赛这样的赛事中均取得过优异的成绩。而这款Vision Gran Turismo正是由这个实力超群的团队所打造。它的灵感部分来源于2013年东京车展上亮相的“Mitsubishi Concept XR-PHEV”，通过拓展研发，就变成了一辆意气风发的比赛机器。它采用了插电式混合动力架构，结合了电机和传统引擎，再通过一套S-AWC车辆动态控制系统将强悍的动力输出到全部四个车轮上。

en:
This car put Lamborghini on the supercar map and defined the genre.

Lamborghini’s first supercar, the Miura P400, debuted in 1966 and marked a revolutionary leap in automotive design—catapulting the brand onto the global stage. This groundbreaking machine was the result of a collaboration between industry legends: Marcello Gandini, then chief designer at Bertone; Gian Paolo Dallara, who engineered the chassis; and Paolo Stanzani, who would go on to create the Countach.
zh:
Lamborghini公司的第一款超跑，为公司打响了名声。

作为Lamborghini在1966年推出的首款超级跑车，Miura P400是一个革命性的开发项目，并且帮助Lamborghini在全世界范围内立刻名声大振。为了打造它，许多天才工程师齐聚一堂，包括Bertone的首席设计师马塞罗·甘迪尼，设计底盘的吉安·保罗·达拉拉，以及之后开发出经典车型Countach的保罗·斯坦扎尼。

en:
Simple yet effective, this single-seat sports car is reminiscent of formula cars from a bygone era. 

Built by Britain’s Briggs Automotive Company, this car was designed to deliver “the most authentic and pure driving experience” on the road. Its single-seat layout is built around a tubular chassis wrapped in a carbon-fiber shell, and it’s powered by a Cosworth-tuned 2.5-liter Ford Duratec engine. Weighing just 1279 lbs, the car rockets from 0-60 mph in a blistering 2.8 seconds, and reaches a top speed of 170.3 mph—performance figures on par with a Formula 3 car.
zh:
这款单座跑车在简洁中蕴藏着吸引力，让人想起上一个时代的方程式赛车。

这款车型由英国Briggs Automotive Company打造，目标是创造“提供最纯正驾驶体验的公路车辆”。单座底盘采用管状框架配碳纤维车身，搭载经Cosworth调校的2.5升Ford Duratec引擎。车重仅580 公斤，达到了极致轻量化。0-60英里/小时加速仅需2.8秒，最高时速274 公里/小时，性能足以媲美F3赛车。

en:
Devised by Formula 1 legend John Cooper, this very special Mini was intended to excel on the race track.

To fully exploit the MINI’s outstanding handling characteristics, the British Motor Corporation joined forces with F1 constructor John Cooper to develop this high-performance variant. The 970 S emerged as a special version, its engine displacement reduced to 970 cc to comply with specific racing class regulations. Whereas the standard 848 cc engine delivered 33.5 HP, this tuned iteration generated an impressive 65.1 HP. Despite a limited production run of just 963 units, the car achieved remarkable success in touring car competitions.
zh:
这辆Mini由一级方程式赛车领域的传奇人物约翰·库珀设计，专为胜利而生。

为了充分发挥Mini的杰出操控性，BMC（British Motor Corporation）与F1汽车工程师约翰·库珀联手打造了这款运动车型。其标准版的848 立方厘米排量引擎能够输出34 PS。而这个970 "S"版本则为了满足赛车组别要求，将引擎排量扩大为970 立方厘米，能够输出66 PS。虽然总共只生产了963辆，但这丝毫不妨碍它在各大房车赛中取得巨大成功。

en:
This 2016 Super GT race car was driven by the team of Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie Quintarelli.

The new regulations for 2014 required the GT500 car to share the same monocoque weight and key components with its DTM counterpart. As a result, the GT-R underwent significant revisions to meet GT500 specifications, with ongoing refinements continuing through to the 2016 model. During the 2014 and 2015 seasons, the MOTUL AUTECH GT-R secured back-to-back series championships. Aiming for a third consecutive title in 2016, the team ultimately concluded the season in third place overall.
zh:
在2016年Super GT赛事中由松田次生和罗尼·昆塔雷利驾驶。

2014年实施的全新规则意味着这辆车也会采用与DTM版本相同的单体车壳车重和其他主要部件。这辆GT500规格GT-R加入了多项重大调整。直至2016年，车型经历了不少后续优化。在2014和2015赛季，这辆MOTUL AUTECH GT-R连续两年蝉联系列赛冠军。2016年，车队志在夺取三连冠，但最后仅以第三名的总成绩遗憾完赛。

en:
The MP4-12C was the first McLaren production car since the McLaren F1 road car.

Bearing the name MP4—a subtle nod to McLaren’s F1—the MP4-12C stood out for its advanced carbon-composite "MonoCell" chassis. This lightweight structure played a crucial role in reducing overall mass, allowing the car, despite its relatively modest power figures by McLaren standards, to equal or even surpass the performance of its chief rival, the Ferrari 458 Italia.
zh:
McLaren的第三代超跑，拥有新的轻盈车身。

这辆McLaren MP4-12C名字中的“MP4”仿佛是在向它的姊妹F1赛车致敬，而它最为人知晓的特点便是采用了碳纤维复合材料“单体车壳”。即便这辆车的动力指标在McLaren公路车中也算是比较保守，但其选用的车身材料有效地减轻了车重，让它的整体性能依然能比肩乃至超过了竞品车型Ferrari 458 Italia。

en:
This legendary machine marked the end of the turbocharged era in Formula 1.

This McLaren race car contested the 1988 F1 World Championship. Its chassis, the work of Gordon Murray and Steve Nichols, was paired with the Honda RA168E powerplant. Dominating the season, it triumphed in 15 of the 16 races. Car No. 12, the MP4/4, was piloted by Ayrton Senna. Senna delivered a stellar performance, securing 13 pole positions and 8 victories en route to the drivers' championship title.
zh:
标志着涡轮增压时代终结的传奇F1赛车。

这款McLaren赛车参加了1988年F1世界锦标赛。底盘由戈登·穆雷和史蒂夫·尼科尔斯设计，搭载Honda RA168E引擎。该车在当赛季的16场比赛中赢得了15场胜利。标号12号的MP4/4由埃尔顿·塞纳驾驶。他拿出了极为出色的表现，总共获得13个杆位和8场分站冠军，最终夺得车手总冠军。

en:
The turbocharged model of Toyota's mid-engine sports car featured a rigid chassis that matched its extra power.

Introduced in 1989, the second-generation MR2, designated SW20, succeeded the AW11, Japan’s first mass-produced mid-engine sports car. Its body dimensions were stretched to the upper limits of Japan’s Class 5 vehicle regulations, while its design adopted smoother, more aerodynamic lines to emphasize its mid-engine configuration. At launch, the car faced criticism for its challenging handling character, but subsequent refinements transformed it into a well-balanced performer.
zh:
最终的涡轮增压机车型，具有可以承受引擎动力的底盘稳定性。

第二代MR2发布于1989年，也被称为SW20，是日本第一部中置布局量产车AW11的继任者。SW20的车身延长后达到日本5级汽车尺寸的上限，平滑圆润的造型也与第一代MR2截然不同，但仍然采用了中置式布局。发布初期，这辆车因其糟糕的操控而饱受批评，后续的更新升级却将其打造成了一款平衡性极佳的中置引擎跑车。

en:
With only 200 units ever produced, this is the ultimate works-tuned roadster.

This machine was created by Mazda Spirit Racing, an initiative launched in 2021 to embody Mazda’s motorsport ambitions. Although derived from the ND Roadster, it has a 2.0-liter block not typically offered on Japanese soft-top models, distinguished by specially developed camshafts, a bespoke cylinder head, forged pistons, and a custom exhaust manifold. This delivers an output of 197.2 HP, a figure that stands near the upper limit of what remains practical in a production car. Additional refinements were made throughout the chassis, drawing upon the wealth of expertise Mazda had accumulated through years of Super Endurance racing.
zh:
这是一台经过官方调校的终极敞篷跑车，全球限量仅200台。

这台车由MAZDA SPIRIT RACING打造——该项目于2021年启动，旨在展示Mazda的赛车运动实力。虽然基于ND Roadster打造而成，却搭载了日本软顶车型上不常见的2.0升引擎，配备专门设计的凸轮轴、气缸盖、活塞和排气歧管。最终实现200 PS的惊人动力，这一数据已逼近量产车型工程设计的极限。底盘整体调校充分借鉴了公司在超级耐力锦标赛中的丰富经验。

en:
With 631.2 HP, the flagship supercar from Lamborghini reached a top speed of 211.3 mph.

A high-performance evolution of Lamborghini’s flagship Murciélago made its debut in 2006. The transversely mounted V-12 engine, originally displacing 6.2 liters, was enlarged to 6.5 liters, delivering an impressive 631.2 HP. Its exterior received a comprehensive aerodynamic redesign, complemented by upgrades to the transmission and electronic systems.
zh:
旗舰超跑，马力输出达到了640 PS，最高时速高达340 公里/小时。

2006年推出的Lamborghini旗舰车型Murciélago的高性能版本。最初排量为6.2升，后来横置V12引擎扩大至6.5升，输出动力达到640 PS。外观经过全面的空气动力学改进，变速箱和电子系统也进行了相应升级。

en:
This special high-performance Mustang was produced for only two years.

This enhanced variant was exclusively offered on the 1969 and 1970 model years of Ford’s original Mustang. Built for NASCAR homologation, this Mustang housed the largest engine ever fitted to the model—a 7.0-liter V-8 known as the 429. Easily identified by its prominent hood scoop, it is often hailed as the most powerful Mustang in the model’s storied history.
zh:
这是符合NASCAR赛事认证的Mustang，仅仅只生产了两年。

这款高性能车型仅在1969年和1970年款Ford初代Mustang上提供。为满足NASCAR赛事认证要求而生产，搭载Mustang历史上最大排量的7L V8 429引擎。那标志性的大型引擎盖进气口极易辨认，常被誉为史上最强的Mustang。

en:
The 50th Anniversary sixth-generation Ford Mustang GT goes international.

In 2014, marking the 50th anniversary of the Mustang’s debut and amid unprecedented global demand, Ford unveiled the sixth-generation model after an intensive development effort. This new iteration featured more aggressive styling and introduced 4-wheel independent suspension for the first time in the car’s lineage. Among many variants in the lineup, it is the Mustang GT that captures the hearts of true enthusiasts, thanks to its iconic V-8 powerplant.
zh:
在该车型50周年亮相的第6代Mustang，这款备受期待的产品在全球120个国家销售。

在经过漫长而艰巨的开发周期之后，2014年，Ford推出了第六代Ford Mustang。这款经典车型不仅迎来了50周年纪念，在全球市场上的销量也攀至顶峰。这辆车采用了更具侵略性的外观风格，还配备了一套四轮独立悬挂系统。这一代的产品谱系中包含了多个版本，而采用了标志性V8引擎的Mustang GT是最受关注的一款。

en:
The sixth-generation Mustang marked the model’s 50th anniversary and was sold in 120 countries around the world.

This particular version serves as a homologation model of the Mustang Gr.3—a Gran Turismo Original that reimagines Ford’s legendary coupe to comply with Gr.3 racing regulations. With its roots in motorsport, the car’s performance has been finely tuned, placing particular emphasis on cornering prowess. A true all-rounder, it excels equally in circuit time attacks and controlled drifting alike.
zh:
诞生于该车型第50周年的第6代Mustang，Ford的这款杰作广销至全球120多个国家。

Mustang Gr.3是为了符合Gr.3组别规则而对传奇跑车Ford Mustang改装而来的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，而这辆车则是它的赛事认证车型。这一车型本身就是基于赛车打造，所以这次主要围绕过弯能力对其性能指标进行了优化。它在赛道上非常均衡、全面，不论是计时挑战还是漂移赛，都能做到游刃有余。

en:
The sixth-generation Mustang marked the model’s 50th anniversary and was sold in 120 countries around the world.

The Mustang Gr.3 is a Gran Turismo Original creation, transforming Ford’s legendary Mustang coupe into a machine built to meet Gr.3 race regulations. Its fenders have been dramatically widened to accommodate broader tires, while large rear air outlets were integrated to efficiently channel airflow. This modern muscle car excels through the stability offered by its long wheelbase and boasts an exceptional top speed that’s hard to match.
zh:
诞生于该车型第50周年的第6代Mustang，Ford的这款杰作广销至全球120多个国家。

Mustang Gr.3是为了符合Gr.3组别规则而对传奇跑车Ford Mustang改装而来的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。为了容纳更宽大的轮胎，它的挡泥板得到了外拓，而为了将气流高效地排出，车身后部也相应地添加了大尺寸出气口。这辆肌肉车优点众多，比如它较长的轴距能够提供优秀的稳定性，更不必说它无人可敌的极速性能。

en:
The 50th Anniversary sixth-generation Ford Mustang GT goes international.

The Mustang Gr.4 is a Gran Turismo Original model that reimagines Ford’s iconic Mustang coupe to comply with Gr.4 race regulations. Built upon the inherently stable platform of the production model, this touring car is an ideal choice for newcomers. Visually, it commands attention with the timeless appeal of classic Ford racing stripes adorning its exterior.
zh:
在该车型50周年亮相的第6代Mustang，这款备受期待的产品在全球120个国家销售。

Mustang Gr.4是为了符合Gr.4组别规则而对传奇跑车Ford Mustang改装而来的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。因为它的改装原型本身就拥有极高的稳定性，这款房车对于新手来说非常友好。由于采用了Ford的经典赛车条纹涂装，它的外观也尤为出众。

en:
The 50th Anniversary sixth-generation Ford Mustang GT goes international.

The Mustang Gr.B was a Gran Turismo Original creation, reimagining Ford’s legendary Mustang coupe to comply with Gr.B rally regulations. Its livery draws inspiration from the factory colors of the Ford GT race program. Although it may have seemed an unlikely candidate at first glance, the car echoes Ford’s rich rallying heritage, embodied by icons like the Escort and RS200, making the concept feel surprisingly authentic.
zh:
在该车型50周年亮相的第6代Mustang，这款备受期待的产品在全球120个国家销售。

Mustang Gr.B是为了符合Gr.B组别规则而对传奇跑车Ford Mustang改装而来的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。它的涂装直接沿用了Ford GT的原厂车队涂装。Ford公司浸淫于拉力赛多年，推出了如Escort和RS200之类的成功车型，因此这款看似格格不入的定制款车型其实完全能够胜任一切挑战。

en:
With more muscle than others in its class, this pony car set a new standard for aggressiveness.

Following its debut in 1964, the original Ford Mustang underwent a transformation in 1969, adopting a larger and more muscular body design. Among the updated lineup, the Mach 1, distinguished by its bold SportsRoof fastback, stood out for its aggressive appearance. Its styling left a lasting impression, influencing sports car design across the globe for years to come.
zh:
全球的跑车都追随着这款车型掀起的激进风格潮流。

在1964年首次亮相以来，初代Ford Mustang在1969年迎来了重大改款，采用了尺寸更大的全新车身设计。这款Mach 1型号拥有被称为“运动车顶”的斜背车身，而这种威武霸气的形象也让它在整个产品家族中人气特别高。它的风格甚至对全世界的跑车外观设计都产生了深远的影响。

en:
This performance-focused model is a first kei-car with front-wheel drive, a turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual transmission.

Honda’s N-ONE was a retro-inspired kei-car that paid homage to the company's first entry into the segment, the classic N360. The second-generation model retained the charming silhouette of the original, but rode on a completely new chassis that brought modern refinement to its compact dimensions. Among the highlights of the lineup was the RS trim, a sporty variant that borrowed close-ratio gearing from the S660 sports car. It featured reinforced synchronizers for second and third gear, and a heavy-duty clutch to handle spirited driving. While the RS badge had been offered on the first-gen N-ONE, the new RS stood out as the first kei-car to pair a turbocharged, front-wheel-drive layout with a 6-speed manual transmission — a groundbreaking move in the world of Japan’s smallest cars.
zh:
这款“性能”车型搭载了轻型车史上首个前驱涡轮增压+6速手动变速箱的动力组合。

N-ONE的设计灵感源自Honda首款满足轻型车规格的车型——N360。第二代N-ONE延用了初代车型的车身板件，但采用了全新底盘。二代产品线还包括“RS”运动版，采用了与S660跑车相同的密齿比档位，第二和第三挡配备重载同步器，离合器同样得到了强化。初代车型也提供RS版本，但第二代RS的独特之处在于它是首款结合涡轮增压前轮驱动布局与6速手动变速箱的轻型车。

en:
Boasting 394.5 HP and an extremely limited production run, this is the ultimate R33 GT-R from Nismo.

In an era when Japanese passenger cars were generally capped at 276.1 HP, NISMO defied convention with a fully tuned machine delivering 394.5 HP. At its heart was the RB-X GT2, an enlarged 2.8-liter evolution of the revered RB26, paired with an N1-spec turbocharger. The suspension setup featured Bilstein dampers, reinforced by upgraded stabilizers and bushings. Flared fenders accommodated the wider tires, offering a visual cue to the car’s formidable capabilities.
zh:
这款NISMO打造的终极R33 GT-R拥有400 PS的动力，只生产了极其有限的数量。

在日本乘用车的动力普遍被限制在280 PS的时代，NISMO推出了这款最大功率达400 PS的完整调校车型。搭载经典RB26引擎的2.8L扩缸版本RB-X GT2，且配备N1规格涡轮增压器。悬挂系统采用Bilstein减震器，并配备升级的防倾杆和衬套。轮拱经过拓宽以容纳更宽的轮胎，同时也彰显了这款车型的极致性能。

en:
This GT-R bows out with the ultimate complete tuned model.

The Nismp R34 GT-R Z-tune stood as the ultimate expression of Nissan’s tuning prowess — a fully re-engineered, limited-production masterpiece based on the R34 Skyline GT-R.  Under the hood, the standard RB26DETT engine was replaced with a 2.8-liter version of the RB26DETT Kai-Z2, derived from Nissan’s GT500 race program. Nismo reinforced the chassis with additional spot welds and strategically integrated carbon fiber components, while fine-tuning the suspension and braking systems to deliver razor-sharp performance. The result was a road-going GT-R with motorsport DNA baked into every detail. Including the original prototype, only 19 units were ever built, making the Z-tune one of the rarest and most revered GT-Rs ever created.
zh:
第二代GT-R车系以这款终极完全调校版本作为完美收官。

NISMO R34 GT-R Z-tune经过了全方位改装，使用的套件都是完全定制的。这台车以R34 Skyline GT-R为基础进行打造，但引擎采用了GT500级别的RB26DETT Kai-Z2引擎的2.8升版本。通过增加点焊数量、添置更多碳纤维部件，使得车身刚性得到了显著提升，此外还对悬挂和制动系统进行精细调校，彰显了NISMO对改装的执着追求。包含最初的样车在内，这款车仅生产了19辆。

en:
A look into the future of performance-minded touring cars.

This Vision Gran Turismo concept offered a glimpse into Nissan’s not-too-distant future, brought to life through a collaboration between a youthful team of British designers and Japanese engineers. Its powertrain fuses a twin-turbo V-6 with three electric motors, forming a high-performance hybrid FR-4WD system. With active suspension maximizing its aerodynamic potential, the car remains poised to deliver its full performance the instant the driver calls upon it.
zh:
采用跑车空气动力学技术的下一代GT概念车。

这款Vision Gran Turismo车型不仅为大家描绘了Nissan对于不久之后的未来的畅想，还通过一群由英国设计师和日本工程师组成的年轻团队的精诚合作而化为了现实。它的动力系统结合了一部V6双涡轮增压引擎和3部电机，共同构成了一套高性能混动前置后驱四驱系统。这辆车还采用了主动式悬挂，能够充分利用车身的空气动力学优势，不论在什么场景下都能让驾驶者发挥出它全部的实力。

en:
Acura's popular exotic sports car returns after a 10-year hiatus.

Making its official debut 25 years after the original, the second-generation NSX emerged as a true supercar, equipped with an advanced electric all-wheel-drive system called the Sports Hybrid SH-AWD, which employed independent electric motors on the front wheels. By enhancing both acceleration and deceleration, it enabled torque vectoring that provided exceptional stability through corners across the entire speed range.
zh:
自第一代车型推出以来，经受住了25年的考验，打开了SH-AWD跑车的新天地。

在初代上市的25年之后，第二代NSX也千呼万唤始出来。这款超级跑车采用了一套被称为“运动混动SH-AWD”的电动四驱系统，左右前轮也分别安装了独立的电机。这次更新换代的提升不仅在于加速和刹车性能，这套系统还提供了扭矩矢量控制功能，能够在各种不同的速度范围下确保稳定过弯。

en:
Acura's popular exotic sports car returns after a 10-year hiatus.

A Gran Turismo Original, Honda’s flagship NSX sports car has been reengineered to comply with Gr.3 racing regulations. It features a range of aerodynamic enhancements, including a large front splitter with precision cutouts to manage airflow, and a swan-neck rear wing.
zh:
自第一代车型推出以来，经受住了25年的考验，打开了SH-AWD跑车的新天地。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Honda的旗舰跑车NSX针对Gr.3规则进行改装而来。这款车为了提升空气动力学性能而加装了若干部件，例如大尺寸前定风翼和天鹅颈尾翼，其中前者还为了平稳气流而刻有沟槽。

en:
This second-generation NSX with SH-AWD was modified for Gr.4 competition.

A Gran Turismo Original, Honda’s flagship NSX sports car has been adapted to meet Gr.4 regulations. This design prioritizes preserving the character of the base car, adding only a subtle front splitter, compact canards, and a rear wing. To enhance structural rigidity, a rear bulkhead has been added, accompanied by a rear camera.
zh:
一款专为Gr.4竞赛而改装的SH-AWD四驱系统2代NSX。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Honda的旗舰跑车NSX针对Gr.4规则进行改装而来。它的设计注重于利用基础车型的优势，只加装了小尺寸定风翼、前翼和尾翼。为了提升刚性，车身上还加装了后隔板，以及一部后方摄像头。

en:
The NSX was revived with SH-AWD 25 years after the debut of the original model.

A Gran Turismo Original, Honda’s flagship NSX has been reimagined to conform to Gr.B rally regulations. While sporting a rugged rally-cross exterior, it retains the NSX’s signature mid-engine layout, now paired with a 4-wheel-drive system. The original rear-biased weight distribution has been preserved, promising thrilling tail-out dynamics on loose surfaces.
zh:
在初版NSX首次亮相的25年后，新一代的SH-AWD四驱系统跑车终于问世。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Honda的旗舰跑车NSX针对Gr.B规则进行改装而来。这款车整体呈现出拉力跨界风格外观，但也保留了NSX标志性的中置布局，只是改为了四轮驱动。原版车的前轻后重重量分配比例也保持不变，而这样的配重比可以让它上演非常精彩的车尾漂移。

en:
Thanks to advancements in aerodynamics, the 2nd-gen NSX had more downforce than the original.

The second-wave NSX Type R made its debut in 2002. In addition to the original Type R’s weight-saving measures and increased rigidity, this model underwent a full aerodynamic redesign, generating remarkable levels of downforce rarely seen in a road car. Carbon fiber was employed extensively, including for key components such as the hood and rear wing. During a time attack at the Nürburgring Nordschleife, the car shattered expectations by breaking the eight-minute barrier, a feat once thought unattainable for a road car.
zh:
2代NSX改进了空气动力学设计，增加了车辆的下压力。

这款第二代NSX Type R于2002年发布。在继承初代Type R的轻量化和刚性提升基础上，这款车型还进行了全面的空气动力学改进，作为一款公路车达成了惊人的下压力。引擎盖和尾翼等部位大量采用了碳纤维部件。在纽博格林北侧赛道的计时圈中，这款车成功突破了此前被视为公路车极限的8分钟大关。

en:
The first of the Honda Type R series, only 500 cars of this rare model were produced. 

A high-performance variant of the NSX was introduced in November 1992. Weight was reduced by 265 lbs through the elimination of luxury amenities and the use of lighter functional components. Each engine was carefully balanced to deliver a refined and exhilarating experience at high rpm. It remains a legendary model, one whose significance in the evolution of the NSX cannot be overstated.
zh:
这款赛车正是Honda Type R系列的起源，当时仅生产不足500辆。

这是1992年11月发布的NSX的高性能版本。通过拆除豪华内饰和给功能部件减重，成功削去了120 公斤。此外，这个车型的每一部引擎都经过了精心的平衡性调整，确保能够在高转速下提供最优体验。在NSX的进化史上，这个传奇型号的重要性不容低估。

en:
This handsome supercar was limited to 77 units, and could very well be the most desirable British car ever. 

This was Aston Martin’s new flagship model, unveiled in 2009. Although it shared visual cues with the DB9 and DBS, it was, in fact, a bespoke creation developed almost entirely from the ground up. At its heart lay a 7.3-liter V-12 engine, co-developed with Cosworth, producing 749.5 HP and 549.7 ft-lb of torque, making it the most powerful naturally aspirated engine ever fitted to a production car. Initially priced at £1,200,000 in the UK, all 77 units were spoken for within a year of deliveries commencing in early 2011.
zh:
Aston Martin仅有77辆的限量版车型。

这是Aston Martin在2009年推出的全新旗舰车型。虽然外观上与DB9和DBS非常近似，但其实它是一款从头开始设计的特殊车型。其动力单元采用了一部与Cosworth联合开发的7.3升V12引擎，动力输出达到了760 PS/76.0 公斤力米，是有史以来量产车中性能最强大的自然进气引擎。这款车起初在英国官方公布的售价为120万英镑。但在2011年初开始交车后，全部77台车在一年时间内便被抢购一空。

carNameEn: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo
en:
This Vision Gran Turismo embodies the electric spirit of Opel’s GSE sports car brand.

The Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo is a fully electric high-performance concept car that blends Opel’s respect for tradition with its passion for futuristic technology. Twin electric motors, one mounted on each axle, delivers a combined output of 588 kW (788 HP). This enables the car to accelerate from 0-62.1 mph in just two seconds and reach a top speed of 198.8 mph. Its aerodynamic performance is equally impressive, with an active aero diffuser and spoiler that ensures stability even at the highest speeds.
zh:
这款Vision Gran Turismo承载了Opel GSE运动品牌的电动精神，电力十足。

Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo是一款全电动高性能概念车，将Opel对传统的敬意与对未来科技的激情完美融合。前后轴双电机总输出功率高达588千瓦（800 PS）。让车辆仅需2秒即可完成0-100 公里/小时加速，最高速度能达到320 公里/小时。它还拥有出色的空气动力学性能，配备主动式空气扩散器和后扰流板，确保高速行驶时的稳定性。

en:
This jewel of a compact car is the one designer Giugiaro called his greatest work.

The FIAT Panda is a front-wheel-drive hatchback introduced in 1980, born amid the compact-car boom that followed the oil crises. Its design was penned by the master stylist Giorgetto Giugiaro. To keep costs low, the body was crafted with straight lines and flat panels, achieving a look that was both practical and modern. At launch, buyers could choose between an air-cooled 652 cc 2-cylinder engine or a water-cooled 903 cc 4-cylinder unit. The model featured in Gran Turismo is the former.
zh:
紧凑型车中的瑰宝，被其设计师乔治亚罗视作个人巅峰之作。

FIAT Panda是一款前轮驱动掀背车，于1980年第二次石油危机后的小型车热潮中推出。其外观设计由设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗操刀完成。为控制成本，车身采用直线线条和平整面板设计，呈现出简洁、现代且实用的外观。该车首发时提供两种引擎选项：风冷652 立方厘米双缸引擎或水冷903 立方厘米四缸引擎。这款在《跑车浪漫旅》游戏中登场的车型采用的是前者。

en:
This extremely rare supercar combined vivid Italian design with no-nonsense American power.

This was the third model created by De Tomaso. Its sleek body, crafted by Carrozzeria Ghia, was paired with a robust 5.8-liter OHV V-8 sourced from Ford. This striking combination delivered performance on par with its more expensive contemporaries.
zh:
这款极为稀有的超级跑车融合了意大利的精妙设计和美国的强劲马力。

这是De Tomaso推出的第三款车型。它的意大利风格车身由Carrozzeria Ghia打造，并安装有一台Ford 5.8升V8顶置气门引擎。尽管与同一时代的竞品相比，这款车价格比较实惠，但在性能方面，这套奢华的配置一点也不落下风。

en:
With its tremendous performance and 6-speed gearbox, this kart proves fast enough for full-size tracks.

While racing karts are typically viewed as the gateway to motorsports, the Shifter Kart is more akin to a sub-formula race car. Equipped with a 125 cc water-cooled two-stroke engine mated to a 6-speed gearbox and featuring front-only braking, it is capable of reaching speeds up to 124.3 mph. This is a racing machine that hones the skills of race drivers.
zh:
拥有能在全尺寸赛道飞驰的速度：拥有6速变速箱的完整赛道车型。

尽管卡丁车通常会被视作是赛车竞技领域的入门级车辆，但这款Shifter Kart更该被称为是一辆“迷你版”方程式赛车。它采用了一台125 立方厘米水冷2冲程引擎，连接到一套6速变速箱，而且仅配备了前轮刹车，可以达到时速200 公里的惊人极速。这是一部真正的比赛机器，通常被用于训练顶级车手。

en:
This JGTC machine gained its edge by lowering the center of gravity and shortening the wheelbase.

This R34 GT-R took to the track in the 1999 All Japan GT Championship. Compared to the previous R33 model, its wheelbase was shortened by 2.2 inches, and the engine was repositioned using a shallow oil pan—enhancements that significantly boosted overall performance. At Round 4 held at Mine Circuit, Érik Comas and Satoshi Motoyama claimed a decisive victory in the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R, securing Comas his second consecutive drivers' title.
zh:
通过降低重心和缩短轴距来提高速度的JGTC赛车。

这款R34型GT-R参加了1999年全日本GT锦标赛。相比前代R33车型，轴距缩短了55毫米，因为采用浅油底壳调整了引擎位置，显著提升了整体性能。在第4轮Mine Circuit赛道上，埃里克·科马斯和本山哲驾驶Pennzoil NISMO GT-R夺得胜利，科马斯还因此蝉联了车手冠军。

en:
Won the Super GT team title with its stable performance on high-speed circuits.

This Super GT race car competed during the 2008 season. To enhance aerodynamic efficiency, both the front and rear overhangs were extended, and its compact body proved highly effective on high-speed circuits. Although it didn’t claim any outright wins, its consistent performance throughout the season earned enough points to secure the team title.
zh:
在高速赛道上的稳定发挥帮助车队赢下了Super GT组别的桂冠。

这是一辆曾参加过2008赛季的Super GT赛车。根据前一年度积累的经验，工程师们将它的车头和车尾加长，以有效优化空气动力学性能，而它的紧凑型车身也能在高速赛道上发挥出色。尽管它并没能拿下任何一场比赛的胜利，但确保了整个赛季持续有积分入账，最终赢下了车队冠军头衔。

carNameEn: Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
sourceName: Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
en:
This Vision Gran Turismo pays homage to the legendary L45 race machine.

This Vision Gran Turismo was created as a tribute to Peugeot’s historic triumph at the 1916 Indianapolis 500 Mile Race. Standing at just 3.3 ft tall, the car boasts a low-slung profile, with a gracefully tapered tail reminiscent of the Indy-winning L45 machine. Its powertrain features a hybrid setup, pairing a 1.6-liter turbocharged 4-cylinder engine with two electric motors, delivering a combined output of 493.1 HP and 730 Nm (535.2 ft-lb) of torque.
zh:
专为致敬传奇的L45赛车而打造的Vision Gran Turismo。

这款Vision Gran Turismo车型的诞生是为了纪念Peugeot在1916年印地500英里比赛上取得的胜利。它采用了令人难以置信的低悬架设计，车身高度仅有1 米，而它那逐渐收窄的车尾设计则直接沿用自在印地赛上夺冠的L45赛车。其动力系统采用混动架构，搭载了一部1.6升4缸涡轮增压引擎和两部电机，总计能够输出500匹马力/730牛米（500 PS/74.0 公斤力米）。

carNameEn: Peugeot L750R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
sourceName: Peugeot L750R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
en:
This Vision Gran Turismo pays homage to the legendary L45 race machine.

This is the competition version of the L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo. The rev limiter on its 1.6-liter 4-cylinder engine has been raised to 10,000 rpm, boosting peak output to 571 HP. When combined with the 167.7 HP produced by the electric motors, total system output reaches an impressive 739.6 HP. Visually, the car features a prominent front under spoiler and a large rear wing, both added to generate increased downforce.
zh:
专为致敬传奇的L45赛车而打造的Vision Gran Turismo。

这是L500R Hybrid Vision Gran Turismo的赛事车型。原版L500R的1.6升4缸引擎的转速限制器被拉高到每分钟10000转，从而将最大动力输出推高到了580马力。再加上几部电机提供的170马力，其总动力输出达到了750马力。在外观方面，它在车头下加装了一部大尺寸前扰流板，外加一部大尺寸尾翼，有效地提升了下压力。

en:
Experience pure steering response in a car that generates powerful downforces directly from its body panels.

This Gran Turismo Original is a Gr.3-spec version of the PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo, developed through a collaboration between Peugeot and Gran Turismo. To enhance aerodynamic performance, the front splitter and rear diffuser have been enlarged, while a swan-neck rear wing was added.
zh:
在直接通过车身板件产生下压力的跑车中体验纯粹的转向反应。

Peugeot Vision Gran Turismo是Peugeot和《跑车浪漫旅》合作打造的车型，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型就是它的Gr.3改装版本。为了制造更多下压力，它的前定风翼和后扩散器再次加大，还在车尾加入了一部天鹅颈尾翼。

en:
Experience pure steering response in a car that generates powerful downforces directly from its body panels.

The PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo is the result of a collaboration between Peugeot’s design team and the engineers at Peugeot Sport. With a height of just 3.3 ft, its low-slung body hugs the ground. Powered by a turbocharged 3.2-liter V-6 producing 875 ch (874.8 HP), it's clear this machine was conceived to deliver the quintessential driving experience.
zh:
在直接通过车身板件产生下压力的跑车中体验纯粹的转向反应。

Peugeot设计团队和Peugeot Sport工程师们为PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo的诞生贡献了卓越的头脑。它的车身仅高1 米，仿佛紧紧趴在地面上一般，再加上它的3.2升V6涡轮增压引擎能够输出高达875的动力（887 PS），很明显这辆车唯一的开发焦点就是驾驶性能。

en:
Polestar's flagship model combines sustainability with high-performance.

Created by the Scandinavian electric performance brand Polestar, the Polestar 5 is an all-wheel-drive electric sedan distinguished by its sleek, sub-five-meter profile and a glass roof that extends gracefully to the rear. Power came from a dual-motor setup, with one motor mounted on each axle. In Performance trim, it delivered an impressive 650 kW and 1,015 Nm of torque. Its 800-volt electrical architecture supported 350 kW rapid charging, replenishing the battery from 10 to 80 percent in just 22 minutes. Under WLTP testing, the dual-motor version achieved a maximum range of 416.3 miles.
zh:
将可持续性理念与高性能完美融合的Polestar旗舰车型。

由北欧电动汽车品牌Polestar打造的Polestar 5是一款全轮驱动电动轿车，其特点是拥有修长的5 米流线型车身以及一直延伸至车尾的玻璃车顶。它采用双电机布局，前后轴各配备一台电机。性能版车型可输出650千瓦功率和1015牛米扭矩。800伏电气架构支持350千瓦快速充电，仅需22分钟即可将电池电量从10%提升至80%。在WLTP测试下，最大续航里程为670 公里（双电机版）。

en:
The 'hot' version of the 5th generation Polo uses an advanced engine setup.

This was the high-performance variant of the fifth-generation Polo, Volkswagen’s standout in the compact car segment. Initially powered by a 1.4-liter engine featuring both a supercharger and turbocharger, the 2014 update saw a switch to a 1.8-liter turbocharged unit, delivering 189.3 HP along with improved fuel efficiency. With performance worthy of the GTI badge, it stood as a strong contender among B-segment hot hatches.
zh:
第五代Polo的“高性能”版本使用了先进的引擎配置。

Volkswagen经典紧凑型车第5代Polo的高性能版本。最初搭载1.4升双增压引擎，2014年款改为1.8升涡轮增压引擎，在实现192 PS高功率输出的同时提升了燃油经济性。凭借配得上GTI徽章的出色性能，这款车型是B级高性能掀背车的杰出代表。

en:
The ultimate sports spec car that appeared towards the end of the GTO era, when muscle cars flourished.

Introduced in 1968, the second-generation Pontiac GTO was hailed as a pioneer of the muscle car era, though it faced fierce competition. To silence the debate, Pontiac unveiled “The Judge." Equipped with a 6.6-liter Ram Air III V-8, a Hurst shifter, heavy-duty suspension, wide tires, and a rear spoiler, the package propelled the GTO back to the forefront of the muscle car wars.
zh:
在肌肉车首次领跑的GTO时代末期出现的终极运动规格车辆。

1968年推出的第二代Pontiac GTO被誉为肌肉车的鼻祖之一，但面临着众多强劲对手的竞争。“The Judge”运动套件的推出正是为了终结这场争论。这个套件包含6.6升V8“Ram Air III”引擎、Hurst换挡器、重型悬挂系统、宽胎和后扰流翼，让GTO重新夺回了王者地位。

en:
Porsche's modern yet daring statement on the future of the sports car remains true to its racing roots.

This lightweight, hyper-performance machine honored Porsche’s storied legacy while offering a glimpse into the future of sports cars. Its exterior and interior flowed together in perfect harmony, delivering an exceptionally immersive driving experience. Power came from twin electric motors, while an innovative active aerodynamic system adjusted in real time to deliver optimal downforce and efficiency for any condition.
zh:
Porsche对未来跑车的现代化且激进的展现。

这款轻量化超级性能机器延续了Porsche的传统，同时展现了跑车的未来发展方向。外观与内饰设计无缝融合，打造最具沉浸感的驾驶体验。动力系统采用双电机配置，创新的主动空气动力学系统可根据实际情况提供最佳的空气动力学效果。

en:
Porsche's modern-yet-daring statement on the future of the sports car.

It was the Spyder variant of the Porsche Vision Gran Turismo, which originally made its debut in 2021. The sculpted surfaces and refined cabin fused artfully to heighten driver engagement. Beneath it all, the dual-motor setup and active aero system worked in concert to ensure performance remained as precise as it was exhilarating.
zh:
Porsche将其对未来跑车的预测以非常现代化且大胆的方式呈现。

这是2021年亮相的Porsche Vision Gran Turismo的Spyder版本。外观与内饰设计无缝融合，打造最具沉浸感的驾驶体验。动力系统采用双电机配置，创新的主动空气动力学系统可根据实际情况提供最佳的空气动力学效果。

en:
This Prius variant focused on both increased performance and delivering better overall driving pleasure.

The third-generation Prius remained synonymous with hybrid technology. This iteration sought to elevate not only its environmental credentials but also the pleasure of driving itself. Its newly sculpted body featured a sleek, aerodynamic silhouette that conveyed a sense of motion even at rest. The engine was upsized to 1.8 liters, and more than 90 percent of the hybrid system components were newly developed. Fuel efficiency reached an astonishing 89.4 MPG, introducing a new dimension to the driving experience, one where performance met the pure satisfaction of exceptional economy.
zh:
这台Prius的目标不仅仅是性能提升，还有驾驶乐趣。

第三代Prius车型，混合动力汽车的代名词。这款车型不仅致力于提升环保性能，更注重驾驶乐趣的提升。全新车身采用利落的空气动力学造型，散发出强烈的速度感。引擎不仅扩大至1.8升，混合动力系统更是有超过90%的部件采用了全新开发的技术。在燃油经济性方面，这款车达到了惊人的2.7 升/百公里，为驾驶世界带来了全新品质——节油的乐趣。

en:
Nissan's compact SUV is even better with e-Power.

Nissan’s Qashqai, a popular compact SUV that was introduced in 2006, entered its third generation with a bolder presence and a more refined design. Built on a larger platform, the new model showcased a more confident stance and featured Nissan’s innovative e-Power hybrid system. Unlike traditional hybrids, e-Power used a gasoline engine solely to generate electricity, which then powered the electric motors that drove the wheels, delivering an EV-like driving experience without the need to plug in. The Tekna trim came well-equipped, offering premium features such as larger alloy wheels, ambient interior lighting, and a sharp head-up display, all included as standard.
zh:
Nissan紧凑型SUV搭载e-Power后更加出色

2006年首次亮相的Qashqai是Nissan产品线中占据C级车细分市场的一款紧凑型SUV。第三代车型拥有更大的车身和全新的外观设计。这台车可选装Nissan专有的“e-Power”串联混合动力系统，该系统利用传统引擎带动发电机发电，驱动电机从而让汽车前进。“Tekna”规格车型提供丰富的配置，标配更大的轮毂、氛围灯和抬头显示器。

carNameEn: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
en:
The 1987 winner of the Pikes Peak that also set a new record that year.

Audi shook the rallying world in 1981 with the debut of its full-time 4-wheel-drive system in the World Rally Championship. This particular variant, a modified version of the Sport quattro S1, was tailored specifically for hill climb competitions, equipped with radical ground effects that pushed the limits of aerodynamics. In 1987, Walter Röhrl piloted this machine to a record-breaking triumph at the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb.
zh:
1987年派克峰国际爬坡赛的冠军，并在同一年创下了当时的赛事纪录。

当Audi在1981年世界拉力锦标赛上派出运用他们的全时四驱技术的赛车出战时，如同一股风暴一般席卷了整个拉力世界。而这辆车是专为爬坡赛所改装的Sports Quattro S1拉力赛车特别版本，其设计实现了极具侵略性的地面效应。1987年，沃尔特·罗尔驾驶这辆车参加派克峰国际爬坡赛，拿下了破纪录的胜利。

en:
Audi's history-making LMP1 car dominated the World Endurance Championship in the 2010s.

The Audi R18 was engineered to compete in the 2016 World Endurance Championship (WEC). Its aerodynamics underwent a complete redesign, adopting a F1-inspired narrow nose with integrated wing, while the hybrid system’s regenerative energy capacity was increased from 4MJ to 6MJ. Although Audi secured 2nd place in the Constructors’ Championship, the brand made the difficult decision to withdraw from the WEC at year’s end.
zh:
具有划时代意义的奥迪LMP1车型，曾在21世纪初的世界耐力锦标赛中称霸赛场。

Audi R18是专为参加2016世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）所开发的车型。它的空气动力学外形得到了全面重塑，改为了F1样式的带前翼长车头，而它的再生动能释放量由4兆焦耳提高到了6兆焦耳。尽管在车厂冠军的争夺中锁定了第二的好成绩，但Audi仍在赛季临近收官时决定从WEC退赛，令人扼腕。

en:
This diesel-powered R18 TDI scored yet another victory for Audi at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2011.

This prototype race car was developed by Audi. While it shared lineage with the diesel-powered R10 and R15, the R18 was Audi’s first closed-cockpit design since the R8C of 1999. Its engine produced a modest 532.5 HP—less than its recent predecessors—but compensated with aggressive weight reduction and the aerodynamic efficiency afforded by its enclosed bodywork. In 2011, the R18 claimed overall victory at Le Mans.
zh:
设计充满先锋精神。2011年勒芒24小时耐力赛的总冠军。

这是由Audi开发的一款原型赛车。虽然与采用柴油动力的R10和R15非常类似，但R18的不同之处在于它是Audi自1999年的R8C之后推出的首款封闭式车身。它的引擎与其他最近推出的车型相比动力稍逊，仅有540 PS，但全方位的减重处理和封闭式车身带来的空气动力学优势已足以弥补。2011年，这辆车在勒芒跑出了全胜的优异战绩。

en:
An unlikely monster machine born from the elegant lines of the seventh-generation Skyline.

This high-performance variant of the seventh-generation Skyline was introduced with Group A competition squarely in its sights. Its RB20DET engine was extensively reworked, featuring a stainless steel exhaust manifold and a T04E turbocharger, complemented by refinements to the suspension and a more aggressive exterior design. The car secured the 1989 All Japan Touring Car Championship season title, yet it sparked curiosity as to why it wasn't given the GT-R name.
zh:
这辆不可思议的怪物赛车脱胎于拥有优雅外形的第7代Skyline。

这款第7代Skyline高性能车型专为征战A组赛事而生。RB20DET引擎经过深度改装，配备不锈钢排气歧管和T04E涡轮增压器，悬挂系统和外观设计也进行了相应调整。它夺得了1989年全日本房车锦标赛赛季冠军，但同时也给车迷们留下了一个谜题——为何不以GT-R命名？

en:
A homologation model with 500 cars produced for Group A racing

This homologation model of the R32 Skyline GT-R was produced in a limited run of just 500 units. With Group A victory as its target, engineers implemented comprehensive cooling enhancements, replaced the turbocharger’s turbine with a more durable metal unit, and reworked the body to optimize aerodynamics while shedding unnecessary weight. The result was a marked increase in performance, propelling the car to numerous touring car victories not only in Japan, but also across Europe and Australia.
zh:
仅量产500辆的A组别赛事认证车型。

这款R32 Skyline GT-R的赛事认证版本限量生产500台。为在A组赛事中夺冠，全面升级了散热系统，涡轮增压器叶轮改用金属材质，车身也经过空气动力学优化并实现轻量化。性能提升十分显著，这款车不仅在日本本土，更在欧洲和澳大利亚的房车赛事中屡获佳绩。

en:
This unique R32 GT-R came fitted with 17-inch BBS wheels, Brembo brakes and 45-series tires.

The R32 Skyline GT-R marked the triumphant return of the GT-R name after a 16-year hiatus following the legendary "Kenmeri" model. At its heart was the newly developed RB26DETT engine, equipped with ceramic twin turbochargers to deliver 276.1 HP and 260.4 ft-lb of torque. Power was channeled through the innovative ATTESA E-TS all-wheel-drive system, engineered with a focus on handling precision. Introduced in 1994, the V-Spec II was a high-performance variant that came equipped with wider 245/45R17 tires.
zh:
配备了Brembo刹车和45小尺寸轮胎的特殊R32 GT-R。

自从“Kenmeri”停产之后，R32 Skyline GT-R将成为16年来首次再度冠以GT-R之名的车型。全新开发的RB26DETT引擎配备有陶瓷双涡轮增压器，能够输出280 PS/36.0 公斤力米的动力。其传动系统采用了革命性的Attesa E-TS四轮驱动系统，着重满足“让车辆实现轻松转向”的需求。V-Spec II是1994年推出的高性能车型，采用了更宽大的245/45R17轮胎。

en:
This top-of-the-line GT-R R33 included the ATTESA ET-S Pro high-performance all-wheel drive system.

The R33 GT-R made its debut in January 1995. Faced with the challenge of following a car often hailed as one of the greatest in automotive history, Nissan introduced the new model with the bold slogan, “Minus 21-Second Dream”—a nod to its Nürburgring lap time, where it outpaced the R32 by a remarkable 21 seconds. The RB26DETT engine returned with refined tuning that delivered improved throttle response and increased torque. The V-Spec variant came fitted with the advanced ATTESA E-TS Pro all-wheel-drive system as standard, offering integrated control of the active limited-slip differential and ABS.
zh:
R33 GT-R的顶级车型，搭载ATTESA E-TS Pro系统。

R33 GT-R于1995年1月推出。在面对种种质疑时，如与前代车型相比获得了哪些提升，有哪些特点能让它成为历史上最伟大车型之一，Nissan为这款新车设计了“减掉21秒的梦”的广告词，着重宣传它在纽博格林赛道上的单圈成绩比R32缩短了整整21秒。新车型沿用了前代的RB26DETT引擎，但优化了引擎响应和扭矩。这款V-Spec型号同样也标配了Attesa E-TS Pro四轮驱动系统，能够实现主动限滑差速器（LSD）和防抱死刹车系统（ABS）的联动控制。

carNameEn: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
en:
A limited-edition model signifying the end of production, the "Nür" stands for Nürburgring, where the car was developed.

The R34 GT-R was unveiled in January 1999. In contrast to the larger R33, the new model adopted a more compact, muscular profile—3.0 inches shorter in overall length with a wheelbase reduced by 2.2 inches. The now fully matured RB26DETT engine received a final round of enhancements, pushing torque to 289.3 ft-lb, while refinements to the chassis brought sharper control and more intuitive handling. Crowning the lineup was the limited-edition Nür, fitted with the N1-spec RB26DETT engine, marking the final evolution of the powerplant.
zh:
以研发地为名；限量版V Spec II，为纪念停产推出。

R34 GT-R于1999年1月亮相。与尺寸更大的R33相比，这款新车采用了紧凑有力的车身设计，长度缩短了75毫米，轴距也缩短了55毫米。而日臻成熟的RB26DETT引擎也得到了进一步提升，扭矩提升到了40.0 公斤力米，再加上底盘优化，让这辆车的稳定性更上一层楼，操控性也更易预测。而“Nur”也是Nissan推出的最后一款搭载N1 spec RB26DETT引擎的限量车型。

en:
Engineered to the finest detail, this Audi supercar features welds measured in microns.

Although derived from the "Le Mans quattro" concept, the production version of this sports car took its name from Audi’s R8 race cars, which had earned a solid reputation with dominant performances at Le Mans. Built around Audi’s ultra-lightweight aluminum space frame, the car featured a 4.2-liter V-8 producing 414.2 HP, delivering power to all four wheels via the quattro system, which employed viscous couplings. In 2009, the lineup was expanded with the addition of the 5.2 FSI model, powered by a 5.2-liter V-10 generating 517.7 HP.
zh:
Aud超跑的焊点据称已达到微米级别，堪称完美无瑕。

尽管是基于“Le Mans Quattro”概念车开发而来，这辆量产版本跑车在命名时却投向了在勒芒表现亮眼的Audi R8赛车。这款车型使用了Audi的超轻量空间车架技术，装备了一部420 PS的4.2升V8引擎，并通过采用了粘性耦合器的Quattro系统将动力输送到全部四个车轮。2009年，产品线中又增添了5.2 FSI版本，换用了能够输出525 PS动力的5.2升V10引擎。

en:
A French icon of the '60s, the R8 Gordini is still popular half a century after its birth.

This high-performance version of the Renault 8 was tuned by Amédée Gordini, known as "The Sorcerer" for his remarkable engine tuning. Building on the strengths of the original 1108 cc compact sedan, Gordini transformed the modest Renault 8 into a formidable touring machine, blending precision engineering with motorsport spirit. In 1966, the engine was enlarged to 1300 cc and paired with a 5-speed transmission, further unlocking its performance potential. With its distinctive character and motorsport pedigree, this automotive gem holds a cherished place in the hearts of enthusiasts to this day.
zh:
作为1960年代标志性的法国车，自其诞生之后的半个世纪，依旧经久不衰。

这款Renault 8高性能版本由被誉为引擎“魔法师”的阿梅德·戈迪尼亲自调校。巧妙发挥了Renault 8基础车型的设计优势，让看似平凡的1,108 立方厘米紧凑型轿车蜕变为强悍的竞技房车。1966年，引擎排量扩大至1,300 立方厘米，变速箱升级为5速，进一步挖掘出车辆潜能。凭借独特的设计理念，这款汽车杰作至今仍在车迷心中占据特殊地位。

en:
This updated version of a champion race car won the Nürburgring 24 Hour Race immediately after its debut.

In 2015, the production Audi R8 underwent a full model change, and with it came the debut of the updated R8 LMS, built to FIA GT3 specifications. This new generation brought significant advancements in both safety and aerodynamics, while the transmission and traction control systems were replaced with newly developed, race-focused components. Mere moments after its unveiling, the R8 LMS proved its capabilities by taking overall victory in its debut outing at the Nürburgring 24 Hours.
zh:
亮相之后立刻赢得纽博格林赛道24小时耐力赛的强劲GT3。

Audi R8量产车型在2015年迎来了全面改款，公司也随之推出了升级版的R8 LMS FIA-GT3规格赛车。除了在安全性和空气动力学性能方面进了重大提升之外，其传动系统和牵引力控制也更换为了最新开发的系统。在公布后不久，R8 LMS就在纽博格林24小时耐力赛上首次亮相，并拿下了全面碾压式的胜利。

en:
This evolved version of Audi's R8 LMS competed in various GT3 events across the globe.

This was the evolution model of the R8 LMS. Cooling efficiency and aerodynamic performance saw notable improvements over its predecessor, while the entire drivetrain was upgraded to boost reliability under the demands of endurance racing. Although engine output remained unchanged, a 55 lbs reduction in body weight allowed greater flexibility in weight distribution through ballast adjustment. Making its debut in the autumn of 2018, the car demonstrated its potential with a victory at the Gulf 12 Hours later that year.
zh:
Audi R8 LMS的进化车型，在全球各地接受各种GT3赛事的考验。

R8 LMS的进化版本。相比R8 LMS，散热和空气动力学性能得到改善，整套传动系统也经过升级，以提升赛事可靠性。引擎动力保持不变，但车身减重25 公斤，为添加压舱配重时的重量平衡调校提供了更大灵活性。2018年秋季首次亮相，年底便在海湾12小时耐力赛中夺冠，迅速证明了自身实力。

en:
Audi's second-generation sports car based on the Le Mans-conquering R8.

The second-generation model of Audi’s road car, bearing the name of its renowned Le Mans prototype, continued the legacy of performance and innovation. While preserving the silhouette of its predecessor, the new model introduced a revised Audi Space Frame for improved rigidity and reduced weight, alongside an updated quattro all-wheel-drive system. The V10 Plus represented the high-performance model, with its 5.2-liter V-10 engine further refined to deliver an impressive 601.6 HP. It came equipped with a fixed rear wing and a mechanical LSD as standard.
zh:
Audi的第二代公路跑车，与勒芒耐力赛冠军车型R8同名。

这是Audi公路跑车的第二代车型，继承了征战勒芒24小时耐力赛的原型赛车的传奇名号。这款新车型延续了前代的设计精髓，同时升级了Audi空间车架结构和"quattro"四驱系统。这款V10 Plus是高性能版本，将5.2升V10引擎的动力进一步调校至610 PS。还配置了固定式尾翼和机械限滑差速器。

en:
Appearing towards the end of Group C's turbo era, this car won every round of the final All-Japan Sports Prototype Championship.

With the All Japan GT Championship extending its turbocharger regulations through 1992, Nissan pressed forward with development, culminating in the formidable R92CP. Capable of exceeding 248.5 mph on Fuji Speedway’s main straight and generating up to 3.5 tons of downforce, the R92CP proved unstoppable, winning every race that season and bringing the turbo era to a dominant close.
zh:
这款优秀的汽车一直坚持到了C组别涡轮引擎时代的终结，曾在全日本跑车原型锦标赛总决赛中赢下了每一轮的冠军。

在全日本锦标赛决定将旧有的涡轮增压器规定沿用到1992年之后，Nissan也继续开发他们的赛车，直到最后推出了这款R92CP。R92CP在富士高速赛道的直道上跑出了超过400 公里/小时的创纪录极速，同时产生了最高达3.5吨的下压力。它势不可挡地赢下了当个赛季的每一场比赛，为涡轮增压器时代画上了圆满的句号。

en:
The F1 machine that scored Honda its first F1 victory.

In 1965, this legendary machine delivered Honda its first-ever F1 victory. Building upon the foundation of the RA271—Honda’s first F1 challenger—this car achieved greater performance through weight reduction across its components, the adoption of outboard rear suspension, and refined tuning of its 1.5-liter V-12. Although early in the season it grappled with stability issues, significant improvements were introduced midway through the campaign. These efforts culminated in a hard-fought and celebrated triumph at Round 10, the Mexican Grand Prix.
zh:
为Honda斩获了第一场胜利的F1赛车。

1965年，这台传奇赛车为Honda带来了F1历史上的首场胜利。这款赛车沿用了Honda首款F1赛车RA271的基本框架，但通过全方位轻量化、改用外置后悬挂系统，以及对“如钟表般精准”的1.5升V12引擎进行了精密调校，使得性能得以提升。虽然赛季初期饱受稳定性问题困扰，但经过中期的重大改进，最终在第10轮墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了来之不易的胜利。

en:
An adventurous SUV for active lifestyles.

When it was introduced in 1994, the Toyota RAV4 pioneered an entirely new market segment, called the “crossover SUV.” With its compact body and high ground clearance, it quickly gained followers around the world and reached its fifth generation in 2018. The Adventure grade brought rugged off-road styling, highlighted by a custom grille, skid-plate bumpers, and 19-inch wheel rims. A 2.0-liter inline-4 Dynamic Force Engine was mated to a Direct Shift-CVT, delivering smooth acceleration and impressive fuel efficiency.
zh:
专为挑战与活力打造的SUV。

1994年问世的Toyota RAV4开创了“跨界SUV”这一全新的细分市场。这款车型以紧凑的车身和高离地间隙赢得全球拥趸，并在2018年迎来第五代。Adventure版本拥有硬朗的越野造型，配备专属前格栅、防护板式保险杠及19英寸轮毂。2升直列四缸涡轮增压动态出力引擎与直驱式无级变速器，可同时实现平顺加速与出色的油耗。

en:
This race machine claimed the Super GT championship in 2016 equipped with a conventional gasoline engine.

The NSX CONCEPT-GT was a purpose-built racing machine developed by Honda, based on the 2012 next-generation NSX concept, to compete in the GT500 class of the Super GT series. At its debut, the car featured a hybrid powertrain, however, by the 2016 season, the hybrid system was removed due to supply challenges from the battery manufacturer. It concluded the season with a 12th-place finish overall.
zh:
这款未装配混合动力系统的赛车是2016年Super GT锦标赛的参赛车辆。

NSX CONCEPT-GT是Honda基于2012年推出的次时代NSX概念车，专为参加Super GT系列赛的GT500组别所开发的赛车。在首次亮相时，这辆车配备了一套混动系统。但是在2016年，由于电池制造商的供应问题，它不得不在这套系统无法工作的情况下参赛。最后它以第12名的总成绩结束了那个赛季。

en:
Even beginners can experience dynamic driving performance with a range of electronic aids.

The RC F was unveiled by Lexus at the 2014 Detroit Auto Show. At its heart lay a refined version of the 5.0-liter V-8 from the IS F, producing 449.7 HP and 383.3 ft-lb of torque—an increase of 32.5 HP and 10.8 ft-lb more than the original engine. Paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission featuring paddle shifters, the RC F delivered both power and precision. Excluding the LFA, it stood as the most sports-focused model ever introduced in the Lexus lineup.
zh:
即便是新手也可以在多种电子辅助设备的帮助下体验到动态的驾驶表现。

RC F是Lexus在2014年底特律车展上公布的一款高性能双门轿跑。其引擎采用了IS F的5升V8的改良版，能够输出456 PS和53.0 公斤力米，比原版引擎高出了33 PS和1.5 公斤力米。这套动力系统还搭配了一部带换挡拨片的8速自动变速箱。除了LFA之外，这辆车是Lexus产品历史中最强调运动性能的车型。

en:
Emil Frey Racing was one of the first teams to compete with a GT3 version of the Lexus RC F.

Beginning in 2015, Lexus initiated test competition with a purpose-built race car based on the RC F, using the data and experience gained to refine and evolve the machine. This development culminated in the debut of the RC F GT3 in 2017. Emil Frey Racing, who played a key role in the car's development, campaigned the RC F GT3 in the International GT Open. Its efforts were rewarded with a 3rd-place finish in the team standings.
zh:
Emil Frey Racing车队使用的GT3车型。Emil Frey Racing是最早使用Lexus RC F的车队之一。

从2015年起，Lexus开始派出一款基于RC F打造的赛车参加比赛，进行测试。他们利用这些测试中积累来的经验，对这部车进行持续性开发，并最终在2017年首次公布了这辆RC F GT3。作为参与了RC F GT3开发工作的车队，Emil Frey Racing带着这款车参加了国际GT公开赛。他们最终在车队排名上取得了第三的好成绩。

en:
This highly refined Lexus RC F coupe competed in the 2016 VLN as a GT3 race car.

The RC F GT3 is a GT3-spec race car developed from the Lexus RC F, created as a prototype prior to official homologation to evaluate and refine its performance. In its early testing phase, the car claimed victory in Round 9 of the VLN (Nürburgring Endurance Series). At the time, it competed in raw carbon-fiber bodywork, but the version shown here is adorned in the distinctive Emil Frey Racing livery.
zh:
参与过2016 VLN赛事的Lexus RC F GT3。

RC F GT3是Lexus基于RC F开发的一款GT3规格赛车。这辆车就是在认证版本正式定型之前，为了测试性能而开发的原型车。它在纽博格林耐力赛的第九轮中取得了漂亮的胜利。当时它以无涂装的碳纤维裸色车身参赛，不过我们在这里看到的这个版本采用了Emil Frey Racing车队的涂装。

en:
This version of the highly refined Lexus RC F production coupe was modified for Gr.4.

This Gran Turismo Original is a race-prepared version of the Lexus RC F coupe, specifically modified for Gr.4 competition. Harnessing the immense torque of its large-displacement V-8, the car delivers exceptional straight-line acceleration. Its base color is finished in the signature orange used by Lexus for its exclusive special models.
zh:
一款广受好评的Lexus RC F，专为Gr.4而改装。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是Lexus RC F高性能双门轿跑的Gr.4赛事改装版本。它的大排量V8引擎拥有强大的扭矩，极其擅长进行直线加速。其基础配色是Lexus在他们的特殊车型上常用的同款橙色。

en:
A time attack Civic customized in the classic JDM style.

This striking machine was the winner of the 2017 Gran Turismo Award. Based on a 1992 EG Honda Civic, it features a PANDEM wide-body kit and a carbon-fiber hood inspired by a design from J's Racing. The interior has been fully stripped to reduce weight, and the original engine has been replaced with a K24 inline-4. This car stood as a striking symbol of the JDM (Japanese Domestic Market) scene.
zh:
以经典JDM风格改装的计时赛专用Civic。

2017年“Gran Turismo大奖”得主。以1992年的Civic EG为基础，配备PANDEM宽体套件和采用J's Racing设计的碳纤维引擎盖。拆除内饰以进行轻量化处理，引擎换装为K24直列四缸引擎。这款车是JDM（日本国内市场）改装文化的典型代表。

en:
This is a Gr.3 production version of the stylish Peugeot RCZ compact coupe.

This is the homologation model of the RCZ Gr.3, a race-spec version of Peugeot’s gracefully sculpted specialty coupe, adapted for Gr.3 regulations. Transformed into a mid-engine supercar, the design draws inspiration from the 2002 RC concept, one of the earliest visions that eventually gave rise to the RCZ.
zh:
Peugeot RCZ紧凑型双门轿车的Gr.3公路车版。

RCZ是Peugeot的特色车型，拥有优雅流畅的外观，RCZ Gr.3是专为Gr.3规则对其进行改装的版本，而这辆车则是RCZ Gr.3的赛事认证型号。这辆车从RCZ最终定型前的一款早期原型——2002年的“RC”概念车上汲取灵感，改为了一款中置引擎的超级跑车。

en:
This is a Gr.3 race version of the stylish Peugeot RCZ compact coupe.
