A Gran Turismo Original, this is a race-prepared version of the RCZ—Peugeot’s elegantly contoured specialty coupe—adapted for Gr.3 regulations. To enhance weight distribution and overall performance, the drivetrain has been reconfigured from its original front-engine/front-wheel-drive setup to a mid-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout. With its extended 102.8 inches wheelbase, the RCZ provides an ideal foundation for transformation into a competitive race machine.
zh:
Peugeot RCZ紧凑型双门轿车的Gr.3公路车版。

RCZ是Peugeot的特色车型，拥有优雅流畅的外观，而这辆车则是专为Gr.3规则改装的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。为了优化配重比和整体性能，这辆车的传动系统从前置前驱改为了中置后驱布局。RCZ那2,612毫米的长轴距也让它成为了赛车改装的完美候选者。

en:
This is a Gr.4 race car version of the stylish Peugeot RCZ compact coupe.

A Gran Turismo Original, this is a Gr.4-spec version of the RCZ, Peugeot’s gracefully styled specialty coupe. Maintaining a front-wheel-drive layout, this model features motorsports-inspired enhancements including a prominent front splitter, a rear wing, and redesigned aerodynamic front fenders.
zh:
Peugeot RCZ紧凑型双门轿车的Gr.4公路车版。

RCZ是Peugeot的特色车型，拥有优雅流畅的外观，而这辆车则是专为Gr.4规则改装的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。RCZ Gr.4采用了正统的前轮驱动房车架构，还加装了前定风翼和尾翼，以及一套空气动力学性能更强的前挡泥板。

en:
A unique car with a double-bubble rear roof.

First capturing attention with its debut as a concept at the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show, the Peugeot RCZ transitioned to production in 2010 with remarkably few changes from its original design. In 2015, the lineup was enhanced with the introduction of the GT Line model, which brought a new front grille, dual exhaust outlets, 19-inch alloy wheels, and a red-stitched black leather interior.
zh:
具有双气泡后车顶的独特车型。

Peugeot RCZ最初在2007年法兰克福车展上作为概念车亮相之后，立刻获得了广泛的关注。在2010年正式上市时，它基本上保留了原版概念车的形制。2015年，产品线中又加入了GT Line车型。这个新型号采用了全新的前格栅设计和双排气管，换上了19英寸轮毂，还搭配上全新的红色缝线黑色皮革内饰，呈现出更具运动感的外观。

en:
This is an original Gr.B rally-tuned version of the Peugeot RCZ compact coupe.

A Gran Turismo Original, this Gr.B version of the RCZ reimagines Peugeot’s elegantly sculpted specialty coupe. Designed in the spirit of the extreme Pikes Peak hillclimb cars, it features an oversized front spoiler and a towering rear wing. The drivetrain has been completely reengineered, with the engine relocated behind the cockpit and mated to a 4-wheel-drive system.
zh:
一款专为Gr.B拉力赛调校的Peugeot RCZ紧凑型双门轿车。

RCZ是Peugeot的特色车型，拥有优雅流畅的外观，而这辆车则是专为Gr.B规则改装的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。这个车型的外观是按照派克峰爬坡赛赛车的形象所设计，外加超大号的前扰流板和尾翼。其引擎安装的位置也被移到了驾驶舱后方，并使用了一套四轮驱动动力系统。

en:
The ultimate naturally-aspirated flat-6 machine, meticulously crafted by Ruf.

This RUF original was based on the 991-generation Porsche 911 GT3. Developed with the philosophy of blending GT3-level performance with refined road car comfort, it was powered by a naturally-aspirated Mezger engine—fitted with the legendary GT1 crankshaft—and enlarged from 3.8 to 4.2 liters. Riveted overfenders added a bold visual statement, emphasizing the car’s raw capability and presence. A true enthusiast’s machine, tailored for the gentleman driver.
zh:
RUF精心打造的终极自然进气水平对置6缸引擎跑车。

这款RUF原创车型基于991型Porsche 911 GT3打造。以融合GT3性能与公路车舒适性为设计理念，搭载配备传奇GT1曲轴箱的自然进气Metzger引擎，排量也从3.8升扩大至4.2升。外观配备铆钉式宽体轮眉，彰显出这款车的狂野本性。它是绅士车手的理想之选。

en:
This stock car for the street had a wedge-shaped front end and one of the tallest rear wings ever to grace a production car.

This homologation model was released by Plymouth, under the Chrysler umbrella, with the clear intention of dominating stock car racing. Based on the standard Road Runner, it received an extended nose and an enormous rear wing, creating an unmistakable silhouette. Standard power came from the 440 Super Commando engine, delivering 369.8 HP, while performance-minded buyers could opt for the 426 Hemi with more than 419.1 HP or a 384.6 HP Six Barrel setup. It was produced for a single year to meet homologation requirements.
zh:
这是一辆拥有令人难以置信的巨大尾翼和延展车头的原厂赛车。

这是Plymouth在Chrysler集团旗下推出的赛事认证车型，专为征战原厂量产车赛事而生。基础版Road Runner配备了加长车头和巨型尾翼，营造出独特的视觉效果。标配375 PS的440 Super Commando引擎，另可选装输出超过425 PS的426 Hemi引擎或输出390 PS的六腔化油器版本引擎。它只在为期一年的赛事认证期间内生产。

en:
Mazda's Eunos Roadster is credited with reviving the small fun-to-drive rear-drive convertible sports car.

This automotive masterpiece marked the revival of the lightweight sports car as the 20th century drew to a close. First introduced in 1989 with a 1.6-liter engine, the model saw its displacement increased to 1.8 liters in 1993. Its true appeal lay in its mechanical purity—the transmission and rear differential were unified by an aluminum powerplant frame, while double wishbone suspension and disc brakes at all four corners delivered precise, responsive handling.
zh:
这款广受欢迎的畅销车型在全球带起了一阵紧凑型跑车的风潮。

这款汽车杰作为20世纪末的轻量化跑车复兴奠定了基础。最初于1989年搭载1.6升引擎首次登场，1993年引擎排量扩大至1.8升。这款车的魅力在于其基础架构，变速箱和后差速器通过铝制动力单元框架相连，四轮均配备双叉臂悬挂和碟刹，成就了直接、灵敏的操控体验。

en:
A first-generation Mazda Roadster, tuned to perfection by Gran Turismo.

The Eunos Roadster (NA Special Package) '89 has been specially tuned by Gran Turismo to create this original machine. While the engine and suspension have been enhanced and aerodynamic components added, it faithfully preserves the Roadster’s hallmark "Jinba Ittai," the feeling of unity between car and driver. This spartan lightweight can even hold its own in touring car races.
zh:
第一代Roadster，由跑车浪漫旅完成调校。

这款车以Eunos Roadster（NA Special Package）'89为基础，经跑车浪漫旅特别调校打造而成。引擎和悬挂系统经过改装，并增加了空气动力学套件，但仍保持了Roadster特有的“人车一体”灵敏操控特性。这是一台连房车赛事都能胜任的纯粹赛车。

en:
This motorsports-based model epitomizes the core concepts of the Roadster.

This motorsport-focused base model was introduced as part of the fourth-generation Roadster lineup. Its drivetrain was upgraded to meet the demands of track use, complemented by a larger radiator and enhanced disc brakes. The suspension featured height-adjustable dampers supplied by Bilstein. In 2022, the car received Kinematic Posture Control, designed to dramatically improve rear-end stability and cornering composure.
zh:
这款赛车向的基础车型成为了展现Roadster核心理念的典范。

第4代Roadster车系中新增的赛车运动基础版本。传动系统升级至赛道驾驶规格，同时配备了更大的散热器和碟刹。悬挂系统配备Bilstein高度可调减震器。2022年进行了进一步升级，新增运动姿态控制系统，大幅提升后部稳定性。

en:
The MX-5 Miata returns to its roots with a lightweight 2183 lbs body and dashing looks.

The fourth-generation ND Roadster made its global debut in April 2014 at the New York Auto Show. Its compact dimensions, combined with a wide, low stance and elegantly sculpted curves, garnered widespread acclaim when the final design was revealed in September of the same year. Pre-orders commenced in March 2015. The entry-level S grade featured pared-down equipment, and at just 2183 lbs, it stood as the only variant with a curb weight under one ton.
zh:
第四代Roadster，车体加宽，车重更是低至990 公斤。

第四代“ND”Roadster在2014年4月的纽约车展上盛大亮相。它的车身紧凑短小，但呈现出宽大、低伏的风格，外加优雅的弧线造型，在同年九月一经正式公布便受到全世界范围车迷的交口称赞。这款车于2015年3月开启了预购。其最基础的装饰级别为S级，采用了简化的配置，也是唯一一款重量低于1吨的车型，整备重量仅为990 公斤。

en:
This 2014 GT Awards winner was a high-speed monster wearing the skin of a Camaro SS.

This machine was the winner of the 2014 Gran Turismo Award. A heavily customized 1970 Chevrolet Camaro SS, it was reimagined by Roadster Shop in Illinois, USA. The car’s structure was rebuilt from the ground up using lightweight carbon fiber and aluminum components, while under the hood sat a rear-offset 7.0-liter LS7 engine tuned to produce 739.6 HP. Its aggressive aesthetic was matched by performance, with wide overfenders, a bold front spoiler, and a prominent rear wing.
zh:
2014年GT奖得主。披着Camaro SS外皮的高速怪物。

2014年Gran Turismo大奖得主。这款1970年Chevrolet Camaro SS由美国伊利诺伊州Roadster Shop定制改装。基础结构采用碳纤维和铝制部件重新构建，搭载后置布局的7升LS7引擎，调校至750 PS。强劲动力与大尺寸宽体轮眉、前扰流板和尾翼组成的震撼外观完美匹配。

en:
A French race car with a Japanese heart.

In the summer of 2014, Renault Sport unveiled the R.S.01 as its new contender for one-make racing, succeeding the Mégane Trophy. Measuring 164.2 inches in length and 78.7 inches in width, the R.S.01 boasted a lightweight body at just 2425 lbs. Beneath its sculpted exterior was a potent twin-turbo V-6 engine producing 542.4 HP. Every detail of the car—from its advanced aerodynamics to its efficient cooling systems—reflects Renault Sport’s deep expertise, making it an impressive race machine in every sense.
zh:
R.S.01，步入了运动赛车的世界。

在2014年夏天，Renault Sport推出了这款全新赛车R.S.01，代替Mégane Trophy参加单一车种比赛。虽然它的车身长4,170毫米，宽2,000毫米，车重却仅有1,100 公斤。这套轻量级框架由一部能输出550 PS的V6双涡轮增压引擎供能。这辆车能够满足人们对赛车的一切要求，Renault Sport也将他们丰富的汽车工程知识统统运用在了空气动力学和散热部件的设计上。

en:
Renault's special GT3 machine with Nismo power. 

Based on Renault Sport’s purpose-built one-make racer, the R.S.01, the Renault Sport R.S.01 GT3 was developed to compete in FIA GT championships. To comply with FIA GT3 regulations, the car underwent significant modifications. The power output was restricted, and the brake materials were replaced. Also, 110 lbs of ballast was added, and the ground effect aerodynamics were completely reengineered
zh:
参加雷诺世界系列赛的GT赛车，经由NISMO调试后重获新生。

这款Renault Sport R.S.01 GT3基于Renault Sport的单一车种赛车——R.S.01所开发，并用于参加FIA-GT锦标赛。为了符合国际汽联的GT3组别规则，这个车型接受了大量的改动。其马力输出受到了相应的限制，刹车材料也得到了更换，此外还配备了50 公斤的压舱物，地面效应也进行了全面修改。

en:
A DTM machine with two victories in the Class 1 era.

This was a 2019 Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM) machine. In line with the series’ engine downsizing rules, the previous 4.0-liter V-8 was replaced with a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4. Remarkably, the new engine produced more power than its predecessor, while also weighing less, with improved weight distribution. In the 2019 season, Audi’s ace driver René Rast captured the championship title, alongside securing the team championship.
zh:
在Class 1时代蝉联冠军的德国房车大师赛赛车。

这是一款2019年德国房车大师赛（DTM）赛车。根据一级赛车（Class 1）引入的引擎小型化规则，引擎从4升V8改为2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。但后者实际上能产生比前代更强的动力，在车重和重量分布方面也更具优势。2019赛季，王牌车手雷内·拉斯特夺得车手总冠军，同时也为车队赢得团体冠军。

en:
This ultra-exotic concept featured a rotary engine and cutting-edge technology.

This concept car was created to celebrate the 50th anniversary of Mazda’s founding. Its bullet-shaped body was mounted on a steel tube space frame and powered by a 10A-type rotary engine originally developed for the 24 Hours of Spa, delivering around 246.5 HP. Although it appeared publicly in three different body colors, later investigation revealed it was, in fact, a single car repainted for each appearance.
zh:
搭载了转子引擎和尖端科技的超跑概念车。

这是一款为了纪念Mazda成立50周年而专门推出的概念车。其子弹外形车身被安置在一套钢管空间车架底盘上，并配备了一部专为斯帕24小时耐力赛打造、能够输出250 PS级别的10A型转子引擎。尽管市面上能见到三款不同配色的版本，但经过调查，人们发现其实都是同一款车身采用了不同的喷漆。

en:
This version of the second-generation RX-7 offered better driver feedback and agility.

The FC3S, second generation of the RX-7, made its debut in October 1985. Sporting a sleek, futuristic design, it was shorter than its predecessor but both taller and wider. This new generation also carried an additional 441 lbs of weight. To offset the added weight, the FC3S was fitted with the newly developed 13B rotary engine. Each chamber was enlarged to 654 cc, and with the addition of a turbocharger, the engine delivered a peak output of 182.4 HP and 180.8 ft-lb of torque.
zh:
第2代RX-7的完整形态，性能与操控回馈都有提升。

第二代RX-7——FC3S——于1985年10月首次亮相。这辆车拥有全新的未来风外观，从车身尺寸上看，它仅在长度方面小于初代车型，但是更高也更宽。这款新车型的重量也增加了200 公斤。为了驱动更重的车身，这辆车配备了一台全新的13B引擎。通过将每个转子缸体的排量扩大到654 立方厘米，并结合一部涡轮增压器，新引擎的性能得到了极大提升，能够输出185 PS的最大动力和25.0 公斤力米的最大扭矩。

en:
The debut model of the third-generation RX-7, a car developed to be the ultimate sports car.

The third-generation FD3S RX-7 was introduced in December 1991. The Savanna name used on earlier models was retired, with the official name in Japan becoming the ɛ̃fini RX-7. The car carried over the 13B rotary engine from the second generation, but output increased to 251.5 HP with the introduction of a sequential twin-turbo system. Thanks to extensive use of aluminum in components such as the hood, spare wheel, jack and 4-wheel double-wishbone suspension, the FD3S achieved an impressively low curb weight of around 2778 lbs.
zh:
第三代RX-7车型首发，旨在成为一款终极跑车。

第三代RX-7，“FD3S”，于1991年12月首次亮相。前代车型命名中的“Savanna”退出舞台，如今该车的日本市场官方名称为ɛ̃fini RX-7。该车和第二代车型一样，采用“13B”式转子引擎，得益于采用了串列式双涡轮布局，最大动力提升至255 PS。此外，引擎盖、备胎、随车千斤顶以及四轮双叉臂悬架部件均大量采用铝合金材质，使整车实现了令人惊叹的轻量化，整备质量约为1,260 公斤。

carNameEn: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02
en:
This final version of the Mazda RX-7 marked the end of an excellent 25-year run for the model.

The FD3S, the third generation of the RX-7, was introduced in December 1991. Its widened body accommodated broader tires for improved grip, while extensive use of aluminum components throughout the chassis brought the weight down to just under 2646 lbs. Although it retained the 13B engine from the FC3S, the FD3S introduced a sequential twin-turbo system, boosting output to 251.5 HP and 217.0 ft-lb of torque. The lightest variant, the Type S, achieved a power-to-weight ratio of 4.97 kg/HP, making it the most potent RX-7 ever produced.
zh:
RX-7的最后一款纪念车型，25年的历史告一段落。

FD3S，即第三代RX-7，于1991年12月首次亮相。虽然为了容纳更宽的轮胎而增加了车身宽度，但通过在车身各部位大量采用铝合金部件，显著减重至接近1,200 公斤。虽然引擎与FC3S同样采用13B转子引擎，但通过序列式双涡轮系统将功率输出提升至255 PS/30.0 公斤力米。最轻量化的Type S车型功率重量比达到4.90 公斤/PS，成为RX-7历史上性能最强的车型。

en:
The final version of the RX-8, Mazda's rotary engine sports car with a unique 4-door layout.

Introduced in 2011, this marked the final special edition of the Mazda RX-8. Built on the 6-speed manual Type RS—equipped with Bilstein dampers—and the 6-speed automatic Type E—offering upscale touches like leather seating—both variants received exclusive interior and exterior enhancements. Initially planned as a 1,000-unit production, strong demand following the announcement of the RX-8’s discontinuation in 2012 prompted Mazda to double the run with an additional 1,000 units.
zh:
Mazda的转子引擎跑车RX-8的最后限量版车型，具有独特的4门设计。

2011年发布，这是Mazda RX-8的最终特别版本。配备Bilstein减震器的6速手动Type RS基础版和配备皮革座椅等豪华配置的6速自动Type E基础版，均采用了特殊的内外饰装备。原计划限量1000台，但由于2012年RX-8停产消息的刺激，销量激增，最终追加生产1000台。

en:
This stunning concept provided a glimpse of a next-generation rotary-engine-powered car.

This rotary sports-car concept was unveiled at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Every unnecessary line and surface were meticulously carved away from its sleek long-nose, short-deck silhouette, revealing Mazda’s purest interpretation of the ideal rear-wheel-drive sports car. Powered by the next-generation SKYACTIV-R rotary engine, this concept offered a bold glimpse into the future of rotary performance.
zh:
一辆采用了次时代转子引擎的优雅概念车。

2015年东京车展上发布的转子引擎运动概念车。在优雅的长前悬短后悬造型基础上，进行了精心雕琢，去除所有冗余线条，以抒写Mazda对理想后驱跑车的展望。搭载SKYACTIV-R下一代转子引擎，此车展现了对转子动力技术的未来愿景。

carNameEn: MAZDA RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT Stealth Model
en:
Mazda's dream rotary race car.

The RX-VISION concept was introduced at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. The base car’s elegant proportions have been reimagined with a more aggressive, motorsport-focused edge. To meet the performance demands of the Gr.3 class, the lightweight body houses a 4-rotor engine, drawing inspiration from the legendary 787B powerplant, revived through cutting-edge SKYACTIV technology to deliver unprecedented levels of power and responsiveness.
zh:
Mazda的梦幻转子引擎赛车。

MAZDA RX-VISION在2015东京车展上以概念车的身份亮相。原车设计的美感在赛车化改造中得到了更加激进的重新诠释。为满足Gr.3组别的动力需求，轻量化车身搭载了4转子引擎，其设计灵感源自经典787B引擎，采用最新SKYACTIV技术重新打造，带来前所未有的性能表现。

en:
Mazda's dream rotary race car.

The RX-VISION concept was introduced at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. The base car’s elegant proportions have been reimagined with a more aggressive, motorsport-focused edge. To meet the performance demands of the Gr.3 class, the lightweight body houses a 4-rotor engine, drawing inspiration from the legendary 787B powerplant, revived through cutting-edge SKYACTIV technology to deliver unprecedented levels of power and responsiveness.
zh:
Mazda的梦幻转子引擎赛车。

MAZDA RX-VISION在2015东京车展上以概念车的身份亮相。原车设计的美感在赛车化改造中得到了更加激进的重新诠释。为满足Gr.3组别的动力需求，轻量化车身搭载了4转子引擎，其设计灵感源自经典787B引擎，采用最新SKYACTIV技术重新打造，带来前所未有的性能表现。

en:
This special S13 had many previously optional items now included as standard equipment.

Built between 1988 and 1993, the S13-generation Silvia won over enthusiasts with its nimble handling and well-balanced rear-wheel-drive layout. Among its various trims, the high-performance K’s stood out—powered by a turbocharged DOHC inline-4, the CA18ET—earning a strong reputation for its versatility and performance. Later, the “Dia Selection” was introduced as a more affordable variant.
zh:
采用特殊规格的S13 Silvia，加入了众多倍受欢迎的选配配置。

1988年至1993年生产的S13 Silvia凭借紧凑型后驱布局提供的出色操控性能赢得了无数车迷的喜爱。在Silvia的众多车型中，搭载涡轮增压直列4缸双顶置凸轮轴“CA18ET”引擎的高性能K's版本因其在各种场合下的巨大潜力而备受推崇。后来还推出了“Dia Selection”作为低成本车型。

en:
A low price, excellent handling and naturally aspirated engine made this S13 quite attractive.

Produced between 1988 and 1993, the S13-generation Silvia earned a devoted following for its sharp, responsive handling and compact rear-wheel-drive layout. While the top-trim K’s came equipped with a turbocharged engine, the Q’s variant featured a naturally-aspirated 138.1 HP unit. Its suspension employed MacPherson struts up front and a multi-link setup at the rear, and select models were available with the advanced Super HICAS 4-wheel steering system.
zh:
S13由自然进气引擎提供动力，平易近人的价格和优越的操作性是其备受欢迎的原因之一。

1988年至1993年生产的S13 Silvia凭借紧凑型后驱布局提供的出色操控性能赢得了无数车迷的喜爱。顶配K's车型搭载涡轮增压引擎，而Q's车型则搭载动力为140 PS的自然进气引擎。悬挂系统前部采用支柱系统，后部采用多连杆系统，还可选装“Super HICAS”四轮转向系统。

en:
The top grade of the S14 adds a rear spoiler and leather wrapped steering wheel.

The S14 Silvia possessed a larger body than the S13 model. In 1996, it underwent a major facelift, incorporating menacing, slanted headlights and a prominent rear spoiler. The Aero package—available on both K’s and Q’s trims—added distinctive front and rear spoilers, exclusive bumpers, white-faced gauges, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob as standard.
zh:
装有后扰流板和皮革包裹方向盘的最顶级S14。

S14款Silvia的车身尺寸比S13更大。1996年，S14进行了大幅改款，增加了凶狠的前大灯和大型尾翼。“Aero”是K's和Q's均可选配的高级版本，标配特殊保险杠、前后扰流板、真皮包裹方向盘和换挡手柄球，以及全白仪表盘。

en:
The sixth-generation Silvia emphasized heightened luxury in a wide body format.

The broader stance of the S14-generation Silvia lent it a more upscale, refined presence. Under the hood, it retained the SR20 engine from the S13, with the top-grade K’s model receiving an added boost from an intercooled turbocharger. The suspension layout mirrored its predecessor’s, utilizing struts up front and a multi-link configuration at the rear. Super HICAS 4-wheel steering system was also offered on a select variant.
zh:
第六代Silvia采用宽体车身设计，呈现出更强的奢华感。

S14型Silvia更宽的车身带来了更胜一筹的豪华感。S13的SR20引擎得到沿用，在顶配K's车型上则进一步配备了中冷涡轮增压器。基本悬挂设置同样沿用了S13的设计，前部采用支柱系统，后部采用多连杆系统。还提供配备电动Super HICAS系统的车型选项。

en:
This popular S15 model included side skirts and a rear spoiler.

The seventh-generation S15 Silvia marked a return to the more compact proportions of the S13, reestablishing itself as an accessible, rear-wheel-drive sports car. While it continued to use the SR20 engine from previous generations, its chassis and running gear underwent a comprehensive redesign. With improved body rigidity, upgraded brakes, a more aggressive suspension setup, and the addition of a helical LSD, the S15 delivered a higher level of performance than its predecessors.
zh:
S15最受欢迎的车型，侧面和尾部扰流板成为标配。

第七代S15 Silvia回归到类似S13的紧凑型设计，成为了一款价格亲民的后驱跑车。延续了前代车型的SR20引擎，但传动系统和悬挂经过了全面升级。车身刚性增强，制动系统升级，悬挂更具运动性，还配备了螺旋式限滑差速器，性能水平较前代车型大幅提升。

carNameEn: Nissan Silvia spec-R Aero (S15) Touring Car
en:
This popular S15 model included side skirts and a rear spoiler.

The seventh-generation S15 Silvia marked a return to the more compact proportions of the S13, reestablishing itself as an accessible, rear-wheel-drive sports car. While it continued to use the SR20 engine from previous generations, its chassis and running gear underwent a comprehensive redesign. With improved body rigidity, upgraded brakes, a more aggressive suspension setup, and the addition of a helical LSD, the S15 delivered a higher level of performance than its predecessors.
zh:
S15最受欢迎的车型，侧面和尾部的扰流板成为标配。

第七代S15 Silvia回归到类似S13的紧凑型设计，成为了一款价格亲民的后驱跑车。延续了前代车型的SR20引擎，但传动系统和悬挂经过了全面升级。车身刚性增强、制动系统升级、悬挂更具运动性，配备螺旋式限滑差速器，性能水平较前代车型大幅提升。

en:
The FR open top sports car debuted for the 50th anniversary of Honda. 

Honda's beloved 'S' series of the 1960s made a return in 1999. Every element of the S2000 was engineered from the ground up to deliver pure, focused driving performance. True to its name, it was powered by a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 engine. Its 6-speed manual transmission was a purpose-built unit, incorporating a secondary reduction gear to optimize shift feel while minimizing weight. Details like these offered a clear window into the passion and precision that defined the S2000's development.
zh:
Honda推出的50周年款S2000，这辆前置后驱敞篷跑车很好地融入了公司的设计哲学。

Honda 1960年代的经典“S”系列在1999年重新复活。S2000的每个部件都经过专门开发以提供最佳运动性能。正如其名称所示，搭载2升直列4缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎。6速手动变速器同样为量身打造，采用副减速齿轮确保出色的换挡手感和轻量化。这些细节充分展现了设计师的用心与专注。

en:
The spiritual successor to the Beat was this small-yet-unadulterated mid-engine kei sports car.

The S660 marked Honda’s return to the convertible ultralight kei-sports-car segment 19 years after the end of production of the Beat in 1996. Its all-new body design delivered exceptional rigidity while maintaining a featherweight curb mass in the low 1764 lbs range. Adding to its dynamic prowess, the S660 featured a torque vectoring system that enabled cornering performance previously unimaginable for a kei-car, offering neutral, engaging handling.
zh:
Beat的精神续作，一辆符合日本轻型车标准的纯正中置引擎迷你跑车。

继1996年Beat车型停产之后，S660是Honda 19年来推出的第一款超轻量“日式轻型”敞篷跑车。其全新设计的车身刚度极高，同时还能将车重控制在800 公斤级别上。更厉害的是，这辆车配备了扭矩矢量分配系统，让它能够以对“日式轻型车”来说不可想象的高速通过弯道，同时还能确保适度且充满乐趣的操控性能。

en:
With a larger displacement than its predecessor, this car represented the pinnacle of the "S" line.

Honda’s lineage of sports cars began in 1963 with the ultra-compact, two-seat S500. It was followed by the S600, which delivered more power through a larger engine, and then by the S800, which featured 4-wheel independent suspension. Equipped with a more robust engine than the S600 and a short-throw shift lever positioned within easy reach of its low-slung seats, the S800 earned international praise.
zh:
Honda S系列的巅峰之作，更佳的性能，更大的排量。

Honda跑车系列始于1963年推出的超紧凑双座S500。随后推出了搭载更大引擎、动力更强的S600，接着是主打四轮独立悬挂的S800。S800相比S600引擎排量更大，短小的换挡杆在低矮座椅上轻松可及，赢得了全球赞誉。

en:
This very unqiue sports car was the first from Mercedes-Benz and is known for its characteristic boat tail styling.

This car earned double honors at the 2017 Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance, capturing both Best of Show and the Gran Turismo Trophy. Produced between 1926 and 1933, what many regard as Mercedes-Benz’s first true sports car was the vision of Ferdinand Porsche. Powered by a supercharged 7.0-liter inline-6, it was wrapped in elegant "boat tail" coachwork crafted by Barker.
zh:
最古早的Mercedes跑车，拥有优美的收敛式车尾。

在2017年圆石滩经典车展中荣获双料大奖，同时摘得“最佳巡展奖”和“Gran Turismo奖杯”。1926年至1933年间生产，可以认为是Mercedes-Benz首款跑车，由费迪南德·保时捷设计。搭载7升机械增压直列六缸引擎，车身采用车身制造商Barker打造的优美“船尾”式设计。

en:
Toyota's exciting concept vehicle that carries on the lightweight sports-car torch established by the Sport 800.

In the fall of 2015, at the Tokyo Motor Show, Toyota unveiled the S-FR lightweight sports car, conceived with the philosophy of delivering “perfect control in an entry model, allowing drivers to fully enjoy the car through everyday engagement." The design captured the spirit of the classic Toyota Sports 800, reimagined with a contemporary sensibility to suit modern tastes.
zh:
沿袭了Toyota轻量跑车传统的概念车。

Toyota在2015年秋季的东京车展上推出了这辆S-FR轻量化跑车，并为其设定了“入门级车型也能提供完美操控性，让驾驶者在日常驾驶中享受与汽车互动”的概念。其设计中提炼了经典车型Toyota Sports 800的精髓，并针对现代品味进行了相应的更新。

en:
The racing version of the attention-getting S-FR concept car.

Unveiled at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show, the S-FR Racing Concept was a track-focused evolution of Toyota’s S-FR. Fender width was extended by 0.8 inches on each side, while a prominent air outlet was integrated into the hood. A large rear wing and aggressive aerodynamic elements transformed the once-playful S-FR Concept into a car exuding the aura of a GT racer.
zh:
备受期待的GT概念车。

这款S-FR Racing Concept是Toyota S-FR的赛车版本，在2015年东京车展上正式公布。它的两侧挡泥板宽度增加了20毫米，引擎盖上也加设了大尺寸通风口。此外它的车身上还加装了一部大尺寸尾翼和其他多种地效部件，让曾经看上去人畜无害的S-FR Concept改头换面，成为了一部纯正的GT赛车。

en:
The unbeatable group C car marked the return of the Mercedes-Benz Works racing team.

The C9 was a Group C race car developed by Switzerland’s Sauber. Having supplied engines in earlier efforts, Mercedes officially brought Sauber under its factory racing umbrella in 1988. By 1989, the C9 appeared in a striking all-silver livery, evoking memories of the legendary Silver Arrows. In a stunning performance at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, car No. 63 claimed victory, followed by No. 61 in 2nd place and No. 62 in 5th.
zh:
战无不胜的C组别赛车，重返赛场的Mercedes车队令人敬畏不已。

C9是瑞士车厂Sauber开发的C组别赛车。在与这家车厂进行引擎供应合作多年后，Mercedes在1988年开始雇佣Sauber担任他们的原厂车队。在1989年，这款车以纯银色车身的涂装亮相，也唤醒了车迷们对“银箭传奇”的回忆。在勒芒24小时耐力赛上，这款车取得了震撼全场的成绩。其中63号赛车夺得了冠军，61号则屈居第二，而62号也跻身前五。

en:
This attractive coupe possessed the sharp cornering ability of a full-fledged sports car.

A Gran Turismo Original, Volkswagen’s sleek Scirocco sports coupe has been reimagined to meet Gr.4 race standards. Its aerodynamic enhancements are subtle—a modest front splitter and a compact rear wing—underscoring a focus on preserving the strengths of the base model. The result is a front-wheel-drive machine with remarkable cornering prowess.
zh:
堪称完成体的运动双门跑车，过弯干净利落。

对Volkswagen那独具风格的Scirocco跑车进行Gr.4规格改装，便得到了这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。在空气动力学方面，它采用了相对低调保守的设计，只安装了小尺寸的前定风翼和尾翼。但这辆车的开发重心是发挥基础车型的高性能，并实现了远超大部分前驱车的过弯性能。

en:
This attractive coupe possesses the sharp cornering ability of a fully-fledged sports car.

The Scirocco R was a high-performance sports coupe developed from the core architecture of the Golf. Its body sat lower, with a wider track for enhanced stability, and is fitted with unique bumpers, side skirts, and a roof-mounted spoiler. Significant upgrades were made to the suspension and braking systems. Lighter than the Golf R of the same era, the Scirocco R was refined into a nimble, high-spec sports machine with a sharp, responsive edge.
zh:
堪称完成体的运动双门跑车，过弯干净利落。

Scirocco R是一款基于Golf基础组件开发的高性能运动轿跑车。车身采用低离地间隙和宽轮距设计，配备了专用保险杠、侧边包围和车顶扰流板。悬挂系统和制动系统也得到了重大升级。这款车相比同期推出的Golf R更加轻盈，被精心打造成一台“身手矫健”的高规格运动车型。

en:
This high-performance model of the seventh-generation Mustang takes its name from a legend.

The original GT350R was developed for race competition in 1965, based on the original Mustang. The 2016 Shelby GT350R was similarly based on the seventh generation Mustang, with the engine tuned to 525.6 HP. The chassis components supporting the engine performance were also upgraded, resulting in a car that was fit to go to the circuit straight from the factory.
zh:
这款7代Mustang的高性能车型被赋予了一位传奇的名字。

原版GT350R于1965年基于初代Mustang开发，专为赛道竞技而设计。2016款Shelby GT350R同样基于第七代Mustang打造，发动机调校达到533马力。为了匹配发动机性能，底盘部件也进行了升级，同样是一款可以直接开上赛道，享受风驰电掣感觉的车。

en:
A Cosworth tuned masterpiece that dominated touring car racing.

The Sierra RS Cosworth was created in 1995 by the masters at Cosworth. Originally a family car, the Sierra’s 2L inline-4 engine was fully tuned, adding a DOHC head and turbocharger, along with other chassis upgrades. The Sierra RS500 Cosworth was introduced a year later. Between 1988 and 1990, it competed in Group A category races around the world, winning several championship titles.
zh:
一辆称霸房车赛的Cosworth杰作。

Sierra RS Cosworth由Cosworth大师们于1995年打造。原本是一款家用车，但Sierra搭载的2升直列四缸发动机经过全面调校，增加了双顶置凸轮轴（DOHC）气缸盖和涡轮增压器，同时对底盘也进行了多项升级。Sierra RS500 Cosworth则于一年后问世。在1988至1990年间，它参加了全球的A组赛事，赢得了多项冠军头衔。

en:
This Nissan blended the 180SX with the appealing front end of the Silvia.

The 180SX was introduced as the liftback version of the S13 Silvia. Although it carried slightly more weight and had reduced rear-end rigidity compared to the Silvia, it quickly gained a following as aftermarket tuning parts became widely available. One of the most iconic customizations was the combination of the 180SX body with the front end of the Silvia, also known as “Sileighty.”
zh:
将180SX和Silvia糅合在一起，车迷的狂热喜爱让它得以诞生。

180SX是作为S13代Silvia的掀背版本推出的。它比Silvia更重，后部刚性也有所不足，性能上存在差距。但很快就推出了众多改装部件，以便车迷打造属于自己的个性化设定。最著名的改装之一是为180SX换装S13的前脸造型，创造出了被称为“Sileighty”的经典车型。

en:
A single-seat all-wheel-drive EV from the distinguished Czech manufacturer.

With more than 130 years of heritage, Czech manufacturer Škoda made its Gran Turismo debut with a single-seater EV producing 800kW (1071 HP). The exterior design blended styling cues from Škoda’s classic forebears with a host of advanced technologies, including independent left and right rear wings that respond to driving conditions. It also incorporates onboard distance sensors that assess the position of other vehicles.
zh:
由知名捷克制造商推出的单座全驱电动车。

作为拥有130年历史的捷克制造商，Škoda在《跑车浪漫旅》中的首款车型是一台800千瓦（1,087 PS）的单座电动赛车。外观融合了其经典前辈车型的设计元素，同时搭载了大量尖端技术，如可根据驾驶条件调节的左右独立主动后翼，以及能够判断其他车辆位置的车载距离传感器。

en:
An extraordinary Skyline that stood out in races of the 1980s

The Skyline Super Silhouette was a silhouette formula race car—built using only the basic outline of the production model—based on the sixth-generation Skyline. Its aggressive bodywork featured flared front and rear fenders and a large rear wing, and powered by a turbocharged 2.1-liter LZ20B inline-4 race engine. Between 1982 and 1984, this car secured an impressive eight victories.
zh:
一辆超凡卓绝的Skyline，在1980年代的赛事中脱颖而出

Skyline Super Silhouette是基于第6代Skyline打造的剪影方程式赛车（指一种仅保留量产车型基本轮廓的赛车）。配备了宽大的前后轮拱和大型后翼，车身内搭载着2.1升4缸涡轮增压“LZ20B”赛车引擎。这款车在1982年至1984年间斩获了8场胜利。

en:
The already aggressive-looking SLR McLaren looked even more ominous with optional 19-inch wheels.

The SLR McLaren was the production realization of the 1999 Mercedes-Benz Vision SLR concept. Its most distinctive feature was the carbon-fiber monocoque chassis, dramatically reducing weight while enhancing rigidity. Power came from a 5.5-liter SOHC V-8 equipped with a twin-screw supercharger, paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission offering sport, comfort, and manual modes.
zh:
造型更具攻击性的SLR车型，可选19寸轮毂。

SLR McLaren是1999年Mercedes-Benz Vision SLR概念车的量产版本。最显著的特点是其碳纤维单体壳车身，大幅降低了整车重量。动力单元采用5.5升V8顶置单凸轮轴引擎，配备双螺杆机械增压器，匹配5速自动变速箱，提供运动、舒适和手动三种驾驶模式。

en:
With the SLS AMG, Mercedes-Benz recreates the 300 SL for the modern era.

Unveiled at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show, this striking sports car was distinguished by its signature gull-wing doors. Beneath its all-aluminum body was a newly developed 6.3-liter V-8 engine, producing 563.1 HP and 477.4 ft-lb of torque. The 7-speed dual-clutch transmission was integrated with the rear differential, offering five selectable driving modes. Performance was formidable, with a zero-to-62.1 mph acceleration in just 3.8 seconds and a top speed of 197 mph.
zh:
体现Mercedes历史和驾驶天赋的超跑。

这款于2009年法兰克福车展亮相的车型采用了鸥翼车门。其全铝合金车身中安装了一台全新开发、能够输出571 PS/66.0 公斤力米的6.3升V8引擎。其7档双离合变速箱也与后差速器进行了统合，并提供5种可选驾驶模式。在性能方面，这辆车可以在3.8秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速，且能够达到317 公里/小时的最高时速。

en:
This race car version of Mercedes-Benz's supercar was tailored to FIA GT3 regulations.

The SLS AMG GT3 was a race machine based on the road-going SLS AMG. It retained the same fundamental powerplant as the production model. Although official output figures were never released, estimates placed it at over 591.7 HP. Entering full-scale competition in 2011, the car secured 25 victories out of the 101 races it contested that year.
zh:
Mercedes专为FIA GT3规则打造的超跑。

SLS AMG GT3是一款基于SLS AMG打造的GT3规格赛车。它与量产型号采用了相同的基础动力单元。虽然其动力指标从未正式公布，但外界估计动力输出超过了600 PS。这款车从2011年起开始全面参加比赛，在当年参加的全部101场比赛中赢下了25场。

en:
With the SLS AMG, Mercedes-Benz recreates the 300 SL for the modern era.

The SLS supercar paid tribute to Mercedes-Benz’s storied design heritage. This Gr.4 variant is a Gran Turismo Original. Fitted with a GT3-style roll cage, its long-nose, short-deck proportions echo the legendary 300SL, contributing to impressive cornering stability. Yet it’s not all about handling—the classic V-8 engine delivers formidable straight-line speed that’s equally hard to overlook.
zh:
体现Mercedes历史和驾驶天赋的超跑。

SLS超级跑车是对Mercedes历史上的经典设计的致敬。这个专为Gr.4改装的版本是一款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。它采用了GT3风格的防滚架、长车鼻和短车尾，整体车身尺寸与300SL非常近似，并且可以提供良好的过弯稳定性。当然也不要忽略了它的常规款V8引擎所能提供的直线速度。

en:
With its wide tread and low center of gravity, the "Yota-Hachi" was a capable sports car.

The Toyota Sports 800, affectionately known as the “Yota-Hachi,” was a compact sports car distinguished by its fixed B-pillar Targa-style removable roof panel. Extensive use of aluminum and acrylic throughout the body kept its weight down to just 1279 lbs. While its 750 cc engine produced a modest 44.4 HP, the car’s featherlight construction allowed it to reach a top speed of 96.3 mph—comparable to many 1.500 cc-class vehicles of its era.
zh:
被车迷爱称为“Toyota 8”的车型。宽胎搭配上较低的重心，在过弯时优势明显。

被昵称为“Yota-Hachi”的Toyota Sports 800是一款小型跑车，采用固定B柱式可拆卸车顶设计（即Targa顶）。车身大量采用铝合金和丙烯酸材质部件，将整车重量降至仅580 公斤。750 立方厘米引擎虽然仅有45 PS的功率输出，但凭借轻量化的车身，最高速度可达到155 公里/小时，这已经与当时许多1,500 立方厘米级别车型的速度相当了。

en:
This French blue Porsche wears the original livery from the 1956 24 Hours of Le Mans race.

First sold in 1954, the 550/1500RS was a racing sports car featuring a lightweight aluminum body over a steel tube frame, powered by a 4-cam flat-4 engine producing 133.1 HP. It delivered impressive results on the track, securing class victories at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in both 1954 and 1955. This particular 1500RS is especially prized, still wearing the original paint it sported during the 1956 running of Le Mans.
zh:
一辆参加过1956年Le Mans赛事的法国蓝Porsche竞技型跑车。

自1954年开始销售的550/1500RS是一款竞速跑车，采用钢管框架结构搭配铝制车身，搭载4凸轮轴水平对置4缸引擎，输出功率为135 PS。它在赛道上取得了卓越战绩，在1954年和1955年的勒芒24小时耐力赛中均获得了组别冠军。这台1500RS是一台特别珍贵的收藏，仍保留着它参加1956年勒芒24小时耐力赛时的原始涂装。

en:
The road-going racer that can handle both pleasure cruises and circuit laps.

The Radical SR3 SL was a road-legal track machine that closely resembled a scaled-down Le Mans Prototype. Among its powertrain options was a 2.0-liter Ford EcoBoost inline-4 with direct injection and a turbocharger, producing 295.9 HP and paired with a 6-speed sequential paddle-shift transmission. With a curb weight of just 1709 lbs, the SR3 SL delivered remarkable performance, launching from zero to 59.7 mph in just 3.4 seconds and reaching a top speed of 159.7 mph.
zh:
既能享受巡游乐趣、又能在赛道上奔驰的公路赛车。

Radical SR3 SL是一款外形酷似小型勒芒原型车的公路赛车。可选装Ford EcoBoost 300 PS 2升直列四缸直喷涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速序列式拨片换挡变速箱。整车重量仅775 公斤，性能数据令人震撼，静止加速至96 公里/小时仅需3.4秒，最高时速可达257 公里/小时。

carNameEn: Dodge SRT Tomahawk GTS-R Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: SRT Tomahawk GTS-R Vision Gran Turismo
en:
A lightweight racing version of the visionary near-future single-seater concept.

This was a car of the future, blending uncompromising, unrestrained performance with a striking, futuristic design. This mid-engine, all-wheel-drive single-seater featured a body constructed from advanced composite materials. The engine was a 6.98-liter V-10 producing 1,000 horsepower, supported by a pneumatic sub-system. The GTS-R was the dedicated racing variant of the Tomahawk. Drivers were equipped with a specialized racing suit designed to cope with the extraordinary G-forces this machine can generate.
zh:
一款放眼未来的近未来单座概念的轻量化赛车版本。

这辆属于未来的汽车结合了毫不妥协的理念，不加拘束的性能，以及令人惊叹的设计。它采用了中置引擎四轮驱动布局和单座的形式，其车身也采用最顶尖的复合材料打造。动力方面，它安装了一部高达1000马力的气动式附件辅助6.98升V10引擎。这辆GTS-R是来自Tomahawk的赛车版本。为了帮助车手应对驾驶这辆车时可能承受的强大重力加速度，甚至还附带了专用比赛服。

carNameEn: Dodge SRT Tomahawk S Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: SRT Tomahawk S Vision Gran Turismo
en:
Featuring more than 1000 horsepower from a V-10 and compressed air unit with near-future technology.

This was a car of the future, blending uncompromising, unrestrained performance with a striking, futuristic design. A mid-engine, 4-wheel-drive single-seater, its body was crafted from cutting-edge composite materials. The engine was a 6.98-liter V-10 producing 1,000 horsepower, supported by a pneumatic sub-system. The "S" variant represented a more grounded interpretation of the Tomahawk, designed with considerations for open-road drivability. However, unlocking its full potential demanded near-superhuman reflexes from the driver.
zh:
凭借近未来技术控制超过1000马力的V10引擎和压缩空气设备。

这辆属于未来的汽车结合了毫不妥协的理念，不加拘束的性能，以及令人惊叹的设计。它采用了中置引擎四轮驱动布局和单座的形式，其车身也采用最顶尖的复合材料打造。动力方面，它安装了一部高达1000马力的气动式附件辅助6.98升V10引擎。“S”是Tomahawk的一款更贴近现实的车款，其设计着重考虑了公路行驶的场景。不过要将这辆车推向性能极限，需要驾驶者具备近乎超人般的反应速度。

carNameEn: Dodge SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo (Gr.1)
en:
A mid-engine rear-wheel drive version of the Tomahawk for Gr.1 competition.	

A Gran Turismo Original, this Gr.1-spec version of the Dodge SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo was the result of a collaboration between Gran Turismo and Dodge. To ensure that its 700 horsepower-plus was effectively translated to the ground, the car was outfitted with aerodynamic enhancements. These included an extended front splitter, a prominent rear wing, and four canards.
zh:
一款专用于Gr.1竞赛，配备中置引擎及后轮驱动的Tomahawk。

Dodge SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo是《跑车浪漫旅》和Dodge合作开发的概念车，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是它的Gr.1规则改装版本。这辆车采用了全新的空气动力学部件，确保它超过700马力的输出能够完全施加在路面上。这些部件包括了由Dodge Design部门设计的一部拓宽前定风翼和尾翼，以及4片前翼。

carNameEn: Dodge SRT Tomahawk X Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: SRT Tomahawk X Vision Gran Turismo
en:
Power exceeding 2500 horsepower and with unrivaled handling, this machine belongs in the hands of only a chosen few.

This was a car of the future, blending uncompromising, unrestrained performance with a striking, futuristic design. A mid-engine, 4-wheel-drive single-seater, its body was crafted from cutting-edge composite materials. The engine was a 6.98-liter V-10 producing 1,000 horsepower, supported by a pneumatic sub-system. The "X" was the ultimate expression reserved only for drivers deemed capable of handling its 2465.5 HP total output.
zh:
功率超过2500马力，转弯时的重力加速度堪比喷气式战斗机。只有少数天赋异禀的赛车手才能驾驭的终极机器。

这辆属于未来的汽车结合了毫不妥协的理念，不加拘束的性能，以及令人惊叹的设计。它采用了中置引擎四轮驱动布局和单座的形式，其车身也采用最顶尖的复合材料打造。动力方面，它安装了一部高达1000马力的气动式附件辅助6.98升V10引擎。“X”是一部极致的车型，总系统功率输出提升到了2,500 PS，专为那些有资格驾驶它的人所设计。

en:
This mid-engine sports car made quite the impression on the rally world with its sharp wedge-shaped body.

In 1970, Bertone unveiled the visionary Stratos Zero. The bold, wedge-shaped concept would evolve into the production Lancia Stratos. Built on a rigid monocoque frame with lightweight fiberglass body panels, it housed a 2.4-liter DOHC V-6 engine. With its exceptionally short wheelbase and razor-sharp handling, it excelled in rally competition.
zh:
这辆中置引擎跑车以其轮廓鲜明的楔形车身在拉力赛中崭露锋芒。

Bertone于1970年发布了“Stratos Zero”概念车。这款楔形概念车后来以“Stratos”之名正式量产。车身采用刚性单体框架和玻璃纤维外板，搭载2.4升V6双顶置凸轮轴引擎。凭借短轴距带来的卓越过弯能力，它在拉力赛中表现极为出色。

en:
It's the smartphone giant’s expression of automotive innovation.

The Xiaomi SU7 Ultra was an extreme performance version of the first car from smart device maker Xiaomi, the SU7 sports sedan. The all-wheel-drive system, which used three electric motors spread across the front and rear axles, boasted a total system output of 1526.6 HP. The "V8" model motors located on the rear axle were the most powerful in any production car, able to rotate at speeds of up to 27,200 rpm. Also, extensive aerodynamic development resulted in the car being able to produce up to 628 lbs of downforce.
zh:
智能手机巨头推出的极致出行解决方案。

智能设备厂商小米进军汽车市场后推出的首款车型是小米SU7运动型轿车，小米SU7 Ultra是它的极致性能版本。该车的全轮驱动系统在前后轴布置了共三台电机，系统综合输出功率高达1,548 PS。其中布置于后轴的“V8”电机，功率输出超过所有当前量产车型，最高转速可达27,200 转每分。此外，深度的空气动力学研发使得该车能够产生285 公斤的下压力。

carNameEn: SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo
en:
Subaru's most aggressive sports car ever is potent yet civilized. 

The SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo is Subaru’s ultimate expression of a next-generation sports car, carrying forward the brand’s “VIZIV” philosophy—Vision for Innovation. Carbon materials have been used extensively throughout the body, keeping weight down to 3042 lbs. At its heart is a specially tuned horizontally-opposed 2.0-liter engine paired with high-output electric motors, delivering a combined output of 591.7 HP and a peak torque of 800Nm (593.1 ft-lb).
zh:
Subaru历史上最激进的跑车，但依然易于操纵，驾驶充满乐趣。

“SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo”是Subaru旗下最终极的跑车，延续了他们对“VIZIV”——即“创新的愿景”——这一概念的坚持。这款车全车采用了碳纤维材料，仅重1,380 公斤。在一部特殊调校的2升水平对置引擎和高功率电机的驱动下，这套动力系统总共能够输出最大600 PS的动力，而最大扭矩也达到了800牛米（82.0 公斤力米）。

en:
This variant of the Supra was a homologation model with special equipment for Group A racing.

Originally introduced as a variant of the Celica, the XX evolved into a standalone model in February 1986 with the debut of the Supra. Among its various trim levels, the most celebrated was the high-performance 3.0GT Turbo A—built for championship homologation—featuring the turbocharged 3.0-liter 7M-GTEU engine, producing 266.3 HP. It also featured a wider body, matching the North American specification at 68.7 inches, along with reinforced suspension.
zh:
获得认证的车型，具备A组别标准的特殊设备。

XX起初只是Celica的一个改款，后来在1986年2月独立成一个车型，并获得了Supra的名号。在所有不同档次型号之中，人气最高的就是高性能的3.0GT Turbo A。这个型号是专为参加锦标赛而生产的认证车型，采用了一台270 PS的7M-GTEU 3升涡轮增压引擎。此外，它还采用了与北美规格车型相同的1,745毫米宽车身，外加一套加强型悬挂。

en:
Toyota's flagship FR sports car returned after a 17-year absence with a completely new look.

The Toyota Supra made its long-awaited return in 2019, following its discontinuation in 2002. The new model retained an inline-6 engine and rear-wheel-drive layout, embodying the essence of a pure sports car. It featured an ideal 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution and a low center of gravity, delivering superb balance and driving dynamics. A twin-scroll turbocharger ensured strong, responsive acceleration, while its wide stance and short wheelbase contributed to nimble, agile handling, making it a truly compelling performance machine.
zh:
丰田的旗舰版前置后驱跑车在缺席17年后再次回归，底盘变得更宽更短。

Toyota Supra在2002年停产后，于2019年重新回归。新一代Supra延续了前代的直列六缸引擎和后轮驱动布局，追求纯粹跑车的理想境界。它拥有理想的车身平衡，前后50:50的重量分布和低重心设计。双涡流涡轮增压器带来出色加速性能，宽体车身和短轴距成就敏捷操控，组合之后极具吸引力。

en:
The 2020 Supra possessed a significant power boost compared to the past model. 

The Toyota Supra made its long-awaited return in 2019, following its discontinuation in 2002. The new model retained an inline-6 engine and rear-wheel-drive layout, embodying the essence of a pure sports car. It featured an ideal 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution and a low center of gravity, delivering superb balance and driving dynamics. A twin-scroll turbocharger ensured strong, responsive acceleration, while its wide stance and short wheelbase contributed to nimble, agile handling, making it a truly compelling performance machine.
zh:
这辆2020款Supra的3升涡轮引擎经过了大幅的动力提升。

Toyota Supra在2002年停产后，于2019年重新回归。新一代Supra延续了前代的直列六缸引擎和后轮驱动布局，追求纯粹跑车的理想境界。它拥有理想的车身平衡，前后50:50的重量分布和低重心设计。双涡流涡轮增压器带来出色加速性能，宽体车身和短轴距成就敏捷操控，组合之后极具吸引力。

en:
This Supra was all business, equipped with a 6-speed gearbox and Bilstein suspension.

In May 1993, the Toyota Supra was reborn, shedding its long-nose silhouette in favor of a bold, muscular new design. At the heart of the twin-turbo 3.0-liter DOHC model was the legendary 2JZ engine, delivering 276.1 HP. The highest-grade variant came equipped with a 6-speed manual transmission and Bilstein suspension. Structural reinforcements, along with carefully tuned dampers and bushings, transformed the car into a refined high-performance machine.
zh:
6速变速箱和Blistein悬挂，让Supra更上层楼。

1993年5月，Toyota Supra重获新生，摒弃了传统的长车鼻设计，换上了更具魅力的肌肉形态。这个车型采用了著名的2JZ 3升双顶置凸轮轴双涡轮增压引擎，能够输出280 PS的动力。而最高档车型还搭载了一套六速手动变速箱和Bilstein悬挂。此外它还获得了结构强化，并对避震器和衬套进行了调校，让这只桀骜的野兽更易驯服。

en:
This Gr.3 Vision Gran Turismo possesses Suzuki's racing spirit.

The SUZUKI Vision Gran Turismo harnesses the cutting-edge engine technology of the renowned Hayabusa sports bike, paired with advanced electrification and weight-saving innovations. Its powertrain combines the 1,340 cm³ (1340 cc) Hayabusa engine with three high-output electric motors in an all-wheel-drive layout. Together, they deliver a total system output of 426 HP at 9700 rpm, making this compact machine a true super sports car.
zh:
这辆Gr.3 Vision Gran Turismo充满了Suzuki的不屈斗争精神。

SUZUKI Vision Gran Turismo采用“隼”运动摩托车的最新引擎技术，结合最新的电动化和轻量化技术。动力系统采用“隼”的1,340 立方厘米引擎搭配3个高出力电机，组成全轮驱动配置。引擎与电机结合在9,700 转每分时输出总动力432 PS，成就了这台紧凑型超级跑车。

en:
A super sports car combining the heart of the Hayabusa with electric motors.

The SUZUKI Vision Gran Turismo harnesses the cutting-edge engine technology of the renowned Hayabusa sports bike, paired with advanced electrification and weight-saving innovations. Its powertrain combines the 1,340 cm³ (1340 cc) Hayabusa engine with three high-output electric motors in an all-wheel-drive layout. Together, they deliver a total system output of 426 HP at 9700 rpm, making this compact machine a true super sports car.
zh:
用一颗Hayabusa的心脏加上多台电机综合打造的超级跑车。

SUZUKI Vision Gran Turismo采用“隼”运动摩托车的最新引擎技术，结合最新的电动化和轻量化技术。动力系统采用“隼”的1,340 立方厘米引擎搭配3个高出力电机，组成全轮驱动配置。引擎与电机结合在9,700 转每分时输出总动力432 PS，成就了这台紧凑型超级跑车。

en:
Suzuki's fun-to-drive Swift Sport was made even more lively with a high-revving engine and close-ratio gears.

The Suzuki Swift Sport was the performance-focused variant of the second-generation Swift. At its heart was a naturally-aspirated 1.6-liter engine, tuned for high-revs and equipped with forged pistons and variable valve timing. A minor update in 2007 raised the rev limit from 7000 rpm to 7500 rpm. Paired with a close-ratio 5-speed manual gearbox, it delivered an exhilarating driving experience.
zh:
改良版Swift Sport，拥有密齿轮比和高转速引擎。

Suzuki Swift Sport是基于第二代Swift开发的一款跑车型号。它的自然进气1.6升引擎针对高转速进行过特别调校，还采用了锻造活塞和可变气门正时技术。2007年，它又得到了小幅加强，将转速上限从7000转提升到了7500转，外加一套密齿轮比5速手动变速箱，能够提供更令人愉悦的驾驶体验。

en:
Superb handling was just one of the fortes of this high-performance Japanese hatchback. 

The Swift Sport was the high-performance variant of the fourth-generation Suzuki Swift, launched in 2016. Its aerodynamic body concealed a downsized turbocharged 1.4-liter engine, specially tuned to run on high-octane fuel. The suspension received dedicated tuning to sharpen handling. Notably, this iteration was 154 lbs lighter than its predecessor, contributing to its agility and dynamic driving feel.
zh:
这款纯粹的日系性能小钢炮展现出远超以往的操控性。

Swift Sport是2016年推出的第4代Suzuki Swift运动版本。追求空动效应的流畅车身搭载经过调校的1.4升小排量涡轮增压引擎，采用高辛烷值燃料。悬挂系统也经过特别调校以提升操控性能。值得注意的是，这款车型比上一代Swift Sport减重70 公斤。

carNameEn: Suzuki Swift Sport KATANA Edition Gr.4
en:
A tuned up Gr. 4 version of the Swift Sport based on the 'KATANA Edition'.

This is the Gr.4 version of the KATANA Edition concept, a fusion of the ZC33 Swift Sport and the striking style and performance of the iconic KATANA sports bike. Enhancements include an extended front under spoiler and the addition of a GT-style rear wing, With staggered tire sizing, interior weight reduction, and the installation of a roll cage, the machine has been transformed into a true Gran Turismo Gr.4-spec race car.
zh:
基于Swift Sport KATANA版调校的Gr.4级别赛车。

这是“KATANA Edition”概念车型的Gr.4版本，融合了ZC33 Swift Sport与KATANA运动摩托车的美感和力量。前置底部扰流器经过延长设计，并新增GT风格尾翼。配合大尺寸轮胎、内饰轻量化和防滚架，这款车成功蜕变为Gran Turismo Gr.4规格赛车。

en:
With a total system voltage of 800V, this fully electric sedan boasts both comfort and remarkable performance.

The Taycan marked Porsche’s first fully electric sports sedan. Equipped with electric motors on the front and rear axles, its advanced all-wheel-drive system was paired with a 2-speed transmission, delivering blistering acceleration and top-end performance. The overboost-equipped Turbo S variant produced 560 kW (750.5 HP). Notably, the Taycan was the first mass-produced vehicle to feature an 800V electrical system, enhancing both powertrain efficiency and reducing charging times.
zh:
这辆全电动轿车搭载800伏超级快速充电系统，不仅乘坐舒适，更拥有难以置信的性能。

Taycan是Porsche首款纯电动运动轿车。四驱系统在前后轴分别配备电机，搭配2速变速箱，实现了惊人的加速性能和极速表现。配备超级增压功能的Turbo S版本可输出560千瓦（761 PS）。它采用量产车中首创的800V电气系统，在动力单元效率和充电时间方面均具优势。

en:
A best-seller from the company that changed the EV market forever.

The Tesla Model 3 is a compact battery-electric sedan. At the top of the lineup sat the Performance Dual Motor AWD variant, capable of accelerating from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.3 seconds and reaching a top speed of 162.2 mph. Under WLTP testing—the global standard for electric and fuel efficiency—it offered an impressive maximum range of 339.9 miles. In 2023, it received its first major update, introducing refinements to the front fascia, overall length, and interior controls.
zh:
彻底改变了电动汽车行业的企业所推出的销冠产品。

Tesla Model 3是一款紧凑型纯电动轿车。车系中最强悍的车型是Performance Dual Motor AWD版本，0-100 公里/小时加速时间仅需3.3秒，最高时速可达261 公里/小时。在WLTP测试（电力和燃油效率国际标准）下，这款车的最大续航里程达到547 公里。2023年，它迎来了首次重大更新，前脸造型、车身长度和控制系统均有所改变。

en:
A stylish 5-door sedan introduced by Tesla, the pioneer of electric cars.

This vehicle marked Tesla’s second production model, following the Roadster. Its spacious sedan form incorporated a rear hatch, classifying it as a 5-door. Buyers could choose from three distinct battery capacities, each aligned with a specific price tier. At the top of the range, the Signature Performance variant delivered 410.3 HP and 441.2 ft-lb of torque, firmly placing it in supercar territory.
zh:
由电动汽车的先锋企业特斯拉打造的别具一格的5门轿车。

这是电动车巨头Tesla继Roadster之后推出的第二款车。它采用了大尺寸轿车车身和掀背式后备箱，成为一款五门车型。根据不同的价位，消费者还可以选择三种不同的电池容量。其中最高档的高性能签名版能够输出416 PS/61.0 公斤力米的动力，使其足以跻身超级跑车的行列。

en:
This historic Ferrari flagship impressed all with its vivid design.

Unveiled in 1984, the Testarossa stood as Ferrari’s flagship mid-engine masterpiece. Its heart was a 5.0-liter 180-degree V-12, delivering a maximum output of 384.6 HP and torque of 361.6 ft-lb. Acceleration from zero to 62.1 mph took just 5.8 seconds, with the car ultimately achieving a top speed of 180.2 mph. With its sculpted form—defined by signature 5-fin strakes and rear fenders that flared boldly from the tight cockpit—the Testarossa captivated a new generation of enthusiasts.
zh:
这款历史悠久的Ferrari旗舰车型以其出格而细致的设计令车迷们惊叹不已。

1984年亮相的Testarossa是Ferrari的旗舰中置引擎车型。引擎为平卧放置的5升V12引擎，最大动力高达390 PS，峰值扭矩50.0 公斤力米。0-100 公里/小时加速时间为5.8秒，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。这款车拥有艺术化的优雅车身设计，采用标志性的5片式侧边条翼和从紧凑座舱异军突起的后挡泥板，赢得了全新一代车迷的青睐。

en:
The "Nürburgring Meister" in the form of the Toyota 86.

Available exclusively through online orders beginning in January 2016, the 86 GRMN was a fully tuned machine crafted by Toyota, based on its beloved 86 sports car. Beyond structural enhancements, its center of gravity was further lowered through the extensive use of lightweight materials. A host of additional refinements were made—not only was power output increased, but the car also received a newly developed close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission, upgraded brakes, and staggered tire sizing between the front and rear.
zh:
纽博格林赛道大师，终极版Toyota 86。

86 GRMN于2016年1月开始发售，且仅提供网络渠道的预订。这款车是以Toyota备受欢迎的“86”跑车为原型，经过完整调校而诞生的车型。除了进行结构强化之外，这款车还通过采用轻量化材料，将整体重心降低。此外它还接受了一系列其他改装。首先增强的自然是它的动力，同时还换用了一套全新的密齿轮比6速手动变速箱，就连刹车也得到提升，前后轮也使用了不同尺寸的轮胎。

en:
This is a Gran Turismo original version of the Toyota 86 FR sports car modified for Gr.4.

A Gran Turismo Original, this version of Toyota’s new sports car, the 86, has been specially modified to comply with Gr.4 racing regulations. While the 86 had already seen action in clubman-level motorsports across the globe, this iteration transforms it into a true race machine, with its power output raised to 364 horsepower. It excels through corners, where its lightweight and compact body can be fully exploited to deliver exceptional handling.
zh:
Toyota 86前置后驱跑车的跑车浪漫旅原创版本，专为Gr.4而改装。

“86”是Toyota的新一代标准跑车，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是针对Gr.4规则开发的改装版本。虽然86本身就已经在全世界范围内参加各种爱好者赛事，但这个版本却将其升级成了一款真正的赛车，就连动力输出都提升到了364马力。这部赛车以弯道见长，它能在过弯时将自己轻量化紧凑车身的优势发挥到最大。

en:
The rebirth of the AE86, Toyota creates an exciting 21st-century version of the ideal sports car.

The Toyota 86 represents Toyota’s take on the compact, front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car co-developed with Subaru. Its front-mid-engine-mounted, naturally-aspirated 2.0-liter DOHC boxer engine produced 197.2 HP and 144.7 ft-lb of torque. Many components were freshly designed specifically for this model, resulting in precise, responsive handling that made the driver feel truly connected to the car. It was a next-generation lightweight sports car, created with driving enthusiasts at its core.
zh:
新一代的86，21世纪前置后驱紧凑车型理念的发扬光大者。

Toyota 86是与Subaru联合开发的Toyota版紧凑型前置后驱跑车。它的前中置自然进气2升双顶置凸轮轴水平对置引擎能够输出200 PS/20.0 公斤力米的动力。团队为这款车设计和开发了许多新的部件，最终实现的效果就是让车手感觉和汽车合二为一。这是一辆真正将车迷们放在第一位的新一代轻量化跑车。

en:
The "classic" Toyota 86 sports car takes on a more mature character.

Released in 2012, the Toyota 86 was a sports car that combined a compact body with a rear-wheel-drive layout. The first minor update came in 2016, enhancing body rigidity and aerodynamics. Models equipped with the 6-speed manual transmission received engine retuning along with upgrades to numerous components, placing greater emphasis on performance rather than appearance. The GT Limited trim represented the highest grade in the 86 lineup. Its interior featured upscale materials such as leather and Alcantara, offering a more premium and mature cabin environment.
zh:
和Subaru联合研发的前置后驱跑车，有着较低的重心和极佳的前后配重比。

2012年发布的Toyota 86是一款采用紧凑车身和后轮驱动布局的跑车。2016年首次小改款提升了车身刚性和空气动力学性能。6速手动版本还进行了引擎调校和多项部件改进，注重性能提升胜过外观变化。这款“GT Limited”是86车系中的最高等级版本。内饰采用皮革和Alcantara等高品质材料，营造更加成熟的整体氛围。

en:
This off-road version of Toyota's 86 was modified for Gr.B competition.

A Gran Turismo Original, this version of Toyota’s new sports car, the 86, has been specially modified to comply with Gr.B racing regulations. The car has been transformed into a top-class rally machine, with its original rear-wheel-drive layout converted to 4-wheel drive, while aggressive aerodynamic elements such as canards and a two-level rear wing generated substantial downforce.
zh:
Toyota 86前置后驱跑车的越野版本，专为Gr.B而改装。

“86”是Toyota的新一代标准跑车，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是针对Gr.B规则开发的改装版本。这个版本将基础车型的后轮驱动布局改为了四轮驱动，还加上了能够产生强劲下压力的前翼和二段式尾翼，让它脱胎换骨，成为一辆顶级的拉力赛车。

en:
The FT-1 design concept transformed into a pure race car.

This Gran Turismo Original is a Gr.3 specification version of Toyota’s next-generation racing concept, the FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo. The base FT-1 has been outfitted with wide fenders, a prominent rear wing, and a front splitter, transforming it into a cutting-edge race car.
zh:
FT-1概念设计升级，化身纯粹运动赛车。

FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo是Toyota的新一代概念赛车，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是针对Gr.3规则开发的改装版本。以FT-1为基础原型，这个版本安装了加宽的挡泥板、大尺寸尾翼和前定风翼，将其转化成了一辆拥有顶级性能的赛车。

en:
The FT-1 design concept transformed into a pure race car.

The FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo itself was a racing adaptation of Toyota’s FT-1 sports design concept, developed by CALTY Design Research, the company’s North American design studio. The design drew heavily from data and practical experience, featuring oversized fenders, an expanded front air intake, a large rear wing, and aggressive front canards.
zh:
FT-1概念设计升级，化身纯粹运动赛车。

FT-1是由Toyota北美设计中心CALTY DESIGN打造的一款设计概念跑车，而这辆FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo则是前者的赛车版本。这款车的设计大量运用了团队积累的数据和经验，外观上采用了超大尺寸挡泥板、扩大的进气口、大尺寸尾翼以及前翼。

en:
The tossable nature of this original hatchback 86 more than compensated for its lack of structural rigidity.

In 1983, the Corolla and Sprinter lines largely transitioned to a front-wheel-drive layout, with the sole exception being the rear-wheel-drive AE86 variant—the Corolla Levin and Sprinter Trueno—affectionately known as the "Hachi-Roku." It was offered as a 3-door hatchback and a 2-door notchback coupe. Power came from a newly developed 1.6-liter DOHC 4A-GEU inline-4. While several rivals featured similar specifications, the Hachi-Roku continued to win over driving enthusiasts with its playful, rewarding handling.
zh:
原版86掀背车，车身刚性欠缺的问题在怀旧面前就不再是问题了。

Corolla/Sprinter在1983年大部分改为前轮驱动布局，唯一例外是后轮驱动的AE86型Corolla Levin/Sprinter Trueno，也就是俗称的“Hachi-Roku”（86）。车身提供3门掀背和2门三厢斜背车两种版本。引擎为新开发的1.6升4A-GEU直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴型。虽然竞争对手也推出了相似规格的车型，但86至今仍因其趣味十足的操控体验而深受汽车爱好者喜爱。

carNameEn: Toyota Trueno 3door 1600GT APEX (AE86 Shuichi Shigeno Version)
sourceName: Sprinter Trueno 3door 1600GT APEX (AE86 Shuichi Shigeno Version) '00
en:
This modified 86 was built to order for the author of the "Initial D" comic books.

This car was the Trueno owned by Shuichi Shigeno, the creator of the acclaimed manga "Initial D," which prominently featured the "Hachi-Roku" AE86 Levin and Trueno models. Fitted with an HKS exhaust manifold and a Trust silencer, its engine was tuned to produce 207.1 HP. A TRD suspension kit was also installed, enabling agile handling and high cornering speeds.
zh:
调校版86，专为《头文字D》作者量身定制。

这台车是人气漫画《头文字D》作者重野秀一所拥有的Trueno，该漫画对“Hachi-Roku”，即AE86型Levin/Trueno有很多描绘。该车加装了HKS排气歧管和Trust消音器，使引擎输出动力提升至210 PS。此外还配备了TRD悬挂套件，实现了敏捷的车身动态和高速过弯能力。

en:
The revolutionary hybrid-powered racing prototype that waged war at Le Mans and the WEC.

The TS030 Hybrid was developed to compete in the 2012 World Endurance Championship. Its THS-R powertrain was the result of a collaborative effort between Toyota’s production hybrid engineers and the motorsports division at the Higashi-Fuji Technical Center, built around a newly designed V-8 engine. Although it was forced to retire during its debut at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the car went on to claim three victories over the season, ultimately securing 2nd place in the championship standings.
zh:
参加勒芒24小时耐力赛和WEC的原型赛车，采用混动系统。

这辆TS030 Hybrid是专为参加2012世界耐力锦标赛所开发。它的“THS-R”动力系统由Toyota的量产混动开发团队与东富士技术中心的赛车运动部门合作打造，采用了一部全新设计的V8引擎。在参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的首秀中，这辆车不幸被迫退赛。但在接下来的整个赛季里，它夺得了3场胜利，并最终在排行榜上位列第二。

en:
Toyota's hybrid LMP1 car was developed to dominate the World Endurance Championship.

The TS050 - Hybrid was developed for competition in the 2016 World Endurance Championship. It featured motor generator units (MGUs) on both the front and rear axles, paired with a V-6 direct-injection twin-turbocharged engine. The combined output of the engine and electric motors reached 986.2 HP. While the car showed strong potential as a title contender, it ultimately finished 3rd in the drivers’ standings. It also secured 3rd place in the manufacturers’ rankings.
zh:
Toyota的混合动力LMP1车型，专为在世界耐力锦标赛中夺冠而设计。

这辆TS050 - Hybrid 是专为参加2016世界耐力锦标赛所开发。这辆车安装有一部V6直喷双涡轮增压引擎，前后轴上还安装了电机发电机单元。引擎和电机的总动力输出达到了1,000 PS。这辆车来势汹汹，似乎对车手冠军头衔志在必得，但最终只在排行榜上屈居第三。而在车厂排行上，这款车也以第三名的成绩收官。

en:
With its ground-breaking exterior design, this agile coupe took the sports car world by storm.

The Audi TT was a sports coupe introduced in 1998. The base model came equipped with the same 177.5 HP turbocharged 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4 found in the Audi A3 and A4, while higher trims featured more powerful versions of the same powerplant. In 2003, the 3.2 quattro variant joined the lineup, powered by a 3.2-liter V-6 engine producing 246.5 HP. It was paired with Audi’s next-generation two-pedal manual, the DSG (Direct Shift Gearbox), offering lightning-fast gear changes.
zh:
绝无仅有的未来风格设计让这款运动双门跑车吸引到了老中青车迷的目光。 

Audi TT是1998年发布的运动型轿跑车。基础版搭载与Audi A3和A4相同的180 PS 1.8升直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压引擎，高级版本则采用同款引擎的高调校版本。2003年，3.2 quattro加入车系，搭载输出250 PS的3.2升V6引擎。匹配新一代双踏板手动“DSG”（直接换挡变速箱）变速箱。

en:
These TTs were produced specifically for the "Audi Sport TT Cup" one-make race.

This racing machine was based on the Audi TT and developed specifically for the Audi Sport TT Cup one-make series. Sections of the body shell were replaced with carbon fiber, and all driver comforts were stripped away, reducing the car’s weight to just 2480 lbs. It was powered by a 305.7 HP 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine, the same unit found in the standard TTS, but enhanced with a "push to pass" system that temporarily boosted output by an additional 29.6 HP.
zh:
这些TT跑车是专为“Audi Sport TT杯”单一车种赛而生产的。

这是一款基于Audi TT，专为参加“Audi Sport TT杯”单一车种赛而生产的赛车。其车身材料部分换用了碳纤维，所有的舒适性内饰也都被拆除，从而将车重降低到了1,125 公斤。其动力系统与常规版本的TTS相同，采用了一部310 PS的2升4缸引擎，但加入了一个“按键超车”功能，可以让其在短时间内将动力输出再提升30 PS。

en:
A high-performance model, aggressively evolved from the TT.

The TTS was the high-performance variant of the TT series, introduced in 2008. Its powertrain featured a 2.0-liter direct-injection turbocharged engine paired with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed S-Tronic transmission. The engine block, pistons, and connecting rods were uniquely developed for the TTS, and the turbocharger was upgraded to handle the increased output. Power was delivered through Audi’s proprietary full-time 4-wheel-drive system, enabling a zero-62.1 mph acceleration time of 5.2 seconds with the S-Tronic model, and 5.4 seconds with the manual.
zh:
代表更高性能的车型，相比师出同门的TT，性能突飞猛进。

TTS是2008年首次亮相的TT系列中的高性能版本。动力系统采用2升直喷涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速手动或6速S-Tronic变速箱。引擎缸体、活塞和连杆均为TTS专用设计，涡轮增压器也经过升级以承受更大动力输出。传动系统采用Audi专有的全时四驱系统，S-Tronic版本0-100 公里/小时加速时间为5.2秒，手动版本为5.4秒。

en:
With more power, the sporty version of the third-gen TT took a good thing and made it even better.

The third-generation TT made its debut in 2014. While it retained the core design philosophy of its predecessors, it adopted a more aggressive look, highlighted by a larger single-frame grille and headlights inspired by the R8. At the top of the range sat the TTS, the flagship sports variant, equipped with a 2.0 TFSI turbocharged 4-cylinder engine tuned to produce 309.7 HP and 274.9 ft-lb of torque in the German domestic model. Paired with a 6-speed manual transmission and Audi’s quattro all-wheel-drive system, it delivered a truly exhilarating driving experience.
zh:
简洁又不乏动力。第三代TT的跑车级别车型。

第三代TT于2014年公布。尽管其整体设计概念与前两代并无不同，但这款新车的外观采用了更大尺寸的单体框架格栅和R8风格的头灯，呈现出更凶猛的面貌。TTS是整个产品线中最高档的跑车型号，配备了一部4缸涡轮增压2.0 TFSI引擎，而德国本土型号还进行了精细调校，将动力输出提升到了314 PS/38.0 公斤力米。再加上连接到Quattro系统的6速手动变速箱，提供令人不可置信的驾驶体验。

en:
Toyota's large pickup was equipped with a unique suspension system to maximize its sporting performance.

The Tundra was a full-size pickup truck developed by Toyota specifically for the North American market. Introduced in 2015, the TRD Pro variant featured a 5.7-liter V-8 and was specially tuned by Toyota’s motorsports division, TRD. Its suspension was refined with the addition of Fox dampers, while a newly designed hood scoop and BBS wheels enhanced its aggressive appearance.
zh:
Toyota的全尺寸皮卡使用了独特的悬挂系统和配件，可最大程度发挥运动性能。

Tundra是Toyota专为北美市场开发的全尺寸皮卡。2015年推出的TRD Pro是由Toyota赛车运动部门TRD调校的5.7升V8四驱版本。悬挂系统经过调校并配备Fox减震器，新设计的引擎盖进气口和BBS轮毂打造出更加运动化的外观。

en:
This unique machine offers a classic sports car feel to enthusiast drivers of today.

Introduced in 2000 by British sports car manufacturer TVR, this two-door coupe featured a detachable roof and a distinctive exterior design that blended bold curves with aggressive lines. Power came from TVR’s in-house developed 4.0L inline-6, known as the Speed 6, which produced 359 HP. With a lightweight body tipping the scales at just 2425 lbs, the car delivered truly staggering performance.
zh:
独特的双门跑车，在今天又重现了经典跑车的观感。

这款双门轿跑由跑车制造商TVR于2000年推出，采用了活动式顶篷和有趣而又犀利的曲线外观设计。它配备了一款内部团队开发、被称为“Speed 6”的4升直列6缸引擎，能够输出365 PS的动力，而车重也仅有1,100 公斤，具备不可思议的性能素质。

en:
Practical yet cute. A breath of fresh air for the A-segment.

The Twingo became known for its 3-door monospace design, with a near-continuous curve flowing from the truncated hood, over the roof and into the rear. The wheels were positioned at the extreme corners of the body, allowing for an unusually spacious interior despite its compact form. At launch, the engine delivered modest output, but paired with the lightweight body, it provided a lively and engaging drive in urban settings. It was also praised for bringing character to a practical vehicle, with sliding rear seats that enabled a variety of seating/cargo configurations.
zh:
实用又可爱。为A级车市场注入清新活力。

Twingo以其三门单厢式车身而闻名，其轮廓线条从短促的引擎盖开始，经车顶延伸至车尾，几乎一气呵成，流畅自然。四个车轮被极限排布在车身的四角，使其在紧凑车身尺寸下，仍然保证了超乎寻常的内部空间。虽然Twingo在问世之初所搭载的引擎，动力只是仅仅够用，但搭配轻量化的车身，足以让它轻快灵动地在都市中穿行。此外它还配备了可滑动的后排座椅，可以实现多种空间布局，这种在实用车型中添加独特功能的设计受到了好评。

en:
With maximum interior space in a small body, this cute bus was highly efficient.

Dr. Ferdinand Porsche’s Volkswagen was developed into a broad range of variants. One such version was the Sambabus, which reimagined the car as a van with generous luggage capacity. By positioning the horizontally-opposed engine at the very rear, designers were able to create a wide, low floor while preserving the vehicle’s compact footprint. This clever layout gave the model a number of advantages as a commercial vehicle, adding to its appeal and versatility.
zh:
具有露营车风格，以最小的体量实现了最大的内部空间。

由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计的Volkswagen车型推出过多种不同版本。其中一款改成了厢式货车，提供更大的行李空间，那就是Sambabus。通过将水平对置引擎安装在车尾，设计师成功地在保持紧凑车身尺寸的同时，腾出了宽敞且极低的地板空间。这一高实用性的特点给了这个车型诸多优点，使其成为了一款非常成功的商用车辆。

carNameEn: Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2  carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
en:
Both in style and substance, this car represented all that was good about sports cars in the 1960s.

This racing machine was the result of a collaborative effort between Alfa Romeo and Carrozzeria Zagato. Based on the TZ, its body shell was replaced with lightweight FRP, while the nose and roof were lowered to enhance aerodynamic performance. Under the hood, it featured the twin-ignition cylinder head from the Giulia GTA, allowing it to produce 162.7 HP and reach a top speed of 152.2 mph.
zh:
来自60年代的优美经典车型。  

这辆赛道机器是Alfa Romeo和Carrozzeria Zagato联手打造的产物。它的车身设计借鉴了经典车型TZ，但外壳换用了纤维强化塑料，为了优化空气动力学性能，还降低了车头和车顶的高度。在动力方面，它采用了一部由Giulia GTA打造的双火花塞点火引擎，能够输出165 PS的动力，最高时速更是达到了245 公里/小时。

en:
This rare electric super car broke world speed records.

Released by Yangwang, BYD’s luxury brand, the U9 is a supercar aimed at delivering the ultimate in power, technology and speed in the electric era. It uses the proprietary e⁴ platform, featuring four electric motors that produce a total system output of 960 kW, or roughly 1286 HP. It accelerates from 0-62.1 mph in 2.36 seconds. In 2025, the high-performance U9 Xtreme variant attempted to set a world speed record, reaching 308.3 mph.
zh:
这款稀有的电动超级跑车刷新了世界速度纪录。

作为比亚迪旗下豪华品牌仰望发布的车型，U9致力于在电动车时代定义性能、技术与速度的终极标杆。此车基于品牌专属的e⁴平台打造，采用四电机布局，系统综合动力输出高达960kW，即1,305 PS。全力加速下，此车仅用2.36秒即可完成0-100 公里/小时加速。2025年，U9的高性能版本U9 Xtreme对世界纪录发起挑战，并跑出了惊人的496.2 公里/小时。

en:
The benchmark for versatile, high-mobility vehicles.

The Unimog was a commercial vehicle developed and sold by Daimler Truck. First produced in 1948, it went on to become a long-running success as a highly versatile, multi-purpose machine. Introduced in 1956, the 411 series served as its successor, featuring a more powerful engine and a reinforced body structure. With three available wheelbase options and a variety of body styles, the lineup included twelve distinct models, each of which could be further customized with a wide range of attachments.
zh:
多用途高机动性作业车辆的代名词。

Unimog是由Daimler Truck制造和销售的商用车辆。1948年首次生产，作为多用途车辆成为长期畅销车型。411系列是1956年推出的后继车型，配备更强劲的引擎和更坚固的车身结构。通过提供3种轴距选择和多种车身类型，组成12款不同车型，还可通过各种附件进行进一步改装。

en:
Lamborghini's take on a high-performance exotic SUV.

Introduced in 2018, the Urus was Lamborghini’s high-performance SUV. It marked the brand’s first use of forced induction, powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 capable of accelerating from zero to 62.1 mph in 3.6 seconds, and reaching a top speed of 189.5 mph—a record at the time of its debut. Equipped with active air suspension, rear-wheel steering, and a torque vectoring system, it delivered exceptional handling and cornering capabilities uncommon in vehicles of its class.
zh:
Lamborghini对全球SUV浪潮的回应。

2018年推出的Urus是Lamborghini的超级SUV。这是Lamborghini历史上首次采用强制进气技术，搭载4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，0-100 公里/小时加速只要3.6秒，最高时速305 公里/小时，在初次亮相时便创下纪录。凭借主动空气悬挂、后轮转向和扭矩矢量系统，该车还具备卓越的操控和过弯性能。

en:
A well-balanced, high-performance car that immediately became a familiar presence on race podiums.

This was a purpose-built racing machine that began competing in GT events in 2012, continuing the proud legacy established by its predecessors, the DBR9 and DBRS9. Based on the V8 Vantage platform, it featured widened fenders and a prominent rear wing, while its weight was reduced to just 2756 lbs. The V-12 engine was tuned to deliver 591.7 HP and 513.5 ft-lb of torque, paired with an XTrac sequential transmission with paddle shifters. The car would go on to deliver exceptional performances at circuits across the globe.
zh:
平衡性良好的高性能车型，立即就成为了领奖台上的常客。

这款纯正的赛车从2012年开始参加GT赛事，延续了它的前代车型DBR9和DBRS9的辉煌纪录。这款车基于V8 Vantage的车身打造，其前挡泥板得到了拓宽，还加装了一部大尺寸尾翼，而车重也被削减到仅1,250 公斤的水平。其V12引擎经过精心调校，能够输出600 PS/71.0 公斤力米，并搭配了一套带换挡拨片的XTrac序列式变速箱。在之后的时间里，这款车在全世界范围内的各条赛道上都献上了精彩的表现。

en:
The globally successful Volvo that served as a sedan, estate and coupe.

The V40 was a 5-door hatchback positioned in the C-segment. Drawing inspiration from Volvo classics of the 1960s—such as the P1800 and 1800ES—its flowing silhouette blended cues of both a coupe and a wagon. The T5 R-Design was the sportiest model in the lineup. Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-5 producing 210.1 HP, it was paired with a sport suspension and 18-inch wheels to deliver sharp, refined handling.
zh:
身兼轿车、旅行车和双门轿车三种身份，在全球范围内取得巨大成功的Volvo车型。

V40是瞄准C级车定位的5门掀背车型。汲取Volvo 1960年代经典车型如P1800和1800ES的设计灵感，流畅的车身轮廓既可诠释为双门轿车，也可视为旅行车。T5 R-Design是该系列中最具运动性的车型。2L直列五缸涡轮增压引擎输出213 PS，运动悬挂和18英寸轮毂带来敏锐而平顺的操控体验。

en:
Aston Martin's Porsche 911 fighter: The new Vantage.

This Gran Turismo Original takes Aston Martin’s mid-range Vantage sports car and reimagines it to comply with Gr.4 race regulations. Its spirited V-8 engine delivers strong straight-line performance, while the car’s near-perfect weight distribution contributes to superb cornering dynamics, resulting in a highly capable racing machine.
zh:
无论是公路还是赛道，都能提供优异性能的表现。

这个跑车浪漫旅原创车型是Aston Martin的中档跑车“Vantage”按照Gr.4规则进行改装的版本。它配备了一台动力澎湃的V8引擎，能够提供强悍的直线速度性能和非常杰出的过弯能力，再加上高效的重量配比设计，让它成为了一款平衡性极佳的优秀赛车。

en:
Aston Martin's Porsche 911 fighter: The new Vantage.

The "Baby Aston" was developed with the goal of delivering top-tier performance. This front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car first appeared in 2005, powered by a 4.3-liter V-8 engine. In 2008, displacement was increased to 4.7 liters, resulting in improved performance across the board. The Vantage S was a special high-performance variant introduced in 2011. In addition to its uprated engine, it featured a stiffer suspension setup and a quicker steering ratio, delivering a sharper driving experience.
zh:
无论是公路还是赛道，都能提供优异性能的表现。

这辆昵称“Baby Aston”的车型旨在尽其所能提供最优秀的性能。在2005年首次亮相时，这款前置后驱跑车安装了一部4.3升V8引擎，然后在2008年，为了提升性能，引擎排量被提高到了4.7升。Vantage S是2011年推出的一款特殊高性能版本。除了高动力输出引擎之外，它还采用了更硬的悬挂和更激进的转向比，进而能够提供更敏锐的运动驾驶体验。

en:
A uniquely shaped hypercar with F1-derived aerodynamics.

The Valkyrie hypercar was the result of a collaboration between Red Bull Racing and Aston Martin. Its front wing was suspended beneath a high-nose front section, while the entire underbody functioned as an aerodynamic tunnel, generating immense downforce. Power came from a naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V-12 paired with a KERS hybrid system. With a total system output of 1139 HP, the Valkyrie delivered performance on par with top-tier racing machines.
zh:
造型独特的、采用F1空气动力学理念的终极跑车。

Valkyrie超级跑车由红牛车队和Aston Martin联合开发。前翼悬挂在高车鼻前部下方，整个车身底板设计成风道结构，可产生巨大下压力。这款车搭载6.5升自然进气V12引擎，配备KERS（动能回收系统）混合动力配置。总系统输出达到1,155 PS，在性能上接近顶级赛车水准。

en:
This lightweight cornering machine has been hailed as the finest Aston Martin ever.

The Vantage proved to be a success as a performance-focused, rear-wheel-drive sports car. The model introduced in 2017 shared much of its construction with the DB11 V8, but featured a shorter wheelbase and was approximately 265 lbs lighter. These changes earned it widespread acclaim, with many praising it as the best-handling Aston Martin to date. The engine was a Mercedes-AMG–derived twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8, capable of reaching a top speed of 195.1 mph (195 mph).
zh:
这款轻量化的弯道之王被誉为史上最出色的Aston Martin。

Vantage作为高性能后驱跑车取得了巨大成功。2017年推出的车型在结构上与DB11 V8几乎相同，但轴距更短且减重约120 公斤，因此获得好评，被誉为Aston Martin历史上过弯操控最佳的车型。引擎采用源自Mercedes-AMG的4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，最高时速可达195英里（314 公里/小时）。

en:
Lamborghini celebrated its 50th anniversary with this extremely limited-production super car.

The Veneno was a special limited-edition model created to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Lamborghini’s founding. Only three units were ever sold to the public. Based on the Aventador and sharing its chassis and powertrain, the Veneno featured an uprated engine producing 739.6 HP, while weight was reduced through enhancements such as a carbon-fiber monocoque. As a result, the Veneno was 276 lbs lighter than the Aventador, with a total weight of just 3197 lbs.
zh:
仅生产了3辆。Lamborghini 50周年纪念款。

Veneno是Lamborghini为了庆祝公司成立50周年而推出的一款特别限量版车型。这款车总共仅售出3辆。它基于Aventador开发，且采用同款底盘和动力系统，而引擎的动力输出被提升到了750 PS，此外还进行了车身减重，如采用碳纤维单体车壳等各种改进。这些改动将Veneno的车重削减到了1,450 公斤，比Aventador轻了125 公斤。

en:
With a little help from a special key, this remarkable automobile reached speeds of over 233 mph.

This car was the ultimate expression of a modern super sports machine. First unveiled at the 2005 Tokyo Motor Show, it delivered figures rarely seen even among elite supercars: 987.2 HP, a top speed of 252.9 mph, and a price tag of one million euros. Its engine was an 8.0-liter W-16 equipped with four turbochargers, paired with a 7-speed DSG transmission. To access its maximum velocity, a special key was required to activate top-speed mode, allowing the car to exceed 233 mph.
zh:
利用特殊的钥匙，令这辆令人难以置信的野兽达到375 公里/小时。

这是一台终极超跑。这辆车于2005年东京车展上首次亮相，采用了即便在超级跑车中也极其罕见的规格数值：1,001 PS的动力输出，407 公里/小时的极速性能，还有高达一百万欧元的单价。它安装了一台包含4部涡轮增压器的8升W16引擎，并连接到一部7档双离合变速箱。驾驶者还能使用一把特殊钥匙来解锁极速模式，让这辆车的最高时速来到375 公里/小时。

en:
With a little help from a special key, this remarkable automobile reached speeds of over 233 mph.

Bugatti’s Veyron supercar has been reimagined to meet Gr.4 regulations for this Gran Turismo Original. Although its power output was reduced from that of the standard model to comply with class rules, it can still hold its own against rivals with impressive straight-line speed. Its 4-wheel-drive system also provides a distinct advantage in cornering, offering exceptional stability through turns.
zh:
利用特殊的钥匙，令这辆令人难以置信的野兽达到375 公里/小时。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Bugatti Veyron超级跑车针对Gr.4组别规则进行改装的版本。尽管为了符合Gr.4规则而对基础车型的动力输出进行了削弱，但它在直线加速中依然拥有不输任何对手的实力。得益于四轮驱动布局提供的稳定性，它在弯道中也占据一定优势。

en:
A machine for private racers, carrying on the bloodline of the GTS-R.

When the third-generation Viper appeared in 2012, it was accompanied by the announcement of a racing variant—the GTS-R. From that foundation, the GT3-R was developed as a customer-focused race machine for private teams. Created through a collaboration between SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance division, and Riley Technologies, it featured significant weight reduction and a host of aerodynamic upgrades. It quickly demonstrated its competitiveness, proving its racing potential in GT events across America and around the world.
zh:
为私人赛车手打造的赛车，延续了GTS-R的血统。

当第三代Viper于2012年首次亮相时，官方还公布会推出一款赛车车型，GTS-R。而GT3-R则是基于GTS-R，专为私人车队开发的一款GT3赛车。这个车型由Chrysler的高性能车开发团队SRT和Riley Technologies联合打造，他们对车重进行了大幅削减，还添加了许多空气动力学性能强化件。这辆车在北美和全球其他地区的GT比赛中证明了自己的竞速潜力。

en:
With its monstrous levels of power and grip, this venerable machine could arguably be called America's first supercar.

This coupe was developed to fully exploit the Viper’s performance potential. While its basic structure, suspension, and V-10 engine remained largely unchanged from the RT/10 roadster, power output was increased to 449.7 HP. The addition of a fixed roof allowed the car to reach a top speed of 185 mph—approximately 183.9 mph—surpassing the roadster’s 165-mph limit. Introduced alongside it, the GTS-R race version appeared in endurance events across the globe, where it consistently demonstrated its superior capabilities.
zh:
打破束缚的车型，推动Viper跑车进入超跑领域。

这款双门轿跑的设计宗旨是为了发挥出Viper的全部潜力。它原封不动地沿用了RT/10敞篷跑车的基础架构、悬挂和V10引擎，但动力输出增强到了456 PS。但因为改为了硬顶，这款车能够跑出185英里/小时（约296 公里/小时）的最高时速，较敞篷版的165英里/小时有了较大提升。于同一时间亮相的GTS-R版本参与了全球范围内的多项耐力赛，展示了其优越的性能。

en:
This third-generation Viper is now marketed under Dodge's extreme performance SRT brand.

The third-generation Viper made its debut in 2012. A key highlight of this new model was that it was released under SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance brand. Although the V-10 engine retained its 8.4-liter displacement, numerous internal upgrades boosted output to 640 HP and 600.3 ft-lb of torque. As with previous generations, the chassis featured a steel tube frame, though torsional rigidity was improved by 50 percent. At the top of the range, the GTS offered an active suspension system.
zh:
第三代Viper，获得SRT的极限性能支持。

第三代Viper于2012年公布。这款新车型的主要亮点在于它将由Chrysler的高性能品牌SRT打造。尽管它的V10引擎依然保持8.4升的排量不变，但SRT对其内部进行了多项改良，让这部引擎能够输出649 PS/83.0 公斤力米。和前代车型相同，它采用了一套钢管空间车架，但刚性提升了50%。最高档的车型GTS还换用了主动式悬挂。

en:
The third-generation Viper boasted extreme performance that was developed by the SRT division. 

This Gran Turismo Original took Dodge’s high-performance Viper and modified it to comply with Gr.4 regulations. Its exterior features an aggressive front splitter, aerodynamic canards, and a prominent rear wing to generate substantial downforce. The result is a machine that delivered impressive straight-line speed while offering significant potential through the corners as well.
zh:
第3代Viper，继承了SRT品牌的极致优越性能。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是对Dodge的高性能跑车Viper针对Gr.4组别规则进行改装的版本。它的车身外观采用了锐气十足的前定风翼和侧翼，外加一部大尺寸尾翼，能够产生强大的下压力。这也让它在拥有卓越直线性能的同时，过弯性能也不容小觑。

en:
The much-anticipated fixed-roof version of the supercar featured better aerodynamics and lighter weight.

This coupe was introduced during the Viper’s second generation, marking the car’s continued evolution as a true sports machine. It also carried the SRT badge, a symbol shared across many of Chrysler’s high-performance offerings. With its lightweight body and an 8.3-liter V-10 producing 509.9 HP, the car possessed the performance to compete against its international rivals.
zh:
让大家望眼欲穿的全封闭车身，更加优秀的空气动力学，更轻的车重，换来真正的极速性能。

这款双门车型随Viper的第二代产品一并推出，并进化为了一辆跑车。Chrysler高性能车型通用的“SRT”徽标也出现在了它的车身上。它的轻量化车身中安装了一台517 PS的8.3升V10引擎，在与其他国际品牌的竞争车型对垒时也绝不落下风。

en:
Its cute silhouette and rear-engine layout made this car an icon in automobiledom.

Often referred to by its nicknames—most famously, the "Beetle"—the Volkswagen Type I was a rear-wheel-drive vehicle powered by an air-cooled, rear-mounted 4-cylinder engine. Produced from 1938 to 2003, it saw over 21 million units built. The Volkswagen 1200 was the official designation for the version produced between the mid-1950s and late 1960s, which featured a 1.2-liter engine.
zh:
外形可爱的后驱车，也是商用车历史上的一个里程碑。

以“甲壳虫”为世人所熟知的Volkswagen Type I是一款后轮驱动车型，它的气冷式4缸引擎也安装在车身后部。这款车的生产周期从1938年一直持续到2003年，总共生产了超过2100万辆。从二十世纪50年代中期到60年代末期生产的型号安装了一台1.2升引擎，而它的正式名称就是Volkswagen 1200。

en:
With a mere 24 units produced, this hypercar shined on the track and became an instant collector's item.

A special circuit-only model limited to 24 units, this car was developed using the knowledge and experience gained from the One-77 project. Its front mid-mounted 7.0-liter V-12 produced 799.8 HP, delivered through a transaxle for optimal weight distribution. Damping, ABS, and traction control could all be fine-tuned to suit the driver’s preferences. Each fortunate owner received full technical support from Aston Martin, along with access to a dedicated circuit driving program.
zh:
这款纯粹的终极跑车总共只生产了24辆，只为主宰赛道而生。

这是一款赛道专用的特别版限量车型，总共只生产了24辆，汇聚了One-77项目中积累来的经验。它采用了一台前中置布局的7升V12引擎，动力输出高达811 PS，并通过一套驱动桥式传动系统得到传输。驾驶者还能够按照自己的喜好对减震器、ABS和TCS进行调整。每一名有幸购入它的车主都能够获得Aston Martin的全面技术支持，甚至还能接受专门的赛道驾驶课程。

carNameEn: Volkswagen GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo
en:
The ultimate GTI; there's a reason this car's name includes "Supersport." 

The GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo draws upon the DNA of Volkswagen’s legendary GTI lineage to create a supercar that was both technically advanced and visually striking. Its body, inspired by the iconic Golf silhouette, houses a 502 HP VR6 TSI engine. With a lowered center of gravity and the extensive use of lightweight components, the car exhibits an exceptional handling experience.
zh:
超跑的性能和外形。拓展了GTI的可能。

这款“GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo”的基因继承自Volkswagen GTI发展史上的诸多传奇车型，铸就了一辆从技术上到外观上都精益求精的超级跑车。它的车身给人以经典车型Golf的熟悉感，车身内安装了一部510 PS排量的VR6 TSI引擎。轻量化部件和低重心姿态的设计提供了非常优秀的操控体验。

en:
This supercar with the GTI's DNA possesses race car-like acceleration.

This Gran Turismo Original is a Gr.3 specification version of the GTI Vision Gran Turismo, a concept born from the collaboration between Volkswagen and Gran Turismo. Significant aerodynamic enhancements were made, including an extended front splitter and an enlarged rear wing.
zh:
体验极限加速性能。具有“GTI”血统的超跑。

GTI Vision Gran Turismo是Volkswagen和《跑车浪漫旅》联合开发的车型，而这辆跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是它的Gr.3规则改装版本。设计师为它加装了大尺寸前定风翼和扩宽的尾翼，进而使下压力得到了大幅度提升。

carNameEn: Volkswagen GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo
en:
This supercar with the GTI's DNA possesses race car-like acceleration.

The GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo is a supercar that embodies the spirit and performance heritage of Volkswagen’s GTI lineage. At its heart beats a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter VR6 TSI engine, delivering 502 HP and 484.6 ft-lb of torque.
