Power is routed through a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission to all four wheels, ensuring exceptional traction and rapid acceleration.
zh:
体验极限加速性能。具有“GTI”血统的超跑。

“GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo”是一款继承了Volkswagen“GTI”经验和基因的超级跑车。它的心脏是一部3升双涡轮增压VR6 TSI引擎，能够输出510 PS/67.0 公斤力米。这股动力通过一套7档双离合传动系统输送到前后车轮，实现了无与伦比的牵引力和加速性能。

en:
A legendary F1 car that made motorsports history.

The W 196 was developed by Mercedes-Benz in anticipation of the new F1 regulations shifting to 2.5-liter engines from 1954. The W 196 R variant was specifically constructed for competition in F1. Its 2496 cc inline-8 engine produced 285 HP and was capable of reaching a top speed of 180.2 mph. The car delivered outstanding results during the 1954 and 1955 Formula One World Championships, with driver Juan Manuel Fangio securing the drivers' title in both seasons.
zh:
一款在赛车运动上名留青史的传奇F1赛车。

W 196是Mercedes-Benz针对1954年开始实施的2.5升F1新规则而开发。W 196 R是专为F1赛事而打造。2,496 立方厘米直列八缸引擎可输出290 PS的动力，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。它在1954年和1955年两届世界一级方程式锦标赛中取得了傲人成绩，助力车手胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥连续两年夺得车手总冠军。

en:
The U.S. Army-commissioned vehicle that became the forefather of the modern SUV.

The roots of the SUV category could be traced back to this compact 4-wheel-drive vehicle, developed at the request of the U.S. military in 1940. Among the prototypes submitted by Bantam, Ford, and Willys, it was the Willys MB—an improved version of the MA—that proved to be the winner, ultimately leading to the production of over 360,000 units. Its straightforward yet durable construction, featuring a ladder frame, rigid axles, and 4-wheel drive, resulted in a truly historic vehicle whose legacy has endured for generations.
zh:
它诞生于战场上，美国陆军的苛刻要求促成了现代4x4之父的诞生。

SUV车型的起源可追溯到这款1940年应美军要求开发的紧凑型四轮驱动车辆。在Bantam、Ford和Willys生产的测试车型中，Willys MB表现最佳。作为MA的升级版本，最终生产了超过36万辆。其简单坚固的结构（采用边梁式车架和刚性车轴）与四轮驱动形成完美结合，成就了一款真正具有历史意义的汽车，其精神传承至今。

en:
The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.

A Gran Turismo Original, Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan has been modified to meet Gr.3 racing regulations. To reduce the frontal cross-sectional area, the lower chassis has been trimmed and the overall ride height lowered as much as possible. Equipped with a diffuser-style front splitter and a two-level rear wing, this 4-door sedan generates more downforce than many coupes.
zh:
源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

这是一款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，它是Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.3组别规则进行改装的版本。为了缩减车身正面的横截面积，设计师减小了它的底盘下部，并尽可能地降低了车身高度。在扩散器样式前定风翼和二段式尾翼的加持下，这款4门轿车能够产生远超双门轿跑的下压力。

en:
The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.

A Gran Turismo Original, Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan has been modified to meet Gr.4 racing regulations. A front splitter and rear wing have been added to generate additional downforce. The base car’s 4-wheel-drive system is retained, giving it class-leading traction among the Gr.4 field.
zh:
源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

这是一款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，它是Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.4组别规则进行改装的版本。为了提升下压力和优化弯道性能，它加装了前定风翼和尾翼。此外它还沿用了基础车型的四轮驱动系统，在所有Gr.4车型中拥有最优秀的牵引力。

en:
This road-going version of the WRX Gr.B was modified to excel on the tarmac.

This is the homologation model of the WRX Gr.B, a variant of Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan engineered to meet Gr.B regulations. Although rooted in rally car design, greater emphasis has been placed on on-road performance, with the addition of a race-inspired front splitter, side skirt winglets, and a rear diffuser.
zh:
WRX Gr.B的公路车版本，专为在柏油公路上实现顶级性能而改装。

WRX Gr.B是对Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.B组别规则进行改装的版本，这辆车是它的赛事认证车型。虽然原型车是一台拉力赛车，开发团队却将更多工作重心放在了铺装路面驾驶性能上，添加了赛车风格的前定风翼、侧裙小翼和后扩散器。

en:
The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.

A Gran Turismo Original, Subaru’s high-performance WRX sedan has been modified to comply with Gr.B regulations. To enhance downforce and agility, the car’s track width has been significantly widened, while long-stroke suspension was fitted to improve off-road capability. The result is a cutting-edge rally machine.
zh:
源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

这是一款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，它是Subaru的高性能轿车WRX针对Gr.B组别规则进行改装的版本。为了提升下压力和机动性，其轮距得到了大幅拓宽，另外还为了优化越野性能而安装了长行程悬挂，使它成为了一款拥有顶尖水平的拉力赛车。

carNameEn: Subaru WRX STI Isle of Man Time Attack Car '16
en:
This celebrated WRX set the lap record on the holy ground of motorcycle racing, the Isle of Man.

In June 2016, a Subaru WRX STI set a new record for 4-wheeled vehicles during a time attack on the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy course. While Subaru had been competing in the event since 2011, the 2016 machine was specially prepared by Britain’s Prodrive, a team renowned for its multiple World Rally Championship titles. Thanks to their expertise, the record was lowered by nearly two minutes, with a final time of 17:35.139 and an average speed of 128.6 mph.
zh:
这辆著名的WRX曾在摩托车赛事的圣地马恩岛上创下单圈纪录。

2016年6月，一辆Subaru WRX STI在马恩岛旅行者杯大奖赛的计时赛中为四轮汽车创下新纪录。WRX STI自2011年起就参加这项赛事，2016年的冠军赛车由英国Prodrive打造，该公司曾多次夺得世界拉力锦标赛冠军。因此，他们成功将纪录缩短近2分钟至17:35.139，平均时速更是达到207 公里/小时。

en:
The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.

Introduced in the autumn of 2013, the Subaru WRX compact sedan emerged as a standalone model, separating itself from the Impreza lineup. Built on a platform closely related to that of the Levorg, the WRX featured significant structural reinforcements. The high-performance STI edition took things further, offering enhanced dynamics with newly developed suspension and a refined version of the EJ20 engine, delivering 303.7 HP and 311.0 ft-lb of torque.
zh:
源自Impreza，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

2013年秋季公布的Subaru WRX从Impreza产品线中独立出来，是一款中档轿车。WRX基于与Levorg几乎一模一样的平台打造，但进行了大范围的强化。其高功率版本STI拥有更强大的性能，采用了全新开发的悬挂和EJ20引擎的改进版本，能够输出308 PS/43.0 公斤力米。

carNameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Junior
en:
A beginner level machine for learning the basics of formula cars.

The X2014 Series was the result of a collaborative “fan car” project between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo. The entry-level X2014 Junior model combined a compact body with a similarly compact engine producing approximately 246.5 HP, making it the ideal platform for learning the fundamentals of formula driving.
zh:
入门级车型，用于熟悉方程式赛车。

X2014系列诞生于Red Bull Racing和《跑车浪漫旅》合作的一次“车迷赛车计划”。入门级的X2014 Junior采用了紧凑型车身设计，安装了一台同样较为收敛的引擎，动力输出仅为大约250 PS，使其成为了学习方程式驾驶基础的完美平台。

carNameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Standard
en:
A traditional venturi car with the axial flow fan and skirts removed from the X2014.

The X2014 Series was the result of a collaborative “fan car” project between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo. The mid-tier X2014 Standard followed as a more advanced model, developed as a conventional Venturi car. Its design minimized aerodynamic drag through front and rear wheel covers and a glass canopy, while simultaneously increasing downforce.
zh:
继承Venturi传统的车型，但加装了X2014的轴流风机和包围。

X2014系列诞生于Red Bull Racing和《跑车浪漫旅》合作的一次“车迷赛车计划”。X2014 Standard是系列中的中档型号，被开发成一款常规的文丘里效应车型。它采用了前后轮罩和玻璃顶篷，既可以降低风阻，又产生了更大的下压力。

carNameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2019 25th Anniversary
en:
This is an evolution of the X2014 created for the FIA Gran Turismo Championships.

The X2019 Competition was developed at the inception of the Gran Turismo Championship, with the goal of creating a race car that was as thrilling to watch as it was to drive. Based on the X2014 Standard, it featured revised design elements, including new front wheel styling, a reworked rear body structure, and reshaped rear wheel covers. Also, the powertrain was updated from a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine to a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter unit, and the throttle system was replaced with a more conventional mechanical setup.
zh:
X2014的演化版，专为FIA的Gran Turismo锦标赛而打造。

X2019 Competition是在Gran Turismo锦标赛创立之初开发的，旨在打造一款视觉享受和驾驶体验同等出色的赛车。它基于X2014 Standard打造，但前轮、后车身结构和后轮罩的设计美学均有所改变。此外，引擎从2升涡轮增压改为3升自然进气型，油门系统也改为传统配置。

carNameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2019 Competition
en:
This is an evolution of the X2014 created for the FIA Gran Turismo Championships.

The X2019 Competition was developed at the inception of the Gran Turismo Championship, with the goal of creating a race car that was as thrilling to watch as it was to drive. Based on the X2014 Standard, it featured revised design elements, including new front wheel styling, a reworked rear body structure, and reshaped rear wheel covers. Also, the powertrain was updated from a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine to a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter unit, and the throttle system was replaced with a more conventional mechanical setup.
zh:
X2014的演化版，专为FIA的Gran Turismo锦标赛而打造。

X2019 Competition是在Gran Turismo锦标赛创立之初开发的，旨在打造一款视觉享受和驾驶体验同等出色的赛车。它基于X2014 Standard打造，但前轮、后车身结构和后轮罩的设计美学均有所改变。此外，引擎从2升涡轮增压改为3升自然进气型，油门系统也改为传统配置。

en:
The KTM X-Bow is a unique Audi turbo-powered track car from the Austrian motorcycle manufacturer.

The X-BOW was the first sports car developed by Austrian motorcycle manufacturer KTM. Pronounced “Crossbow,” it drew inspiration from the mechanical bow weapon that shares its name. Stripped of doors and windows, this minimalist two-seater eliminated all superfluous features in pursuit of pure performance. With its precise handling, the car was capable of sustaining up to 1.5 lateral Gs through corners.
zh:
摩托车制造商KTM的第一款跑车。

X-BOW是奥地利摩托车制造商KTM开发的第一款超级跑车。这个名字的意思是“十字弩”，它的造型设计也采用了同名机械式弓弩武器的概念。这款双门跑车没有车门也没有车窗，还取消了一切不必要的功能。这辆车拥有绝佳的操控性能，在过弯时最大水平重力加速度能够达到1.5G。

en:
This very fast GT-R scored wins at Suzuki, Okayama, and Autopolis in the 2008 Super GT.

After a surprise return to competition, the Nissan GT-R made its debut in the 2008 Super GT Championship. In preparation for upcoming regulation changes, the car received a pipe frame chassis and equipped with the same 4.5-liter V-8 previously used in the Z. The XANAVI NISMO demonstrated remarkable pace from the opening round and ultimately secured the drivers’ championship title.
zh:
第一款符合新规则的GT-R，以压倒性的速度回应了车迷的期待。

在完成令人惊喜的回归后，Nissan GT-R开始参加2008赛季Super GT锦标赛。为了针对下一年的规则改动提前做好准备，这款车采用了管式框架车身，并安装了一台沿用自Z车型的4.5升V8引擎。从第一轮起，Xanavi Nismo便展现出了不可思议的实力，并一路势如破竹般拿下了车手冠军。

en:
A dream car that never came to be, this beautiful V12 mid-engine race car disappeared. 

Completed in 1966, this was Jaguar’s first mid-engine racing sports car. Its low, aerodynamic body—reminiscent of the E-type—housed a 495.1 HP 5.0-liter DOHC V-12. Although it showed great promise as a competitive circuit machine, Jaguar’s management at the time had little interest in motorsport, and the project was ultimately cancelled. Often regarded as Jaguar’s most beautiful race car, it faded into history without ever turning a wheel in competition.
zh:
从未实现的幻想，美丽的V12中置引擎赛车，已经消失在车迷的视野中。

这辆1966年推出的车型是Jaguar的一款中置引擎运动型赛车。其低矮的流线型车身与E-Type非常类似，并安装了一部502 PS动力的5升V12双顶置凸轮轴引擎。虽然这款车理应在赛道上驰骋纵横，但当时的管理层对赛车运动并不感兴趣，于是这个项目最终惨遭下马。它被称为Jaguar最美的赛车，但还没机会参与任何一场比赛便湮没在了历史的滚滚浪潮中。

en:
A road-going Group C car with breath-taking bodywork

The XJ220 was named for its record-breaking top speed, reaching 220 mph (220 mph), making it the fastest road car of its time. Production was managed by Jaguar Sport, a joint venture between Jaguar and Tom Walkinshaw Racing. It was powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V-6 derived from the XJR-11 Group C race car, mounted to a chassis constructed from aluminum honeycomb and carbon Kevlar composites. Beginning in 1993, the XJ220 also saw competition in GT racing, including entries at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
zh:
一辆车身设计令人惊艳的C组别公路车。

XJ220因创下当时最快公路车纪录而得名——达到了220英里/小时（354 公里/小时）。其生产由Tom Walkinshaw Racing与Jaguar的合资企业Jaguar Sport负责。它采用来自XJR11 Group C赛车的3.5升V6涡轮增压引擎，搭载于铝制蜂窝板和碳纤维凯夫拉复合材料制成的底盘上。从1993年起，它四处征战包括勒芒24小时耐力赛在内的多项GT赛事。

en:
This iconic race car brought Jaguar many victories, notably against turbocharged competitors.

Following its string of successes at Le Mans during the 1950s, Jaguar made a return to endurance racing in 1986 with a Group C prototype. Jaguar reached its peak in 1988 with the XJR-9. Thanks to its exceptional aerodynamics and durability, it claimed victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. That triumph secured its place in motorsports history, as Jaguar dethroned Porsche, the long-reigning champions of Le Mans.
zh:
Jaguar标志性的勒芒参赛车，打败了涡轮增压赛车。

在1950年代的勒芒取得巨大成功后，Jaguar在1986年带着一款C组别赛车再度杀回这项赛事。这辆XJR-9帮助他们在1988年登上了巅峰。它简单的构造提供了优秀的空气动力学性能和耐用性，帮助这款车在勒芒24小时耐力赛上强势夺魁。凭借一场击败勒芒的常胜冠军Porsche的胜利，它为自己在赛车历史上留下了浓墨重彩的一笔。

en:
The Gran Turismo Trophy winner, with unique asymmetric styling.

This was a masterpiece roadster crafted by legendary designer Virgil Exner in 1960. Its asymmetrical styling, hood bulge, and dramatic aero fins gave the impression of Exner’s personal interpretation of a 1950s-era race car. It was awarded the Gran Turismo Trophy in 2011.
zh:
Gran Turismo奖杯获得者，独树一帜的不对称设计风格让人眼前一亮。

由汽车设计大师维吉尔·埃克斯纳在1960年献上的一款敞篷跑车杰作。它采用非对称风格、引擎盖鼓起式进气口和气动翼面设计，成为了埃克斯纳对1950年代赛车精彩的全新演绎。这款车在2011年赢得了“Gran Turismo奖杯”。

en:
With its tidy exterior design, this 4th-gen Z car was a handsome sports car for the global market.

The fourth-generation Fairlady Z was designed for the global market, largely disregarding the size restrictions of the Japanese domestic segment. Its wider body allowed for a broader track, unlocking improved cornering capabilities. Mounted in the front was a 3.0-liter V-6, delivering 226.8 HP in the naturally-aspirated version and 276.1 HP in the twin-turbo model.
zh:
改用宽体车身之后，第四代Z成为了面向全球市场的跑车。

第四代Fairlady Z是专门针对全球市场所设计，基本上没有考虑日本国内的尺寸限制。其较宽的车身让增加轮距成为可能，也让它的过弯性能更上层楼。动力方面，它采用了一部3升V6前中置引擎，其自然进气版本可以输出230 PS，而双涡轮增压版本则可以输出280 PS。

en:
An elegant convertible with an inline-6 engine lurking under its elongated hood.

The Z4 was a convertible sports car that made its debut in 2002 as the successor to the Z3. Its design was distinguished by clean fender lines and a signature Z-shaped press line just ahead of the door. Torsional rigidity was improved by nearly threefold compared to the Z3, while overall weight was reduced by 55 lbs. It also introduced several new technologies, becoming the first BMW to feature electric power steering.
zh:
一款优雅的敞篷车。前部的长引擎盖下安装了一部直列六缸引擎。

Z4是一款敞篷跑车，于2002年首次亮相，用以取代Z3。车身以其简洁的翼子板线条和车门前方标志性的Z形冲压线而著称。与Z3相比，它的扭转刚度翻了三番，而车重却轻了25 公斤。它还搭载了众多新技术，是首款配备电动助力转向系统的BMW车型。

en:
Starting the 2011 24 Hours of Spa from the 49th position on the grid, this BMW Z4 GT3 crossed the finish line in a remarkable 2nd place.

Based on the E89-generation Z4, BMW’s GT3 race machine began competition in 2010. Weight was reduced by 661 lbs through extensive modifications, including the replacement of the retractable roof with a fixed panel. The engine was also changed to a 4.0-liter V-8. In 2011, the car was further refined with wider fenders and a larger 4.4-liter engine producing 507.9 HP. Paired with an upgraded paddle-shift transmission, this Z4 achieved a series of remarkable results in some of the world’s most fiercely contested GT races.
zh:
纽博格林赛道和斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道24小时耐力赛亚军。赛车典范，从最艰巨的战斗中脱颖而出。

这辆BMW的GT3赛车基于E89型号Z4打造，从2010年起开始参加比赛。通过将伸缩式顶篷更换为固定板件等改良，车重成功削减了300 公斤。而动力上也换用了一台4升V8引擎。到了2011年，新版本添加了更宽的挡泥板，还换用了更大排量的4.4升引擎，能够输出515 PS。再搭配升级版拨片换挡变速箱，这辆Z4在一系列竞争最为激烈的赛事中均取得了优秀的成绩。

en:
BMW's contemporary Z8 roadster has the distinction of being one of James Bond's rare non-British vehicles.

This luxury convertible sports car drew inspiration from the iconic BMW 507 of the 1950s. Its aluminum space frame housed the same 5.0-liter V-8 and 6-speed manual transmission found in the E39 M5, producing 394.5 HP and capable of accelerating from zero to 62.1 mph in just 4.7 seconds. It also earned cinematic fame as the featured Bond car in a 007 movie.
zh:
质量和性能均属顶尖的敞篷跑车，拥有“邦德座驾”的殊荣。

这款豪华敞篷跑车从上世纪五十年代的经典车型“507”中获得了大量灵感。其铝合金空间车架中容纳了E39型号M5同款的5升V8引擎和6档变速箱，能够输出400 PS的马力，并在4.7秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速。它还在一部007电影中作为邦德的爱车登场。

en:
The seventh-generation Z is a 21st century reinterpretation of the classic S30.

The production model of the seventh-generation Fairlady Z first appeared in prototype form in 2020. Eschewing electrification, Nissan opted for the VR30DDTT twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6, paired with either a 6-speed manual transmission or a 9-speed automatic with manual shift mode. At a time when the automotive industry was shifting toward self-driving technology and electrification, this car pursued the timeless allure of a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car.
zh:
第七代Z系列跑车是经典S30在21世纪的最新演绎。

第7代Fairlady Z的量产车型最初于2020年以原型车形式亮相。Nissan选择不采用电动传动系统，而是继续利用VR30DDTT 3升V6双涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速手动变速箱或带手动换挡模式的9速自动变速箱。虽然整个汽车行业都在关注自动驾驶和电动化革命，但这款车追求的却是前置引擎、后轮驱动跑车的浪漫主义。

en:
This Vision Gran Turismo machine pays tribute to the legendary manufacturer, Zagato. 

This Vision Gran Turismo was created by the famed Carrozzeria Zagato, drawing inspiration from the IsoRivolta, a grand tourer produced in the 1960s by the Italian sports-car brand ISO. It inherited the DNA of the IsoRivolta, a car with a rich motorsport history, and reimagined it through the lens of cutting-edge design and modern engineering.
zh:
对传奇汽车制造商Zagato的致敬之作。

这款Vision Gran Turismo车型由Carrozzeria Zagato打造，其设计灵感来源于跑车品牌ISO于1960年代推出的一款GT赛车——IsoRivolta。这辆车继承了在赛车运动领域身经百战的IsoRivolta的血统，并采用最新设计工艺和科技进行了全面重建。

en:
The Zonda R featured an adjustable rear wing and a sequential-shift 6-speed transmission.

This was a track-only evolution of the Zonda, unveiled in 1999. Its mid-mounted AMG V-12 delivered 739.6 HP and 520.8 ft-lb of torque. To enhance stability, both the wheelbase and track width were extended. The car was capable of reaching a top speed of 217.5 mph and could accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 2.7 seconds.
zh:
赛道专用Zonda，搭载序列室变速箱和可变尾翼。

这是1999年推出的Zonda的纯赛车版本。其中置布局的AMG V12引擎能够输出750 PS/72.0 公斤力米。此外为了提升稳定性，这款车的轴距和轮距均有扩大。该车的0-100 公里/小时成绩为2.7秒，最高速度达到350 公里/小时。

en:
Taking design cues from the Mako Shark II concept, this 3rd-gen Corvette was known for its distinctive character.

The third-generation Corvette made its debut in the fall of 1967. Heavily inspired by Chevrolet’s 1965 show car, the Mako Shark II, it introduced a bold new coupe design, characterized by its curvaceous “coke bottle” silhouette, which instantly turned heads. Initially launched simply as the Corvette, the model brought back the Stingray name in 1969, along with a larger engine that added greater versatility and performance.
zh:
第3代Corvette，出类拔萃的内饰与外形设计均传承自Mako Shark II型的设计理念。

第3代Corvette于1967年秋季首次亮相。深受Chevrolet 1965年展示车型Mako Shark II的影响，新款Corvette采用了被称为“可乐瓶”的迷人轿跑新造型。首次亮相时，这台车只是简单地被称为Corvette，但在1969年，它重新启用了Stingray的名号，并搭载有更大的引擎，让性能更加游刃有余。

en:
This mid-engine sports car set the stage for the famous Pantera.

This was De Tomaso’s second production mid-engine sports car. To address the lack of power in the earlier Vallelunga, it was fitted with a Ford V-8 engine. Weighing approximately 1.3 tons, the car could reach a top speed of 155.3 mph, thanks to its lightweight construction. The exterior, notable for its gullwing-opening rear section, was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro during his time at Carrozzeria Ghia. Production was limited to just 401 units.
zh:
这台中置引擎跑车为声名卓著的Pantera的登场铺平了道路。

De Tomaso品牌第二款量产中置引擎跑车。为解决前代Vallelunga动力孱弱的问题，该车搭载了Ford V8引擎。凭借约1.3吨的轻盈车重，最高时速可达250 公里/小时。采用鸥翼式开启后舱盖的外观设计出自乔盖托·乔治亚罗在Carrozzeria Ghia时期的手笔。全球仅生产401台。
